items.ma-4436: Aswad ibn ʿĀmir narrated to us, Abū Bakr narrated to us, from ʿĀṣim, from Abū Wāʾil, from ʿAbd Allāh, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Two must not converse privately without their companion, for that grieves him.”
items.ma-4450: Hushaym narrated to us, from Yaḥyā ibn Saʿīd, from Muḥammad ibn Yaḥyā ibn Ḥabbān, from Ibn ʿUmar, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “When you are three, two must not converse privately without the one.”
items.ma-4481: Ismāʿīl narrated to us, Ayyūb informed us, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, he said: I saw men and women performing wuḍūʾ together from one vessel in the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ.
items.ma-4507: Ismāʿīl narrated to us, Ayyūb narrated to us, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Do not travel with the Qurʾān, for I fear that the enemy will get hold of it.”
items.ma-4518: ʿAbd al-Aʿlā narrated to us, from Maʿmar, from al-Zuhrī, from Sālim, from Ibn ʿUmar, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to pray on his mount in whatever direction it turned with him.
items.ma-4556: Sufyān narrated to us, from al-Zuhrī, from Sālim, from his father, from the Prophet ﷺ: “If the wife of one of you asks his permission to go to the mosque, he must not prevent her.”
items.ma-4607: Ibn Idrīs narrated to us, ʿUbayd Allāh informed us, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, he said: In the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ we used to sleep in the mosque, taking the midday rest in it, and we were young men.
items.ma-4662: Yaḥyā ibn Saʿīd narrated to us, from ʿUbayd Allāh, Nāfiʿ informed me, from Ibn ʿUmar, that ʿUmar asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ: May one of us sleep while he is in a state of janābah? He said: “Yes, if he has performed wuḍūʾ.”
items.ma-4730: Ibn Numayr narrated to us, ʿUbayd Allāh narrated to us, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “If one of you is invited to a wedding feast, let him respond.”
items.ma-4744: Abū Dāwūd al-Ḥafarī narrated to us, from Sufyān, from Ismāʿīl, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar: that the Prophet ﷺ commanded the killing of dogs, until we killed the dog of a woman who had come from the desert.
items.ma-4963: ʿAbdah narrated to us, ʿUbayd Allāh narrated to us, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, that the Prophet ﷺ, Abū Bakr and ʿUmar used to begin with the prayer before the sermon on the ʿĪd.
items.ma-4992: Yazīd narrated to us, Hishām informed us, from Muḥammad, from Ibn ʿUmar, from the Prophet ﷺ that he said: “The Maghrib prayer is the witr of the day, so make the night prayer witr.”
items.ma-5026: Muḥammad ibn Jaʿfar narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, from Yaʿlā ibn Ḥakīm, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, that the Prophet of Allah ﷺ said: “I do not eat it, nor do I command it, nor do I forbid it.”
items.ma-5104: Muḥammad ibn ʿAbd Allāh narrated to us, ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz narrated to us, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, that he said: “The righteous dream is one part of seventy parts of prophethood.”
items.ma-5134: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān narrated to us, from Sufyān, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Dīnār, I heard Ibn ʿUmar say: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade that fruit be sold until its soundness appears.
items.ma-5170: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from ʿUbayd Allāh, Nāfiʿ informed me, from Ibn ʿUmar, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade that one travel with the Qurʾān to the land of the enemy, for fear that the enemy would get hold of it.
items.ma-5193: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from Sufyān, Ibn Dīnār narrated to me, I heard Ibn ʿUmar say: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade the muḥrim to wear a garment touched by saffron or wars.
items.ma-5286: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān narrated to us, Sulaym ibn Akhḍar narrated to us, from ʿUbayd Allāh, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ apportioned in the spoils two shares for the horse and one share for the man.
items.ma-5332: I read to ʿAbd al-Raḥmān: Mālik, from Nāfiʿ, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿUmar, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “The congregational prayer is superior to the prayer of the individual by twenty-seven degrees.”
items.ma-5425: ʿAffān narrated to us, ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz ibn Muslim narrated to us, ʿAbd Allāh ibn Dīnār narrated to us, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿUmar, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Two must not converse privately without one.”
items.ma-5465: Yazīd ibn Hārūn narrated to us, Muḥammad ibn Isḥāq informed us, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, he said: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbidding that one travel with the muṣḥaf to the land of the enemy.
items.ma-5604: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, from Wāqid ibn Muḥammad, from his father, from Ibn ʿUmar, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “Do not return after me as disbelievers, some of you striking the necks of others.”
items.ma-5654: Qurād Abū Nūḥ narrated to us, ʿUbayd Allāh ibn ʿUmar informed us, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, he said: The Prophet ﷺ said: “There is no jalab, no janab, and no shighār in Islam.”
items.ma-5921: Isḥāq narrated to us, Mālik narrated to us, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “The congregational prayer is superior to the prayer of the individual by twenty-seven degrees.”
items.ma-5932: Isḥāq narrated to us, Mālik informed us, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Dīnār, from Ibn ʿUmar, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Seek Laylat al-Qadr in the last seven [nights] of Ramaḍān.”
items.ma-6062: Yūnus narrated to us, Layth narrated to us, from Nāfiʿ, from ʿAbd Allāh, from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, he said: “None of you must make a man rise from his seat and then sit in it.”
items.ma-6083: Yūnus and Surayj narrated to us, they said: Fulayḥ narrated to us, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar: that the Prophet ﷺ joined the Maghrib and the ʿIshāʾ when he made his camel kneel on the night of ʿArafah.
items.ma-6277: Ibn Numayr and Muḥammad ibn ʿUbayd narrated to us, they said: ʿUbayd Allāh narrated to us, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Whoever carries weapons against us is not of us.”
items.ma-6289: Ibn Numayr narrated to us, ʿUbayd Allāh narrated to us, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “A woman must not travel three [days] except with one who is maḥram.”
items.ma-6535: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Hammām narrated to me, from Qatādah, from Yazīd ibn ʿAbd Allāh, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿAmr, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Whoever recites the Qurʾān in less than three [days] has not understood it.”
items.ma-6664: Sufyān narrated to us, from Yaʿqūb ibn ʿAṭāʾ and another, from ʿAmr ibn Shuʿayb, from his father, from his grandfather, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “The people of two different religions do not inherit from one another.”
items.ma-6988: Abū Nuʿaym narrated to us, Sufyān narrated to us, from Ḥabīb, from Abū al-ʿAbbās, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿAmr, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “He has not fasted who fasts for all time.”
items.ma-7132: Hushaym narrated to us, ʿUmar ibn Abī Salamah informed us, from his father, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Trim the moustaches, and let the beards grow abundant.”
items.ma-7555: Yaʿlā narrated to us, Muḥammad ibn ʿAmr narrated to us, from Abū Salamah, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Wealth is not from abundance of goods, but wealth is the wealth of the soul.”
items.ma-7752: ʿAbd al-Razzāq narrated to us, Maʿmar narrated to us, from al-Zuhrī, from Abū Salamah, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade the gourd, the muzaffat, the ḥantam, and the naqīr.
items.ma-7939: Yazīd narrated to us, al-Rabīʿ ibn Muslim informed us, from Muḥammad ibn Ziyād, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “He does not thank Allah who does not thank the people.”
items.ma-8019: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān narrated to us, al-Rabīʿ ibn Muslim narrated to us, from Muḥammad ibn Ziyād, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “He does not thank Allah who does not thank the people.”
items.ma-8107: Yaḥyā ibn Ādam narrated to us, Sharīk narrated to us, from Ibn Mawhab, from his father, from Abū Hurayrah, raising it [to the Prophet], he said: “Indeed Allah ﷿ Yuḥibbu an Yarā the trace of His blessing upon His servant.”
items.ma-8216: And the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Whichever village you come to and stay in, your share is in it; and whichever village disobeys Allah and His Messenger, its khumus is for Allah and His Messenger, then it is for you.”
items.ma-8338: ʿAbd al-Ṣamad narrated to us, Ḥammād narrated to us, from Muḥammad ibn ʿAmr, from Abū Salamah, from Abū Hurayrah, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “The two sons of al-ʿĀṣ are believers.”
items.ma-8339: ʿAbd al-Ṣamad narrated to us, Ḥammād narrated to us, from Suhayl, from his father, from Abū Hurayrah, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “If one of you fights his brother, let him avoid the face.”
items.ma-8438: Yaḥyā ibn Ādam narrated to us, Quṭbah narrated to us, from al-Aʿmash, from Abū Ṣāliḥ, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “You will find among the worst of people with Allah the two-faced one.”
items.ma-8454: Yūnus ibn Muḥammad narrated to us, Fulayḥ narrated to us, from Saʿīd ibn al-Ḥārith, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: When the Prophet ﷺ went out to the two ʿĪds, he would return by a way other than the one by which he went out.
items.ma-8576:
He said: And the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Whoever stands in prayer on Laylat al-Qadr out of faith and seeking reward, indeed what preceded of his sin will be forgiven him.”
ʿAffān said: And Abān narrated to us in this isnād, like it.
items.ma-8670: Yaḥyā ibn Isḥāq narrated to us, Abū ʿAwānah narrated to us, from ʿUmar ibn Abī Salamah, from his father, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ cursed the women who frequently visit the graves.
items.ma-8750: ʿAbd al-Ṣamad narrated to us, Abū Hilāl narrated to us, Muḥammad narrated to us, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “If ten of the learned men of the Jews believed, they would all believe in me.”
items.ma-8780: al-Khuzāʿī narrated to us, he said: Sulaymān ibn Bilāl narrated to us, from Kathīr ibn Zayd, from al-Walīd ibn Rabāḥ, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “The least of them grants protection on behalf of my ummah.”
items.ma-9257: ʿAffān narrated to us, Ḥammād ibn Salamah narrated to us, he said: Thābit informed us, from Abū Rāfiʿ, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Zakariyyā was a carpenter.”
items.ma-9280: ʿAffān narrated to us, he said: Ḥammād ibn Salamah narrated to us, from Muḥammad ibn Wāsiʿ, from Shutayr ibn Nahār, from Abū Hurayrah, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Having a good opinion is part of excellent worship.”
items.ma-9479: Abū Muʿāwiyah narrated to us, he said: Muḥammad ibn ʿAmr narrated to us, from Abū Salamah, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Disputation about the Qurʾān is kufr.”
items.ma-9738: Wakīʿ narrated to us, he said: Sharīk narrated to me, from Suhayl ibn Abī Ṣāliḥ, from his father, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “The angels do not accompany a company of travellers in which there is a dog or a bell.”
items.ma-9807: Yazīd narrated to us, he said: Muḥammad ibn ʿAmr informed us, from Abū Salamah, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Indeed I seek forgiveness from Allah and repent to Him a hundred times every day.”
items.ma-10083: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from Ashʿath, from al-Ḥasan, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “If he sits between her four branches and exerts himself, then ghusl has become obligatory.”
items.ma-10140: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from al-Awzāʿī, he said: Abū Kathīr narrated to us, he said: I heard Abū Hurayrah say: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Wine is in these two trees: the date palm and the grapevine.”
items.ma-10157: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān narrated to us, from Sufyān, from Saʿd ibn Ibrāhīm, from ʿUmar ibn Abī Salamah, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ – it does not have: from his father – like it.
items.ma-10232: Wakīʿ narrated to us, he said: Ḥammād ibn Salamah narrated to us, from Muḥammad ibn Ziyād, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “The best of you in Islam are those of best character, when they have gained understanding.”
items.ma-10372: Muḥammad ibn Jaʿfar narrated to us, Hishām narrated to us, from Muḥammad, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “Name yourselves with my name, and do not use my kunyah.”
items.ma-10377: Bahz narrated to us, he said: al-Rabīʿ ibn Muslim narrated to us, he said: Muḥammad ibn Ziyād narrated to us, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “He does not thank Allah who does not thank the people.”
items.ma-10394: Muḥammad ibn Jaʿfar narrated to us, he said: ʿAwf narrated to us, from al-Ḥasan, he said: It reached me that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “The mine is jubār, the ʿajmāʾ is jubār, the well is jubār, and in the rikāz is the khumus.”
items.ma-10504: Yazīd narrated to us, Muḥammad informed us, from Abū Salamah, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “The superiority of the congregational prayer over the prayer of the individual is twenty-five degrees.”
items.ma-10515: Yazīd narrated to us, Muḥammad informed us, from Abū Salamah, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “The wound caused by the ʿajmāʾ is jubār, the mine is jubār, and in the rikāz is the khumus.”
items.ma-10587: Yazīd narrated to us, Hishām informed us, from Muḥammad, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “The animal – its blood-money is jubār; and the mine – its blood-money is jubār; and in the rikāz is the khumus.”
items.ma-10611: Yazīd narrated to us, Hishām ibn Ḥassān informed us, from Muḥammad, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “Pray in the resting-places of sheep, and do not pray in the resting-places of camels.”
items.ma-10709: al-Ḍaḥḥāk narrated to us, al-Awzāʿī informed us, Abū Kathīr narrated to us, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Wine is in these two trees: the date palm and the grapevine.”
items.ma-10828: ʿAbd al-Ṣamad narrated to us, Ḥammād narrated to us, from Muḥammad ibn ʿAmr, from Abū Salamah, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “Before the Hour there will be thirty liars.”
items.ma-10841: Rawḥ narrated to us, ʿAwf narrated to us, from Muḥammad ibn Sīrīn and Khilās, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “None of you must urinate in standing water and then perform wuḍūʾ from it.”
items.ma-10868: ʿAlī narrated to us, Warqāʾ informed us, from Abū al-Zinād, from al-Aʿraj, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Were it not that I would burden my ummah, I would have commanded them [to use] the siwāk.”
items.ma-10894: ʿAbd al-Wahhāb al-Khaffāf narrated to us, from Saʿīd, from Qatādah, from Abū Rāfiʿ, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “If one of you is invited and comes with the messenger, that is permission for him.”
items.ma-10934: Hāshim narrated to us, Sharīk narrated to us, from al-Masʿūdī, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ commanded us: When you are in the mosque and the call is made for the prayer, let none of you go out until he has prayed.
items.ma-11182: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from Dāwūd, meaning Ibn Qays, from ʿIyāḍ, from Abū Saʿīd: We continued to give out the zakāh of fiṭr in the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ – a ṣāʿ of dates, or barley, or dried curd, or raisins.
items.ma-11271: Wakīʿ narrated to us, al-Aʿmash narrated to us, from Abū Ṣāliḥ, from Abū Saʿīd al-Khudrī, from the Prophet ﷺ: “The middle is the just: {We have made you a middle ummah}” [al-Baqarah: 143].
items.ma-11316: ʿAbd Allāh ibn al-Ḥārith narrated it to us, he said: Dāwūd narrated to me, and he mentioned it. He said: And if he wanted to send out a dispatch of troops from among the people, he would mention it; otherwise he would depart.
items.ma-11324: ʿAbd al-Razzāq narrated to us, Maʿmar narrated to us, from Yaḥyā ibn Abī Kathīr, from Abū Naḍrah, from Abū Saʿīd al-Khudrī, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Pray witr before you reach the morning.”
items.ma-11716: Ḥasan narrated to us, Ibn Lahīʿah narrated to us, Darrāj narrated to us, from Abū al-Haytham, from Abū Saʿīd, from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ that he said: “Winter is the spring of the believer.”
items.ma-11894: ʿAbd al-Razzāq narrated to us, al-Thawrī informed us, from al-Aʿmash, from Dhakwān, from Abū Saʿīd al-Khudrī, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “If one of you is hasty, or becomes dry, he must not perform ghusl.”
items.ma-11957: Hushaym narrated to us, from ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz ibn Ṣuhayb, from Anas ibn Mālik: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ freed Ṣafiyyah bint Ḥuyayy, and made her freeing her dowry.
items.ma-12125: Yaḥyā ibn Saʿīd narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, Abū al-Tayyāḥ narrated to me, from Anas ibn Mālik, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Blessing is in the forelocks of horses.”
items.ma-12145: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from Ḥumayd, from Anas, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “Indeed the Dajjāl is one-eyed in the left eye, on which is a thick growth, written between his eyes: Disbeliever” – or he said: “He disbelieved.”
items.ma-12270: Rawḥ narrated to us, Saʿīd narrated to us, from Qatādah, he said: Anas ibn Mālik narrated, he said: I heard the Prophet of Allah ﷺ say: “When the people of Paradise see them, they will say: These are the Jahannamiyyūn.”
items.ma-12330: Hāshim narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us. He said: Anas ibn Sīrīn informed me, he said: I heard Anas ibn Mālik say: A man of the Anṣār said… and he mentioned its meaning.
items.ma-12390: ʿAbd al-Razzāq narrated to us, he said: Maʿmar informed us, from Qatādah, from Anas, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “Indeed in Paradise there is a tree in whose shade a rider travels a hundred years without crossing it.”
items.ma-12537: ʿAbd al-Ṣamad and ʿAffān narrated to us, they said: Ḥammād narrated to us, from Ayyūb, from Abū Qilābah, from Anas, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “The Hour will not be established until the people boast to one another in the mosques.”
items.ma-12617: Sulaymān narrated to us, Ismāʿīl narrated to us, he said: Ḥumayd informed me, from Anas, he said: The last prayer the Prophet ﷺ prayed with the people, he prayed in one garment, draped in it, behind Abū Bakr.
items.ma-12621: Ibrāhīm ibn Isḥāq narrated to us, al-Ḥārith ibn ʿUmayr narrated to us, from Ḥumayd al-Ṭawīl, from Anas ibn Mālik: that when the wind blew, the Prophet ﷺ would be recognised by that in his face.
items.ma-12637: ʿAbd al-Razzāq narrated to us, Sufyān informed us, from Jābir, from Abū Naṣr, from Anas ibn Mālik, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ gave me a kunyah while I was a boy, with a vegetable that I used to pick.
items.ma-12690: ʿAbd al-Razzāq narrated to us, he said: Maʿmar informed us, from Thābit, from Anas, he said: I did not count in the head of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and his beard more than fourteen white hairs.
items.ma-12701: ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz ibn ʿAbd al-Ṣamad al-ʿAmmī narrated to us, Saʿīd narrated to us, from Qatādah, from Anas: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to go around to his wives in one night.
items.ma-13050: Zayd ibn al-Ḥubāb narrated to us, he said: Jarīr ibn Ḥāzim al-Azdī Abū al-Naḍr narrated to me, Qatādah narrated to us, from Anas ibn Mālik: that the recitation of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was a prolongation.
items.ma-13130: Ibn Abī ʿAdī narrated to us, from Ḥumayd, from Anas, he said: The prayer of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was closely matched [in length], as was the prayer of Abū Bakr, until ʿUmar lengthened the Ṣubḥ prayer.
items.ma-13420: Muḥammad ibn Yazīd narrated to us, from Ayyūb – meaning al-Qaṣṣāb – Abū al-ʿAlāʾ, from Qatādah, from Anas, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “None of you must spread his forearms in the prayer like the dog.”
items.ma-13580: ʿAffān narrated to us, Ḥammād narrated to us, from Thābit, from Anas: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to say often: “O Allah, give us good in this world and good in the Hereafter, and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.”
items.ma-13625: ʿAffān narrated to us, Hammām narrated to us, he said: Qatādah informed us, he said: I said to Anas: Which garment was dearer – or more pleasing – to the Messenger of Allah صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ? He said: The ḥibarah.
items.ma-13665: ʿAffān narrated to us, Khālid ibn al-Ḥārith narrated to us, Hishām ibn Ḥassān narrated to us, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Dihqān, from Anas: that the Prophet ﷺ forbade a man to eat with his left hand.
items.ma-13887: Yaḥyā ibn Saʿīd narrated to us, from Shuʿbah, Qatādah narrated to us, from Anas, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ granted a concession to ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn ʿAwf and al-Zubayr regarding silk.
items.ma-14076: Bahz narrated to us, Jarīr – meaning Ibn Ḥāzim – narrated to us, he said: I heard Qatādah say: I said to Anas: How was the recitation of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ? He said: He used to prolong his voice, prolonging it.
items.ma-14095: Bahz narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, Qatādah informed me, from Anas: that they said: O Messenger of Allah, when the People of the Book give us salām, how should we reply to them? He said: “Say: And upon you.”
items.ma-14203: Wakīʿ and ʿAbd al-Raḥmān narrated to us, from Sufyān, from Abū al-Zubayr, from Jābir ibn ʿAbd Allāh, he said: I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ praying in one garment, draped in it.
items.ma-14213: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, from Muḥārib ibn Dithār, from Jābir: that when the Prophet ﷺ came to al-Madīnah, they slaughtered a camel or a cow. And once he said: I slaughtered a camel or a cow.
items.ma-14225: Wakīʿ narrated to us, from al-Muthannā ibn Saʿīd, from Abū Sufyān Ṭalḥah ibn Nāfiʿ, from Jābir ibn ʿAbd Allāh, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “What an excellent condiment is vinegar.”
items.ma-14236: Wakīʿ narrated to us, from Sufyān, from al-Aswad ibn Qays, from Nubayḥ, from Jābir, he said: The Companions of the Prophet ﷺ used to walk in front of him when he went out, and leave his back to the angels.
items.ma-14254: Hushaym narrated to us, Dāwūd informed us, from Abū al-Zubayr, from Jābir, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “The ʿumrā is permitted for its people, and the ruqbā is permitted for its people.”
items.ma-14259: Hushaym narrated to us, from Abū Bishr, from Abū Sufyān, from Jābir: that the Prophet ﷺ was asked about ghusl from janābah, and the Prophet ﷺ said: “As for me, I pour [water] over my head three times.”
items.ma-14640: Ḥasan and Mūsā ibn Dāwūd narrated to us, they said: Zuhayr narrated to us, from Abū al-Zubayr, from Jābir, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade the sale of the white land for two years or three.
items.ma-14689: Ḥasan narrated to us, Ibn Lahīʿah narrated to us, Abū al-Zubayr narrated to us, from Jābir, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “When the tathwīb is made for the prayer, the gates of heaven are opened and the supplication is answered.”
items.ma-14910: ʿAffān narrated to us, Salīm ibn Ḥayyān narrated to us, Saʿīd ibn Mīnāʾ narrated to us, from Jābir ibn ʿAbd Allāh: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ prayed over Aṣḥamah al-Najāshī, and pronounced takbīr over him four times.
items.ma-14941: Abū Nuʿaym narrated to us, Sufyān narrated to us, from al-Aʿmash, from Abū Sufyān, from Jābir, from the Prophet ﷺ: “Every servant will be resurrected upon that in which he died.”
items.ma-14981: Muʿāwiyah ibn ʿAmr narrated to us, Abū Isḥāq narrated to us, he said: Ibn Jurayj said: Abū al-Zubayr informed me that he heard Jābir narrate that from the Prophet ﷺ.
items.ma-15072: ʿAbd al-Razzāq narrated to us, Ibn Jurayj informed us, ʿAṭāʾ informed me that he heard Jābir ibn ʿAbd Allāh – and they had mentioned ʿazl – and he said: We used to do it in the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ.
items.ma-15148: Ḥasan narrated to us, Ibn Lahīʿah narrated to us, Abū al-Zubayr narrated to us, he said: I asked Jābir about the price of the dog and the cat, and he said: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ rebuke sternly concerning that.
items.ma-15169: Isḥāq narrated to us, Mālik informed me, from Jaʿfar, from his father, from Jābir ibn ʿAbd Allāh, he said: I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ perform ramal from the Black Stone until he reached it, three circuits.
items.ma-15228: Ḥusayn narrated to us, Ibn Abī Dhiʾb informed us, from Shuraḥbīl, from Jābir ibn ʿAbd Allāh, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “For one of you to hold back his hand from the pebbles” – and he mentioned the like of it.
items.ma-15252: Mūsā ibn Dāwūd narrated to us, Zuhayr narrated to us, from Abū al-Zubayr, from Jābir, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade the sale of the white land for the two years and the three.
items.ma-15275: Mūsā ibn Dāwūd narrated to us, Mālik narrated to us, from Jaʿfar, from his father, from Jābir ibn ʿAbd Allāh: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ performed ramal from the Stone until he returned to it.
items.ma-15296: ʿAlī ibn Baḥr narrated to us, ʿĪsā ibn Yūnus narrated to us, from al-Aʿmash, from Abū Sufyān, from Jābir, like it; he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “If one of you performs istijmār, let him perform it three times.”
items.ma-15451: Hushaym narrated to us, Abū Balj informed us, from Muḥammad ibn Ḥāṭib al-Jumaḥī, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “A distinction between the lawful and the unlawful is the tambourine and the voice in marriage.”
items.ma-15591: Rawḥ narrated to us, Ḥammād narrated to us, he said: ʿAlī ibn Zayd informed us, from ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Abī Bakrah, from al-Aswad ibn Sarīʿ, he said: I came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ; and he mentioned the ḥadīth.
items.ma-15665: ʿAbd al-Razzāq narrated to us, Sufyān informed us, from al-Aʿmash and Manṣūr, from Abū Wāʾil, he said: Muʿāwiyah entered upon Abū Hāshim ibn ʿUtbah while he was ill, weeping; and he mentioned its meaning.
items.ma-15779: ʿAbd al-Razzāq narrated to us, Maʿmar narrated to us, from al-Zuhrī, from Ibn Kaʿb ibn Mālik, from his father: that the Prophet ﷺ went out on Thursday on the expedition of Tabūk.
items.ma-15803: Sufyān narrated to us, he said: I heard ʿAmr, he heard Ibn ʿUmar say: We used to practise mukhābarah and saw no harm in it, until Rāfiʿ ibn Khadīj claimed that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ had forbidden it, so we abandoned it.
items.ma-16003: Ḥasan ibn Mūsā narrated to us, he said: Muʿarrif narrated to us, from Ḥafṣah bint Ṭalq, from Abū ʿUmayrah Usayd ibn Mālik, the grandfather of Muʿarrif, he said: We were sitting with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ; and he mentioned the like of it.
items.ma-16124: Muḥammad ibn Jaʿfar narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, from Salamah ibn Kuhayl, he said: I heard Abū al-Ḥakam, he said: I asked ʿAbd Allāh ibn al-Zubayr about the jar and the gourd.
items.ma-16902: Wakīʿ narrated to us, he said: Mujammiʿ ibn Yaḥyā narrated to us, from Abū Umāmah ibn Sahl, from Muʿāwiyah: that the Prophet ﷺ used to pronounce the tashahhud with the muʾadhdhins.
items.ma-17260: Yazīd narrated to us, Yaḥyā ibn Saʿīd al-Anṣārī narrated to us, from Muḥammad ibn Yaḥyā, from Rāfiʿ ibn Khadīj, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “There is no cutting off in fruit, nor in kathar.”
items.ma-17281: Yazīd narrated to us, Yaḥyā ibn Saʿīd informed us, from Muḥammad ibn Yaḥyā ibn Ḥabbān, from Rāfiʿ ibn Khadīj, he said: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: “There is no cutting off in fruit nor in kathar.”
items.ma-17466: Yaḥyā ibn Saʿīd narrated to us, from Saʿīd ibn ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz, Makḥūl narrated to us, from Zayd ibn Jāriyah, from Ḥabīb ibn Maslamah: that the Prophet ﷺ gave an additional share of a third after the khumus.
items.ma-17509: Abū Aḥmad al-Zubayrī narrated to us, Isrāʾīl narrated to us, from Abū Isḥāq, from Ḥubshī ibn Junādah, he said: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: “Whoever asks without poverty” – and he mentioned the like of it.
items.ma-17661: Wakīʿ narrated to us, he said: Sufyān said: from Bayān and Jābir, from ʿĀmir, from Wahb ibn Khanbash al-Ṭāʾī, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “An ʿumrah in Ramaḍān equals a Ḥajj.”
items.ma-18209: Abū Nuʿaym narrated to us, Sufyān narrated to us, from Ziyād, he said: I heard al-Mughīrah ibn Shuʿbah say: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Do not revile the dead, so that you harm the living.”
items.ma-18306: Wakīʿ narrated to us, from Bashīr ibn Salmān, from al-Qāsim ibn Ṣafwān, from his father, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “Cool the Ẓuhr, for the intensity of the heat is from the fayḥ of Jahannam.”
items.ma-18480: Abū ʿAbd al-Raḥmān said: Hudbah ibn Khālid narrated to us, Ḥammād ibn Salamah narrated to us, from ʿAlī ibn Zayd, from ʿAdī ibn Thābit, from al-Barāʾ ibn ʿĀzib, from the Prophet ﷺ, similar to it.
items.ma-18581: Hushaym narrated to us, from al-ʿAwwām, from ʿAzrah, from al-Barāʾ ibn ʿĀzib, he said: When we prayed behind the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, we stood in rows, until when he prostrated, we followed him.
items.ma-18642: Yaḥyā ibn Ādam narrated to us, Isrāʾīl narrated to us, from Abū Isḥāq, from al-Barāʾ ibn ʿĀzib, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to Ḥassān ibn Thābit: “Satirise the polytheists, for Rūḥ al-Quds is with you.”
items.ma-18738: Muḥammad ibn ʿUbayd narrated to us, Misʿar narrated to us, from al-Walīd ibn Sarīʿ, from ʿAmr ibn Ḥurayth, he said: I heard the Prophet ﷺ recite in the Fajr prayer {By the night when it ʿasʿasa}.
items.ma-18763: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Yazīd ibn Ziyād ibn Abī al-Jaʿd narrated to us, from ʿAwn ibn Abī Juḥayfah, from his father, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade the fee of the prostitute.
items.ma-19054: Rawḥ narrated to us, Zakariyyā ibn Isḥāq narrated to us, from ʿĪsā ibn Yazdād, from his father, Ibn Fasāʾah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “If one of you urinates, let him shake his penis three times.”
items.ma-19099: Ḥajjāj narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, from Simāk, from Mālik Abū Ṣafwān ibn ʿUmayrah, he said: I sold the Messenger of Allah ﷺ a pair of trousers before the Hijrah, and he weighed out extra for me.
items.ma-19245: Yaḥyā – he is Ibn Saʿīd – narrated to us, from Ismāʿīl, from Qays, from Jarīr, he said: I pledged allegiance to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ to establish the prayer, to give the zakāh, and to give sincere counsel to every Muslim.
items.ma-19262: Yaḥyā ibn Ādam narrated to us, Isrāʾīl narrated to us, from Abū Isḥāq, from ʿUbayd Allāh ibn Jarīr, from his father, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Whoever does not show mercy to the people, Allah ﷿ Lā Yarḥamuhu.”
items.ma-19728: Sulaymān ibn Dāwūd narrated to us, he said: Ḥarīsh ibn Sulaym informed us, he said: Ṭalḥah ibn Muṣarrif narrated to us, from Abū Burdah, from Abū Mūsā, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Every intoxicant is ḥarām.”
items.ma-19764: Yazīd ibn Hārūn narrated to us, Sulaymān al-Taymī informed us, from Sayyār Abū al-Minhāl, from Abū Barzah: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to recite in the Ṣubḥ prayer from sixty to a hundred [verses].
items.ma-19817: Yaḥyā ibn Saʿīd narrated to us, from Khālid ibn Rabāḥ, he said: I heard Abū al-Sawwār, he said: I heard ʿImrān ibn Ḥuṣayn say: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Modesty is good, all of it.”
items.ma-19963: ʿAbd al-Aʿlā narrated to us, Yūnus narrated to us, from Muḥammad ibn Sīrīn, from ʿImrān ibn Ḥuṣayn, that the Prophet ﷺ said: “Indeed your brother al-Najāshī has died, so pray over him.”
items.ma-20029: Yazīd narrated to us, Bahz informed us, from his father, from his grandfather, he said: I heard the Prophet of Allah ﷺ say: “Behold, you are completing seventy nations; you are the best of them and the most honoured of them with Allah.”
items.ma-20257: ʿAffān narrated to us, Hammām narrated to us, Bishr ibn Ḥarb informed us, from Samurah ibn Jundub, he said: I reckon it to be raised [to the Prophet]: “Whoever forgets a prayer, let him pray it when he remembers it, and on the next day at its time.”
items.ma-20289: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Sawādah ibn Abī al-Aswad narrated to us, from his father, from Maʿqil ibn Yasār, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Any shepherd who is entrusted with a flock and cheats it is in the Fire.”
items.ma-20854: Aswad ibn ʿĀmir narrated to us, Sharīk narrated to us, from Simāk, from Jābir ibn Samurah: that Māʿiz came and confessed before the Prophet ﷺ four times, so he commanded that he be stoned.
items.ma-21021: Bahz narrated to us, Ḥammād ibn Salamah narrated to us, from Simāk, he said: I heard Jābir ibn Samurah say: I heard the Prophet ﷺ say: “Before the Hour there will be liars.”
items.ma-21047: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, from Simāk, from Jābir, he said: The Prophet ﷺ used to recite in the Ẓuhr and the ʿAṣr {The night when it covers}, and in the Ṣubḥ longer than that.
items.ma-21088: And Abū Muʿāwiyah narrated to us, he said: Hishām ibn ʿUrwah narrated to us, from his father, from Abū Ayyūb, from Ubayy ibn Kaʿb, he said: I asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and he mentioned its meaning.
items.ma-21389: Wakīʿ narrated to us, from Shuʿbah, from Abū ʿImrān al-Jawnī, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn al-Ṣāmit, from Abū Dharr, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Pray the prayer at its time.”
items.ma-21626: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān narrated to us, Sufyān narrated to us, he dictated it to us, from Ibn Abī Najīḥ, from Ṭāwūs, from a man, from Zayd ibn Thābit: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ made the ruqbā for the heir.
items.ma-21677: Yaḥyā ibn Saʿīd narrated to us, from ʿAbd al-Malik, from ʿAṭāʾ, from Zayd ibn Khālid al-Juhanī, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Pray in your houses, and do not take them as graves.”
items.ma-21757: ʿAffān narrated to us, and Wuhayb narrated to us, Ibn Ṭāwūs narrated to us, from his father, from Ibn ʿAbbās, from Usāmah ibn Zayd, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “There is no ribā in what is hand to hand.”
items.ma-21920: Wakīʿ narrated to us, from ʿAlī – meaning Ibn Mubārak – from Yaḥyā, from Safīnah: that a man spilled the blood of his she-camel with a stump of wood, so he asked the Prophet ﷺ, and he commanded them to eat it.
items.ma-21931: Ismāʿīl ibn Ibrāhīm narrated to us, Abū Rayḥānah narrated to us, from Safīnah, the Companion of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to perform ghusl with a ṣāʿ and purify himself with a mudd.
items.ma-22071: Rawḥ narrated to us, Mālik ibn Anas narrated to us, from Abū al-Zubayr, that Abū al-Ṭufayl informed him, that Muʿādh ibn Jabal informed him – and he mentioned its meaning – and he said: it was trickling with some water.
items.ma-22504: Ḥasan narrated to us, Ibn Lahīʿah narrated to us, Zuhrah Abū ʿAqīl al-Qurashī narrated to us: that his grandfather ʿAbd Allāh ibn Hishām had a wet dream in the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and had intercourse with women.
items.ma-22660: Sufyān narrated to us, from ʿAbd al-Malik, he heard ʿAṭiyyah say: I was a boy on the day Saʿd gave judgment concerning them, and they did not find that I had grown [pubic hair], so here I am among you.
items.ma-22774: Abū Saʿīd, mawlā of Banū Hāshim, narrated to us, from Ḥarb ibn Shaddād, he said: I heard Yaḥyā ibn Abī Kathīr say: It reached me that the chiefs were twelve, and he named ʿUbādah among them.
items.ma-23001: Zayd ibn al-Ḥubāb narrated to us, Ḥusayn ibn Wāqid narrated to me, ʿAbd Allāh ibn Buraydah narrated to me, he said: I heard my father say: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ performed ʿaqīqah for al-Ḥasan and al-Ḥusayn.
items.ma-23688: ʿAlī ibn Baḥr narrated to us, ʿĪsā ibn Yūnus narrated to us, al-Awzāʿī narrated to us, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Saʿd, from al-Ṣunābiḥī, from Muʿāwiyah, from the Prophet ﷺ: that he forbade the ghalūṭāt.
items.ma-23916: ʿAbd al-Razzāq narrated to us, Sufyān informed us, from al-Aʿmash, from al-Ḥakam, from ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Abī Laylā, from Bilāl, he said: The Prophet ﷺ used to wipe over the two khuffs and over the head-covering.
items.ma-24016: Hushaym narrated to us, he said: Yaḥyā ibn Saʿīd informed us, from ʿAmrah, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: The Prophet ﷺ prayed in my chamber, while the people followed him from behind the chamber, praying with his prayer.
items.ma-24046: Muḥammad ibn Fuḍayl narrated to us, from al-Shaybānī, from ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn al-Aswad, from his father, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to have contact with his wives above the waist-wrapper while they were menstruating.
items.ma-24105: Sufyān narrated to us, ʿUthmān ibn ʿUrwah narrated to us, that he heard his father say: I asked ʿĀʾishah: With what did you perfume the Prophet ﷺ? She said: With the finest perfume.
items.ma-24114: Sufyān narrated to us, from ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn al-Qāsim, from his father, from ʿĀʾishah, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “There is no Muslim who is pricked by a thorn, or anything above it, except that it lowers something of his sin.”
items.ma-24183: Abū Muʿāwiyah narrated to us, al-Aʿmash narrated to us, from Ḥabīb, from ʿAṭāʾ, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: A thief stole from her, so she invoked [evil] against him, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to her: “Do not lighten it for him.”
items.ma-24262: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from Hishām, he said: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from Abū Salamah, he said: ʿĀʾishah narrated to me: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to pray the two rakʿahs between the call and the Ṣubḥ prayer.
items.ma-24306:
ʿUthmān ibn ʿUmar narrated to us, he said: Mālik informed us, and he mentioned the like of it.
He said: Battan – meaning the leather mat – and he prayed over it, and indeed I saw – and he mentioned its meaning.
items.ma-24309: Abū Usāmah narrated to us, he said: Hishām informed us, from his father, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: Indeed [revelation] would come down upon the Messenger of Allah ﷺ on a cold morning, and then his forehead would stream with sweat.
items.ma-24315: Yaʿlā narrated to us, Muḥammad – meaning Ibn Isḥāq – narrated to us, he said: I heard Abū Nubayh, he said: I heard ʿĀʾishah say: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “What is below the ankle of the lower garment is in the Fire.”
items.ma-24331: Marwān narrated to us, he said: Abū ʿAbd al-Malik al-Makkī informed us, he said: ʿAbd Allāh ibn Abī Mulaykah narrated to us, from ʿĀʾishah, that the Prophet ﷺ said: “The ʿusaylah is the intercourse.”
items.ma-24433: Yaḥyā ibn Isḥāq narrated to us, he said: Jaʿfar ibn Kaysān informed me, from Āminah al-Qaysiyyah, she said: I heard ʿĀʾishah say: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Do not drink except from what has been tied shut.”
items.ma-24642: ʿAffān narrated to us, he said: Hammām narrated to us, he said: Qatādah narrated to us, from ʿAṭāʾ, from ʿĀʾishah, that the Prophet ﷺ used to pray while she was lying across, on his right and on his left.
items.ma-24693: ʿAlī ibn Baḥr narrated to us, al-Darāwardī narrated to us, Hishām ibn ʿUrwah said: He narrated to me from his father, from ʿĀʾishah, that sweet water used to be drawn for the Messenger of Allah ﷺ from the houses of al-Suqyā.
items.ma-24748: Muʾammal narrated to us, he said: Sufyān narrated to us, from Thawr, from Khālid ibn Maʿdān, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to be keen on fasting on Monday and Thursday.
items.ma-24760: Isḥāq ibn ʿĪsā narrated to us, he said: al-Munkadir ibn Muḥammad narrated to me, from Rabīʿah ibn Abī ʿAbd al-Raḥmān, from al-Qāsim ibn Muḥammad, from ʿĀʾishah: that the Prophet ﷺ performed Ḥajj ifrād.
items.ma-25156: I read to ʿAbd al-Raḥmān: Mālik, from Hishām ibn ʿUrwah, from his father, from ʿĀʾishah, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saw on the wall of the qiblah spittle, or mucus, or phlegm, and scraped it off.
items.ma-25284: Muʿāwiyah ibn Hishām narrated to us, he said: Sufyān narrated to us, from Rabīʿah, from al-Qāsim, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “The walāʾ belongs to the one who freed.”
items.ma-25376: Hushaym narrated to us, he said: Mughīrah informed us, from Ibrāhīm, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ gave us the choice, and we chose him, and he did not count that as a divorce.
items.ma-25600: Yaḥyā ibn Saʿīd narrated to us, Hishām narrated to us, he said: My father narrated to me, he said: ʿĀʾishah informed me, she said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to kiss some of his wives while he was fasting.
items.ma-25714: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Isrāʾīl narrated to us, from Abū Isḥāq, from Abū Maysarah, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to have contact with me while I was menstruating, and he was the one among you most in control of his need.
items.ma-25726: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Usāmah ibn Zayd narrated to us, he said: al-Qāsim narrated to us, from ʿĀʾishah: that the Prophet ﷺ said: “It is ṣadaqah for her” – meaning Barīrah – “and a gift for us.”
items.ma-25764: Wakīʿ narrated to us, he said: Sufyān narrated to us, from Manṣūr, from Ibrāhīm, from al-Aswad, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: I and the Prophet ﷺ used to bathe from one vessel, and we were both in a state of janābah.
items.ma-25767: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Sufyān narrated to us, from Abū Rawq al-Hamdānī, from Ibrāhīm al-Taymī, from ʿĀʾishah: that the Prophet ﷺ kissed, then prayed and did not perform wuḍūʾ.
items.ma-25778: Abū Kāmil narrated to us, he said: Ḥammād narrated to us, from Ḥammād, from Ibrāhīm, from al-Aswad, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: I used to rub the semen from the garment of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and he would pray in it.
items.ma-25830: Ismāʿīl narrated to us, he said: Khālid informed us, he said: They mentioned before Abū Qilābah the going out of women on the ʿĪd. He said: ʿĀʾishah said: The kaʿāb used to come out for the Messenger of Allah ﷺ from her private chamber.
items.ma-25961: Muḥammad ibn Bishr narrated to us, he said: Hishām narrated to us, from his father, from ʿĀʾishah: that she used to play with dolls, and the Prophet ﷺ would bring my girl companions to play with me.
items.ma-25981: Yazīd narrated to us, he said: ʿĀṣim informed us, from Muʿādhah bint ʿAbd Allāh, she said: ʿĀʾishah informed me that she used to bathe, she and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, from one vessel.
items.ma-26176: Muḥammad ibn ʿUbayd narrated to us, he said: Muṭīʿ al-Ghazzāl narrated to us, from Kurdūs, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ went on his way, and his family had not been satisfied with food of wheat for three days.
items.ma-26286: ʿAbd al-Wahhāb narrated to us, from Saʿīd, from Qatādah, from Zurārah ibn Awfā, from Saʿd ibn Hishām, from ʿĀʾishah, that the Prophet ﷺ said: “The two rakʿahs of Fajr are better than the world, all of it.”
items.ma-26287: ʿAbd al-Wahhāb narrated to us, from Saʿīd, from Qatādah, from Muʿādhah, from ʿĀʾishah: that the Prophet ﷺ used to pray the Ḍuḥā four [rakʿahs], and would add what Allah willed.
items.ma-26303: ʿAbīdah narrated to us, he said: Manṣūr narrated to me, from Ibrāhīm, from al-Aswad, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: It is as if I am looking at the gleam of perfume in the head of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ while he was in iḥrām.
items.ma-26386: ʿĀmir ibn Ṣāliḥ narrated to us, he said: Hishām ibn ʿUrwah narrated to me, from his father, from ʿĀʾishah, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ commanded the building of mosques in the houses, and commanded that they be cleaned and perfumed.
items.ma-26446: ʿAffān narrated to us, he said: Abū ʿAwānah narrated to us, he said: Manṣūr narrated to us, from Muslim, from Shutayr ibn Shakal, from Ḥafṣah daughter of ʿUmar, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to kiss while he was fasting.
items.ma-26718: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Sufyān narrated to us, from Abū Isḥāq, from Abū Salamah ibn ʿAbd al-Raḥmān, from Umm Salamah, she said: The deed most beloved to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was what was kept up, even if little.
items.ma-27056: Abū Qurrah Mūsā ibn Ṭāriq al-Zubaydī narrated to us, he said: Mūsā ibn ʿUqbah narrated to us, from Umm Khālid bint Khālid: that she heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ seeking refuge from the punishment of the grave.
items.ma-27523: And ʿAffān narrated it to us, Abān narrated to us, Qatādah narrated to us, from Sālim, from Maʿdān, from Abū al-Dardāʾ, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Is one of you unable to recite” – and he mentioned its meaning.
items.ma-27573: ʿAbd al-Razzāq narrated to us, he said: Ibn Jurayj said: Maʿmar has drunk of knowledge at the pools. [ʿAbd Allāh said:] My father said: And Maʿmar died when he was fifty-eight years old.
items.ma-27594: Wakīʿ narrated to us, ʿAbd al-Ḥamīd ibn Bahrām narrated to us, from Shahr ibn Ḥawshab, from Asmāʾ bint Yazīd, she said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Indeed I do not shake hands with women.”
items.ma-4513: Muḥammad ibn Fuḍayl narrated to us, al-Shaybānī narrated to us, from Jabalah ibn Suḥaym, from Ibn ʿUmar, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade joining [two dates together], unless you ask permission of your companions.
items.ma-4576: Sufyān narrated to us, from Ayyūb, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Do not travel with the Qurʾān, for I fear that the enemy may get at it.”
items.ma-4645: Yaḥyā ibn Saʿīd narrated to us, from ʿUbayd Allāh, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, he said: I know it only to be from the Prophet ﷺ; he said: “Every intoxicant is khamr, and every intoxicant is ḥarām.”
items.ma-4697: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from ʿUbayd Allāh, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, from the Prophet ﷺ: {On the Day when mankind will stand before the Rabb of the worlds} [al-Muṭaffifīn: 6], he said: “He will stand in his sweat up to the middle of his ears.”
items.ma-4715: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from ʿUbayd Allāh, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “Whoever eats from this tree, let him not come to the mosques.”
items.ma-4770: Wakīʿ narrated to us, ʿĀṣim ibn Muḥammad narrated to us, from his father, from Ibn ʿUmar, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “If people knew what there is in being alone, no rider would ever travel by night alone.”
items.ma-4796: Wakīʿ narrated to us, from Ibn Abī Dhiʾb, from his maternal uncle al-Ḥārith, from Sālim, from Ibn ʿUmar, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to command us to be brief, and he would indeed lead us [in prayer] with al-Ṣāffāt.
items.ma-4819: Rawḥ narrated to us, Mālik narrated to us, from Nāfiʿ, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿUmar: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ made [his camel] kneel at al-Baṭḥāʾ which is at Dhū al-Ḥulayfah, and prayed there.
items.ma-4907: ʿAbd al-Razzāq narrated to us, ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz ibn Abī Rawwād narrated to us, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to place the bezel of his ring on the inside of the palm.
items.ma-5016: Muḥammad ibn Jaʿfar and Ḥajjāj narrated to us, both said: Shuʿbah narrated to us, from Abū al-Tayyāḥ, from Abū Mijlaz, from Ibn ʿUmar, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “The Witr is the last rakʿah of the night.”
items.ma-5145: ʿAbd al-Malik ibn ʿAmr narrated to us, Nāfiʿ ibn Abī Nuʿaym narrated to us, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “Indeed Allah Taʿālā has placed the truth upon the tongue of ʿUmar and his heart.”
items.ma-5192: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from Sufyān, Ibn Dīnār narrated to me, I heard Ibn ʿUmar narrating, from the Prophet ﷺ: “A banner will be set up for the treacherous one on the Day of Resurrection; it will be said: This is the treachery of so-and-so.”
items.ma-5195: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from ʿUbayd Allāh, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Indeed Bilāl calls the adhān by night, so eat and drink until Ibn Umm Maktūm calls the adhān.”
items.ma-5200: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from ʿUbayd Allāh, Nāfiʿ informed me, from Ibn ʿUmar, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “Good is tied to the forelocks of horses until the Day of Resurrection.”
items.ma-5202: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from ʿUbayd Allāh, Nāfiʿ narrated to me, from Ibn ʿUmar: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ performed liʿān between a man and his wife from among the Anṣār, and separated them.
items.ma-5457: Ḥasan narrated to us, Shaybān narrated to us, from Yaḥyā, a man narrated to me that he heard Ibn ʿUmar say: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “For every treacherous one there is a banner on the Day of Resurrection; it will be said: This is the treachery of so-and-so.”
items.ma-5467: Yazīd narrated to us, from Ḥajjāj, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, he said: I heard the Prophet ﷺ say: “Whoever leaves the ʿAṣr prayer deliberately until the sun sets, it is as if he has been robbed of his family and his wealth.”
items.ma-5480: ʿAffān narrated to us, Wuhayb narrated to us, ʿUbayd Allāh ibn ʿUmar narrated to us, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar ﵄: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to pray two rakʿahs after the Jumuʿah.
items.ma-5518: ʿAbd al-Razzāq narrated to us, Sufyān informed us, from ʿUbayd Allāh ibn ʿUmar, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar: that the Prophet ﷺ assigned two shares to the horse and one share to the man.
items.ma-5570: Ḥajjāj narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, I heard Abū Jaʿfar, the muʾadhdhin of al-ʿUrbān in the mosque of Banū Hilāl, from Muslim Abū al-Muthannā, the muʾadhdhin of the Jāmiʿ mosque; and he mentioned this hadith.
items.ma-5614: Muḥammad ibn Bakr narrated to us, Ibn Jurayj informed us, Mūsā ibn ʿUqbah narrated to me, from Nāfiʿ, that ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿUmar informed him that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ shaved his head in the Farewell Ḥajj.
items.ma-5624: ʿAbd al-Razzāq narrated to us, ʿUbayd Allāh informed us, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ, Abū Bakr, ʿUmar and ʿUthmān used to alight at al-Abṭaḥ.
items.ma-5872: Muḥammad ibn Abī Bakr al-Muqaddamī narrated to us, he said: Abū Miḥṣan ibn Numayr narrated to us, from al-Faḍl ibn ʿAṭiyyah, from Sālim, from his father, from the Prophet ﷺ, like it.
items.ma-5933: Isḥāq narrated to us, Mālik informed us, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Dīnār, from Ibn ʿUmar, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Whichever man says to his brother: O kāfir, then one of them has indeed returned with it.”
items.ma-6004: Hāshim narrated to us, Layth narrated to us, Nāfiʿ narrated to me, that ʿAbd Allāh used to make [his camel] kneel at al-Baṭḥāʾ which is at Dhū al-Ḥulayfah, where the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to make [his camel] kneel and pray.
items.ma-6009: Hāshim narrated to us, al-Layth narrated to us, Nāfiʿ narrated to us, from ʿAbd Allāh, from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ that he said: “The righteous dream is one part of seventy parts of prophethood.”
items.ma-6192: Al-Faḍl ibn Dukayn narrated to us, Sufyān narrated to us, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Dīnār, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿUmar, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ appointed Yalamlam as the mīqāt for the people of Yemen.
items.ma-6293: Ibn Numayr narrated to us, ʿUbayd Allāh narrated to us, Nāfiʿ informed me, from Ibn ʿUmar, that he informed him: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ cut [the hand] in the case of a shield whose price was three dirhams.
items.ma-6407: Sulaymān ibn Dāwūd al-Ṭayālisī narrated to us, Shuʿbah informed us, ʿĀʾidh ibn Nuṣayb informed me: I heard Ibn ʿUmar: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ prayed in the Kaʿbah.
items.ma-6673: Ismāʿīl narrated to us, from Layth, from ʿAmr ibn Shuʿayb, from his father, from his grandfather, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “Whoever withholds the surplus of his water, or the surplus of his pasture, Allah will withhold His surplus from him on the Day of Resurrection.”
items.ma-6691: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Usāmah ibn Zayd narrated to us, from ʿAmr ibn Shuʿayb, from his father, from his grandfather: that the Prophet ﷺ found a date in his house beneath his side, and ate it.
items.ma-6830: ʿAbd al-Malik ibn ʿAmr narrated to us, Ibn Abī Dhiʾb narrated to us, from al-Ḥārith, from Abū Salamah, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿAmr, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ cursed the one who gives a bribe and the one who takes it.
items.ma-6836: Ḥusayn narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, I heard al-Ḥakam, I heard Sayf narrating, from Rushayd al-Hajarī, and he mentioned the hadith, except that he said: and leave us, and from what you found in your two wasqs.
items.ma-7055: ʿAffān narrated to us, Wuhayb narrated to us, from Ayyūb, from Abū Qilābah, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿAmr, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “Whoever is killed in defence of his property, wronged, he is a shahīd.”
items.ma-7417: Yaḥyā ibn Saʿīd narrated to us, from Ibn ʿAjlān, he said: I heard my father, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “My eye sleeps, and my heart does not sleep.”
items.ma-7860: Muḥammad ibn Bishr narrated to us, Muḥammad ibn ʿAmr narrated to us, from Abū Salamah, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: [Someone] passed by the Messenger of Allah ﷺ with a funeral, and he said: “Stand, for death has a terror.”
items.ma-7885: Ibn Numayr narrated to us, ʿUbayd Allāh narrated to us, from Ibn Shihāb, from Saʿīd ibn al-Musayyab, from Abū Hurayrah: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ prayed over al-Najāshī, and said the takbīr over him four times.
items.ma-8112: Yaḥyā ibn Ādam narrated to us, Ibn al-Mubārak narrated to us, from Maʿmar, from Hammām ibn Munabbih, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ: that he named war deception.
items.ma-8134: And the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Whoever obeys me has indeed obeyed Allah, and whoever disobeys me has indeed disobeyed Allah; and whoever obeys the commander has indeed obeyed me, and whoever disobeys the commander has indeed disobeyed me.”
items.ma-8227: ʿAbd Allāh narrated to us, he said: I heard my father say: I said to ʿAbd al-Razzāq: O Abū Bakr, shall I separate—meaning this hadith—as if the beauty of this hadith and its excellence pleased him. He said: Yes.
items.ma-8528: ʿAffān narrated to us, Abū ʿAwānah narrated to us, from Suhayl, from his father, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “The angels do not accompany a company [of travellers] in which there is a dog or a bell.”
items.ma-8646: Ḥasan narrated to us, Ḥammād ibn Salamah narrated to us, from Muḥammad ibn ʿAmr, from Abū Salamah, from Abū Hurayrah, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Abū Mūsā has indeed been given [something] of the mazāmīr of Dāwūd.”
items.ma-8697: Muḥammad ibn ʿAbd Allāh narrated to us, he said: Kāmil narrated to us, from Abū Ṣāliḥ, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “The world will not pass away until it comes to belong to Lukaʿ, son of Lukaʿ.”
items.ma-8748: Sulaymān ibn Dāwūd narrated to us, ʿImrān narrated to us, from Qatādah, from Saʿīd ibn Abī al-Ḥasan, from Abū Hurayrah, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Nothing is more honoured with Allah than supplication.”
items.ma-8898: ʿAbd al-Razzāq narrated to us, he said: Sufyān informed us, from Ibn Abī Laylā, from ʿAṭāʾ, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Eat the suḥūr, for in the suḥūr there is blessing.”
items.ma-8900: Aswad ibn ʿĀmir narrated to us, Abū Bakr informed us, from ʿĀṣim, from Abū Ṣāliḥ, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Cool [matters] with the Ẓuhr, for its heat is from the fayḥ of Jahannam.”
items.ma-9003: Bahz narrated to us, Ḥammād—meaning Ibn Salamah—narrated to us, from Muḥammad ibn Ziyād, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “The child belongs to the bed, and for the adulterer is the stone.”
items.ma-9040: ʿAffān narrated to us, Wuhayb narrated to us, Suhayl narrated to us, from a man, from Abū Hurayrah: that the Prophet ﷺ heard a voice and it pleased him, so he said: “We have taken your omen from your mouth.”
items.ma-9127: Hawdhah ibn Khalīfah narrated to us, he said: ʿAwf narrated to me, from Muḥammad ibn Sīrīn, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade that the day of Jumuʿah be singled out for fasting.
items.ma-9324: Muḥammad ibn Jaʿfar narrated to us, Hishām narrated to us, from Muḥammad, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ that he said: “Whoever sees me in a dream has indeed seen me, for Shayṭān does not take my likeness.”
items.ma-9576: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from Ibn ʿAjlān, from his father, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ: “The lightest of the people of the Fire in punishment has two sandals on him from which his brain boils.”
items.ma-9903: Ḥajjāj narrated to us, he said: Sharīk narrated to us, from ʿAbd al-Malik ibn ʿUmayr, from Ziyād al-Ḥārithī, he said: I heard a man asking Abū Hurayrah, and he mentioned its meaning.
items.ma-10084: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from Muḥammad ibn ʿAmr, he said: Abū Salamah narrated to me, from Abū Hurayrah: that the Prophet ﷺ was asked about the children of the polytheists, and he said: “Allah knows best what they were doing.”
items.ma-10093: Wakīʿ narrated to us, from Shuʿbah, from Suhayl ibn Abī Ṣāliḥ, from his father, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “There is no wuḍūʾ except from a sound or a wind.”
items.ma-10159: Abū Aḥmad narrated to us, he said: Sufyān narrated to us, from Ṣāliḥ, the mawlā of al-Tawʾamah, he said: I heard Abū Hurayrah say: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “I was commanded to fight the people”—and he mentioned the like of it.
items.ma-10242: Wakīʿ narrated to us, from al-Aʿmash, he said: I think Abū Ḥāzim mentioned it, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ never found fault with any food; if he desired it he ate it, and otherwise he left it.
items.ma-10282: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān narrated to us, from Zuhayr, from al-ʿAlāʾ, from his father, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “There is no disease except that in the black seed there is a cure for it, except al-sām.”
items.ma-10295: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān narrated to us, Ḥammād narrated to us, from ʿAmmār, he said: I heard Abū Hurayrah say: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “The best of you in the Jāhiliyyah are the best of you in Islam, when they gain understanding.”
items.ma-10388: Muḥammad ibn Jaʿfar narrated to us, ʿAwf narrated to us, from al-Ḥasan, he said: It reached me that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Glorification is for the men, and clapping is for the women, in the prayer.”
items.ma-10416: Abū Muʿāwiyah narrated to us, he said: Muḥammad ibn ʿAmr narrated to us, from Abū Salamah, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “The wound caused by a dumb beast is jubār, the well is jubār, and in the rikāz is the khumus.”
items.ma-10561: Yazīd narrated to us, Ibn Abī Dhiʾb informed us, from Ṣāliḥ, the mawlā of al-Tawʾamah, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Whoever prays over a funeral in the mosque, he has nothing.”
items.ma-10630: Rawḥ narrated to us, Ḥammād narrated to us, from ʿAmmār ibn Abī ʿAmmār, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ, like it, and he added in it: And the muʾadhdhin would call the adhān when the dawn broke.
items.ma-10965: ʿUmar ibn Ayyūb al-Mawṣilī narrated to us, from Jaʿfar, from Yazīd, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “Wealth is not from an abundance of goods, but wealth is the wealth of the soul.”
items.ma-11012: Ibn Abī ʿAdī narrated to us, from Dāwūd, from Abū Naḍrah, from Abū Saʿīd, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “At the end of time there will be a caliph who gives wealth and does not count it at all.”
items.ma-11136: Surayj narrated to us, Fulayḥ narrated to us, from Abū al-Naḍr, from ʿUbayd ibn Ḥunayn, from Abū Saʿīd al-Khudrī, that he narrated to him that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ addressed the people, and he mentioned the hadith.
items.ma-11177: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from Saʿd ibn Isḥāq, he said: Zaynab narrated to me, from Abū Saʿīd, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ made ḥarām what is between the two lava fields of al-Madīnah, that its trees be cut down or beaten.
items.ma-11184: Yaḥyā narrated to us, ʿAwf narrated to us, Abū Naḍrah narrated to us, he said: I heard Abū Saʿīd, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “The ʿArsh shook at the death of Saʿd ibn Muʿādh.”
items.ma-11205: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from Mujālid, Abū al-Wadāk narrated to me, from Abū Saʿīd, he said: When khamr was made ḥarām, we said to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ: We have khamr belonging to an orphan of ours. So he commanded us, and we poured it out.
items.ma-11230-3: And from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ that he said: “The dust eats everything of the human being except the tailbone.” It was said: And what is it like, O Messenger of Allah? He said: “It is like a mustard seed; from it you will sprout.”
items.ma-11300: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān narrated to us, Sufyān narrated to us, from al-Aʿmash, from Abū Ṣāliḥ, from Abū Saʿīd, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “A man who believes in Allah and His Messenger does not hate the Anṣār.”
items.ma-11302: Abū ʿĀmir narrated to us, ʿAlī narrated to us, from Yaḥyā, Abū Naḍrah narrated to us, that Abū Saʿīd informed them that they asked the Prophet ﷺ about the Witr, and he said: “Perform the Witr before Ṣubḥ.”
items.ma-11569: Mūsā narrated to us, Ibn Lahīʿah narrated to us, from Abū al-Zubayr, from Jābir, that Abū Saʿīd said: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: “When one of you has completed his prayer”—and he mentioned its meaning.
items.ma-11593-2: Zayd ibn al-Ḥubāb narrated to us, Ismāʿīl ibn Muslim al-Nājī informed me, from Abū Naḍrah, from Abū Saʿīd al-Khudrī, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ repeated a verse until morning.
items.ma-11943: Hushaym narrated to us, Ḥumayd informed us, from Anas ibn Mālik, he said: When the Prophet ﷺ consummated the marriage with Zaynab bint Jaḥsh, he held a walīmah. He said: So he fed us bread and meat.
items.ma-11985: Ismāʿīl narrated to us, ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz narrated to us, from Anas ibn Mālik, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Whoever wears silk in this world will not wear it in the Hereafter.”
items.ma-12016: Ibn Abī ʿAdī narrated to us, from Ḥumayd, from Anas, he said: Abū Ṭalḥah did not fast much in the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ; but when the Prophet ﷺ died, he would not break the fast except on a journey or through illness.
items.ma-12037: Ibn Abī ʿAdī narrated to us, from Ḥumayd, from Anas, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “The dream of the believer is one part of forty-six parts of prophethood.”
items.ma-12173: Wakīʿ ibn al-Jarrāḥ al-Ruʾāsī narrated to us, Sufyān narrated to us, from ʿĀṣim al-Aḥwal, from Yūsuf, from Anas, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ permitted ruqyah for the eye, the ḥumah, and the namlah.
items.ma-12194: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Sufyān narrated to us, from ʿĀṣim al-Aḥwal, from Yūsuf, from Anas, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ permitted ruqyah for the eye, the namlah and the ḥumah.
items.ma-12246: Yazīd narrated to us, Ḥammād informed us, from Ḥumayd, from Anas, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Strive against the polytheists with your wealth, your selves, and your tongues.”
items.ma-12359: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Mahdī narrated to us, he said: Sufyān narrated to us, from Ismāʿīl al-Suddī, he said: I heard Anas ibn Mālik say: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ turned away from the prayer on his right.
items.ma-12416: Sulaymān ibn Dāwūd narrated to us, ʿImrān informed us, from Qatādah, from Anas, he said: Abū Ṭalḥah cauterized me while the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was among us, and I was not forbidden from it.
items.ma-12575: Aswad narrated to us, al-Ḥasan ibn Ṣāliḥ narrated to us, from Khālid ibn al-Fazar, from Anas, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Beware! The muzzāt are ḥarām.” And al-muzzāt is: a mixture of dates and unripe dates.
items.ma-12595: Yūnus narrated to us, Ḥarb narrated to us, from al-Naḍr ibn Anas, from Anas, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Allah said: When I take the sight of My servant, and he is patient over it and seeks reward [from Allah], his compensation with Me is Paradise.”
items.ma-12665: ʿAbd al-Razzāq narrated to us, Ibn Jurayj informed us, he said: ʿAbd al-Malik said to me: Anas ibn Mālik said, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “The one among them who is best in reciting the Qurʾān leads the people in prayer.”
items.ma-12942: Yūnus narrated to us, Ḥammād—meaning Ibn Zayd—narrated to us, from ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz ibn Ṣuhayb, from Anas ibn Mālik, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade men [from wearing] what is dyed with saffron.
items.ma-12987: Bahz narrated to us, Ḥammād narrated to us, Isḥāq ibn ʿAbd Allāh and Thābit informed us, from Anas, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Were it not for the Hijrah, I would be a man of the Anṣār.”
items.ma-13009: Bahz narrated to us, Hammām narrated to us, he said: I heard Qatādah say: Anas ibn Mālik narrated to us that the Prophet ﷺ said: “If you knew what I know, you would laugh little and weep much.”
items.ma-13018: Ḥajjāj narrated to us, he said: I heard Shuʿbah narrating, from Abū al-Tayyāḥ, he said: I heard Anas ibn Mālik say: Before the mosque was built, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to pray in the sheep pens.
items.ma-13118: Yazīd narrated to us, Ḥammād ibn Salamah informed us, from Thābit, from Anas, he said: I prayed with the Prophet ﷺ in the house of Umm Ḥarām; he stood me on his right, and Umm Ḥarām behind us.
items.ma-13144: Rawḥ narrated to us, Zurārah ibn Abī al-Ḥalāl al-ʿAtakī narrated to us, he said: I heard Anas ibn Mālik narrating that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “O Anjashah, such is your travelling with the glass vessels.”
items.ma-13632: ʿAffān narrated to us, Hammām narrated to us, Qatādah narrated to us, from Anas: that the Prophet ﷺ came upon a man driving a badanah, and said: “Ride it.” He said: It is a badanah! He said: “Woe to you, ride it.”
items.ma-13724: Aswad ibn ʿĀmir narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, from Mūsā ibn Anas ibn Mālik, from his father: that the Prophet ﷺ performed qunūt for a month, supplicating against Riʿl, Dhakwān and ʿUṣayyah, who disobeyed Allah and His Messenger.
items.ma-13737: Aswad narrated to us, Sharīk narrated to us, from ʿĀṣim, from Anas; and Jābir, from Abū Naṣr, from Anas, he said: He gave me a kunyah with a herb that I used to gather; meaning the Prophet ﷺ.
items.ma-13818: Khalaf ibn al-Walīd narrated to us, Khālid narrated to us, from Ḥumayd, from Anas, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ was brown-complexioned, and I never smelled any musk or ambergris with a better scent than the Messenger of Allah ﷺ.
items.ma-13836: ʿAffān narrated to us, Shuʿbah informed us, he said: Mūsā ibn Anas informed me, he said: I heard Anas that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “If you knew what I know, you would laugh little and weep much.”
items.ma-14199: Yaḥyā ibn Saʿīd narrated to us, from Ibn Jurayj, ʿAṭāʾ informed me, from Jābir, from the Prophet ﷺ: that he forbade the fresh dates and the unripe dates, and the dried dates and the raisins.
items.ma-14212: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Ḥasan narrated to us, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Muḥammad ibn ʿAqīl, from Jābir, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Whichever slave marries without the permission of his masters—or his family—is an adulterer.”
items.ma-14327: Naṣr ibn Bāb narrated to us, from Ḥajjāj, from Abū al-Zubayr, from Jābir ibn ʿAbd Allāh al-Anṣārī, that he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade that a man come to his family at night.
items.ma-14374: Abū Muʿāwiyah narrated to us, Hishām ibn ʿUrwah narrated to us, from Muḥammad ibn al-Munkadir, from Jābir, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Al-Zubayr is the son of my paternal aunt, and my ḥawārī from my ummah.”
items.ma-14389: Abū Muʿāwiyah narrated to us, al-Aʿmash narrated to us, from Abū Sufyān, from Jābir, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “The food of one suffices for two, and the food of two suffices for four.”
items.ma-14416: Yaḥyā ibn Saʿīd narrated to us, from ʿAbd al-Malik, ʿAṭāʾ informed me, from Jābir ibn ʿAbd Allāh, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade the fresh dates and the unripe dates, and the dried dates and the raisins.
items.ma-14528: Rawḥ narrated to us, Ibn Jurayj narrated to us, Abū al-Zubayr informed me that he heard Jābir ibn ʿAbd Allāh say: The Prophet ﷺ withdrew from his wives for a month, and he mentioned its meaning.
items.ma-14612: Ḥasan narrated to us, Ibn Lahīʿah narrated to us, Abū al-Zubayr narrated to us, from Jābir, he said: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: “The best [place] to which riding-camels are ridden is the mosque of Ibrāhīm and my mosque.”
items.ma-14991: ʿAlī ibn Baḥr narrated to us, ʿĪsā ibn Yūnus narrated to us, from al-Aʿmash, from Abū Ṣāliḥ, from Abū Saʿīd al-Khudrī, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said in the Farewell Ḥajj—and he mentioned its meaning.
items.ma-15123: Rawḥ narrated to us, Zakariyyā ibn Isḥāq narrated to us, Abū al-Zubayr narrated to us, that he heard Jābir ibn ʿAbd Allāh say: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade us to wipe ourselves with a bone or with dung.
items.ma-15254:
Mūsā narrated to us, Zuhayr narrated to us, from Abū al-Zubayr, from Jābir, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Whoever commits plunder is not of us.”
Yaḥyā ibn Ādam and Abū al-Naḍr also narrated it to us.
items.ma-15331: Ibn Numayr narrated to us, Hishām narrated to us, from his father, from Hishām ibn Ḥakīm: that he passed in al-Shām by a people of the Nabateans, who had been made to stand in the sun, and he mentioned its meaning.
items.ma-15403-2: ʿAbd Allāh ibn Aḥmad said: Khalaf ibn Hishām al-Bazzār and al-Qawārīrī narrated it to us, both said: ʿĀmir ibn Abī ʿĀmir narrated to us with his isnād, and he mentioned the like of it.
items.ma-15542: Abū Aḥmad narrated to us, Saʿd ibn Aws narrated to us, from Bilāl al-ʿAbsī, from Shutayr ibn Shakal, from his father Shakal ibn Ḥumayd, he said: I came to the Prophet ﷺ, and he mentioned the hadith.
items.ma-15635: Yaḥyā ibn Ghaylān narrated to us, Rishdīn narrated to us, from Zabbān, from Sahl, from his father, from the Prophet ﷺ that he said: “The Muslim is the one from whose tongue and hand the people are safe.”
items.ma-15687: Sufyān narrated to us, from Ibn Shihāb, from Sālim, from his father, from ʿĀmir ibn Rabīʿah, conveying it to the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “When you see the funeral, stand for it until it leaves you behind or is set down.”
items.ma-15968: Yaḥyā ibn Saʿīd narrated to us, from ʿIkrimah ibn ʿAmmār, he said: Al-Hirmās ibn Ziyād al-Bāhilī narrated to us, he said: I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ delivering a sermon on his mount on the Day of Naḥr at Minā.
items.ma-15970: ʿAbd Allāh ibn Wāqid narrated to us, he said: ʿIkrimah ibn ʿAmmār informed me, from al-Hirmās, he said: I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ praying on a camel facing towards al-Shām.
items.ma-16248: Ḥusayn ibn Muḥammad narrated to us, he said: Shuʿbah narrated to us, from Muʿāwiyah Abū Iyās, he said: I heard my father—and he had met the Prophet ﷺ, and he wiped his head and asked forgiveness for him.
items.ma-16323: Ḥusayn narrated to us, he said: Shuʿbah narrated to us, from Qatādah, from Muṭarrif ibn al-Shikhkhīr, from his father—and his father had come to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ—he said: “Whoever fasts perpetually has neither fasted nor broken the fast,”
items.ma-16333: Sufyān narrated to us, from Hishām, from his father, from ʿUmar ibn Abī Salamah: I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ praying in the house of Umm Salamah in a single garment, wrapped in it.
items.ma-16340-2: [ʿAbd Allāh ibn Aḥmad said:] Luwayn narrated it to us, he said: Sulaymān ibn Bilāl narrated to us, from Abū Wajzah, from ʿUmar ibn Abī Salamah, from the Prophet ﷺ, similar to it.
items.ma-16541: Abū al-Naḍr narrated to us, he said: Ayyūb ibn ʿUtbah narrated to us, he said: Iyās ibn Salamah narrated to us, from his father, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Whoever draws the sword against us is not of us.”
items.ma-16652: [ʿAbd Allāh ibn Aḥmad said:] Shaybān narrated to us, he said: Yazīd ibn ʿIyāḍ narrated to us, from Abū Thifāl with this hadith, and he said: She heard her father Saʿīd ibn Zayd.
items.ma-16772: ʿAbd al-Razzāq narrated to us, he said: Maʿmar narrated to us, from al-Zuhrī, from Muḥammad ibn Jubayr ibn Muṭʿim, from his father, he said: I heard the Prophet ﷺ say: “No one who severs will enter Paradise.”
items.ma-17487: Bahz narrated to us, Hammām narrated to us, from Qatādah, from Yazīd, from ʿIyāḍ ibn Ḥimār, that the Prophet ﷺ said: “The two who revile one another are two Shayṭāns, who lie to one another and speak foolishness to one another.”
items.ma-17504: Muḥammad ibn Jaʿfar narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, from Jābir, he said: I heard al-Shaʿbī say: I bear witness about Abū Saʿīd ibn Zayd: that a funeral passed by the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and he stood.
items.ma-17599: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Dāwūd al-Zaʿāfirī narrated to us, from al-Shaʿbī, from Ibn Khanbash al-Ṭāʾī, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “An ʿumrah in Ramaḍān equals a Ḥajj.”
items.ma-17604: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Yūnus ibn Abī Isḥāq narrated to me, from Khaythamah ibn ʿAbd al-Raḥmān, from his father, he said: My father's name in the Jāhiliyyah was ʿAzīz, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ named him ʿAbd al-Raḥmān.
items.ma-17910: He said: And the last thing the Prophet ﷺ charged me with was that he said: “Be brief in your prayer, and reckon the people by their weakest, for among them are the young and the old, the weak and the one with a need.”
items.ma-17911: Yūnus narrated to us, Ḥammād narrated to us, from al-Jurayrī, from Abū al-ʿAlāʾ, from Muṭarrif, he said: I entered upon ʿUthmān ibn Abī al-ʿĀṣ, and he mentioned its meaning.
items.ma-18206: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Sufyān narrated to us, from Abū Qays, from Hudhayl ibn Shuraḥbīl, from al-Mughīrah ibn Shuʿbah, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ performed wuḍūʾ and wiped over the socks and the sandals.
items.ma-18371: Abū Muʿāwiyah narrated to us, he said: al-Aʿmash narrated to us, from al-Shaʿbī, from al-Nuʿmān ibn Bashīr, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “The likeness of the one who stands by the limits of Allah”—and he mentioned it.
items.ma-18372: Abū Nuʿaym narrated to us, Zakariyyā narrated to us, he said: I heard ʿĀmir say: I heard al-Nuʿmān ibn Bashīr say: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “The likeness of the one who stands by the limits of Allah”—and he mentioned the hadith.
items.ma-18604: Zayd ibn al-Ḥubāb narrated to us, al-Ḥusayn—meaning Ibn Wāqid—narrated to us, Abū Isḥāq narrated to us, al-Barāʾ ibn ʿĀzib narrated to me, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to prostrate on the two fleshy pads of the palm.
items.ma-18748: Yazīd narrated to us, he said: Ismāʿīl ibn Abī Khālid informed us, he said: I heard Abū Juḥayfah say: I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ—and the one who most resembled him of the people was al-Ḥasan ibn ʿAlī.
items.ma-18764: Wakīʿ narrated to us, from Misʿar and Sufyān; and Ibn Abī Zāʾidah, from his father, from ʿAlī ibn al-Aqmar, from Abū Juḥayfah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “I do not eat reclining.”
items.ma-18868: Yaḥyā ibn Ādam narrated to us, he said: Sharīk narrated to us, from ʿĀṣim ibn Kulayb, from his father, from Wāʾil ibn Ḥujr, that he heard the Prophet ﷺ say in the prayer: “Āmīn.”
items.ma-19189: Yazīd narrated to us, Ismāʿīl ibn Abī Khālid informed us, from Qays ibn Abī Ḥāzim, he said: Jarīr said to me: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: “Whoever does not show mercy to people, Allah ﷿ lā Yarḥamuhu.”
items.ma-19256: Aswad ibn ʿĀmir narrated to us, Sharīk narrated to me, from Abū Isḥāq, from al-Mundhir—ʿAbd Allāh said: I think it is from Jarīr—from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “No people have done”—and he mentioned it.
items.ma-19398: Sufyān narrated to us, Abū Yaʿfūr, ʿAbdī, a mawlā of theirs, narrated to us, he said: I went to Ibn Abī Awfā to ask him about locusts. He said: I fought six campaigns with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, eating locusts.
items.ma-19459: ʿAffān narrated to us, Hammām narrated to us, Qatādah informed us, from ʿAmr ibn Shuʿayb, from al-Sharīd ibn Suwayd al-Thaqafī, that the Prophet ﷺ said: “The neighbour of the house is more entitled to the house than anyone else.”
items.ma-19842: ʿAbd al-Razzāq narrated to us, Maʿmar informed us, from Qatādah, from Muṭarrif, he said: ʿImrān ibn Ḥuṣayn said to me—and he mentioned the like of it—and he said: Do not narrate the two of them until I die.
items.ma-19864: Hushaym narrated to us, from Yūnus, from al-Ḥasan, from ʿImrān ibn Ḥuṣayn, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade cauterization, but we cauterized, and they did not succeed and did not prosper.
items.ma-19943: ʿAbd al-Ṣamad narrated to us, Ḥājib ibn ʿUmar narrated to us, al-Ḥakam ibn al-Aʿraj narrated to us, that ʿImrān ibn Ḥuṣayn said: I have not touched my private part with my right hand since I pledged allegiance with it to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ.
items.ma-20055: Yazīd narrated to us, Bahz informed us, from his father, from his grandfather, he said: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: “Woe to the one who narrates and lies so that the people laugh by it; woe to him, woe to him.”
items.ma-20102: Yūnus ibn Muḥammad narrated to us, Sallām ibn Abī Muṭīʿ narrated to us, from Qatādah, from al-Ḥasan, from Samurah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Ḥasab is wealth, and nobility is taqwā.”
items.ma-20109: ʿAbd al-Ṣamad narrated to us, ʿUmar ibn Ibrāhīm narrated to us, Qatādah narrated to us, from al-Ḥasan, from Samurah, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “Whoever finds his goods, the very same item, with an insolvent person, he is more entitled to it.”
items.ma-20191: ʿAbd Allāh narrated to us, Khalaf ibn Hishām and ʿAbd al-Wāḥid ibn Ghiyāth narrated to us, both said: Abū ʿAwānah narrated to us, from al-Aswad ibn Qays, from Thaʿlabah, from Samurah, from the Prophet ﷺ, like it.
items.ma-20241: ʿAbd al-Ṣamad narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, Qatādah narrated to us, from al-Ḥasan, from Samurah ibn Jundub, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “The two parties to a sale have the choice as long as they have not separated.”
items.ma-20590: Abū Muʿāwiyah and ʿAbdah narrated to us, both said: ʿĀṣim narrated to us, from Abū al-ʿĀliyah, he said: One who heard the Prophet ﷺ say narrated to me: “Give every sūrah its share of bowing and prostration.”
items.ma-20626: Sulaymān ibn Dāwūd narrated to us, Jarīr narrated to us, from Yaʿlā ibn Ḥakīm, from Abū Labīd, from ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Samurah: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Whoever commits plunder is not of us.”
items.ma-21235: ʿAbd Allāh narrated to us, Abū Bakr ibn Abī Shaybah narrated to us, ʿĪsā ibn Yūnus narrated to us, from ʿAwf, from al-Ḥasan, from ʿUtayy, from Ubayy, from the Prophet ﷺ, like it.
items.ma-21251: Aḥmad ibn ʿAbd al-Malik narrated to us, ʿUbayd Allāh—meaning Ibn ʿAmr—narrated to us, ʿAbd Allāh ibn Muḥammad narrated to us, from al-Ṭufayl ibn Ubayy, from his father, from the Prophet ﷺ, like it.
items.ma-21583: Ismāʿīl narrated to us, Ayyūb narrated to us, from Nāfiʿ, he said: And Ibn ʿUmar said: Zayd ibn Thābit narrated to me: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ permitted the sale of the ʿarāyā by their estimate.
items.ma-21759: Hāshim ibn al-Qāsim narrated to us, al-Masʿūdī narrated to us, Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī Abū Jaʿfar narrated to us, from Usāmah ibn Zayd, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ prayed in the house.
items.ma-21869: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Mahdī narrated to us, Hishām narrated to us, from Ḥammād, from Ibrāhīm, from Abū ʿAbd Allāh al-Jadalī, from Khuzaymah ibn Thābit, from the Prophet ﷺ, like it.
items.ma-22010: Abū Kāmil narrated to us, Ḥammād ibn Zayd narrated to us, ʿAmr ibn Dīnār narrated to us, from Ṭāwūs, from Muʿādh ibn Jabal, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ did not command me anything concerning the awqāṣ of cattle.
items.ma-22047: Abū al-Mughīrah narrated to us, Abū Bakr narrated to us, ʿAṭiyyah ibn Qays narrated to me, from Muʿādh ibn Jabal, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Jihād is the pillar of Islam, and the summit of its hump.”
items.ma-22098: Bahz narrated to us, Hammām narrated to us, from Qatādah, from Anas, from Muʿādh, he said: I was riding behind the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and there was nothing between me and him except the back of the saddle—and he mentioned something similar.
items.ma-22147: ʿAffān narrated to us, Abān narrated to us, Yaḥyā ibn Abī Kathīr narrated to us, from Zayd, from Abū Sallām, from Abū Umāmah, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said—and he mentioned its meaning.
items.ma-22198: Aswad narrated to us, al-Ḥasan ibn Ṣāliḥ narrated to us, from Abū al-Muhallab, from ʿUbayd Allāh ibn Zaḥr, from ʿAlī ibn Yazīd—and he mentioned the hadith, and he tapped with his hand.
