items.ma-22858: Ḥusayn narrated to us, Muḥammad ibn Muṭarrif narrated to us, from Abū Ḥāzim, from Sahl ibn Saʿd, that he heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: “An evening journey in the way of Allah”—and he mentioned its meaning.
items.ma-23298: Abū Aḥmad al-Zubayrī narrated to us, Isrāʾīl narrated to us, from Abū Isḥāq, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Ghālib, from Ḥudhayfah, he said: The master of the children of Ādam on the Day of Resurrection is Muḥammad ﷺ.
items.ma-24001: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān narrated to us, from Muʿāwiyah, from Azhar ibn Saʿīd, from Dhū Kalāʿ, from ʿAwf ibn Mālik, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “The storytellers are three: a commander, or one commanded, or a conceited one.”
items.ma-24018: Hushaym narrated to us, he said: Mughīrah informed us, from Ibrāhīm, from al-Aswad, from ʿĀʾishah, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ permitted a household of the Anṣār to use ruqyah for everything with a sting.
items.ma-24043: Muḥammad ibn Fuḍayl narrated to us, he said: al-Aʿmash narrated to us, from Abū Ṣāliḥ, he said: ʿĀʾishah and Umm Salamah were asked: Which deed was most pleasing to the Prophet ﷺ? They both said: What is continued, even if little.
items.ma-24135: Sufyān narrated to us, from al-Aʿmash, from Ibrāhīm, from ʿUmārah, from an aunt of his, from ʿĀʾishah, from the Prophet ﷺ: “Indeed your children are among the best of your earnings, so eat from the earnings of your children.”
items.ma-24201: Ismāʿīl narrated to us, Isḥāq—meaning Ibn Suwayd—narrated to us, from Muʿādhah, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade the gourd, the ḥantam, the naqīr and the muzaffat.
items.ma-24237: Yaḥyā narrated to us, Hishām narrated to us, he said: My father narrated to me, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: The Prophet ﷺ was bewitched, so it would seem to him that he had done something when he had not done it.
items.ma-24292: Ibn Numayr narrated to us, Hishām narrated to us, from his father, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: The Prophet ﷺ said: “Seek Laylat al-Qadr in the last ten [nights] of Ramaḍān.”
items.ma-24445: Sulaymān narrated to us, he said: Ismāʿīl informed us, he said: Abū Suhayl informed me, from his father, from ʿĀʾishah, that the Prophet ﷺ said: “Seek Laylat al-Qadr in the odd [nights] of the ten.”
items.ma-24451: Isḥāq narrated to us, ʿAbd al-Raḥmān—meaning Ibn Abī al-Zinād—narrated to us, from Hishām ibn ʿUrwah, from his father, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: The bedding of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was of leather, and its stuffing was palm fibre.
items.ma-24553: Muḥammad ibn Muṣʿab narrated to us, he said: al-Awzāʿī narrated to us, from al-Zuhrī, from ʿUrwah, from ʿĀʾishah, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “Indeed Allah ﷿ Yuḥibbu gentleness in all matters.”
items.ma-24787: Aswad ibn ʿĀmir narrated to us, he said: Sharīk narrated to us, from al-Aʿmash Sulaymān, from Muslim, from Masrūq, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: The Prophet ﷺ sent sheep as a gift to the House.
items.ma-24789: Aswad narrated to us, he said: Shuʿbah narrated to us, from Ashʿath, from his father, from Masrūq, he said: I asked ʿĀʾishah about the prayer of the Prophet ﷺ at night. She said: When he heard the crier, he would rise and pray.
items.ma-24834: Abū Nuʿaym narrated to us, ʿAbd al-Wāḥid ibn Ayman narrated to us, he said: Ibn Abī Mulaykah narrated to me, from al-Qāsim, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ went out, he would draw lots between his wives.
items.ma-24889: Bahz narrated to us, Hammām narrated to us, from Qatādah, from Muʿādhah, she said: I asked ʿĀʾishah: How many [rakʿahs] did the Messenger of Allah ﷺ pray in the Ḍuḥā? She said: Four rakʿahs, and he would add whatever Allah willed.
items.ma-24894: ʿAffān narrated to us, he said: Abū ʿAwānah narrated to us, from ʿUmar ibn Abī Salamah, from his father, from ʿĀʾishah, that she said: When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saw that the wind had become intense, his face would change.
items.ma-25052: Wakīʿ narrated to us another time, he said: Sufyān narrated to us, from Ḥabīb, from ʿAṭāʾ, from ʿĀʾishah: that a garment of hers was stolen, so she supplicated against the one who had taken it, and he said: “Do not lighten [it] for him.”
items.ma-25242: Abū al-Naḍr narrated to us, Abū Muʿāwiyah—meaning Shaybān—narrated to us, from Layth, from ʿAṭāʾ, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “The cupper and the one cupped have broken the fast.”
items.ma-25277: Marwān ibn Muʿāwiyah al-Fazārī narrated to us, ʿĀṣim narrated to us, from Muʿādhah al-ʿAdawiyyah, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ and I used to perform ghusl from one vessel, and it was between the two of them.
items.ma-25289: Sufyān ibn ʿUyaynah narrated to us, ʿUthmān ibn ʿUrwah narrated to me, from ʿUrwah, from ʿĀʾishah, like it. Sufyān said: He said to me—meaning ʿUthmān ibn ʿUrwah—: Hishām reports it from me.
items.ma-25336: ʿAbd al-Razzāq narrated to us, Maʿmar narrated to us, from Ayyūb, from al-Qāsim ibn Muḥammad, from ʿĀʾishah: that the Prophet ﷺ, when he saw the rain, would say: “O Allah, a pouring rain, agreeable.”
items.ma-25512: ʿAlī narrated to us, he said: Khālid informed us, from Abū Qilābah, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: The maidens used to come out from their seclusion for the Messenger of Allah ﷺ at the two ʿĪds.
items.ma-25737: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Sufyān narrated to us, from Manṣūr and al-Aʿmash, from Ibrāhīm, from al-Aswad ibn Yazīd, from ʿĀʾishah: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ once sent sheep as a gift, garlanded.
items.ma-25749: Wakīʿ narrated to us, he said: Ḥammād ibn Salamah narrated to us, from al-Azraq ibn Qays, from Dhakwān, from ʿĀʾishah: that the Prophet ﷺ used to pray on the khumrah.
items.ma-25801: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān narrated to us, from Sufyān, from Manṣūr ibn Ṣafiyyah, from his mother, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ died, and we had been satisfied with the two black things: water and dates.
items.ma-25874: Abū Muʿāwiyah narrated to us, he said: al-Aʿmash narrated to us, from Ibrāhīm, from al-Aswad, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: It is as though I am looking at the gleam of perfume in the partings of the hair of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ while he was assuming iḥrām.
items.ma-25901: Abū Kāmil and ʿAffān narrated to us, both said: Ḥammād narrated to us, from Ḥumayd, from Bakr ibn ʿAbd Allāh, from Saʿd ibn Hishām, from ʿĀʾishah, from the Prophet ﷺ, like it.
items.ma-25933: Ibn Numayr narrated to us, from al-Aʿmash, from Ibrāhīm, from al-Aswad, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: I indeed saw the gleam of perfume on the head of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ while he was uttering the talbiyah.
items.ma-26024: Yazīd narrated to us, he said: Hishām ibn Ḥassān informed us, from Abū Maʿshar, from Ibrāhīm, from al-Aswad, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: I used to rub the semen off the garment of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ.
items.ma-26033: Yazīd narrated to us, from Ibrāhīm ibn Saʿd, he said: My father informed me, from al-Qāsim, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Whoever introduces into this matter of ours what is not from it, it is rejected.”
items.ma-26145: ʿAbd al-Malik ibn ʿAmr narrated to us, he said: Hishām narrated to us, from Yaḥyā, from Abū Salamah, from ʿUrwah, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: The Prophet ﷺ used to kiss me while he was fasting.
items.ma-26379: ʿĀmir ibn Ṣāliḥ narrated to us, he said: Hishām ibn ʿUrwah narrated to me, from his father, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: We would indeed slaughter a sheep, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ would send its limbs to the close friends of Khadījah.
items.ma-26544: Abū Qaṭan narrated to us, Yūnus—meaning Ibn Abī Isḥāq—narrated to us, from his father, from al-Aswad, from Umm Salamah, she said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ was not taken until most of his prayer was sitting.
items.ma-26553: Ḥammād ibn Masʿadah narrated to us, Maymūn ibn Mūsā al-Marʾī narrated to us, from al-Ḥasan, from his mother, from Umm Salamah: that the Prophet ﷺ used to pray two rakʿahs after the Witr while sitting.
items.ma-26554: ʿAffān narrated to us, Ḥammād ibn Salamah narrated to us, he said: ʿAlī ibn Zayd narrated to us, from Umm al-Ḥasan, that Umm Salamah narrated to them that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ measured a span for Fāṭimah from her waist-wrapper.
items.ma-26797: Sufyān narrated to us, from ʿAmr ibn Dīnār, from Abū al-Shaʿthāʾ Jābir—meaning Ibn Zayd—from Ibn ʿAbbās, from Maymūnah, she said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ and I used to perform ghusl from one vessel.
items.ma-26913: Sufyān narrated to us, from Hishām, from his father, from his mother, she said: My mother came to me, desirous, in the time of the treaty of Quraysh, and she was a polytheist, so I asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ: Shall I maintain ties with her? He said: “Yes.”
items.ma-26978: Yaḥyā ibn Saʿīd narrated to us, from Hishām, he said: Fāṭimah bint al-Mundhir narrated to me, from Asmāʾ, she said: We ate a horse of ours in the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ.
items.ma-27295: Yaḥyā ibn Saʿīd narrated to us, from Hishām, he said: My father narrated to me, that Busrah bint Ṣafwān informed him that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Whoever touches his male organ, let him not pray until he performs wuḍūʾ.”
items.ma-27335: Yaʿqūb narrated to us, he said: My father narrated to us, from Ibn Isḥāq, he said: And Muḥammad ibn Muslim al-Zuhrī mentioned, from Abū Salamah, from Fāṭimah bint Qays, the like of that.
items.ma-27619: Sufyān ibn ʿUyaynah narrated to us, from ʿAbd al-Ḥamīd ibn Jubayr ibn Shaybah, from Saʿīd ibn al-Musayyab, from Umm Sharīk, from the Prophet ﷺ: that he commanded her to kill the geckos.
items.ma-4330: ʿAffān narrated to us, Ḥammād narrated to us, from ʿĀṣim ibn Bahdalah, from Zirr ibn Ḥubaysh, from Ibn Masʿūd, he said: I took seventy sūrahs from the mouth of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and no one disputes with me concerning them.
items.ma-4341: Muʿāwiyah narrated to us, Zāʾidah narrated to us, ʿĀṣim ibn Abī al-Najūd narrated to us, from Zirr, from ʿAbd Allāh: that the Prophet ﷺ came to him between Abū Bakr and ʿUmar ﵄ … and he mentioned something like it.
items.ma-4485: Ismāʿīl narrated to us, Ayyūb informed us, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, that he used to narrate: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to visit it, riding and walking – meaning the mosque of Qubāʾ –.
items.ma-4579: Sufyān narrated to us, from Ayyūb, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ sent a detachment to Najd, and their shares reached twelve camels, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ granted us an additional share of a camel each.
items.ma-4687: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from Sufyān, Ibn Dīnār narrated to me, I heard Ibn ʿUmar, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “If one of you says to his brother: O disbeliever, then one of the two of them has indeed returned with it.”
items.ma-4706: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from ʿUbayd Allāh, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “When the slave is sincere to his master and performs the worship of his Rabb well, he has the reward twice.”
items.ma-4774: Wakīʿ narrated to us, al-ʿUmarī narrated to us, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “Indeed, among the best of your names are ʿAbd Allāh and ʿAbd al-Raḥmān.”
items.ma-4809: Yazīd narrated to us, Shuʿbah informed us, from Jabalah ibn Suḥaym, from Ibn ʿUmar, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade the ḥantamah. It was said: What is the ḥantamah? He said: The jar, meaning nabīdh.
items.ma-4885: ʿAbd al-Razzāq narrated to us, Mālik narrated to us, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Let none of you deliberately seek to pray at the rising of the sun, nor at its setting.”
items.ma-4896: ʿAbd al-Razzāq narrated to us, Maʿmar informed us, from Ayyūb, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar. And Mālik, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, from the Prophet ﷺ, the like of it.
items.ma-4999: Abū Muʿāwiyah narrated to us, ʿUbayd Allāh narrated to us, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ assigned three shares to the man and his horse: a share for him, and two shares for his horse.
items.ma-5155: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from Mūsā al-Juhanī, I heard Nāfiʿ, I heard Ibn ʿUmar, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “A prayer in my mosque is better than a thousand prayers in any other than it, except al-Masjid al-Ḥarām.”
items.ma-5280: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān narrated to us, Sufyān narrated to me, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Dīnār, I heard Ibn ʿUmar say: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ was asked about the spiny-tailed lizard, and he said: “I am not one who eats it, nor one who forbids it.”
items.ma-5289:
ʿAbd al-Raḥmān narrated to us, Mālik narrated to us, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar: that the Prophet ﷺ forbade the shighār.
Mālik said: The shighār is that he says: Give me your daughter in marriage, and I will give you my daughter in marriage.
items.ma-5312: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān narrated to us, from Mālik, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar: that a man performed liʿān against his wife and disowned her child, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ separated the two of them, and attached the child to its mother.
items.ma-5409: Abū Salamah narrated to us, Ḥammād ibn Salamah informed us, from Farqad al-Sabakhī, from Saʿīd ibn Jubayr, from Ibn ʿUmar: that the Prophet ﷺ anointed himself with oil that was not muqattat while he was in iḥrām.
items.ma-5445: ʿAffān narrated to us, ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz ibn Muslim narrated to us, ʿAbd Allāh ibn Dīnār narrated to us, from Ibn ʿUmar: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade the sale of fruit until its soundness becomes apparent.
items.ma-5447: ʿAffān narrated to us, Wuhayb narrated to us, ʿUbayd Allāh narrated to us, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to pray on his mount in whatever direction it faced with him.
items.ma-5473: Yazīd narrated to us, Yaḥyā ibn Saʿīd informed us, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Do not trade in fruit until its soundness becomes apparent.”
items.ma-5482: Muḥammad – meaning Ibn Jaʿfar – narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, from al-Ḥakam, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, he said: The Prophet ﷺ delivered a sermon, and said: “When one of you goes out to the Jumuʿah, let him perform ghusl.”
items.ma-5522: ʿAbd al-Razzāq narrated to us, Sufyān informed us, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Dīnār, from Ibn ʿUmar, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to come to the mosque of Qubāʾ riding and walking.
items.ma-5609: Abū Kāmil narrated to us, Ḥammād informed us, Anas ibn Sīrīn narrated to us, from Ibn ʿUmar: that the Prophet ﷺ used to pray the two rakʿahs before the Fajr prayer as if the adhān were in his ears.
items.ma-5619: ʿAbd al-Razzāq narrated to us, Maʿmar narrated to us, from al-Zuhrī, from Sālim, from Ibn ʿUmar, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “You will find people like a hundred camels, among which a man does not find a single riding camel.”
items.ma-5831: ʿAlī ibn Isḥāq narrated to us, ʿAbd Allāh informed us, Mūsā ibn ʿUqbah informed us, from Sālim and Nāfiʿ, from ʿAbd Allāh: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to.. and he mentioned the like of it.
items.ma-5845: Wakīʿ narrated to us, al-ʿUmarī narrated to us, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Whoever drinks wine in the world will not drink it in the Hereafter.”
items.ma-5914: Muʾammal narrated to us, Sufyān narrated to us, ʿAbd Allāh ibn Dīnār narrated to us, I heard Ibn ʿUmar say: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Whoever says to his brother: O disbeliever, then one of the two of them has indeed returned with it.”
items.ma-5917: Isḥāq narrated to us, Mālik narrated to us, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade wiṣāl. So it was said: Do you not practise wiṣāl? He said: “Indeed, I am fed and given to drink.”
items.ma-6018: Wakīʿ narrated to us, from Ismāʿīl ibn ʿAbd al-Malik, from Ḥabīb ibn Abī Thābit, he said: I went out with my father to meet the pilgrims, and we would greet them with salām before they became soiled.
items.ma-6182: Yaʿqūb narrated to us, ʿĀṣim ibn Muḥammad narrated to us, from his brother ʿUmar ibn Muḥammad, from Sālim, from Ibn ʿUmar, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Indeed, the dead person is punished by the weeping of the living.”
items.ma-6381: ʿAbd al-Razzāq narrated to us, Maʿmar narrated to us, from Ayyūb, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Whoever carries weapons against us is not of us.”
items.ma-6687: Ibn Idrīs narrated to us, Ibn Isḥāq narrated to us, from ʿAmr ibn Shuʿayb, from his father, from his grandfather: that the value of a shield in the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was ten dirhams.
items.ma-6693: Yazīd narrated to us, Ḥajjāj informed us, from ʿAmr ibn Shuʿayb, from his father, from his grandfather, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Indeed, Allah ﷿ has increased you by a prayer, and it is the witr.”
items.ma-6844: Rawḥ narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, ʿĀmir al-Aḥwal narrated to us, from ʿAmr ibn Shuʿayb, from his father, from his grandfather, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “The people of two religions, different from one another, do not inherit from each other.”
items.ma-6941: Yazīd ibn Hārūn narrated to us, al-Ḥajjāj ibn Arṭāh informed us, from ʿAmr ibn Shuʿayb, from his father, from his grandfather, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Indeed, Allah ﷿ has increased you by a prayer, and it is the witr.”
items.ma-6956: Rawḥ narrated to us, Ḥammād narrated to us, from Qatādah, from Shahr ibn Ḥawshab, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿAmr, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “The one who is killed [in defence of] his property is a shahīd.”
items.ma-7253: Sufyān narrated to us, from al-Zuhrī, from Saʿīd, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ: “A prayer in my mosque is better than a thousand prayers in any other than it, except al-Masjid al-Ḥarām.”
items.ma-7265: Sufyān narrated to us, from al-Zuhrī, from Saʿīd, from Abū Hurayrah, conveying it to the Prophet ﷺ: “There is no Muslim of whom three of his children die and who then enters the Fire, except for the release of the oath.”
items.ma-7532: ʿAbd al-Wahhāb al-Thaqafī narrated to us, Ayyūb narrated to us, from Muḥammad, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ: “Name yourselves by my name, but do not take my kunyah.”
items.ma-7550: Yaʿlā narrated to us, al-Aʿmash narrated to us, from Abū Ṣāliḥ, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Tasbīḥ is for the men, and clapping is for the women.”
items.ma-8042: Abū Kāmil narrated to us, Ḥammād narrated to us, Muḥammad ibn ʿAmr informed us, from Abū Salamah, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “The two sons of al-ʿĀṣ are believers: ʿAmr and Hishām.”
items.ma-8287: Abū ʿĀmir narrated to us, ʿAbd Allāh narrated to us, from ʿUthmān ibn Muḥammad, from al-Maqburī, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah cursed al-muḥill and al-muḥallal lahu.
items.ma-8331: Yaḥyā ibn Ḥammād narrated to us, Abū ʿAwānah narrated to us, from al-Aʿmash, from Abū Ṣāliḥ, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “Most of the punishment of the grave is in urine.”
items.ma-8572: ʿAffān narrated to us, Hammām narrated to us, he said: Muḥammad ibn Wāsiʿ narrated to us, from a man called Maʿrūf, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: My intimate friend ﷺ enjoined me not to sleep except upon a witr.
items.ma-8759: ʿAbd al-Ṣamad narrated to us, ʿUmar ibn Rāshid narrated to us, Abū Kathīr narrated to us, from Abū Hurayrah: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade that fruit be sold until its soundness becomes apparent.
items.ma-8854: Sulaymān ibn Dāwud narrated to us, Ismāʿīl informed us, al-ʿAlāʾ informed me, from his father, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Whoever sends ṣalāh upon me once, Allah sends ṣalāh upon him ten [times].”
items.ma-8921: Qutaybah narrated to us, ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz narrated to us, from Suhayl, from his father, from Abū Hurayrah, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “This fire is one part out of a hundred parts of Jahannam.”
items.ma-8928: Qutaybah narrated to us, Layth narrated to us, from ʿUqayl, from al-Zuhrī, from Ibn al-Musayyib, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “A believer is not stung from one hole twice.”
items.ma-8969: Muḥammad ibn Jaʿfar narrated to us, he said: Shuʿbah narrated to us, he said: I heard Muḥammad ibn Juḥādah narrating from Abū Ḥāzim, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ: that he forbade the earnings of slave-women.
items.ma-8998: ʿAlī narrated to us, Muʿādh narrated to us, he said: My father narrated to me, from Qatādah, from Zurārah ibn Awfā, from Abū Hurayrah, that the Prophet ﷺ said: “The angels do not accompany a company in which there is a bell.”
items.ma-9251: Khalaf narrated to us, he said: Abū Maʿshar narrated to us, from Saʿīd, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ: “Whoever is granted a long life of sixty years or seventy years, excuses have indeed been made to him with regard to [his] lifespan.”
items.ma-9409: And he said: “The best day on which the sun has risen is the day of Jumuʿah; on it Ādam was created, and on it he was admitted to Paradise, and on it he was expelled from it, and the Hour will not be established except on the day of Jumuʿah.”
items.ma-9411: And he said: “The head of kufr is toward the east, and boasting and arrogance are among the owners of horses and camels, the loud-voiced ones, the people of camel-hair, and tranquillity is among the owners of sheep.”
items.ma-9478-1: And likewise Aswad narrated it to us, he said: Sharīk narrated to us, from al-Aʿmash, from Abū Ṣāliḥ, from Abū Hurayrah, as Muḥammad said: “Guide the imāms rightly, and forgive the muʾadhdhins.”
items.ma-9577: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from Ibn ʿAjlān, from his father, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “If you knew what I know, you would laugh little and weep much.”
items.ma-9681: Muḥammad ibn ʿUbayd narrated to us, he said: al-Aʿmash narrated to us, from Abū Ṣāliḥ, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Tasbīḥ is for the men, and clapping is for the women.”
items.ma-9701: Marwān al-Fazārī narrated to us, he said: Ṣabīḥ Abū al-Malīḥ informed us, he said: I heard Abū Ṣāliḥ narrating from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Whoever does not ask Him, Yaghḍab ʿalayhi.”
items.ma-10191: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Dāwud ibn Qays narrated to us, from Mūsā ibn Yasār, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Name yourselves by my name, but do not take my kunyah.”
items.ma-10206: Wakīʿ narrated to us, he said: Sufyān narrated to us, from Suhayl ibn Abī Ṣāliḥ, from al-Ḥārith ibn Makhlad, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Cursed is the one who approaches a woman in her rear.”
items.ma-10367: Muḥammad ibn Jaʿfar narrated to us, he said: Hishām narrated to us, from Muḥammad, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “Do not revile al-Dahr, for Allah is al-Dahr.”
items.ma-10368: Muḥammad ibn Jaʿfar narrated to us, he said: Hishām narrated to us, from Muḥammad, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ: that he said: “Let none of you say: My slave, my slave-woman; let him say: My young man and my young woman.”
items.ma-10386: Muḥammad ibn Jaʿfar narrated to us, ʿAwf narrated to us, from al-Ḥasan, he said: It reached me that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ ruled that the child belongs to the owner of the bed, and in the mouth of the adulterer is the stone.
items.ma-10503: Yazīd narrated to us, Muḥammad ibn ʿAmr informed us, from Abū Salamah, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ was asked: Does a man pray in a single garment? He said: “Does each of you have two garments?”
items.ma-10514: Yazīd narrated to us, Muḥammad ibn ʿAmr informed us, from Abū Salamah, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “The heart of the old man remains young in the love of two: the love of life and the love of wealth.”
items.ma-10744: Shuʿayb ibn Ḥarb Abū Ṣāliḥ narrated to us, he said: I heard Mālik ibn Anas, and he mentioned Sufyān al-Thawrī, and said: Indeed, he parted from me on the understanding that he does not drink nabīdh.
items.ma-10860: ʿAlī narrated to us, Warqāʾ informed us, from Abū al-Zinād, from al-Aʿraj, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “The Hour will not be established until you fight a people whose sandals are of hair.”
items.ma-10905: Muʾammal narrated to us, Ḥammād narrated to us, ʿAmmār ibn Abī ʿAmmār narrated to us, he said: I heard Abū Hurayrah say: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “The Angel of Death ﵇ was” and he mentioned it.
items.ma-10907: Rawḥ narrated to us, Hishām narrated to us, from Muḥammad, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “The right of hospitality is three days, and whatever he receives after that is ṣadaqah.”
items.ma-11166: Muḥammad ibn Jaʿfar narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, from Khālid, from ʿIkrimah, from Abū Saʿīd al-Khudrī, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to ʿAmmār: “The transgressing group will kill him.”
items.ma-11221: Sulaymān ibn Dāwud narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, from ʿAmr ibn Dīnār, from Abū Hishām, from Abū Saʿīd al-Khudrī, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to ʿAmmār: “The transgressing group will kill you.”
items.ma-11350: Muʿāwiyah ibn Hishām narrated to us, Shaybān narrated to us, from Firās, from ʿAṭiyyah, from Abū Saʿīd, from the Prophet of Allah ﷺ, he said: “Whoever lies about me deliberately, indeed he has a house in the Fire.”
items.ma-11430: Surayj narrated to us, Fulayḥ narrated to us, from Suhayl, from his father, from Abū Saʿīd, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Gold for gold, silver for silver, and do not favour some of it over others.”
items.ma-11497: Yaḥyā ibn Saʿīd narrated to us, from al-Aʿmash, he said: I heard Abū Ṣāliḥ, from Abū Saʿīd, from the Prophet ﷺ [that he said]: “The intensity of the heat is from the blast of Jahannam, so observe coolness with the prayer.”
items.ma-11671: Yaḥyā ibn Isḥāq narrated to us, Ibn Lahīʿah narrated to us, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Hubayrah, from Ḥanash, he said: I heard Abū Saʿīd al-Khudrī say: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ led us in prayer, and he mentioned it.
items.ma-11856: Mūsā narrated to us, Ibn Lahīʿah informed us, from Abū al-Zubayr, from Jābir, that Abū Saʿīd informed him that he heard the Prophet ﷺ say: “Some people will soon come out of the Fire” and he mentioned it.
items.ma-11891: Isḥāq ibn Sulaymān narrated to us, he said: I heard Mālik ibn Anas, from al-Zuhrī, from ʿAṭāʾ ibn Yazīd al-Laythī, from Abū Saʿīd al-Khudrī, and he mentioned the like of its meaning.
items.ma-11922: ʿAffān narrated to us, Hammām narrated to us, Qatādah informed us, from Abū Naḍrah, from Abū Saʿīd al-Khudrī, he said: Our Prophet ﷺ commanded us to recite the Opening of the Book and whatever is easy.
items.ma-11964: Muʿtamir narrated to us, from Ḥumayd, from Anas: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “If a morsel of one of you falls, let him take it, and wipe off the dirt that is on it, and not leave it for Shayṭān.”
items.ma-12138: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from Ḥumayd, he said: Anas was asked about the sale of fruit, and he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade the sale of the fruit of the date palm until it tazhū. It was said to Anas: What is tazhū? He said: It turns red.
items.ma-12149: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from Shuʿbah, Qatādah narrated to us, from Anas, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “Be moderate in prostration, and let none of you spread out his forearms like the spreading of the dog.”
items.ma-12356: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Mahdī narrated to us, ʿAzrah narrated to us, from Thumāmah ibn ʿAbd Allāh, that Anas used not to refuse perfume. He said: And Anas claimed that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used not to refuse perfume.
items.ma-12462: Ḥasan ibn Mūsā narrated to us, Ḥammād ibn Salamah narrated to us, from Thābit, Ḥumayd and Yūnus, from al-Ḥasan, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “The likeness of my ummah” and he mentioned it.
items.ma-12466: Yūnus narrated to us, Abān – meaning Ibn Yazīd al-ʿAṭṭār – narrated to us, from Qatādah, from Anas ibn Mālik: that he saw the Prophet ﷺ slaughter his sacrificial animal with his hand, and he used to say the takbīr over it.
items.ma-12554: Ḥasan ibn Mūsā narrated to us, Ḥammād ibn Salamah narrated to us, from Thābit, from Anas: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ sought rain, and he pointed with the backs of his palms toward the sky.
items.ma-12734: Muḥammad ibn Jaʿfar and Asbāṭ narrated to us, they said: Saʿīd narrated to us, from Qatādah, from Anas, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ was among the lightest of people in prayer while [it was] complete.
items.ma-12756: Muḥammad ibn Jaʿfar narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, from Muʿāwiyah ibn Qurrah, from Anas ibn Mālik, from the Prophet ﷺ: that he said: “The son of the sister of a people is of them.”
items.ma-12787: Muʾammal narrated to us, Ḥammād narrated to us, from Thābit and Ḥumayd, from Anas, he said: The Prophet ﷺ liked gourd, so when broth containing gourd was brought, the gourd was placed on the side nearest him.
items.ma-12816: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān narrated to us, from Sufyān, from ʿAmr ibn ʿĀmir, he said: I heard Anas say: The Prophet ﷺ used to have himself cupped, and he would not wrong anyone of his wage.
items.ma-13059: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid narrated to us, from Ḥumayd, from Anas, he said: We used to pray the Maghrib prayer with the Prophet of Allah ﷺ, then a man would go off to Banū Salimah while he could see where his arrow fell.
items.ma-13081: Yazīd narrated to us, Ḥumayd informed us, from Anas, that the Prophet ﷺ said: “Indeed, the Dajjāl is wiped out in the left eye, over it is a growth, written between his eyes: kāfir.”
items.ma-13090: Yazīd narrated to us, Shuʿbah informed us, from Qatādah, from Anas, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ passed by a man who was driving a sacrificial camel. He said: “Ride it.” He said: It is a sacrificial camel! He said: “Ride it, woe to you.”
items.ma-13135: Ibn Abī ʿAdī narrated to us, from Ḥumayd, from Anas: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ loved that the Muhājirūn and the Anṣār be next to him in the prayer, so that they would memorise from him.
items.ma-13153: Rawḥ narrated to us, Ashʿath narrated to us, from al-Ḥasan, from Anas ibn Mālik: that the Prophet ﷺ prayed the Ẓuhr prayer, then mounted his riding camel, and when he ascended the mountain of al-Baydāʾ, he raised the talbiyah.
items.ma-13183: ʿUthmān ibn ʿUmar narrated to us, he said: Yūnus informed us, from al-Zuhrī, from Anas: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ took a ring of silver that had an Abyssinian bezel, and he engraved it: Muḥammad is the Messenger of Allah.
items.ma-13353: Bishr ibn Shuʿayb narrated to us, he said: My father narrated to me, from al-Zuhrī, he said: Anas ibn Mālik informed me that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Indeed, in my Ḥawḍ are jugs equal in number to the stars of the sky.”
items.ma-13458: ʿAbd al-Wahhāb narrated to us, from Saʿīd, from Qatādah, from Anas ibn Mālik, that the Prophet of Allah ﷺ used to say: “Indeed, in Paradise is a tree in whose shade a rider travels for a hundred years without crossing it.”
items.ma-13614: ʿAffān narrated to us, Bishr ibn al-Mufaḍḍal narrated to us, Ḥumayd narrated to us, from Anas; he said: I did not hear him narrate a ḥadīth from the Prophet ﷺ except that he said: Or as the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said.
items.ma-13649: ʿAffān narrated to us, Ḥammād narrated to us, he said: Thābit al-Bunānī informed us, from Anas ibn Mālik: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said on the day of Uḥud: “O Allah, if You will, You will not be worshipped on the earth.”
items.ma-13739: Ḥusayn narrated to us, Shaybān narrated to us, from Qatādah, Anas ibn Mālik narrated to us: that the Prophet ﷺ, when he was taken up to the heaven, said: “I came upon Idrīs in the fourth heaven.”
items.ma-13845: ʿAffān and Bahz narrated to us, they said: Hammām narrated to us, from Qatādah – Bahz said: Qatādah narrated to us –, from Anas: that the sandal of the Prophet ﷺ had two straps.
items.ma-13864: ʿAffān narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, from Qatādah, from Anas ibn Mālik: that ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn ʿAwf married a woman of the Anṣār for the weight of a date-stone in gold. He said: And that was permitted.
items.ma-13901: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, from Qatādah, from Anas ibn Mālik, that the Prophet ﷺ said: “Complete your rows, for the straightening of the row – meaning – is part of the completion of the prayer.”
items.ma-13932: Rawḥ narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, from Qatādah, from Anas, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Every prophet has a supplication with which he has supplicated for his ummah, and I have kept my supplication in reserve as an intercession for my ummah.”
items.ma-14320: Sufyān narrated to us, from Ḥumayd al-Aʿraj, from Sulaymān ibn ʿAtīq, a Makkan, from Jābir: that the Prophet ﷺ forbade the sale of years, and waived the jawāʾiḥ.
items.ma-14379: Abū Muʿāwiyah narrated to us, al-Aʿmash narrated to us, from Abū Sufyān, from Jābir, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ sent a physician to Ubayy ibn Kaʿb, and he cut a vein for him, then cauterised it over him.
items.ma-14540: Yaḥyā ibn Ādam narrated to us, Quṭbah narrated to us, from al-Aʿmash, from Abū Sufyān, from Jābir, he said: The Prophet ﷺ said: “When you fumigate the dead person, fumigate him three times.”
items.ma-14645: Aswad narrated to us, Isrāʾīl narrated to us, from Jābir, from Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī, from Jābir ibn ʿAbd Allāh, he said: We went on a military expedition with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and we obtained locusts, and ate them.
items.ma-14666: Ḥasan narrated to us, Ibn Lahīʿah narrated to us, from Abū al-Zubayr, from Jābir, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “On what the sky and the springs water is the ʿushr, and on what the draw-camel waters is half the ʿushr.”
items.ma-14749: Mūsā narrated to us, Ibn Lahīʿah narrated to us, from Abū al-Zubayr, that he said: I asked Jābir: Did the Messenger of Allah ﷺ combine the Maghrib and the ʿIshāʾ? He said: Yes, at the time of our expedition against Banū al-Muṣṭaliq.
items.ma-15094: Yazīd narrated to us, al-Ḥajjāj informed us, from Abū al-Zubayr, from Jābir: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said regarding animals, two for one: “There is no harm in it hand to hand, and there is no good in it with delay.”
items.ma-15155: Ḥasan narrated to us, Ibn Lahīʿah narrated to us, Abū al-Zubayr narrated to us, he said: I asked Jābir: How many times did the Messenger of Allah ﷺ perform ṭawāf between al-Ṣafā and al-Marwah? He said: Once.
items.ma-15218: ʿAbd al-Razzāq narrated to us, Sufyān informed us, from Abū al-Zubayr, from Jābir, that the Prophet ﷺ said: “The disbeliever eats in seven intestines, and the believer eats in one intestine.”
items.ma-15366: Yaḥyā ibn Saʿīd narrated to us, from Shuʿbah, Qatādah narrated to us, from Zurārah, from ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Abzā: that the Prophet ﷺ used to pray the witr with {Glorify the name of your Rabb, al-Aʿlā}.
items.ma-15510: Khalaf ibn al-Walīd narrated to us, Ayyūb ibn ʿUtbah narrated to us, from Yaḥyā ibn Abī Kathīr, from Abū Salamah, from Muʿayqīb, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Woe to the heels from the Fire.”
items.ma-15644: Ḥasan narrated to us, Ibn Lahīʿah narrated to us, Zabbān narrated to us, from Sahl, from his father, from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ: that he said: “Indeed, the safe one is he from whose hand and tongue the people are safe.”
items.ma-15688: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from Sufyān, from ʿĀṣim ibn ʿUbayd Allāh, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿĀmir ibn Rabīʿah, from his father, he said: I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ use the siwāk more times than I can count or number, while he was fasting.
items.ma-15865: Yaḥyā ibn Ādam narrated to us, he said: Sufyān narrated to us, from Abū Isḥāq, from a man of Juhaynah, he said: The Prophet ﷺ heard him saying: O Ḥarām, so he said: “O Ḥalāl.”
items.ma-16249: ʿAffān narrated to us, he said: Shuʿbah narrated to us, from Muʿāwiyah ibn Qurrah, from his father, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said regarding fasting three days of the month: “It is the fasting of all time and its breaking of the fast.”
items.ma-16447: Muʿtamir ibn Sulaymān narrated to us, from Maʿmar, from al-Zuhrī, from ʿAbbād ibn Tamīm, from his uncle, he said: I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ placing one of his legs upon the other.
items.ma-16492: Wakīʿ narrated to us, he said: Abū ʿUmays narrated to us, from Iyās ibn Salamah, from his father, he said: I engaged a man in single combat and killed him, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ granted me his salab as an additional share.
items.ma-16680: He said: And I gave the Messenger of Allah ﷺ a wild donkey as a gift while he was in iḥrām, and he returned it to me, and that was noticed in my face, and he said: “We returned it to you only because we are in iḥrām.”
items.ma-16900: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Sufyān narrated to us, from Jābir, from ʿAmr ibn Yaḥyā, from Muʿāwiyah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ cursed those who split speech the way poetry is split.
items.ma-16912: And I heard him say: “A group from my ummah will not cease to be prevailing upon the truth; whoever opposes them will not harm them until the command of Allah comes while they are prevailing over the people.”
items.ma-16916: Rawḥ narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, from Abū al-Fayḍ, from Muʿāwiyah ibn Abī Sufyān, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “Whoever lies about me deliberately, let him take his seat in the Fire.”
items.ma-17568: ʿAffān narrated to us, Wuhayb narrated to us, ʿAṭāʾ ibn al-Sāʾib narrated to us, from Yaʿlā ibn Murrah al-Thaqafī, he said: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: “Allah said: Do not mutilate My servants.”
items.ma-17580: Yaʿlā and Muḥammad, the two sons of ʿUbayd, narrated to us, they said: Ismāʿīl narrated to us, from Qays, from Dukayn ibn Saʿīd al-Muzanī, he said: We came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and he mentioned the ḥadīth.
items.ma-17688: Hishām ibn Saʿīd narrated to us, he said: al-Ḥasan ibn Ayyūb al-Ḥaḍramī narrated to me, he said: ʿAbd Allāh ibn Busr narrated to me, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to accept a gift, and would not accept ṣadaqah.
items.ma-17747: Yaʿqūb narrated to us, he said: My father narrated to us, from Ṣāliḥ, and Ibn Shihāb narrated to me that Abū Idrīs informed him that Abū Thaʿlabah said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ prohibited the meat of domestic donkeys.
items.ma-17875: Hushaym narrated to us, Yūnus narrated to us, from Ibn Sīrīn, from Salmān ibn ʿĀmir al-Ḍabbī, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “With the boy is his ʿaqīqah; shed blood on his behalf, and remove the harm from him.”
items.ma-17973: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Hishām narrated to us, from his father, from ʿUbayd Allāh, he said: Two men narrated to me: that they came to the Prophet ﷺ during the Farewell Ḥajj, he said: So he raised [his gaze] over the two of them, and he mentioned the ḥadīth.
items.ma-18108: ʿAffān narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, al-Ḥakam informed me, he said: I heard ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Abī Laylā say: Kaʿb ibn ʿUjrah met me … and he mentioned the ḥadīth.
items.ma-18286: Aswad ibn ʿĀmir narrated to us, Sharīk narrated to us, from Ismāʿīl, from ʿAṭāʾ, from ʿĀmir ibn Shahr, he said: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: “Take the word of Quraysh and leave their deed.”
items.ma-18487: Hushaym narrated to us, from Yazīd ibn Abī Ziyād, from ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Abī Laylā, from al-Barāʾ ibn ʿĀzib, he said: I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, when he began the prayer, raise his hands.
items.ma-18607: Maʿmar ibn Sulaymān al-Raqqī narrated to us, al-Ḥajjāj narrated to us, from Abū Isḥāq, from al-Barāʾ ibn ʿĀzib, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ was asked about the kalālah, and he said: “The verse of the summer is sufficient for you.”
items.ma-18700: Yaʿlā narrated to us, al-Ajlaḥ narrated to us, from Abū Isḥāq, from al-Barāʾ ibn ʿĀzib, he said: I never saw a man more handsome than the Messenger of Allah ﷺ in a red ḥullah.
items.ma-18919: Abū Muʿāwiyah narrated to us, Hishām narrated to us, from his father, from ʿĀṣim ibn ʿUmar, from al-Miswar ibn Makhramah, he said: Subayʿah gave birth, and he mentioned the ḥadīth.
items.ma-19132: Yazīd narrated to us, Misʿar informed us, from Ziyād ibn Fayyāḍ, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Abī Awfā, he said: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: “O Allah, to You is praise, abundant, good, and blessed therein.”
items.ma-19178: Muʿāwiyah ibn ʿAmr narrated to us, Zāʾidah narrated to us, Bayān narrated to us, from Qays, from Jarīr, he said: The Prophet ﷺ has not kept me out since I became Muslim, and he did not see me except that he smiled.
items.ma-19241: Abū Aḥmad narrated to us, Isrāʾīl narrated to us, from Abū Isḥāq, from his father, from Jarīr, he said: I heard the Prophet ﷺ say: “Whoever does not show mercy to the people, Lā yarḥamhu Allāh ﷿.”
items.ma-19296: ʿAbd Allāh said: ʿUbayd Allāh ibn Muʿādh narrated to us, my father narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, from al-Ḥakam, from Muḥammad ibn Kaʿb al-Qurāẓī, from Zayd ibn Arqam, from the Prophet ﷺ, the like of it.
items.ma-19422: Sufyān narrated to us, from ʿAbd al-Malik, that he heard ʿAṭiyyah say: I was a boy on the day Saʿd judged concerning them, and they did not find me to have grown [hair], so here I am in your midst.
items.ma-19474: Hushaym ibn Bashīr narrated to us, from Yaʿlā ibn ʿAṭāʾ, from ʿAmr ibn al-Sharīd, from his father, he said: In the delegation of Thaqīf there was a man with leprosy, so the Prophet ﷺ sent to him: “Return, for I have pledged [allegiance] with you.”
items.ma-19855: Muḥammad ibn Jaʿfar narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, from Abū Qazaʿah, from al-Ḥasan, from ʿImrān ibn Ḥuṣayn, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “No jalab, no janab, and no shighār.”
items.ma-19940: ʿAffān narrated to us, Ḥammād narrated to us, Ḥumayd informed us, from al-Ḥasan, from ʿImrān ibn Ḥuṣayn, he said: We performed tamattuʿ in the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and he did not forbid us from it, and no prohibition concerning it was revealed.
items.ma-20018: Abū Kāmil narrated to us, from Ḥammād, Abū Qazaʿah narrated to us, from Ḥakīm ibn Muʿāwiyah, from his father, he said: The Prophet ﷺ said: “Indeed, Allah does not accept the repentance of a servant who committed kufr after his Islām.”
items.ma-20049: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from Bahz, my father narrated to me, from my grandfather, he said: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: “Indeed, you complete seventy ummahs; you are the last of them and the most honoured of them with Allah.”
items.ma-20105: ʿAlī ibn ʿĀṣim narrated to us, from Khālid al-Ḥadhdhāʾ, from Abū Qilābah, from Samurah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Wear the white of your garments, and shroud your dead in them.”
items.ma-20170: Muʿādh ibn Hishām narrated to us, my father narrated to me, from Qatādah, from al-Ḥasan, from Samurah, he said: The sky [rain] struck us while we were with the Prophet of Allah ﷺ, and he called out: “Prayer is in the riḥāl.”
items.ma-20176: Muḥammad ibn Salamah narrated to us, from Muḥammad ibn Isḥāq, from Muḥammad ibn ʿAmr ibn ʿAṭāʾ, he said: ʿAlī ibn Ḥusayn said to me: The name of Jibrīl ﵇ is ʿAbd Allāh, and the name of Mīkāʾīl ﵇ is ʿUbayd Allāh.
items.ma-20211: Sulaymān ibn Dāwud narrated to us, Hishām narrated to us, from Qatādah, from al-Ḥasan, from Samurah ibn Jundub: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ commanded his caller, and he called out on a rainy day: Prayer is in the riḥāl.
items.ma-20238: Muḥammad ibn Bishr narrated to us, Saʿīd ibn Abī ʿArūbah narrated to us, from Qatādah, from al-Ḥasan, from Samurah: that the Prophet of Allah ﷺ said: “Whoever builds a wall around a piece of land, it is his.”
items.ma-20264: ʿAffān narrated to us, Ḥammād narrated to us, Qatādah informed us, from al-Ḥasan, from Samurah: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade the sale of an animal for an animal with delay.
items.ma-20676: Aswad ibn ʿĀmir narrated to us, Jarīr narrated to us, from al-Ḥasan, from ʿAmr ibn Taghlib, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Indeed, among the signs of the Hour is that you fight peoples who put on sandals of hair.”
items.ma-20713: Yaḥyā ibn Saʿīd narrated to us, from Shuʿbah, Qatādah narrated to us, from Abū al-Malīḥ, from his father: that rain struck them at Ḥunayn, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Pray in the riḥāl.”
items.ma-20868: Bahz and Abū Kāmil narrated to us, they said: Ḥammād ibn Salamah narrated to us, from Simāk – Abū Kāmil said: Simāk informed us – from Jābir ibn Samurah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to deliver the sermon standing.
items.ma-21655: ʿAbd al-Aʿlā narrated to us, from Maʿmar, from al-Zuhrī, from Khārijah ibn Zayd, from Zayd ibn Thābit, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Perform wuḍūʾ from what the fire has touched.”
items.ma-22031: Rawḥ narrated to us, al-Ḥajjāj al-Aswad narrated to us, from Shahr ibn Ḥawshab, from Muʿādh ibn Jabal, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Those who love one another for [the sake of] Allah are in the shade of the ʿArsh on the Day of Resurrection.”
items.ma-22113: Muḥammad ibn Jaʿfar narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, from Qatādah, from Qays, from Muʿādh, from the Prophet ﷺ: that he said: “Whoever frees a believing slave, it is his ransom from the Fire.”
items.ma-22176: Ḥusayn narrated to us, Shaybān narrated to us, from Qatādah, he said: Shahr ibn Ḥawshab narrated, from Abū Umāmah, he said: A man of the People of the Ṣuffah died, and he mentioned the like of it.
items.ma-22295: ʿAbd Allāh narrated to us, Yaḥyā ibn Maʿīn narrated to us, Ismāʿīl ibn ʿAyyāsh narrated to us, from Shuraḥbīl, from Abū Umāmah, from the Prophet ﷺ: “The guarantor is a debtor.”
items.ma-22577: Ibn Mahdī narrated to us, Ḥammād ibn Zayd narrated to us, from Thābit, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Rabāḥ, from Abū Qatādah, that the Prophet ﷺ said: “The one who serves drink to the people is the last of them.”
items.ma-23088: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Misʿar narrated to us, from ʿAmr ibn Murrah, from Sālim ibn Abī al-Jaʿd, from a man of Aslam, that the Prophet ﷺ said: “O Bilāl, give us rest with the prayer.”
items.ma-23257: Muḥammad ibn Jaʿfar narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, from Sulaymān, he said: I heard Zayd ibn Wahb narrating from Ḥudhayfah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ narrated to us two ḥadīths, and he mentioned the ḥadīth.
items.ma-23313: Muʿāwiyah ibn ʿAmr narrated to us, Zāʾidah narrated to us, from Ḥuṣayn, from Shaqīq, he said: I heard Ḥudhayfah say: When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ rose for tahajjud, he would scour his mouth with the siwāk.
items.ma-23837: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Yaḥyā ibn Abī al-Haytham al-ʿAṭṭār narrated to us, he said: I heard Yūsuf ibn ʿAbd Allāh ibn Salām say: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ named me, and wiped over my head.
items.ma-24134: Sufyān narrated to us, he said: I saw the gleam of perfume – and it was read to Sufyān: I heard ʿAṭāʾ ibn al-Sāʾib, from Ibrāhīm, from al-Aswad, from ʿĀʾishah – in the parting of the hair of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ after three.
items.ma-24151: Abū Muʿāwiyah narrated to us, al-Aʿmash narrated to us, from Ibrāhīm, from al-Aswad, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: The Messenger of Allah was not satisfied with wheat bread for three days in succession, until he went on his way.
items.ma-24155: Abū Muʿāwiyah narrated to us, al-Aʿmash narrated to us, from Ibrāhīm, from al-Aswad, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ once presented sheep to the House, and garlanded them.
items.ma-24266: Rawḥ narrated to us, Ḥātim ibn Abī Ṣaghīrah narrated to us, ʿAbd Allāh ibn Abī Mulaykah narrated to us, he said: al-Qāsim ibn Muḥammad narrated to me, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, and he mentioned the like of it.
items.ma-24389: Aswad ibn ʿĀmir narrated to us, he said: Sharīk narrated to us, from Abū Isḥāq, from al-Aswad, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ would not perform wuḍūʾ after ghusl.
items.ma-24551: Muḥammad ibn Muṣʿab narrated to us, al-Awzāʿī narrated to us, from al-Zuhrī, from ʿUrwah, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ never performed the subḥah of Ḍuḥā, neither while travelling nor while resident.
items.ma-24591: ʿAlī ibn Baḥr narrated to us, ʿĪsā ibn Yūnus narrated to us, he said: Hishām ibn ʿUrwah narrated to us, from his father, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to accept a gift, and give something in return for it.
items.ma-24638: Bahz narrated to us, he said: Hammām narrated to us, from Qatādah, from Muʿādhah, she said: I asked ʿĀʾishah: How many [rakʿahs] of Ḍuḥā did the Messenger of Allah ﷺ pray? She said: Four rakʿahs, and he would add whatever Allah ﷿ willed.
items.ma-24833: Abū Nuʿaym narrated to us, he said: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid ibn Ayman narrated to us, he said: My father narrated to me, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to pray much of his prayer while sitting.
items.ma-25011: Sulaymān ibn Dāwud al-Hāshimī narrated to us, he said: Abū Zubayd informed us, from al-Aʿmash, from Ibrāhīm, from al-Aswad, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: The Prophet ﷺ forbade the gourd and the pitch-coated [vessel].
items.ma-25034: Ibn al-Ashjaʿī narrated to us, he said: My father narrated to us, from Sufyān, from Manṣūr, from Ibrāhīm, from Hammām, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: I indeed saw myself scraping semen from the garment of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ.
items.ma-25077: Wakīʿ narrated to us, from Sufyān, from Usāmah, from al-Zuhrī, from ʿUrwah, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: The speech of the Prophet ﷺ was distinct, every person could understand it; he did not rattle it off.
items.ma-25204: Yaḥyā ibn Ādam narrated to us, Ibn al-Mubārak narrated to us, from Maʿmar, from al-Zuhrī, from ʿUrwah, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: The hand of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ never touched the hand of a woman in a pledge.
items.ma-25253: ʿĀmir ibn Ṣāliḥ al-Zubayrī narrated to us, Hishām ibn ʿUrwah narrated to me, from his father, from ʿĀʾishah, from al-Ḥārith ibn Hishām, that he asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and he mentioned something like it.
items.ma-25317: Ibn Numayr narrated to us, he said: Saʿd ibn Saʿīd narrated to us, from al-Qāsim ibn Muḥammad, from ʿĀʾishah, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “The most beloved of deeds to Allah ﷿ is the most constant of them, even if little.”
items.ma-25381: Muḥammad ibn Jaʿfar narrated to us, he said: Muḥammad ibn ʿAmr narrated to us, from Abū Salamah, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ and I used to perform ghusl from janābah from one vessel.
items.ma-25397: Muḥammad ibn Jaʿfar and Ḥajjāj narrated to us, they said: Shuʿbah narrated to us, from Mālik ibn ʿUrfuṭah, from ʿAbd Khayr, from ʿĀʾishah: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade the gourd, the ḥantam and the pitch-coated [vessel].
items.ma-25424: Rawḥ narrated to us, he said: Shuʿbah narrated to us, from Abū ʿImrān, from Ṭalḥah, a man of Quraysh of Banū Taym ibn Murrah, from ʿĀʾishah, that she asked the Prophet ﷺ, and he mentioned the like of it.
items.ma-25539: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān narrated to us, from Sufyān, from Zubayd, from Mujāhid, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Jibrīl continued to enjoin me concerning the neighbour until I thought that he would make him an heir.”
items.ma-25569: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān narrated to us, from Sufyān, from Ḥammād, from Ibrāhīm, from al-Aswad, from ʿĀʾishah, that the Prophet ﷺ used to go out to the Ṣubḥ prayer with his head dripping, and he would begin the morning fasting.
items.ma-25664: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from Shuʿbah, from Ashʿath, from his father, from Masrūq, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ loved beginning on the right in his purification, his sandal, and his combing.
items.ma-25685: Wakīʿ narrated to us, he said: Hishām ibn ʿUrwah narrated to us, from his father, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to pray the ʿAṣr prayer while the sun was falling in my room.
items.ma-25759: Wakīʿ narrated to us, from Ibn Abī Dhiʾb, from al-Zuhrī, from ʿUrwah, from ʿĀʾishah: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ did not perform the subḥah of Ḍuḥā, and I perform it.
items.ma-25896: ʿAbd al-Razzāq narrated to us, he said: Ibn Jurayj narrated to us, he said: Ibn Shihāb informed me, from ʿUrwah, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: The Prophet ﷺ entered upon me while the lines of his face were gleaming.
items.ma-25949: ʿAbd al-Razzāq narrated to us, he said: Maʿmar narrated to us, from al-Zuhrī, from ʿUrwah, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: The Prophet ﷺ was shrouded in three white Saḥūlī garments.
items.ma-26011: Yazīd narrated to us, he said: Ibn Abī Dhiʾb informed us, from al-Zuhrī, from ʿUrwah, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ never performed the subḥah of Ḍuḥā, and I perform it.
items.ma-26074: [ʿAbd Allāh ibn Aḥmad said]: Naṣr ibn ʿAlī narrated to us, Muḥammad ibn Abī Bukayrah narrated to us, from Hishām, from Shumaysah, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade the nabīdh of the jar.
items.ma-26226: Yūnus narrated to us, Ḥammād narrated to us, from Qatādah, from Ibn Sīrīn, from Ṣafiyyah bint al-Ḥārith, from ʿĀʾishah, from the Prophet ﷺ: that he said: “The prayer of a woman who menstruates is not accepted except with a head-covering.”
items.ma-26382: ʿĀmir ibn Ṣāliḥ narrated to us, he said: Yūnus ibn Yazīd narrated to us, from Ibn Shihāb, from ʿUrwah, from ʿĀʾishah, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “The gecko is a little transgressor.”
items.ma-26422:
Abū Dāwud al-Ṭayālisī narrated to us, Zamʿah narrated to us, from Ibn Abī Mulaykah, he said: Fāṭimah used to dandle al-Ḥasan ibn ʿAlī and say:
By my father – the likeness of the Prophet … not resembling ʿAlī.
items.ma-26448: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān narrated to us, from Sufyān, from Manṣūr and al-Aʿmash, from Abū al-Ḍuḥā, from Shutayr ibn Shakal, from Ḥafṣah, that the Prophet ﷺ used to kiss while he was fasting.
items.ma-26719: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Ṭalḥah ibn Yaḥyā narrated to us, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Farrūkh, from Umm Salamah, she said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to kiss me while he was fasting and I was fasting.
items.ma-26818: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Jaʿfar ibn Burqān narrated to us, from Yazīd ibn al-Aṣamm, from Maymūnah, she said: When the Prophet ﷺ prostrated, he held [his arms] apart until the one behind him could see the whiteness of his armpits.
items.ma-27208: Ḥusayn ibn Muḥammad and Surayj ibn al-Nuʿmān narrated to us, they said: Khalaf narrated to us, from Abū Mālik al-Ashjaʿī, from his father, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Whoever sees me in a dream has indeed seen me.”
items.ma-27541: Ḥusayn narrated to us in the tafsīr of Shaybān, from Qatādah, he said: Sālim ibn Abī al-Jaʿd narrated to us, from Maʿdān ibn Abī Ṭalḥah, from Abū al-Dardāʾ, and he mentioned the like of it.
items.ma-27621: Yūnus narrated to us, Ḥammād ibn Salamah narrated to us, from Hishām ibn ʿUrwah, from ʿUrwah, from Umm Sharīk, that she was among [the women] who gave themselves to the Prophet ﷺ.
items.ma-4532: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān narrated to us, Sufyān narrated to us, from Mūsā ibn ʿUqbah, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ cut down the date palms of Banū al-Naḍīr and burned [them].
items.ma-4684: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from Ibn Abī Rawwād, Nāfiʿ narrated to me, from Ibn ʿUmar: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saw phlegm in the qiblah of the mosque, so he scraped it off and applied khalūq to its place.
items.ma-4696: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from ʿUbayd Allāh, Nāfiʿ narrated to me, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿUmar, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “A woman must not travel three [days] except that she has with her a dhū maḥram.”
items.ma-4709: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from ʿUbayd Allāh, he said: Nāfiʿ narrated to me, from Ibn ʿUmar, from the Prophet ﷺ: “When the evening meal of one of you has been set down and the iqāmah has been called for the prayer, let him not get up until he has finished.”
items.ma-4725: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from ʿUbayd Allāh, Nāfiʿ narrated to me, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿUmar, he said: The Prophet ﷺ entered Makkah by the upper mountain pass, the one at al-Baṭḥāʾ, and left by the lower mountain pass.
items.ma-4729: Ibn Numayr narrated to us, ʿUbayd Allāh informed us, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Whoever drinks khamr in this world will not drink it in the Hereafter, unless he repents.”
items.ma-4830: Rawḥ narrated to us, Ibn Jurayj narrated to us, Mūsā ibn ʿUqbah informed me, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Every intoxicant is khamr, and every khamr is forbidden.”
items.ma-5004: Abū Muʿāwiyah narrated to us, from Mālik – meaning Ibn Mighwal –, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was asked about the desert lizard, and he said: “I do not eat it, and I do not forbid it.”
items.ma-5005: Abū Muʿāwiyah narrated to us, from Mālik – meaning Ibn Mighwal –, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Whoever comes to the Jumuʿah, let him bathe.”
items.ma-5045: Muḥammad ibn Jaʿfar narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, from Ayyūb – meaning al-Sakhtiyānī –, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “Do not prevent your women from the mosques.”
items.ma-5065: He said: I found in my father's book: Yazīd narrated to us, Shuʿbah informed us, from Simāk – meaning al-Ḥanafī –, I heard Ibn ʿUmar say: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ prayed two rakʿahs in the house.
items.ma-5158: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from ʿUbayd Allāh, Nāfiʿ informed me, from Ibn ʿUmar, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “Every two parties to a sale – one of them has the option over his companion until they separate, or it is an option.”
items.ma-5235: Wakīʿ and ʿAbd al-Raḥmān narrated to us, from Sufyān, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Dīnār, from Ibn ʿUmar, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Whoever buys food, let him not sell it until he has taken possession of it.”
items.ma-5260: Wakīʿ narrated to us, from Fuḍayl ibn Ghazwān, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Whichever man declares a man to be a disbeliever, then one of them is a disbeliever.”
items.ma-5328: Aswad ibn ʿĀmir narrated to us, Isrāʾīl narrated to us, from Thuwayr, from Mujāhid, from Ibn ʿUmar, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ cursed the effeminate men and the women who imitate men.
items.ma-5453: Ḥasan ibn Mūsā narrated to us, Shaybān narrated to us, from Yaḥyā, Abū Salamah informed me that he heard Ibn ʿUmar say: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: “The month is twenty-nine.”
items.ma-5500: Muḥammad ibn Jaʿfar narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Dīnār, I heard Ibn ʿUmar narrating from the Prophet ﷺ that he said: “Whoever buys food, let him not sell it until he has taken possession of it.”
items.ma-5519: He said: The Prophet ﷺ sent us on a raiding party toward Tihāmah, and we obtained spoils, and our shares came to twelve camels each, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ gave us an extra share of one camel each.
items.ma-5529: Muḥammad ibn Jaʿfar narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Dīnār, he said: I saw Ibn ʿUmar praying wherever his mount turned with him, and he would say: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to do it.
items.ma-5534: Muḥammad narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, from Jabalah ibn Suḥaym, I heard Ibn ʿUmar narrating from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “Whoever is seeking it, let him seek it in the last ten.”
items.ma-5566: Muḥammad ibn Jaʿfar narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, from Ismāʿīl, I heard Ḥakīm al-Ḥadhdhāʾ: I heard Ibn ʿUmar when he was asked about the prayer on a journey, and he said: Two rakʿahs, the sunnah of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ.
items.ma-5595: Mūsā said: Sālim also informed me that ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿUmar informed him: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ came to his muʿarras, and it was said to him: You are in a blessed Baṭḥāʾ.
items.ma-5649: Hāshim ibn al-Qāsim narrated to us, Isrāʾīl narrated to us, Thuwayr narrated to us, from Mujāhid, from Ibn ʿUmar: that the Prophet ﷺ cursed the effeminate men and the women who imitate men.
items.ma-5663: Ḥammād ibn Masʿadah narrated to us, from ʿUbayd Allāh, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to pray on the two festivals, al-Aḍḥā and al-Fiṭr, then deliver the sermon after the prayer.
items.ma-5786: Muḥammad ibn ʿUbayd narrated to us, ʿUbayd Allāh narrated to us, from Nāfiʿ and Sālim, from Ibn ʿUmar: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade eating the meat of domestic donkeys.
items.ma-5915: Muʾammal narrated to us, Ḥammād – meaning Ibn Zayd – narrated to us, from Ayyūb, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, he said: I heard the Prophet ﷺ say: “A banner will be set up for every treacherous person on the Day of Resurrection.”
items.ma-6040: Hāshim narrated to us, Isḥāq ibn Saʿīd narrated to us, from his father, from Ibn ʿUmar, he said: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: “Aslam – Allah has made peace with them; and Ghifār – Allah has forgiven them.”
items.ma-6049: Hāshim narrated to us, ʿAbd al-Raḥmān narrated to us, from Zayd ibn Aslam, from Ibn ʿUmar, from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, he said: “People are only like a hundred camels; you can hardly find among them a single riding camel.”
items.ma-6238: Bahz narrated to us, Ḥammād narrated to us, Ṭalḥah ibn ʿUbayd Allāh ibn Karīz informed us, from Ibn ʿUm: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ prayed in the house between the two pillars.
items.ma-6264: Isḥāq ibn Yūsuf narrated to us, al-Aʿmash narrated to us, from Abū Ṣāliḥ, from Ibn ʿUmar, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “When you are three, let two not converse privately to the exclusion of their companion.”
items.ma-6270: Ibn Numayr narrated to us, ʿUbayd Allāh narrated to us, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “When they are three, let two not converse privately to the exclusion of one.”
items.ma-6463: Ḥammād ibn Khālid narrated to us, ʿAbd Allāh narrated to us, from Nāfiʿ, he said: Ibn ʿUmar used to do raml from the Stone to the Stone, and he claimed that the Prophet ﷺ used to do that.
items.ma-6824: Wakīʿ narrated to us, from Khalīfah ibn Khayyāṭ, from ʿAmr ibn Shuʿayb, from his father, from his grandfather: that the Prophet ﷺ gave a sermon with his back leaning against the Kaʿbah, and he mentioned it.
items.ma-6866: Muḥammad ibn Muṣʿab narrated to us, al-Awzāʿī narrated to us, from ʿAṭāʾ, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿAmr: that the Prophet ﷺ said: “Whoever fasts perpetually has not fasted.”
items.ma-7133: Hushaym narrated to us, from ʿUmar ibn Abī Salamah, from his father, from Abū Hurayrah – meaning from the Prophet ﷺ; so my father said –: that he forbade that a woman be married over her paternal aunt or over her maternal aunt.
items.ma-7274: Sufyān narrated to us, from al-Zuhrī, from Abū Salamah and Sulaymān ibn Yasār, both heard Abū Hurayrah, ascribing it to the Prophet ﷺ: “Indeed the Jews and the Christians do not dye, so oppose them.”
items.ma-7283: Sufyān narrated to us, from al-Zuhrī, from Abū Salamah, from Abū Hurayrah: that when al-Najāshī died, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ informed them that he had died, and they asked forgiveness for him.
items.ma-7378: ʿAbd al-Wahhāb ibn ʿAbd al-Majīd narrated to us, Ayyūb narrated to us, from Muḥammad, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ: “Name yourselves with my name, and do not take my kunyah.”
items.ma-7397: Sufyān narrated to us, from Ayyūb ibn Mūsā, from Makḥūl, from Sulaymān ibn Yasār, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ: “There is no ṣadaqah upon a Muslim concerning his slave or his horse.”
items.ma-7482: Yazīd narrated to us, Muḥammad ibn ʿAmr informed us, from Abū al-Ḥakam, the mawlā of the Laythīs, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “There is no stake except in a [camel's] foot or a hoof.”
items.ma-7848: Ḥammād ibn Usāmah narrated to us, Muḥammad ibn ʿAmr al-Laythī narrated to me, Abū Salamah narrated to us, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Disputation about the Qurʾān is kufr.”
items.ma-7987: Then he said thus with his hand: “[It is] close to the time before the Hour: you will come to fight a people whose sandals are of hair, as though their faces were hammered shields.”
items.ma-8098: Khalaf ibn al-Walīd narrated to us, Khālid narrated to us, from Suhayl, from his father, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “The child of zinā is the worst of the three.”
items.ma-8121: And the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “The angels pray for one of you as long as he is in his place of prayer in which he prayed, as long as he has not committed ḥadath: O Allah, forgive him; O Allah, have mercy on him.”
items.ma-8141: And the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “By the One in whose Yad is the soul of Muḥammad, a day will surely come upon one of you in which his seeing me, and then his seeing me, will be dearer to him than his family and his wealth and the like of them with them.”
items.ma-8452: Yaḥyā ibn Isḥāq narrated to us, Abū ʿAwānah narrated to us, from ʿUmar ibn Abī Salamah, from his father, from Abū Hurayrah: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ cursed the women who frequently visit graves.
items.ma-8855: Sulaymān narrated to us, Ismāʿīl informed me, he said: al-ʿAlāʾ informed me, from his father, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “He will not enter Paradise whose neighbour is not safe from his harms.”
items.ma-8899: ʿAbd al-Razzāq narrated to us, Sufyān informed us, ʿAbd al-Malik ibn ʿUmayr narrated to me, one who heard Abū Hurayrah say narrated to me: I saw the Prophet ﷺ pray in his sandals.
items.ma-9006: ʿAffān narrated to us, Ḥammād narrated to us, from Muḥammad ibn Ziyād, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “Whoever buys a muṣarrāh sheep has the choice: if he wishes, he may return it along with a ṣāʿ of dates.”
items.ma-9023: ʿAffān narrated to us, Abū ʿAwānah narrated to us, ʿUmar ibn Abī Salamah narrated to us, from his father, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “May Allah curse the one who gives a bribe and the one who takes it in judgment.”
items.ma-9043: ʿAffān narrated to us, Wuhayb narrated to us, Suhayl narrated to us, from his father, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “If you speak on the day of Jumuʿah, you have talked idly and have made [it] idle.”
items.ma-9044: ʿAffān narrated to us, Wuhayb narrated to us, Suhayl narrated to us, from his father, from Abū Hurayrah: that the Prophet ﷺ said: “Whoever takes a span of the earth without right, he will be encircled with it from seven earths.”
items.ma-9422: Qutaybah narrated to us, ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz ibn Muḥammad narrated to us, from Muḥammad ibn ʿAmr, from Abū Salamah, from Abū Hurayrah: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade every one with a fang among the beasts of prey.
items.ma-9564: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from Muḥammad ibn ʿAmr, he said: Abū Salamah narrated to me, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “Indeed hospitality is three [days], and whatever exceeds that is ṣadaqah.”
items.ma-9596: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from Ibn ʿAjlān, he said: I heard my father, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “Let none of you urinate in standing water, nor bathe in it from janābah.”
items.ma-9634: Ḥusayn narrated to us, in the tafsīr of Shaybān, from Qatādah, he said: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Ādam narrated from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said … and he mentioned the ḥadīth.
items.ma-9730: Wakīʿ narrated to us, he said: Ibn Abī Dhiʾb narrated to us, from Ṣāliḥ, the mawlā of al-Tawʾamah, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Whoever prays over a funeral in the mosque, he has nothing.”
items.ma-9742: Wakīʿ narrated to us, from Sufyān, from al-Suddī, from his father, from Abū Hurayrah – Sufyān said: he raised it [to the Prophet ﷺ] – he said: “Indeed the dead person hears the shuffling of their sandals when they turn away, departing.”
items.ma-10108: Yaḥyā narrated to us, he said: Ibn Abī Dhiʾb narrated to us, he said: Ṣāliḥ, the mawlā of al-Tawʾamah, narrated to us, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “Whoever washes a dead person, let him bathe.”
items.ma-10114: Yaḥyā narrated to us, ʿAwf narrated to us, he said: Muḥammad narrated to us, from Abū Hurayrah and al-Ḥasan, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “Glorification is for the men, and clapping is for the women.”
items.ma-10228: Wakīʿ narrated to us, he said: Sufyān narrated to us, from Abū al-Zinād, from al-Aʿraj, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade the sale of munābadhah and mulāmasah.
items.ma-10432: Ibn Numayr narrated to us, al-Aʿmash narrated to us, from Abū Ṣāliḥ, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ: “On the road there was a branch of a tree that harmed the people, and a man removed it, so he was admitted to Paradise.”
items.ma-10582: Yazīd narrated to us, Hishām informed us; and Rawḥ, he said: Hishām ibn Ḥassān narrated to us, from Muḥammad, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “There is no ʿadwā and no ṭiyarah, and I love the good fāl.”
items.ma-10601: Ḥasan ibn Mūsā narrated to us, Ḥammād ibn Salamah narrated to us, from Thābit al-Bunānī, from Abū Rāfiʿ, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: And I know it only as raised [to the Prophet ﷺ]; and he mentioned its meaning.
items.ma-10634: Rawḥ narrated to us, Mālik narrated to us, from Muḥammad ibn Yaḥyā ibn Ḥabbān, from al-Aʿraj, from Abū Hurayrah: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade fasting on two days: the day of al-Fiṭr and the day of al-Naḥr.
items.ma-10806: ʿAbd Allāh ibn Yazīd narrated to us, ʿIkrimah narrated to us, Abū Kathīr narrated to me, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Khamr is from these two trees: the date palm and the grapevine.”
items.ma-10892: Ḥammād ibn Khālid narrated to us, Muʿāwiyah ibn Ṣāliḥ narrated to us, from Abū Maryam, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ: that he forbade that one urinate in stagnant water and then perform wuḍūʾ from it.
items.ma-10998: ʿAbd al-Ṣamad narrated to us, Hammām narrated to us, Qatādah narrated to us, from Abū Naḍrah, from Abū Saʿīd: Our Prophet ﷺ commanded us to recite the Opening of the Book and what is made easy.
items.ma-11357: Muʿāwiyah narrated to us, Shaybān narrated to us, from Firās, from ʿAṭiyyah, from Abū Saʿīd, from the Prophet of Allah ﷺ that he said: “Whoever makes a show, Yurāʾī Allāh bihi; and whoever makes [it] heard, Yusammiʿ Allāh bihi.”
items.ma-11439: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, from Khulayd ibn Jaʿfar, from Abū Naḍrah, from Abū Saʿīd, he said: Musk was mentioned in the presence of the Prophet ﷺ, and he said: “It is the best of perfumes.”
items.ma-11493: Muḥammad ibn ʿUbayd narrated to us, al-Aʿmash narrated to us, from Abū Sufyān, from Jābir, from Abū Saʿīd, he said: I entered upon the Messenger of Allah ﷺ while he was praying, draped [in a garment].
items.ma-11559: Ibn Numayr narrated to us, from al-Aʿmash, from Ḥabīb, from Abū Arṭāh, from Abū Saʿīd al-Khudrī, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade the unripe dates and the dates, and the raisins and the dates.
items.ma-11572: Yaḥyā ibn Ādam narrated to us, like it with its isnād, and he said: dates; and ʿAbd al-Razzāq said: fruit; and he said: Maʿmar and al-Thawrī narrated to us, from Ismāʿīl ibn Umayyah; and he mentioned it.
items.ma-11597: ʿAbd Allāh ibn al-Walīd narrated to us, Sufyān narrated to us, from Salamah ibn Kuhayl, from Qazaʿah, from Abū Saʿīd al-Khudrī, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “There is no continuous fasting,” meaning in the fast.
items.ma-11668: Ḥasan ibn Mūsā narrated to us, Ḥammād ibn Salamah narrated to us, from Aflaḥ al-Anṣārī, from Abū Saʿīd al-Khudrī, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Love of the Anṣār is īmān, and hatred of them is hypocrisy.”
items.ma-11852: Rawḥ narrated to us, he said: Ashʿath narrated to us, from al-Ḥasan, from Abū Saʿīd al-Khudrī, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade the gourd, the naqīr and the pitch-coated vessel. And he said: “Make nabīdh in your waterskin and tie it up.”
items.ma-11968: Muʿtamir narrated to us, he said: I heard al-Akhḍar ibn ʿAjlān, from Abū Bakr al-Ḥanafī, from Anas ibn Mālik: that the Prophet ﷺ sold a cup and a saddle-cloth in the man yazīd [sale].
items.ma-11976: ʿAbbād ibn ʿAbbād and Ghassān ibn Muḍar narrated to us, from Saʿīd ibn Yazīd Abū Maslamah, he said: I said to Anas ibn Mālik: Did the Messenger of Allah ﷺ pray in his sandals? He said: Yes.
items.ma-12129: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from Ḥumayd, he said: Anas was asked about the prayer of the Prophet ﷺ at night, and he said: We would not wish to see him praying except that we saw him, nor sleeping except that we saw him.
items.ma-12176: Wakīʿ narrated to us, ʿAzrah ibn Thābit al-Anṣārī narrated to us, from Thumāmah ibn ʿAbd Allāh ibn Anas, from Anas, he said: When perfume was brought to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, he would not refuse it.
items.ma-12357: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Mahdī narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, from Khālid, from Abū Qilābah, from Anas, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “Every ummah has a trustworthy one, and Abū ʿUbaydah is the trustworthy one of this ummah.”
items.ma-12358: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Mahdī narrated to us, Sufyān narrated to us, from al-Suddī, he said: I heard Anas ibn Mālik say: Had Ibrāhīm, the son of the Prophet ﷺ, lived, he would have been a ṣiddīq, a prophet.
items.ma-12368: Bahz narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿAbd Allāh ibn Jabr narrated to us, from Anas, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to bathe with one of his women from a single vessel.
items.ma-12545: ʿAbd al-Ṣamad narrated to us, Ḥammād narrated to us, Thābit narrated to us, from Anas: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ established brotherhood between Abū ʿUbaydah ibn al-Jarrāḥ and Abū Ṭalḥah.
items.ma-12559: Ḥasan narrated to us, Ḥammād ibn Salamah narrated to us, from Thābit al-Bunānī, from Anas ibn Mālik: that the Prophet ﷺ said: “Paradise is surrounded by disliked things, and the Fire is surrounded by desires.”
items.ma-12643: ʿAbd al-Razzāq narrated to us, Maʿmar narrated to us, from al-Zuhrī, he said: Anas ibn Mālik narrated to me: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ prayed the Ẓuhr when the sun had declined.
items.ma-12860: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Muṣʿab ibn Sulaym narrated to us, he said: I heard Anas ibn Mālik say: The Prophet ﷺ sent me on an errand, and I came while he was eating dates, sitting on his haunches.
items.ma-12971: Ismāʿīl narrated to us, Khālid informed us, from Abū Qilābah, Anas said: Bilāl was commanded to make the adhān in pairs and the iqāmah in singles. So I narrated it to Ayyūb, and he said: Except the iqāmah.
items.ma-13091: Yazīd narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, from Qatādah, from Anas ibn Mālik: that the Prophet ﷺ said: “Let one of you be moderate in his prayer, and let him not spread his forearms like the dog.”
items.ma-13105: Yazīd ibn Hārūn narrated to us, Ḥammād ibn Salamah narrated to us, from Thābit, from Anas, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “The voice of Abū Ṭalḥah in the army is more severe upon the polytheists than a troop.”
items.ma-13159: Rawḥ and Muḥammad ibn Jaʿfar narrated to us, both said: Saʿīd narrated to us, from Qatādah, from Anas ibn Mālik: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ cried out with both of them together, or said the talbiyah with both of them together.
items.ma-13355: Ḥaywah ibn Shurayḥ narrated to us, Baqiyyah narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, from Hishām ibn Zayd, from Anas, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to go around to his women with a single ghusl.
items.ma-13416: Abū Qaṭan narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, from Muʿāwiyah ibn Qurrah, from Anas, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “The sister's son of a people is from them” or “from themselves.”
items.ma-13465: Abū Qaṭan narrated to us, Ibn ʿAwn narrated to us, from Muḥammad, he said: When Anas narrated a ḥadīth from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and finished it, he would say: Or as the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said.
items.ma-13530: al-Ashyab narrated it to us, from Ḥammād, from Thābit, from Anas. And ʿAffān: Ḥammād narrated to us, Thābit informed us, and he said: “And let Shayṭān not draw you on.”
items.ma-13676: Ḥasan ibn Mūsā narrated to us, Sallām narrated to us, from ʿUmar ibn Maʿdān, from Anas ibn Mālik, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ attended a walīmah in which there was neither bread nor meat.
items.ma-13706: ʿAffān narrated to us, Ḥammād ibn Salamah narrated to us, Qatādah informed us, from Anas: that the Prophet ﷺ would pass by a date, and nothing prevented him from taking it except the fear that it was from ṣadaqah.
items.ma-13716: ʿAffān narrated to us, Shuʿbah informed us, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿAbd Allāh ibn Jabr, he said: I heard Anas say: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to perform wuḍūʾ with the makkūk, and he used to bathe with five makākī.
items.ma-13729: Aswad ibn ʿĀmir narrated to us, Ḥammād ibn Salamah narrated to us, from Thābit, from Anas, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “The Hour will not be established until it is no longer said on the earth: Allah, Allah.”
items.ma-13789: Muʿāwiyah ibn ʿAmr narrated to us, Zāʾidah narrated to us, from al-Aʿmash, he said: It was narrated to me from Anas ibn Mālik, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “The longest of people in necks on the Day of Resurrection are the muʾadhdhins.”
items.ma-13841: ʿAffān and Bahz narrated to us, both said: Hammām narrated to us, Qatādah narrated to us, from Anas: that the Prophet's ﷺ hair used to reach his shoulders. Bahz said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ had hair that reached his shoulders.
items.ma-13910: Muḥammad narrated to us, from Shuʿbah, from Qatādah, from Anas, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ saw a man driving a badanah. He said: “Ride it.” He said: It is a badanah! He said: “Ride it, woe to you.”
items.ma-13979: Hāshim ibn al-Qāsim narrated to us, ʿĪsā – meaning Ibn Ṭahmān – narrated to us, he said: I heard Anas ibn Mālik say: Indeed the Prophet ﷺ has a secret with me, which I will not inform anyone of, ever, until I meet him.
items.ma-14037: ʿAffān narrated to us, Sallām Abū al-Mundhir narrated to us, from Thābit, from Anas, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Women and perfume were made beloved to me from this world, and the coolness of my eye was placed in the prayer.”
items.ma-14155: ʿAbd al-Razzāq narrated to us, Ibn Jurayj informed us, Abū al-Zubayr informed me that he heard Jābir ibn ʿAbd Allāh say: The Prophet ﷺ rebuked a woman for joining anything to her head.
items.ma-14289: Sufyān ibn ʿUyaynah narrated to us, from Abū al-Zubayr, who heard it from Jābir: Nabīdh used to be made for the Prophet ﷺ in a waterskin, and if there was no waterskin, then in a basin of stone.
items.ma-14424: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from Ibn Jurayj, Abū al-Zubayr informed me, he said: I heard Jābir ibn ʿAbd Allāh say: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade branding on the face, and striking on the face.
items.ma-14448: Muḥammad ibn Bakr narrated to us, Ibn Jurayj informed us, Abū al-Zubayr informed me that he heard Jābir ibn ʿAbd Allāh say: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade that any animal be killed ṣabran.
items.ma-14723: Mūsā narrated to us, Ibn Lahīʿah narrated to us, from Abū al-Zubayr: that he asked Jābir about the funeral. He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ stood for a funeral that passed, and those with him [stood], until it was out of sight.
items.ma-14754: Mūsā narrated to us, Ibn Lahīʿah narrated to us, from Abū al-Zubayr, he said: I asked Jābir about a woman who has bodily contact with a woman. He said: The Prophet ﷺ rebuked that.
items.ma-14891: Sulaymān ibn Dāwūd al-Hāshimī narrated to us, ʿAbthar ibn al-Qāsim Abū Zubayd informed us, from al-Aʿmash, from Abū Sufyān, from Jābir, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ presented sheep to the House.
items.ma-14996: ʿAbd Allāh ibn al-Walīd narrated to us, ʿAbd Allāh ibn al-Muʾammal narrated to us, from Abū al-Zubayr, from Jābir, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “The water of Zamzam is for what it is drunk for.”
items.ma-15204: ʿAffān narrated to us, Salīm ibn Ḥayyān narrated to us, Saʿīd ibn Mīnāʾ narrated to us, from Jābir, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade muzābanah, muḥāqalah and mukhābarah.
items.ma-15224: Ḥusayn narrated to us, Sufyān narrated to us, from Abū al-Zubayr, from Jābir: that the Prophet ﷺ commanded licking the fingers and the dish, and said: “One of you does not know in which of that the blessing is.”
