items.ma-15514: Rawḥ narrated to us, Ibn Jurayj narrated to us, he said: Muzāḥim ibn Abī Muzāḥim informed me, from ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz ibn ʿAbd Allāh, from Muḥarrish al-Kaʿbī: that the Prophet ﷺ went out; and he mentioned it.
items.ma-15575: [It was] read to Sufyān: I heard Hishām, from his father, from Ḥakīm ibn Ḥizām, he said: In the Jāhiliyyah I freed forty slaves. So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “You have accepted Islam upon the good that preceded for you.”
items.ma-15594: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, from Muʿāwiyah ibn Qurrah, from his father, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Fasting three days of every month is the fasting of perpetuity and its breaking of the fast.”
items.ma-15666-2: Then he said: “Indeed the merchants are the wicked.” They said: O Messenger of Allah, has Allah not made sale lawful and forbidden ribā? He said: “Yes, but they swear and commit sin.”
items.ma-16119: Aswad ibn ʿĀmir narrated to us, he said: Isrāʾīl narrated to us, he said: Thuwayr narrated to us, he said: I heard Ibn al-Zubayr say: This is the day of ʿĀshūrāʾ, so fast it, for the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Fast it.”
items.ma-16212: Ḥajjāj narrated to us, from Ibn Jurayj, he said: Abū al-Zubayr informed me, from Jābir, like this ḥadīth of Zubayd from Abū Saʿīd – not all of that reached him – from the Prophet ﷺ.
items.ma-16230: Hushaym narrated to us, he said: Yūnus informed us, from Ibn Sīrīn, from Salmān ibn ʿĀmir al-Ḍabbī, he said: He said: “With the boy is his ʿaqīqah, so shed blood for him and remove the harm from him.”
items.ma-16876: Aswad ibn ʿĀmir narrated to us, Abū Bakr informed us, from ʿĀṣim, from Abū Ṣāliḥ, from Muʿāwiyah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Whoever dies without an imām dies a death of Jāhiliyyah.”
items.ma-17079: Yaḥyā ibn Zakariyyā narrated to us, he said: Mujālid narrated to us, from ʿĀmir, from Abū Masʿūd al-Anṣārī, like this. He said: And Abū Masʿūd was the youngest of them in age.
items.ma-17106: Wakīʿ narrated to us, from Sufyān, from Abū Qays, from ʿAmr ibn Maymūn, from Abū Masʿūd, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “{Say: He is Allah, One} equals a third of the Qurʾān.”
items.ma-17372: Qutaybah narrated to us, Ibn Lahīʿah narrated to us, from Abū ʿUshshānah, from ʿUqbah ibn ʿĀmir, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “The first two disputants on the Day of Resurrection are two neighbours.”
items.ma-17373: Qutaybah narrated to us, Ibn Lahīʿah narrated to us, from Abū ʿUshshānah, from ʿUqbah ibn ʿĀmir, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Do not dislike daughters, for they are the comforting, precious ones.”
items.ma-17961: Sufyān ibn ʿUyaynah narrated to us, from ʿAmr – meaning Ibn Dīnār –, from ʿAṭāʾ, from Ṣafwān, from his father, he said: I heard the Prophet ﷺ on the minbar reciting {And they will call: O Mālik} [al-Zukhruf: 77].
items.ma-18018: Yaḥyā ibn Isḥāq narrated to us, Ibn Lahīʿah narrated to us, from al-Ḥārith ibn Yazīd and ʿAbd Allāh ibn Hubayrah, from ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Jubayr; and he mentioned the ḥadīth.
items.ma-18065: He said: O Kaʿb ibn Murrah, narrate to us from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and be careful. He said: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: “Whoever shoots an arrow in the path of Allah, it is like one who has freed a slave.”
items.ma-18165: Aswad ibn ʿĀmir narrated to us, Jarīr ibn Ḥāzim narrated to us, from Muḥammad ibn Sīrīn, he said: A man narrated to me from ʿAmr ibn Wahb, meaning: and he mentioned its like.
items.ma-18197: al-Walīd ibn Muslim narrated to us, Thawr narrated to us, from Rajāʾ ibn Ḥaywah, from the scribe of al-Mughīrah, from al-Mughīrah: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ performed wuḍūʾ and wiped the underside of the khuff and its upper side.
items.ma-18279: ʿAffān narrated to us, Abū ʿAwānah narrated to us, Abū Balj narrated to us, from Muḥammad ibn Ḥāṭib, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “The distinction between the lawful and the forbidden is the sound and the beating of the tambourine.”
items.ma-18574:
Hāshim narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, from ʿAdī ibn Thābit, from al-Barāʾ ibn ʿĀzib, from the Prophet ﷺ, like it.
And Ibn Jaʿfar, in this ḥadīth, said: I heard al-Barāʾ and Ibn Abī Awfā.
items.ma-18640: Yaḥyā ibn Ādam and Ḥusayn narrated to us, both said: Isrāʾīl narrated to us, from Abū Isḥāq, from al-Barāʾ, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Indeed Allah and His angels Yuṣallūn ʿalā the front row.”
items.ma-18732: Abū Nuʿaym narrated to us, Sufyān narrated to us, from Maʿbad ibn Khālid, he said: I heard Ḥārithah ibn Wahb al-Khuzāʿī, he said: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ; and he mentioned the ḥadīth.
items.ma-18761: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Misʿar narrated to us, from ʿAwn ibn Abī Juḥayfah, from his father: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ prayed toward a short spear or the like of it, with the road behind it.
items.ma-18820: ʿAffān narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, al-Ḥakam narrated to us, he said: I heard Ibn Abī Laylā, from a man of the Companions of the Prophet ﷺ: that he forbade the unripe dates and the dates, and the raisins and the dates.
items.ma-19040: Muḥammad ibn Jaʿfar narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, from Jābir, he said: I heard al-Shaʿbī say: I bear witness upon Abū Saʿīd ibn Zayd that a funeral passed by the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and he stood.
items.ma-19179: Muḥammad ibn ʿUbayd narrated to us, Ismāʿīl narrated to me, from Qays, from Jarīr ibn ʿAbd Allāh, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ never barred me since I accepted Islam, and never saw me except that he smiled in my face.
items.ma-19243: ʿAlī ibn ʿĀṣim narrated to us, from Manṣūr ibn ʿAbd al-Raḥmān, from al-Shaʿbī, from Jarīr ibn ʿAbd Allāh, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Whichever slave runs away from his masters has disbelieved.”
items.ma-19427: Abū Aḥmad narrated to us, ʿUmar ibn Saʿīd narrated to us, from Ibn Abī Mulaykah, from ʿUqbah ibn al-Ḥārith, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ departed when he had prayed the ʿAṣr. And he mentioned its meaning.
items.ma-19552: Hāshim ibn al-Qāsim narrated to us, al-Mubārak narrated to us, from al-Ḥasan, from Abū Mūsā, he said: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: “Perform wuḍūʾ from that whose colour the fire has changed.”
items.ma-19641: Yaḥyā ibn Saʿīd narrated to us, from Sufyān, Manṣūr narrated to us, from Abū Wāʾil, from Abū Mūsā, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Free the captive, feed the hungry, and visit the sick.”
items.ma-19902: Rawḥ narrated to us, Saʿīd and Hishām ibn Abī ʿAbd Allāh narrated to us; and he mentioned its meaning, except that he said: So it was lifted from the people. And he said: “Except that the two of them have multiplied it.”
items.ma-19965: Muʿāwiyah narrated to us, Zāʾidah narrated to us, from Hishām, he said: al-Ḥasan claimed that ʿImrān ibn Ḥuṣayn narrated to him, he said: We travelled by night with the Prophet ﷺ one night; and he mentioned the ḥadīth.
items.ma-20125: Muḥammad ibn Jaʿfar narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, from Qatādah, from al-Ḥasan, from Samurah ibn Jundub: that the Prophet ﷺ said: “Whoever kills his slave, we will kill him, and whoever mutilates him, we will mutilate him.”
items.ma-20144: Abū Muʿāwiyah narrated to us, Abū Mālik al-Ashjaʿī narrated to us, from Nuʿaym ibn Abī Hind, from the son of Samurah ibn Jundub, from his father, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Whoever kills, then the salab is his.”
items.ma-20182: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Mahdī narrated to us, Hishām narrated to us, from Qatādah, from al-Ḥasan, from Samurah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “The two parties to a sale have the option as long as they have not separated.”
items.ma-20197: Yazīd ibn Hārūn narrated to us, Hishām informed us, from al-Ḥasan, from Samurah ibn Jundub, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “Whoever kills his slave, we will kill him, and whoever mutilates his slave, we will mutilate him.”
items.ma-20199: Yazīd ibn Hārūn narrated to us, Shuʿbah informed us; and Abū Dāwūd, Hishām informed us, from Qatādah, from al-Ḥasan, from Samurah ibn Jundub, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “The neighbour of the house has greater right to the house.”
items.ma-20220: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Sufyān narrated to us, from al-Aswad ibn Qays, from Thaʿlabah ibn ʿAbbād, from Samurah ibn Jundub: that the Prophet ﷺ prayed during an eclipse, and no voice of his was heard.
items.ma-20247: Muʾammal narrated to us, Ḥammād narrated to us, Yūnus informed us, from al-Ḥasan, from Samurah ibn Jundub, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Soon Allah will fill your hands” – and he mentioned the like of it.
items.ma-20337: Wakīʿ narrated to us, ʿAbbād ibn Rāshid narrated to us, from al-Ḥasan, Aḥmar, the Companion of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, narrated to us, he said: We used to feel compassion for the Messenger of Allah ﷺ because of how he held his arms apart from his sides when he prostrated.
items.ma-20371: Wahb narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, from Muʿāwiyah ibn Qurrah, from his father, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “In the fasting of three days of the month is the fasting of perpetuity and its breaking of the fast.”
items.ma-20550: ʿAbd Allāh narrated to us, ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿAwn al-Kharrāz narrated to us, Ibrāhīm ibn Saʿd narrated to us, from ʿUbaydah ibn Abī Rāʾiṭah, with the like of this ḥadīth.
items.ma-20774:
Abū Saʿīd narrated to us, Thābit narrated to us, ʿĀṣim narrated to us, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Sarjis: that he saw the seal that was between the shoulder blades of the Prophet ﷺ.
And he had seen the Prophet ﷺ, but he had no companionship.
items.ma-20835: Muḥammad ibn Jaʿfar narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, from Simāk ibn Ḥarb, he said: I heard Jābir ibn Samurah say: I saw a seal on the back of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, as though it were the egg of a pigeon.
items.ma-21577: Surayj narrated to us, Ibn Abī al-Zinād narrated to us, from his father, from Khārijah ibn Zayd: that Zayd ibn Thābit said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ permitted the sale of ʿarāyā, that they be sold by their estimate, by measure.
items.ma-22135: Abū Kāmil narrated to us, Ḥammād ibn Zayd narrated to us, ʿAmr ibn Dīnār narrated to us, from Ṭāwūs, from Muʿādh, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ did not say anything concerning the awqāṣ of cattle.
items.ma-22230: ʿAbd al-Razzāq narrated to us, Maʿmar narrated to us, from Abū Ghālib, he said: I asked Abū Umāmah about the extra, and he said: It was an extra for the Prophet ﷺ, and a merit for you.
items.ma-22458: Hāshim narrated to us, al-Mubārak informed us, from al-Ḥasan, from Saʿd ibn ʿUbādah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ passed by me, and I said: O Messenger of Allah, guide me to a ṣadaqah. He said: “Give water to drink.”
items.ma-22643: al-Ḥakam ibn Mūsā narrated to us, al-Walīd ibn Muslim narrated to us, from al-Awzāʿī, from Yaḥyā ibn Abī Kathīr, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Abī Qatādah, from his father, from the Prophet ﷺ, like it.
items.ma-22828: ʿAbd al-Razzāq narrated to us, Sufyān informed us, from Abū Ḥāzim, from Sahl ibn Saʿd, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “The people will continue to be in good as long as they hasten the breaking of the fast.”
items.ma-23252: Abū Muʿāwiyah narrated to us, Abū Mālik al-Ashjaʿī narrated to us, from Ribʿī ibn Ḥirāsh, from Ḥudhayfah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “All kindness is ṣadaqah.”
items.ma-23426: Shuʿbah said: And Abū Bishr narrated to me, with an isnād of his, from Ḥudhayfah, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: I said: O Messenger of Allah, what is a truce upon smoke? He said: “Hearts that do not return to what they were.”
items.ma-23544: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Hishām ibn ʿUrwah narrated to us, from his father, from Abū Ayyūb or from Zayd ibn Thābit: that the Prophet ﷺ recited al-Aʿrāf in the two rakʿahs of the Maghrib prayer.
items.ma-24014: Hushaym narrated to us, from ʿUmar ibn Abī Salamah, from Abū Salamah, from his father, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ and I used to bathe from a single vessel from janābah.
items.ma-24207: Abū Muʿāwiyah narrated to us, ʿAmr ibn Maymūn ibn Mihrān narrated to us, from Sulaymān ibn Yasār, from ʿĀʾishah: that she washed semen that had touched the garment of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ.
items.ma-24209: Abū Muʿāwiyah narrated to us, Hishām ibn ʿUrwah narrated to us, from his father, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: The bedding of the Prophet ﷺ on which he slept at night was of tanned leather, stuffed with palm fibre.
items.ma-24339: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Sufyān narrated to us, from Yaḥyā ibn Saʿīd, from ʿAmrah, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: The people were workers for themselves, and they used to set out as they were; so it was said to them: If only you would bathe.
items.ma-24393: Aswad narrated to us, he said: Sharīk narrated to us, from Muʿāwiyah ibn Isḥāq, from ʿĀʾishah bint Ṭalḥah, from ʿĀʾishah, from the Prophet ﷺ that he said: “Keep to the house, for it is your jihād.”
items.ma-24547: Abū al-Yamān and Muḥammad ibn Muṣʿab narrated to us, both said: Abū Bakr ibn ʿAbd Allāh narrated to us, from Ḥabīb ibn ʿUbayd, he said: ʿĀʾishah said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Ill omen is bad character.”
items.ma-24782: Ibrāhīm ibn Abī al-ʿAbbās narrated to us, he said: Sharīk narrated to us, from Abū Isḥāq, from al-Aswad, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: It is as though I am looking at the gleam of perfume in the parting [of the hair] of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ.
items.ma-24785: Aswad ibn ʿĀmir narrated to us, he said: Isrāʾīl narrated to us, from al-Mughīrah, from Ibrāhīm, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ commanded the killing of the wide-eyed dogs.
items.ma-24821: Abū Aḥmad narrated to us, Sufyān narrated to us, from Manṣūr ibn Ṣafiyyah, from his mother, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ held a walīmah for some of his wives with two mudds of barley.
items.ma-24871: Sulaymān ibn Dāwūd narrated to us, he said: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān informed us, from Hishām ibn ʿUrwah, from his father, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: The hair of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was below the jummah and above the wafrah.
items.ma-25039: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Mughīrah ibn Ziyād narrated to us, from ʿAṭāʾ, from ʿĀʾishah: that the Prophet ﷺ used to delay the Ẓuhr and hasten the ʿAṣr, and delay the Maghrib and hasten the ʿIshāʾ, on a journey.
items.ma-25051: Wakīʿ narrated to us, from Sufyān, from Ḥabīb – meaning Ibn Abī Thābit –, from ʿAṭāʾ, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: A garment of mine was stolen, and I began to invoke against him, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Do not lighten it for him.”
items.ma-25367: Jarīr narrated to us, from Hishām ibn ʿUrwah, from his father, from ʿĀʾishah, like the ḥadīth of Manṣūr, except that he said: Her husband was a slave, and had he been free, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ would not have given her the choice.
items.ma-25408: ʿAbd al-Razzāq narrated to us, he said: Sufyān informed us, from Manṣūr, from Sālim ibn Abī al-Jaʿd, from Abū al-Malīḥ, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ; and he mentioned its meaning.
items.ma-25434: Bahz narrated to us, he said: Shuʿbah narrated to us, from Qatādah, from Muṭarrif, from ʿĀʾishah: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to say in his bowing: “Subbūḥ, Quddūs, Rabb of the angels and the Spirit.”
items.ma-25565: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān narrated to us, from Sufyān, from Manṣūr and al-Aʿmash, from Ibrāhīm, from al-Aswad, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: I used to twist the garlands of the hady of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ – sheep –, then he would not enter iḥrām.
items.ma-25568: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān narrated to us, from Sufyān, from Manṣūr, from Mūsā ibn ʿAbd Allāh ibn Yazīd, from a mawlāh of ʿĀʾishah, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: I never saw the private part of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ at all.
items.ma-25585: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from Shuʿbah, from al-Ḥakam, from Ibrāhīm, from al-Aswad, from ʿĀʾishah: that ṣadaqah was given to Barīrah, and the Prophet ﷺ said: “It is ṣadaqah for her, and a gift for us.”
items.ma-25613: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from Hishām – meaning al-Dastuwāʾī –, he said: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from Abū Salamah, from ʿUrwah, from ʿĀʾishah: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to kiss while fasting.
items.ma-25697: Wakīʿ narrated to us, from Sufyān, from al-Aʿmash, from Tamīm – meaning Ibn Salamah –, from ʿUrwah, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: He woke me – she means the Prophet ﷺ – and said: “Get up and pray witr.”
items.ma-25703: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Ismāʿīl ibn Abī Khālid narrated to us, from al-Shaʿbī, from Masrūq, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ gave us the choice, and we chose him. Was that a divorce?
items.ma-25755: Wakīʿ narrated to us, from Usāmah ibn Zayd, from al-Qāsim, from ʿĀʾishah: that Barīrah was a mukātabah, and her husband was a slave, and when she was freed she was given the choice.
items.ma-25952: ʿAbd al-Razzāq narrated to us, Maʿmar narrated to us, from al-Zuhrī, from ʿUrwah, from ʿĀʾishah: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to observe iʿtikāf in the last ten of Ramaḍān until Allah ﷿ took him.
items.ma-25998: Yazīd narrated to us, he said: Sufyān informed us, from al-Aʿmash, from Ibrāhīm, from al-Aswad, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ died while his coat of mail was pledged for thirty ṣāʿs of barley.
items.ma-26171: Asbāṭ narrated to us, Muṭarrif narrated to us. And ʿUbaydah, from ʿĀmir, from Masrūq, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to remain fasting, not caring what he kissed of my face, until he broke his fast.
items.ma-26236: Sulaymān ibn Ḥayyān narrated to us, from Ḥajjāj, from ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn al-Aswad, from his father, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was in janābah and wanted to sleep, he performed wuḍūʾ.
items.ma-26381: ʿĀmir ibn Ṣāliḥ narrated to us, he said: Hishām ibn ʿUrwah narrated to me, from his father, from ʿĀʾishah: that the Prophet ﷺ said: “My Rabb commanded me to give Khadījah the good news of a house in Paradise made of reed.”
items.ma-26520: Wakīʿ narrated to us, al-Qāsim ibn al-Faḍl narrated to us, from Abū Jaʿfar Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī, from Umm Salamah, she said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Ḥajj is the jihād of every weak person.”
items.ma-26604: Yūnus narrated to us, ʿAbd al-Wāḥid narrated to us, ʿUthmān ibn Ḥakīm narrated to us, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Rāfiʿ, from Umm Salamah, she said: I said: and he mentioned the ḥadīth.
items.ma-26762: Muḥammad ibn Jaʿfar narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, from Manṣūr, from Abū al-Ḍuḥā, from Shutayr ibn Shakal, from Umm Ḥabībah: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to kiss while fasting.
items.ma-26805: Hushaym narrated to us, he said: al-Shaybānī informed us, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Shaddād, from Maymūnah bint al-Ḥārith, she said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to pray on the khumrah.
items.ma-26983: Wakīʿ narrated to us, he said: Hishām narrated to us, from Fāṭimah bint al-Mundhir, from Asmāʾ bint Abī Bakr, she said: We slaughtered a horse in the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and ate its meat, or of its meat.
items.ma-27184: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Sufyān narrated to us, from Mukhawwal ibn Rāshid, from a man, from Abū Rāfiʿ, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade that a man pray while his hair is knotted.
items.ma-27371: Yaḥyā ibn Saʿīd narrated to us, from Ibn Jurayj, ʿAṭāʾ narrated to me, from Ḥabībah bint Maysarah, from Umm Kurz al-Kaʿbiyyah, from the Prophet ﷺ: “For the boy, two sheep, and for the girl, one sheep.”
items.ma-4586: Sufyān narrated to us, he said: ʿAmr heard Ibn ʿUmar [say]: We used to practise mukhābarah and saw nothing wrong in it, until Rāfiʿ ibn Khadīj claimed that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ had forbidden it, so we left it.
items.ma-4603: ʿAbdah narrated to us, ʿAbd al-Malik narrated to us, from Saʿīd ibn Jubayr, from Ibn ʿUmar: that the Prophet ﷺ performed liʿān between a man and his wife, and separated them.
items.ma-4670: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from ʿUbayd Allāh, Nāfiʿ narrated to me, from Ibn ʿUmar, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “Prayer in congregation exceeds the prayer of a man alone by twenty-seven.”
items.ma-4718: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from ʿUbayd Allāh, Nāfiʿ informed me, from Ibn ʿUmar, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “The believer eats in one intestine, and the disbeliever eats in seven intestines.”
items.ma-4720: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from ʿUbayd Allāh, Nāfiʿ narrated to me, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿUmar, from the Prophet ﷺ: that he forbade, on the day of Khaybar, the meat of domestic donkeys.
items.ma-4772: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Hishām narrated to us, from his father, from Ibn ʿUmar, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Do not seek out the rising of the sun or its setting for your prayer, for it rises between the two horns of Shayṭān.”
items.ma-4783: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Ḥammād ibn Salamah narrated to us, from Farqad al-Sabakhī, from Saʿīd ibn Jubayr, from Ibn ʿUmar: that the Prophet ﷺ used to apply oil at iḥrām, with oil that was not muqattat.
items.ma-4801: Wakīʿ narrated to us, from Yazīd ibn Ziyād, from Ḥabīb ibn Abī Thābit, from Ibn ʿUmar, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade the ruqbā, and said: “Whoever is granted a ruqbā, it is his.”
items.ma-4829: Rawḥ narrated to us, Ḥammād narrated to us, from Farqad al-Sabakhī, from Saʿīd ibn Jubayr, from Ibn ʿUmar: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ applied oil, with oil that was not muqattat, while he was in iḥrām.
items.ma-4935: Muḥammad ibn Bakr narrated to us, Ibn Jurayj informed us, Ṣāliḥ ibn Kaysān informed me, from Nāfiʿ, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿUmar, that the Prophet ﷺ raised the talbiyah when his mount stood upright with him.
items.ma-5207: And I read it to ʿAbd al-Raḥmān: Mālik, from ʿAmr ibn Yaḥyā, from Abū al-Ḥubāb Saʿīd ibn Yasār, from Ibn ʿUmar, and he did not say: “toward the east.”
items.ma-5209: And I read it to ʿAbd al-Raḥmān: Mālik, from Abū Bakr ibn ʿUmar ibn ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿUmar ibn al-Khaṭṭāb, from Saʿīd ibn Yasār, and he mentioned the ḥadīth.
items.ma-5216: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Sufyān narrated to us, from ʿUmar ibn Muḥammad, from Nāfiʿ: A man asked Ibn ʿUmar about the witr, whether it is obligatory. He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ prayed the witr, and the Muslims [did too].
items.ma-5250: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Ibn Abī Rawwād narrated to us; and Sufyān, from ʿUmar ibn Muḥammad, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, from the Prophet ﷺ: He used to place the bezel of his ring on the side nearest the inside of his palm.
items.ma-5252: Wakīʿ narrated to us, ʿĀṣim ibn Muḥammad narrated to us, from his father, from Ibn ʿUmar, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “If the people knew what is in being alone, no rider would ever travel at night.”
items.ma-5276: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān narrated to us, from Sufyān, from ʿAbd al-Karīm, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ stoned a Jewish man and a Jewish woman at al-Balāṭ.
items.ma-5523: Rawḥ ibn ʿUbādah narrated to us, Ḥanẓalah narrated to us: I heard Ṭāwūs, I heard ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿUmar say: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ stood among us and said: “Do not sell the fruit until its soundness appears.”
items.ma-5650: Abū ʿUbaydah al-Ḥaddād narrated to us, from ʿĀṣim ibn Muḥammad, from his father, from Ibn ʿUmar: that the Prophet ﷺ forbade being alone: that a man spend the night alone or travel alone.
items.ma-5726: Azhar ibn al-Qāsim narrated to us, ʿAbd Allāh narrated to us, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to give two khuṭbahs on the day of Jumuʿah, sitting between them once.
items.ma-5741: Mūsā ibn Dāwūd narrated to us, Fulayḥ narrated to us, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿIkrimah, from Rāfiʿ ibn Ḥunayn, that Ibn ʿUmar informed him: that he saw the Prophet ﷺ go off to a place, facing the qiblah.
items.ma-5744: Ḥusayn ibn Muḥammad narrated to us, Sufyān ibn ʿUyaynah narrated to us, from Yazīd ibn Abī Ziyād, from Ibn Abī Laylā, from Ibn ʿUmar, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “I am the rallying point of every Muslim.”
items.ma-5779: Muḥammad ibn ʿUbayd narrated to us, ʿUbayd Allāh narrated to us, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “The prayer in congregation excels the prayer of one of you by twenty-seven degrees.”
items.ma-5787: [ʿAbd Allāh ibn Aḥmad said:] Muḥammad ibn al-Ṣabbāḥ narrated to us, Ismāʿīl ibn Zakariyyā narrated to us, from ʿUbayd Allāh, from Nāfiʿ and Sālim, from Ibn ʿUmar, from the Prophet ﷺ, like it.
items.ma-5989: Abū Jaʿfar al-Madāʾinī narrated to us, Mubārak ibn Faḍālah informed us, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Dīnār, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿUmar, who narrated to him, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade qazaʿ.
items.ma-6010: Hāshim narrated to us, Jasr narrated to us, Salīṭ narrated to us, from Ibn ʿUmar, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “When you feel the fever, extinguish it with cold water.”
items.ma-6274: Ibn Numayr narrated to us, ʿUbayd Allāh narrated to us, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Whoever drinks wine in this world will not drink it in the Hereafter, unless he repents.”
items.ma-6287: Ibn Numayr narrated to us, ʿUbayd Allāh narrated to us, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, he said: I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ praying his subḥah wherever his she-camel turned with him.
items.ma-6300: Ibn Numayr and Muḥammad ibn ʿUbayd narrated to us, they said: ʿUbayd Allāh narrated to us, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Make the last of your prayer at night witr.”
items.ma-6304: Muḥammad ibn Bakr narrated to us, Ḥanẓalah informed us, he said: Sālim narrated to us, from Ibn ʿUmar, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “When your women ask your permission [to go] to the mosques, give them permission.”
items.ma-6346: ʿAbd al-Razzāq narrated to us, Maʿmar narrated to us, from al-Zuhrī, from Sālim, from Ibn ʿUmar: that he heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, when he raised his head from the rukūʿ, say: “Our Rabb, and to You is the praise.”
items.ma-6383: ʿAbd al-Razzāq narrated to us, Maʿmar narrated to us, from Ayyūb, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, he said: A Makhzūmī woman used to borrow goods and deny it, so the Prophet ﷺ ordered the cutting off of her hand.
items.ma-6399: Rawḥ narrated to us, Mālik narrated to us, from Ibn Shihāb, from Sālim ibn ʿAbd Allāh, from his father: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ prayed the Maghrib and the ʿIshāʾ [prayers] together at al-Muzdalifah.
items.ma-6674: Yaḥyā ibn Saʿīd narrated to us, from ʿUbayd Allāh, ʿAmr ibn Shuʿayb narrated to me, from his father, from his grandfather, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Whatever intoxicates in its large amount, its small amount is ḥarām.”
items.ma-7149: Ismāʿīl narrated to us, Ayyūb narrated to us, from Muḥammad, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: A man called out to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and said: Can one of us pray in a single garment? He said: “Does each one of you find two garments?!”
items.ma-7266: Sufyān narrated to us, from al-Zuhrī, conveying it to the Prophet ﷺ: “The earth has been made for me a place of prostration and a means of purification.” Sufyān said: I think it is from Saʿīd, from Abū Hurayrah.
items.ma-7348: Sufyān narrated to us, from Abū al-Zinād, from al-Aʿraj, from Abū Hurayrah: The best ṣadaqah is that which is – meaning – from the back of wealth, and begin with those whom you support.
items.ma-7373: Sufyān narrated to us, from Ayyūb, from ʿIkrimah, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: I narrate to you some short things from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ: “A man must not drink from the mouth of the waterskin.”
items.ma-7379: Sufyān narrated to us, he said: I memorised it from Maʿmar, from Yaḥyā, who informed him, from Ḍamḍam, from Abū Hurayrah: that the Prophet ﷺ ordered the killing of the two black ones during the prayer: the scorpion and the snake.
items.ma-7384: Sufyān narrated to us, from ʿAbd al-Malik ibn ʿUmayr, from Abū al-Awbar, from Abū Hurayrah: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to pray standing and sitting, barefoot and wearing sandals.
items.ma-7629: Maʿmar said: Thābit and Qatādah informed me that they both heard Anas ibn Mālik mention this ḥadīth, except that he said: “Banū al-Najjār, then Banū ʿAbd al-Ashhal.”
items.ma-8097: Khalaf ibn al-Walīd narrated to us, Khālid narrated to us, from Suhayl, from his father, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “The angels do not accompany a company of travellers in which there is a dog or a bell.”
items.ma-8123: And he said: While a man was driving a garlanded sacrificial camel, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to him: “Woe to you, ride it.” He said: It is a sacrificial camel, O Messenger of Allah! He said: “Woe to you, ride it.”
items.ma-8147: And the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “When one of you looks at one who has been favoured above him in wealth and character, let him look at one who is below him, from among those over whom he has been favoured.”
items.ma-8176: And the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “The most wrathful man against Allah on the Day of Resurrection, and the vilest of them, and the most wrathful against him, is a man who used to be called Malik al-Amlāk; there is no king except Allah ﷿.”
items.ma-8180: And the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Indeed, in the human being there is a bone that the earth never eats; from it he will be put together on the Day of Resurrection.” They said: Which bone is it? He said: “The tailbone.”
items.ma-8393: Muḥammad ibn Bishr narrated to us, Muḥammad ibn ʿAmr narrated to us, Abū Salamah narrated to us, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to love the good omen and dislike ṭiyarah.
items.ma-8495: Abū Saʿīd narrated to us, Wuhayb narrated to us, ʿIsl ibn Sufyān narrated to us, from ʿAṭāʾ, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “When the star rises one morning, the affliction is lifted.”
items.ma-8945: Qutaybah narrated to us, Ibn Lahīʿah narrated to us, from Darrāj, from Ibn Ḥujayrah, from Abū Hurayrah, that the Prophet ﷺ said: “Travel and you will be healthy; go out on military expeditions and you will become free of need.”
items.ma-9033: ʿAffān narrated to us, Abū ʿAwānah narrated to us, from Sulaymān al-Aʿmash, from Abū Ṣāliḥ, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “Indeed, most of the punishment of the grave is [because of] urine.”
items.ma-9049: ʿAffān narrated to us, Wuhayb narrated to us, Suhayl narrated to us, from his father, from Abū Hurayrah: that the Prophet ﷺ ate a shoulder of mutton, then rinsed his mouth, washed his hand and prayed.
items.ma-9051: ʿAffān narrated to us, Wuhayb narrated to us, Suhayl narrated to us, from his father, from Abū Hurayrah, that the Prophet ﷺ said: “Do not hate one another, do not turn your backs on one another, do not compete with one another, and be, O servants of Allah, brothers.”
items.ma-9055: ʿAffān narrated to us, ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Ibrāhīm narrated to us, al-ʿAlāʾ narrated to us, from his father, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, he said: “The world is the prison of the believer and the Paradise of the disbeliever.”
items.ma-9093: Ḥusayn narrated to us, Sufyān narrated to us, from ʿUbayd Allāh ibn Abī Yazīd, from one who heard Abū Hurayrah say: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Do not sleep in a state of janābah until you perform wuḍūʾ.”
items.ma-9163: Sulaymān ibn Dāwūd narrated to us, Ismāʿīl informed us, al-ʿAlāʾ informed me, from his father, from Abū Hurayrah, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “A disbeliever and his killer will never come together in the Fire.”
items.ma-9289: And the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Whoever stands [in prayer] on Laylat al-Qadr out of faith and seeking reward, indeed his previous sins are forgiven.” ʿAffān said: And Abān narrated to us with this isnād, the like of it.
items.ma-9358: ʿAffān narrated to us, Wuhayb narrated to us, Ayyūb narrated to us, from al-Ḥasan, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “The women who seek release and the women who tear themselves away, they are the hypocrites.”
items.ma-9518: Ismāʿīl narrated to us, from Yūnus ibn ʿUbayd, from al-Ḥasan, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “A man must not make an offer over his brother's offer, nor propose [marriage] over his brother's proposal.”
items.ma-9585: Yaḥyā ibn Saʿīd narrated to us, from ʿAwf, he said: Muḥammad narrated to us, from Abū Hurayrah; and [from] al-Ḥasan, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “Glorification is for the men, and clapping is for the women.”
items.ma-9753: Wakīʿ narrated to us, he said: al-Aʿmash narrated to us, from ʿUmārah ibn al-Qaʿqāʿ, from Abū Zurʿah, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “O Allah, make the provision of the family of Muḥammad sustenance.”
items.ma-9758: Wakīʿ narrated to us, he said: Sufyān narrated to us, from ʿĀṣim ibn Kulayb al-Jarmī, from his father, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: I never saw the Prophet ﷺ pray the Ḍuḥā except once.
items.ma-9759: Wakīʿ narrated to us, from Sufyān, from Abū al-Jaḥḥāf, from Abū Ḥāzim, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “O Allah, I love the two of them, so Aḥibbahumā.”
items.ma-10002: Isḥāq narrated to us, Mālik narrated to us, from Abū al-Zinād, from al-Aʿraj, from Abū Hurayrah, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “The delaying of a wealthy man is wrongdoing. When one of you is made to follow a solvent person, let him follow.”
items.ma-10249: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Ḥammād narrated to us, Muḥammad narrated to us, from Abū Hurayrah: that the Prophet ﷺ used to seek refuge from the fitnah of the Dajjāl and the fitnah of life and death.
items.ma-10456: Hāshim narrated to us, al-Mubārak narrated to us, from al-Ḥasan, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: I know it only to be from the Prophet ﷺ; he said: “A woman must not have bodily contact with a woman, nor a man with a man.”
items.ma-10690: Rawḥ narrated to us, Mālik narrated to us, from Abū al-Zinād, from al-Aʿraj, from Abū Hurayrah, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “A woman and her paternal aunt are not to be joined together, nor a woman and her maternal aunt.”
items.ma-10697: Rawḥ narrated to us, Mālik narrated to us, from Suhayl ibn Abī Ṣāliḥ, from his father, from Abū Hurayrah, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “When you hear a man say: The people are ruined, then he is the most ruined of them.”
items.ma-11073-2: Abū Muʿāwiyah narrated to us, al-Aʿmash narrated to us, from Abū Ṣāliḥ, from Abū Saʿīd al-Khudrī, from the Prophet ﷺ regarding His saying: {while they are in heedlessness} [Maryam: 39], he said: “In the world.”
items.ma-11265: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Sufyān narrated to us, from ʿAmr ibn Yaḥyā, from his father, from Abū Saʿīd al-Khudrī, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Do not choose between the prophets.”
items.ma-11280: al-Muṭṭalib ibn Ziyād narrated to us, Ibn Abī Laylā narrated to us, from ʿAṭiyyah al-ʿAwfī, from Abū Saʿīd al-Khudrī, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Whoever does not thank the people has not thanked Allah.”
items.ma-11281: al-Muṭṭalib narrated to us, Ibn Abī Laylā narrated to us, from ʿAṭiyyah al-ʿAwfī, from Abū Saʿīd al-Khudrī, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Take the suḥūr meal, for in the suḥūr there is blessing.”
items.ma-11414: Muḥammad ibn Jaʿfar Ghundar narrated to us, he said: Ibn Abī Laylā narrated to us, from ʿAṭiyyah, from Abū Saʿīd al-Khudrī, from the Prophet ﷺ, that he said about the foetus: “Its slaughter is the slaughter of its mother.”
items.ma-11500: Suwayd ibn ʿAmr narrated to us, Abān narrated to us, Yaḥyā narrated to us, from Hilāl ibn ʿIyāḍ, from Abū Saʿīd al-Khudrī, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “When one of you prays,” and he mentioned its meaning.
items.ma-11638: Yazīd ibn Hārūn narrated to us, Muḥammad ibn ʿAmr informed us, from Abū Salamah, from Abū Saʿīd al-Khudrī, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade al-muḥāqalah and al-muzābanah.
items.ma-11703: Muḥammad ibn Rabīʿah narrated to us, from Ibn Abī Laylā, from ʿAṭiyyah al-ʿAwfī, from Abū Saʿīd al-Khudrī, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Whoever does not thank the people does not thank Allah ﷿.”
items.ma-11751: Abū Nuʿaym narrated to us, Zakariyyā narrated to us, from ʿAṭiyyah, from Abū Saʿīd al-Khudrī, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Whoever dies not associating anything with Allah enters Paradise.”
items.ma-11803: Yūnus narrated to us, Ḥammād – meaning Ibn Salamah – narrated to us, from Bishr ibn Ḥarb, he said: I heard Abū Saʿīd al-Khudrī say: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to supplicate at ʿArafah like this – meaning with the back of his palm.
items.ma-12035: Ibn Abī ʿAdī narrated to us, from Ḥumayd, from Anas, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “I entered Paradise and heard a rustling in front of me, and behold, it was al-Ghumayṣāʾ bint Milḥān.”
items.ma-12062: Ibn Abī ʿAdī narrated to us, from Saʿīd; and Ibn Jaʿfar said: Saʿīd informed us, from Qatādah, from Anas, that the Prophet of Allah ﷺ said: “Phlegm in the mosque is a sin, and its kaffārah is burying it.”
items.ma-12318: Muḥammad ibn Jaʿfar narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, from Ḥabīb ibn al-Shahīd, from Thābit, from Anas ibn Mālik: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ prayed over the grave of a woman who had been buried.
items.ma-12423: Abū al-Naḍr narrated to us, Abū Jaʿfar narrated to us, from Ḥumayd, from Anas, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade that dates and raisins be steeped together, and that dates and unripe dates be steeped together.
items.ma-12513: Sufyān ibn ʿUyaynah narrated to us, Mālik ibn Anas narrated to us, from Isḥāq ibn ʿAbd Allāh, from his uncle Anas, he said: I saw the Prophet ﷺ going after it from the dish, so I do not cease to love it, ever.
items.ma-12682: ʿAbd al-Razzāq narrated to us, Maʿmar informed us, from Qatādah, from Anas: that the Prophet ﷺ was cupped while in iḥrām, on the top of the foot, because of a pain he had.
items.ma-12785: Muʾammal narrated to us, Ḥammād narrated to us, Thābit narrated to us, from Anas: that Abū Ṭaybah cupped the Prophet ﷺ, so he ordered for him a ṣāʿ of dates, and spoke to his people, and they deducted from his kharāj.
items.ma-12829: Sahl narrated to us, Ḥumayd informed us, from Anas: that a man peered at the Prophet ﷺ through a gap, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ aimed a broad arrowhead at him, and the man withdrew his head.
items.ma-12832: Yaḥyā ibn Saʿīd narrated to us, from Ḥumayd, he said: Anas was asked about the voluntary fasting of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. He said: He would fast until we said: He does not break his fast, and he would break his fast until we said: He does not fast.
items.ma-12964: Muḥammad ibn ʿAbd Allāh narrated to us, Ḥumayd narrated to us, from Anas, he said: We used to pray the Maghrib, then one of us would set off to Banū Salimah, and he could see where his arrows fell.
items.ma-13060: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid narrated to us, Ḥumayd narrated to us, from Anas, he said: The prayer was established, and the Prophet of Allah ﷺ came out, and a man confronted him and detained him until some of the people were almost dozing.
items.ma-13134: Ibn Abī ʿAdī narrated to us, from Ḥumayd, from Anas, he said: The prayer was established, and a man confronted the Prophet ﷺ and detained him after the prayer had been established, until some of the people dozed.
items.ma-13201: ʿAbd al-Ṣamad narrated to us, Abān narrated to us, Qatādah narrated to us, from Anas: that a Jew invited the Prophet ﷺ to barley bread and rancid fat, and he answered him.
items.ma-13273: Abū Qaṭan narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, from Thābit, from Anas, from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, he said: “Patience is at the shock” – I think he said: “the first.” Abū Qaṭan was in doubt.
items.ma-13364: Hāshim narrated to us, al-Mubārak narrated to us, from Ismāʿīl ibn ʿAbd Allāh ibn Abī Ṭalḥah, from Anas ibn Mālik, he said: Perfume was never offered to the Prophet ﷺ and he refused it.
items.ma-13505: Ḥasan ibn Mūsā narrated to us, Abū Hilāl narrated to us, Maṭar al-Warrāq narrated to us, from Anas ibn Mālik, he said: The Prophet of Allah ﷺ used to go round to nine women in one forenoon.
items.ma-13546: Surayj narrated to us, Ḥammād – meaning Ibn Salamah – narrated to us, from Thābit, from Anas ibn Mālik: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ prayed with him, while Umm Sulaym and Umm Ḥarām were behind us, on a mat.
items.ma-13598: ʿAffān narrated to us, ʿAbd al-Wārith narrated to us, Shuʿayb ibn al-Ḥabḥāb narrated to us, from Anas, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “I have [said] much to you concerning the siwāk.”
items.ma-13629: ʿAffān narrated to us, Hammām narrated to us, Qatādah narrated to us, from Anas, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “No servant believes until he loves for his Muslim brother what he loves for himself of good.”
items.ma-13638: ʿAffān narrated to us, Ḥammād narrated to us, from Ḥumayd, from Anas, that the Prophet ﷺ said: “Wage jihād against the polytheists with your wealth, your selves and your tongues.”
items.ma-13704: ʿAffān narrated to us, Ḥammād ibn Salamah narrated to us, he said: ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz ibn Ṣuhayb narrated to us, from Anas ibn Mālik, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “Take the suḥūr meal, for in the suḥūr there is blessing.”
items.ma-13740: Ḥusayn narrated to us in the tafsīr of Shaybān, from Qatādah, he said: I heard Anas ibn Mālik say: I heard the Prophet of Allah ﷺ say: “When the people of Paradise see them, they will say: These are the Jahannamīyyūn.”
items.ma-13751: Abū Nuʿaym narrated to us, Misʿar narrated to us, from ʿAmr ibn ʿĀmir, he said: I heard Anas ibn Mālik say: The Prophet ﷺ used to be cupped, and he never wronged anyone [in] his wage.
items.ma-13860:
ʿAffān narrated to us, Abān narrated to us, Qatādah narrated to us, from Anas: that a Jew invited the Messenger of Allah ﷺ to barley bread and rancid fat, and he answered him.
And Abān also said: that a tailor.
items.ma-13877: Wakīʿ and Yaḥyā ibn Saʿīd narrated to us, from Shuʿbah, from Qatādah, from Anas – Yaḥyā said: Qatādah informed us, from Anas – he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, and he mentioned its meaning.
items.ma-13958: ʿAbd Allāh narrated to us, Abū ʿAbd Allāh al-Sulamī narrated to us, he said: Abū Dāwūd narrated to me, from Shuʿbah, from Qatādah, he said: I heard Anas say: The moon was split in the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ.
items.ma-14050: ʿAffān narrated to us, Ḥammād ibn Salamah narrated to us, he said: Thābit informed us, from Anas ibn Mālik, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Yūsuf was given half of beauty.”
items.ma-14053: ʿAffān narrated to us, Ḥammād ibn Salamah narrated to us, from Thābit, from Anas, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Stand straight, stand straight! By Allah, I see you from behind me as I see you in front of me.”
items.ma-14108: ʿAlī ibn ʿAbd Allāh narrated to us, Muʿādh ibn Hishām narrated to us, my father narrated to me, from Qatādah, from Anas ibn Mālik, he said: The most beloved of garments for the Messenger of Allah ﷺ to wear was the ḥibarah.
items.ma-14138: ʿAbd al-Razzāq narrated to us, Maʿmar narrated to us, from Manṣūr, from Sālim ibn Abī al-Jaʿd, from Jābir ibn ʿAbd Allāh, he said: When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ prostrated, he held [his arms] apart until the whiteness of his armpits could be seen.
items.ma-14250: Hushaym narrated to us, Yazīd ibn Abī Ziyād informed us, from Sālim ibn Abī al-Jaʿd, from Jābir ibn ʿAbd Allāh, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to perform ghusl with a ṣāʿ and perform wuḍūʾ with a mudd.
items.ma-14373: Abū Muʿāwiyah narrated to us, some of our companions narrated to us, from al-Aʿmash, from Abū Sufyān, from Jābir, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Whoever dies upon something, Allah resurrects him upon it.”
items.ma-14464: Yaḥyā ibn Ādam and Abū al-Naḍr narrated to us, Zuhayr narrated to us, from Abū al-Zubayr, from Jābir ibn ʿAbd Allāh, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Whoever seizes plunder is not of us.”
items.ma-14513: Zayd narrated to us, Ḥusayn narrated to us, from Abū al-Zubayr, from Jābir, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “I was brought the keys of the world on a piebald horse, upon which was a velvet cloth of sundus.”
items.ma-14753: Mūsā narrated to us, Ibn Lahīʿah narrated to us, from Abū al-Zubayr, he said: I asked Jābir about a man who has bodily contact with a man, and Jābir said: The Prophet ﷺ rebuked that.
items.ma-14797: Isḥāq ibn ʿĪsā narrated to us, Sharīk narrated to us, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Muḥammad ibn ʿAqīl, from Jābir ibn ʿAbd Allāh, he said: A man came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and he mentioned its meaning.
items.ma-14913: ʿAffān narrated to us, ʿAbd al-Wāḥid narrated to us, al-Ḥajjāj narrated to us, from ʿAṭāʾ, from Jābir, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to go out on the two ʿĪds and bring out his family.
items.ma-14961: Muḥammad ibn Jaʿfar narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, from ʿAmr ibn Dīnār, he said: I heard Jābir ibn ʿAbd Allāh say: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to me: “Is there not a young girl with whom you play and who plays with you?”
items.ma-14993: Ḥusayn ibn Muḥammad narrated to us, Jarīr – meaning Ibn Ḥāzim – narrated to us, from Ayyūb, from Abū al-Zubayr, from Jābir, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Whoever takes charge of his brother, let him make his shroud good.”
items.ma-15011: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Mahdī narrated to us, from Sufyān, from Muḥammad ibn al-Munkadir, from Jābir, he said: The Prophet ﷺ came to visit me, not riding a mule or a pack horse.
items.ma-15270: Aḥmad ibn ʿAbd al-Malik narrated to us, ʿUbayd Allāh ibn ʿAmr narrated to us, from ʿAbd al-Karīm, from ʿAṭāʾ, from Jābir, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “ʿUmrah in Ramaḍān is equal to a Ḥajj.”
items.ma-15712: Rawḥ narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, from ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn al-Qāsim, from his father, from Ṣāliḥ ibn Khawwāt, from Sahl ibn Abī Ḥathmah, from the Prophet ﷺ, like this.
items.ma-15880: Ḥusayn ibn Muḥammad narrated to us, Khalaf – meaning Ibn Khalīfah – narrated to us, from Abū Mālik al-Ashjaʿī, from his father, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Whoever sees me in a dream has seen me.”
items.ma-16110: Yaḥyā ibn Saʿīd narrated to us, from Hishām, he said: My father informed me, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn al-Zubayr, that the Prophet ﷺ said: “The single suck and the two sucks do not make [anything] forbidden through suckling.”
items.ma-16152: Abū Aḥmad al-Zubayrī narrated to us, he said: ʿUmar ibn Saʿīd narrated to us, from Ibn Abī Mulaykah, from ʿUqbah ibn al-Ḥārith, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ left when he had prayed the ʿAṣr, and he mentioned its meaning.
items.ma-16326: ʿAffān narrated to us, he said: Ḥammād narrated to us, he said: Thābit informed us, from Muṭarrif, from his father, he said: I came to the Prophet ﷺ while he was praying, and in his chest was a humming like the humming of a cauldron.
items.ma-16328: Bahz narrated to us, he said: Hammām narrated to us, Qatādah narrated to us, from Muṭarrif, from his father: that he entered upon the Prophet ﷺ and heard him say. And he mentioned the like of the ḥadīth of ʿAffān, but he did not mention the saying of Qatādah.
items.ma-16521: Ḥammād ibn Khālid narrated to us, from Ayyūb ibn ʿUtbah, from Iyās ibn Salamah ibn al-Akwaʿ, from his father, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “When the prayer and the evening meal are present, begin with the evening meal.”
items.ma-16532: Ṣafwān narrated to us, he said: Ibn Abī ʿUbayd narrated to us, from Salamah ibn al-Akwaʿ, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to pray the Maghrib at the hour the sun set, when its rim had disappeared.
items.ma-16901: Wakīʿ narrated to us, he said: Bayhas ibn Fahdān narrated to me, from Abū Shaykh al-Hunāʾī – I heard it from him – from Muʿāwiyah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade wearing gold except in cut [pieces].
items.ma-17696: Rawḥ narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, from Yazīd ibn Khumayr, he said: I heard ʿAbd Allāh ibn Busr narrating from his father: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ visited them, and he mentioned the meaning of the ḥadīth of Ibn Jaʿfar.
items.ma-17746: Abū al-Mughīrah narrated to us, he said: ʿAbd Allāh ibn al-ʿAlāʾ narrated to us, he said: Busr ibn ʿUbayd Allāh narrated to me, from Abū Idrīs, from Abū Thaʿlabah, like that.
items.ma-17969: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Sufyān narrated to us, from Ibn Jurayj, from Ibn Yaʿlā, from his father: that when the Prophet ﷺ arrived, he performed ṭawāf around the House, in iḍṭibāʿ with a Ḥaḍramī cloak of his.
items.ma-18494: Ḥumayd ibn ʿAbd al-Raḥmān narrated to us, from al-Aʿmash, from Ṭalḥah, from ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn ʿAwsajah, from al-Barāʾ, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Adorn the Qurʾān with your voices.”
items.ma-18573: Muḥammad and Hāshim narrated to us, they said: Shuʿbah narrated to us, from Abū Isḥāq, from al-Barāʾ ibn ʿĀzib, he said: On the day of Khaybar we got donkeys, and the caller of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ called out: Overturn the cooking pots.
items.ma-18585: [ʿAbd Allāh said:] And Hudbah narrated to us, Sulaymān ibn al-Mughīrah narrated to us, from Ḥumayd ibn Hilāl, from Yūnus, from al-Barāʾ, similarly. He also said in it: māḥah.
items.ma-18599: ʿAffān narrated to us, ʿUbayd Allāh ibn Iyād narrated to us, Iyād narrated to us, from al-Barāʾ ibn ʿĀzib, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “When you prostrate, place your palms and raise your elbows.”
items.ma-18650: Wakīʿ narrated to us, from Shuʿbah, from ʿAdī ibn Thābit, from al-Barāʾ, that the Prophet ﷺ said to Ḥassān: “Attack them – or: Satirise them – for Jibrīl is with you.”
items.ma-18655: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān and Ibn Jaʿfar narrated to us, they said: Shuʿbah narrated to us, from ʿAmr ibn Murrah, from Saʿd ibn ʿUbaydah, from al-Barāʾ, from the Prophet ﷺ, like that.
items.ma-18742: Ismāʿīl ibn Ibrāhīm narrated to us, from Shuʿbah, from ʿAdī ibn Thābit, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Yazīd al-Khaṭmī – and he is the Anṣārī – he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade mutilation and plunder.
items.ma-18828: Wakīʿ narrated to us, from Sufyān, from ʿAlqamah, from Ṭāriq, he said: A man came to the Prophet ﷺ and said: Which jihād is best? He said: “A word of truth before an unjust imām.”
items.ma-18846: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Mūsā ibn ʿUmayr al-ʿAnbarī narrated to us, from ʿAlqamah ibn Wāʾil al-Ḥaḍramī, from his father, he said: I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ placing his right [hand] on his left in the prayer.
items.ma-18849: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Fiṭr narrated to us, from ʿAbd al-Jabbār ibn Wāʾil, from his father, he said: I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ raise his hands when he began the prayer, until his thumb was level with the lobes of his ears.
items.ma-19211: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Sufyān narrated to us, from Ḥabīb ibn Abī Thābit, from al-Mughīrah ibn Shibl, from Jarīr, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “When the slave runs away, protection is absolved from him.”
items.ma-19518: Wakīʿ and ʿAbd al-Raḥmān narrated to us, from Isrāʾīl, from Abū Isḥāq, from Abū Burdah, from his father, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “There is no marriage except with a guardian.”
items.ma-19637: Ismāʿīl narrated to us, Ayyūb narrated to us, from al-Qāsim al-Tamīmī, from Zahdam al-Jarmī, he said: We were with Abū Mūsā, and his food was brought forward … and he mentioned something like the ḥadīth of Zahdam.
items.ma-19765: Muʿtamir narrated to us, he said: My father informed me, from Abū al-Minhāl, from Abū Barzah: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to recite in the morning [prayer] from sixty to a hundred [verses], and from sixty to a hundred [verses].
items.ma-19979: Rawḥ narrated to us, Ḥammād narrated to us, from al-Jurayrī, from Abū al-ʿAlāʾ, from Muṭarrif, from ʿImrān ibn Ḥuṣayn, from the Prophet ﷺ, like it, except that he did not say: “two days.”
items.ma-20088: Bahz and ʿAffān narrated to us, they said: Hammām narrated to us, from Qatādah, from al-Ḥasan, from Samurah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “The neighbour of the house has more right to the house than others.”
items.ma-20128: ʿAbd al-Wahhāb al-Khaffāf narrated to us, Saʿīd narrated to us, from Qatādah, from al-Ḥasan, from Samurah ibn Jundub, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “The neighbour of the house has more right to the house.”
items.ma-20153: Bahz narrated to us, Hammām narrated to us, from Qatādah, from al-Ḥasan, from Samurah: that the day of Ḥunayn was a rainy day, so the Prophet ﷺ ordered his caller, and he called out: Indeed, the prayer is in the lodgings.
items.ma-20160: Wakīʿ narrated to us, from Sufyān, from al-Aswad ibn Qays al-ʿAbdī, from Thaʿlabah ibn ʿAbbād, from Samurah ibn Jundub, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ prayed with us during an eclipse, and we did not hear a sound from him.
items.ma-20179: Bahz narrated to us, Ḥammād ibn Salamah narrated to us, Qatādah informed us, from al-Ḥasan, from Samurah, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “The Qurʾān was revealed upon seven aḥruf.”
items.ma-20233: Abū Sufyān al-Maʿmarī narrated to us, from Sufyān, from his father, from al-Shaʿbī, from Samʿān ibn Mushannij, from Samurah ibn Jundub, and he mentioned the ḥadīth.
items.ma-20322: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, from Ḥumayd ibn Hilāl, he said: I heard Muṭarrif narrating from a Bedouin, he said: I saw on the foot of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ a mended sandal.
items.ma-20364: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, from Muʿāwiyah ibn Qurrah, from his father, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Fasting three days of every month is the fasting of a lifetime and its breaking of the fast.”
items.ma-20381: Wakīʿ narrated to us, ʿUthmān al-Shaḥḥām narrated to me, from Muslim ibn Abī Bakrah, from his father, that the Prophet ﷺ used to say: “O Allah, I seek refuge in You from disbelief, poverty and the punishment of the grave.”
items.ma-20405: Yaḥyā narrated to us, Ashʿath narrated to us, from Ziyād al-Aʿlam, from al-Ḥasan, from Abū Bakrah: that he bowed short of the row, and the Prophet ﷺ said to him: “May Allah increase you in eagerness, and do not repeat it.”
items.ma-20452: Surayj narrated to us, Ḥashraj narrated to us, from Saʿīd, from ʿAbd Allāh or ʿUbayd Allāh ibn Abī Bakrah, he said: My father narrated to me in this mosque – meaning the mosque of al-Baṣrah – and he mentioned the like of it.
items.ma-20461: ʿAffān narrated to us, Ḥammād ibn Salamah narrated to us, from Yūnus, from al-Ḥasan and Muḥammad, from Abū Bakrah, that the Prophet ﷺ said: “Do not return after me as disbelievers, some of you striking the necks of others.”
items.ma-20474: Muḥammad ibn Bakr narrated to us, ʿUyaynah narrated to us, from his father, from Abū Bakrah, he said: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: “A people who entrust their affair to a woman will never succeed.”
items.ma-20852: Hāshim narrated to us, Zuhayr narrated to us, Simāk narrated to us, from Jābir ibn Samurah, he said: Bilāl used to call the adhān when [the sun] declined, then would not pronounce the iqāmah until he saw the Prophet ﷺ; and when he saw him, he pronounced the iqāmah as he saw him.
items.ma-20895: Muḥammad ibn Jaʿfar narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, from Simāk ibn Ḥarb, he said: I heard Jābir ibn Samurah say: I saw a seal in the back of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, as though it were a pigeon's egg.
items.ma-21316: ʿAffān narrated to us, Abū ʿAwānah narrated to us, from ʿĀṣim, from al-Maʿrūr ibn Suwayd, from Abū Dharr, he said: I heard the truthful, the one who is believed ﷺ, and he mentioned its meaning.
items.ma-21562: Aswad ibn ʿĀmir narrated to us, Abū Bakr narrated to us, from Muṭarrif, from Abū al-Jahm, from Khālid ibn Wahbān, from Abū Dharr, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, and he mentioned the like of it.
items.ma-21584: Sufyān narrated to us, from al-Zuhrī, from Sālim, from his father: that the Prophet ﷺ forbade the sale of fruit for dates, and Zayd ibn Thābit informed them that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ granted a concession in the ʿarāyā.
items.ma-22483: Yaʿqūb narrated to us, my father narrated to us, from Ibn Isḥāq, Jaʿfar ibn ʿAmr ibn Umayyah narrated to me, from his father, he said: I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ wiping over the two khuffs.
items.ma-22859: Ismāʿīl ibn ʿUmar narrated to us, Mālik narrated to us, from Abū Ḥāzim, from Sahl ibn Saʿd, that the Prophet ﷺ said: “The people will continue to be in good as long as they hasten the breaking of the fast.”
items.ma-23057: Wakīʿ narrated to us, al-Aʿmash narrated to us, from Saʿd ibn ʿUbaydah, from Ibn Buraydah, from his father, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Whoever I am his walī, ʿAlī is his walī.”
items.ma-23058: ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥasan – and he is Ibn Shaqīq – narrated to us, al-Ḥusayn ibn Wāqid informed us, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Buraydah, from his father: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ sacrificed the ʿaqīqah for al-Ḥasan and al-Ḥusayn.
items.ma-23418: Wakīʿ narrated to us, from Ibn Abī Laylā, from a shaykh called Hilāl, from Ḥudhayfah, he said: And I asked the Prophet ﷺ about everything, even about wiping away the pebbles, and he said: “Once, or leave it.”
items.ma-23908: Hāshim ibn al-Qāsim narrated to us, Muḥammad ibn Rāshid narrated to us, from Makḥūl, from Nuʿaym ibn Khammār, from Bilāl, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Wipe over the two khuffs and the khimār.”
items.ma-24026: Muʿtamir narrated to us, from Ayyūb, from Ibn Abī Mulaykah, from Ibn al-Zubayr, from ʿĀʾishah, that the Prophet of Allah ﷺ said: “The single suck and the two sucks do not make [anything] forbidden.”
items.ma-24181: Abū Muʿāwiyah narrated to us, al-Aʿmash narrated to us, from Muslim, from Masrūq, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ gave us a choice, and we chose him, and he did not count it against us as anything.
items.ma-24278: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from Sufyān, from Mūsā ibn Abī ʿĀʾishah, from ʿUbayd Allāh ibn ʿAbd Allāh, from ʿĀʾishah and Ibn ʿAbbās: that Abū Bakr kissed the Prophet ﷺ while he was dead.
items.ma-24391: Aswad narrated to us, Ḥasan narrated to us, from Ashʿath, from Abū al-Zubayr, from Jābir, from Umm Kulthūm, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: We did it once, so we performed ghusl – meaning the one who has intercourse and does not ejaculate.
items.ma-24554: Muḥammad ibn Muṣʿab narrated to us, he said: al-Awzāʿī narrated to us, from al-Zuhrī, from ʿUrwah, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to pray the ʿAṣr, while the sun was indeed visible in my chamber.
items.ma-24630: Bahz narrated to us, he said: Shuʿbah narrated to us, from Qatādah, from Muṭarrif, from ʿĀʾishah: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to say in his rukūʿ and his sujūd: “Subbūḥ, Quddūs, Rabb of the angels and the Rūḥ.”
items.ma-24741: Abū Saʿīd narrated to us, he said: Ibn Abī al-Rijāl narrated to us, he said: I heard my father narrating from ʿAmrah, from ʿĀʾishah: that the Prophet ﷺ forbade the naqʿ of the well, and it is al-rahw.
items.ma-24953: Muḥammad ibn Jaʿfar narrated to us, he said: Maʿmar narrated to us, al-Zuhrī informed us, from ʿUrwah, from ʿĀʾishah: that she used to perform ghusl, she and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, from one vessel.
items.ma-25057: Wakīʿ narrated to us, he said: Muḥammad ibn Sulaym narrated to us, from Ibn Abī Mulaykah, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Guard yourselves against the Fire, even with half a date.”
items.ma-25065: Wakīʿ narrated to us, from Sufyān, from al-Miqdām, from his father, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: When the Prophet ﷺ saw a rising cloud, his face would turn red; and when it rained, he would say: “O Allah, a pouring rain, wholesome.”
items.ma-25153: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Mahdī narrated to us, Sufyān narrated to us, from Manṣūr, from his mother, from ʿĀʾishah: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to place his head in her lap and recite the Qurʾān while she was menstruating.
items.ma-25220: Hāshim ibn al-Qāsim narrated to us, Isrāʾīl narrated to us, from Yūsuf ibn Abī Burdah, from his father, he said: ʿĀʾishah narrated to me that the Prophet ﷺ, when he came out of the lavatory, would say: “[I ask] Your forgiveness.”
items.ma-25348: ʿAbd al-Razzāq narrated to us, Maʿmar narrated to us, from Qatādah, from Muʿādhah al-ʿAdawiyyah, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: The Prophet ﷺ used to pray the Ḍuḥā prayer, four rakʿahs, and would add what Allah willed.
items.ma-25436: ʿAffān narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, he said: Abū Isḥāq informed us, he said: I heard al-Aswad say: I asked ʿĀʾishah about the prayer of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and he mentioned the like of it.
items.ma-25444: Ḥajjāj narrated to us, Ibn Abī Dhiʾb informed us, from al-Zuhrī, from ʿUrwah, from ʿĀʾishah, that she used to say: The Prophet ﷺ never prayed the subḥah of the Ḍuḥā, and indeed I pray it.
items.ma-25653: Sufyān ibn ʿUyaynah narrated to us, from Manṣūr, from Ibrāhīm, from ʿAlqamah, from ʿĀʾishah, that the Prophet ﷺ used to kiss while fasting and have bodily contact while fasting, and he was the one among you with the most control over his need.
items.ma-25677: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from Abū Ḥurrah, he said: al-Ḥasan narrated to us, from Saʿd ibn Hishām, from ʿĀʾishah, that the Prophet ﷺ, when he rose at night, would pray two rakʿahs, keeping them brief.
items.ma-25691: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Kahmas narrated to us, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Shaqīq, he said: I said to ʿĀʾishah: Did the Messenger of Allah ﷺ pray the Ḍuḥā? She said: No, except when he came back from his absence.
items.ma-25739: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Sufyān narrated to us, from al-Shaybānī, from ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn al-Aswad, from his father, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ granted a concession for the ruqyah from every one that has a venomous sting.
items.ma-25780: Wakīʿ narrated to us, from Hishām, from a man of the descendants of al-Zubayr, from ʿĀʾishah, that she said: O Messenger of Allah, all your wives have a kunyah except me. He said: “You are Umm ʿAbd Allāh.”
items.ma-25793: Ibn Jaʿfar narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, from al-Miqdām ibn Shurayḥ ibn Hāniʾ, from his father, he said: ʿĀʾishah said: I used to gnaw a bone while I was menstruating, and he mentioned the like of it.
items.ma-25808: Ḥajjāj narrated to us, Layth narrated to us, he said: ʿUqayl narrated to me, from Ibn Shihāb, from ʿUrwah, from ʿĀʾishah – she informed him – that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ delayed [the prayer] into the ʿatamah one night, and he mentioned its meaning.
items.ma-25976: ʿAbd al-Wahhāb narrated to us, from Saʿīd, from Qatādah, from Ṣafiyyah bint Shaybah, from ʿĀʾishah: that the Prophet ﷺ used to perform ghusl with a ṣāʿ, and perform wuḍūʾ with the measure of a mudd or about that.
items.ma-26019: Yazīd narrated to us, he said: Hammām informed us, from Qatādah, from Ṣafiyyah bint Shaybah, from ʿĀʾishah: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to perform wuḍūʾ with the measure of a mudd, and perform ghusl with the measure of a ṣāʿ.
items.ma-26099: ʿUthmān narrated to us, he said: Yūnus narrated to us, from al-Zuhrī, from ʿUrwah, from ʿĀʾishah, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “The single suck does not make [anything] forbidden, nor do the two sucks.”
items.ma-26172: Asbāṭ narrated to us, he said: al-Shaybānī narrated to us, from ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn al-Aswad, from his father, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ granted a concession for the ruqyah from every one that has a venomous sting.
items.ma-26398: Ḥasan ibn Mūsā narrated to us, he said: Ḥammād ibn Salamah narrated to us, from ʿAlī ibn Zayd, from Abū Salamah ibn ʿAbd al-Raḥmān, that ʿĀʾishah said: I raced the Prophet ﷺ, and I beat him.
items.ma-26517: Wakīʿ narrated to us, my father narrated to us, from Manṣūr, from Sālim ibn Abī al-Jaʿd, from Abū Salamah ibn ʿAbd al-Raḥmān, from Umm Salamah, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to fast Shaʿbān and Ramaḍān.
items.ma-26518: Wakīʿ narrated to us, he said: Hārūn al-Naḥwī narrated to us, from Thābit al-Bunānī, from Shahr ibn Ḥawshab, from Umm Salamah, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ recited it: {Indeed, he did [what is] other than righteous} [Hūd: 46].
items.ma-26691: ʿAffān narrated to us, Ḥammād narrated to us, from ʿAlī ibn Zayd, from al-Ḥasan, from his mother, from Umm Salamah, she said: While the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was – and he mentioned its meaning.
items.ma-26851: Hushaym narrated to us, he said: al-Shaybānī informed us, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Shaddād, from Maymūnah bint al-Ḥārith, she said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to pray on the khumrah.
items.ma-27068: Yaḥyā ibn Saʿīd narrated to us, from Usāmah ibn Zayd, he said: Sālim Abū al-Nuʿmān narrated to me, from Umm Ṣubayyah, she said: My hand and the hand of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ went back and forth in a single vessel at wuḍūʾ.
items.ma-4350: Muḥammad ibn ʿUbayd narrated to us, al-Aʿmash narrated to us, from Shaqīq ibn Salamah, from ʿAbd Allāh, he said: I know the counterparts that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to recite, two in one rakʿah.
items.ma-4519: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Mahdī narrated to us, from Mālik, from Abū Bakr ibn ʿUmar, from Saʿīd ibn Yasār, from Ibn ʿUmar, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ prayed witr on the camel.
items.ma-4545: Sufyān narrated to us, from al-Zuhrī, from Sālim, from his father, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “He who misses the ʿAṣr prayer, it is as if he has been robbed of his family and his wealth.”
items.ma-4724: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from ʿUbayd Allāh, Nāfiʿ narrated to me, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿUmar, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ cursed the wāṣilah, the mustawṣilah, the wāshimah, and the mustawshimah.”
items.ma-4757: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Ibn Abī Dhiʾb and al-ʿUmarī narrated to us, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar: that the Prophet ﷺ used to pray two rakʿahs after the Maghrib [prayer] in his house.
items.ma-4847: Yazīd narrated to us, Hishām informed us, from Muḥammad ibn Sīrīn, from Ibn ʿUmar, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “The Maghrib prayer is the witr of the day, so make the night prayer witr.”
items.ma-4879: Yazīd narrated to us, Muḥammad ibn Isḥāq informed us, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “The Dajjāl is one-eyed in the eye; it is as though it were a floating grape.”
items.ma-4931: Ibrāhīm ibn Khālid narrated to us, Rabāḥ narrated to us, from Maʿmar, from Ayyūb, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, that the Prophet ﷺ forbade any one of you to seek out the setting of the sun and pray at that time.
items.ma-4949: Ḥammād ibn Usāmah narrated to us, ʿUbayd Allāh narrated to us, Nāfiʿ narrated to us, from Ibn ʿUmar: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “When one of you is invited to a walīmah, let him respond.”
items.ma-4983: Zayd ibn al-Ḥubāb narrated to us, from ʿAbd Allāh, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ performed ramal for three [circuits] from the Stone to the Stone, and walked four.
items.ma-5064: He said: I found in my father's book: Yazīd narrated to us, Shuʿbah informed us, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Dīnār, from Ibn ʿUmar, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “Whoever buys food, let him not sell it until he has taken possession of it.”
items.ma-5211: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Ḥanẓalah al-Jumaḥī narrated to us, from Sālim, from Ibn ʿUmar, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “When your women ask your permission [to go] to the mosques, give them permission.”
items.ma-5273: Rawḥ narrated to us, Ḥanẓalah narrated to us, I heard Ṭāwūs say: I heard ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿUmar say: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ stood among us and said: “Do not sell fruit until its soundness becomes apparent.”
items.ma-5292: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān narrated to us, Mālik narrated to us, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade the sale of fruit until its soundness becomes apparent; he forbade the seller and the buyer.
items.ma-5293: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān narrated to us, Mālik narrated to us, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade travelling with the Qurʾān to the land of the enemy, for fear that the enemy might get hold of it.
items.ma-5401: Abū Salamah al-Khuzāʿī narrated to us, ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿUmar informed us, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ performed ramal from the Stone to the Stone.
items.ma-5423: ʿAffān narrated to us, Sulaymān narrated to us – meaning Ibn al-Mughīrah – from Thābit, he said: I said to Ibn ʿUmar: Did the Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbid nabīdh of the jar? He said: They have claimed that.
items.ma-5561: Yazīd narrated to us, Shuʿbah ibn al-Ḥajjāj informed us, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Dīnār, from Ibn ʿUmar, he said: A man said: O Messenger of Allah, I am deceived in sales. He said: “Say: There is no khilābah.”
items.ma-5707: ʿAbd al-Ṣamad narrated to us, Ḥammād narrated to us, from Mūsā ibn ʿUqbah, from Sālim, from Ibn ʿUmar, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Usāmah is the most beloved of people to me” – not excepting Fāṭimah, nor anyone else.
items.ma-5764: ʿAffān narrated to us, Wuhayb narrated to us, ʿAbd Allāh ibn Ṭāwūs narrated to us, from his father, from Ibn ʿUmar: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade the jar and the gourd.
items.ma-5799: Muḥammad ibn ʿUbayd narrated to us, ʿUbayd Allāh narrated to us, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar: that the men and the women used to perform wuḍūʾ in the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ from one vessel, all together.
items.ma-5861: ʿAffān narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, ʿAbd Allāh ibn Dīnār informed me: I heard Ibn ʿUmar say, from the Prophet ﷺ: “Whoever purchases food, let him not sell it until he has taken possession of it.”
items.ma-6056: Yūnus narrated to us, Layth narrated to us, from Nāfiʿ, from ʿAbd Allāh: that when he had prayed the Jumuʿah, he would depart and pray two prostrations in his house; then he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to do that.
items.ma-6150: Yaḥyā ibn ʿAbd al-Malik narrated to us, my father narrated to us, from Jabalah, from Ibn ʿUmar, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Whoever drags his garment out of arrogance, Lam yanẓur Allāh ilayhi on the Day of Resurrection.”
items.ma-6280: Ibn Numayr and Ḥammād ibn Usāmah narrated to us, both said: ʿUbayd Allāh narrated to us, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “Whoever declares his brother a disbeliever, one of them has indeed returned with it.”
items.ma-6310: Muḥammad ibn ʿUbayd narrated to us, ʿUbayd Allāh narrated to us, from Nāfiʿ and Sālim, from Ibn ʿUmar: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade eating the meat of domestic donkeys.”
items.ma-6313: ʿAbd al-Razzāq narrated to us, Ibn Jurayj informed us, he said: Sulaymān ibn Mūsā – Nāfiʿ narrated to us, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿUmar: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ ruled that the walāʾ belongs to the one who set free.
items.ma-6320: ʿAbd al-Razzāq narrated to us, Maʿmar informed us, from al-Zuhrī, from Sālim, from Ibn ʿUmar, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “He who misses the ʿAṣr prayer, it is as if he has been robbed of his family and his wealth.”
items.ma-6333: Ibrāhīm ibn Khālid narrated to us, Rabāḥ narrated to us, from Maʿmar, from al-Zuhrī, from Sālim ibn ʿAbd Allāh, raising the ḥadīth, he said: “When one of you eats” – and he mentioned the ḥadīth.
items.ma-6401: Rawḥ narrated to us, Ibn Jurayj narrated to us, he said: It reached me from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, that the Prophet ﷺ used to perform naḥr on the day of al-Aḍḥā in al-Madīnah. He said: And when he did not perform naḥr, he performed dhabḥ.
items.ma-6414: ʿAbd al-Ṣamad narrated to us, my father narrated to me, Ayyūb narrated to us, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, that the Prophet ﷺ said: “Whoever swears an oath and makes an exception, then if he wishes he may proceed, and if he wishes he may go back, not being in breach [of his oath].”
items.ma-6682: Ibn Numayr narrated to us, Ḥajjāj narrated to us, from ʿAmr ibn Shuʿayb, from his father, from his grandfather, he said: The Prophet ﷺ joined the two prayers on the day he raided Banū al-Muṣṭaliq.
items.ma-6762: ʿAbd al-Ṣamad narrated to us, Hishām narrated to us, from Yaḥyā, from Abū Salamah, ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿAmr ibn al-ʿĀṣ narrated to me, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ entered upon me, and he mentioned [a ḥadīth] like the ḥadīth of al-Zuhrī.
items.ma-7147: Ismāʿīl ibn Ibrāhīm narrated to us, Maʿmar narrated to us, from al-Zuhrī, from Saʿīd ibn al-Musayyab, from Abū Hurayrah: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ prayed over al-Najāshī and said takbīr four [times].
items.ma-7403: ʿAbdah narrated to us, Muḥammad ibn ʿAmr narrated to us, from Abū Salamah, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “I was given jawāmiʿ al-kalim, and the earth was made for me a mosque and a purifier.”
items.ma-7411: Yaḥyā ibn Saʿīd narrated to us, from ʿUbayd Allāh, from Abū al-Zinād, from al-Aʿraj, from Abū Hurayrah: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ: “forbade the sale of the pebble and the sale of gharar.
items.ma-7488: Abū al-Qāsim ﷺ said: “The Hour will not be established until knowledge is taken away, the fitan appear, and al-harj increases.” They said: And what is al-harj, O Prophet of Allah? He said: “Killing.”
items.ma-7508: Yazīd narrated to us, Zakariyyā informed us, from Saʿd ibn Ibrāhīm, from Abū Salamah, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Disputation about the Qurʾān is kufr.”
items.ma-7947: Yazīd narrated to us, Ḥammād ibn Salamah informed us, from Thābit, from Abū Rāfiʿ, from Abū Hurayrah, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Zakariyyā was a carpenter.”
items.ma-8122: And the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “When one of you says: Āmīn, and the angels in the heaven [say it], and one coincides with the other, what preceded of his sin is forgiven him.”
items.ma-8151: And the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “When the thong of the sandal of one of you breaks, or its strap, let him not walk in one of them wearing a sandal while the other [foot] is bare; let him make both of them bare, or let him put sandals on both of them.”
items.ma-8169: And the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Were it not for the hijrah, I would be a man of the Anṣār. And if the people were to rush into a mountain path, or into a valley, and the Anṣār into a mountain path, I would rush with the Anṣār into their mountain path.”
items.ma-8289: Abū ʿĀmir narrated to us, Zuhayr narrated to us, from al-ʿAlāʾ, from his father, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “The world is the prison of the believer and the Paradise of the disbeliever.”
items.ma-8377: Abū al-Naḍr narrated to us, Abū ʿAqīl narrated to us, Abū Ḥayyān narrated to us, from Abū Zurʿah, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to love the foreleg.
items.ma-8496: Abū Saʿīd narrated to us, Wuhayb narrated to us, and Ḥammād, from ʿIsl, from ʿAṭāʾ, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade sadl – meaning in the prayer.
items.ma-8551: ʿAffān narrated to us, Ḥammād ibn Salamah narrated to us, ʿIsl ibn Sufyān al-Tamīmī informed us, from ʿAṭāʾ, from Abū Hurayrah: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade sadl in the prayer.
items.ma-8605: Ḥasan narrated to us, Ibn Lahīʿah narrated to us, Abū Yūnus narrated to us, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, that he said: “May Allah have mercy on Lūṭ, for he used to take refuge in a strong support.”
items.ma-8632: Yūnus narrated to us, Ḥammād – meaning Ibn Zayd – narrated to us, Ayyūb narrated to us, from ʿIkrimah, from Abū Hurayrah: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade drinking from the mouth of the waterskin.
items.ma-9004: Bahz narrated to us, Ḥammād narrated to us, from Muḥammad, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: I heard Abū al-Qāsim ﷺ say: “Lā yanẓuru Allāh ilā the one who drags his lower garment out of insolence.”
items.ma-9034: ʿAffān narrated to us, he said: al-Rabīʿ ibn Muslim narrated to us, Muḥammad ibn Ziyād narrated to us, from Abū Hurayrah, that the Prophet ﷺ said: “He does not thank Allah who does not thank the people.”
items.ma-9215: Nūḥ narrated to us, ʿAbd Allāh narrated to us, from Abū al-Zinād, from al-Aʿraj, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ, like that, except that he said: “My pulpit is upon a turʿah from the turaʿ of Paradise.”
items.ma-9435: And that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade two ways of wearing garments: al-ṣammāʾ, and that a man sit wrapped in his garment with nothing of it over his private part; and he forbade al-mulāmasah, al-munābadhah, al-muḥāqalah and al-muzābanah.”
items.ma-9506: Abū Muʿāwiyah narrated to us, ʿAbd Allāh narrated to us, from Yazīd ibn ʿAbd Allāh ibn Usāmah, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ, like it: “So what would that leave of the dirt?”
items.ma-9515: Ismāʿīl narrated to us, from Hishām al-Dastuwāʾī, from Yaḥyā, from a man, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “A funeral is not to be followed with fire or with a voice.”
items.ma-9626: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from Sufyān, he said: Salm ibn ʿAbd al-Raḥmān narrated to me, from Abū Zurʿah, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to dislike the shikāl among horses.
items.ma-9638: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from Ashʿath, from Muḥammad, from Abū Ṣāliḥ Dhakwān, from Abū Hurayrah, Abū Saʿīd and Jābir – two of these three: that the Prophet ﷺ forbade the ṣarf.
items.ma-9718: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Jaʿfar ibn Burqān narrated to us, from Yazīd ibn al-Aṣamm, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Wealth is not through an abundance of goods; wealth is only the wealth of the soul.”
items.ma-9722: Wakīʿ narrated to us, he said: al-Nahhās narrated to us, from a shaykh in Makkah, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: “Flee from the leper as you flee from the lion.”
items.ma-9944: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān narrated to us, he said: al-Rabīʿ ibn Muslim narrated to us, from Muḥammad ibn Ziyād, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “He does not thank Allah who does not thank the people.”
items.ma-10014: Wakīʿ narrated to us, from Sufyān, from al-Aʿmash, from Abū Ṣāliḥ, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “When Allah had finished with the creation, He wrote upon His ʿArsh: My raḥmah has preceded My Ghaḍab.”
items.ma-10022: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān narrated to us, Ḥammād narrated to us, from Muḥammad ibn Ziyād, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: I heard Abū al-Qāsim ﷺ say: “The best of you are the best of you in character, when they have gained understanding.”
items.ma-10094: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Dāwūd al-Awdī narrated to us, from his father, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Let none of you stand for the prayer while he has on him filth of excrement or urine.”
items.ma-10194: Wakīʿ narrated to us, he said: Yūnus ibn Abī Isḥāq narrated to us, from Mujāhid, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade the filthy medicine – meaning poison.
items.ma-10288: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān narrated to us, from Zuhayr, from al-ʿAlāʾ, from his father, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “The world is the prison of the believer and the Paradise of the disbeliever.”
items.ma-10553: Yazīd narrated to us, Salīm ibn Ḥayyān informed us, he said: I heard my father narrating, he said: I heard Abū Hurayrah say: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Beware of suspicion, for suspicion is the most untruthful of speech.”
items.ma-10685: Rawḥ narrated to us, Ibn ʿAwn narrated to us, from Muḥammad, from Abū Hurayrah: Indeed Allah ﷿ has ninety-nine names, one hundred less one; whoever counts them enters Paradise.
items.ma-10807: And the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Do not make nabīdh of dates and raisins together, and do not make nabīdh of unripe dates and dates together, but make nabīdh of each one of them separately.”
items.ma-10835: Muḥammad ibn ʿUbayd narrated to us, Muḥammad ibn ʿAmr narrated to us, from Abū Salamah, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Do not prevent the maidservants of Allah from the mosques of Allah, and let them go out unperfumed.”
items.ma-11204: Yaḥyā ibn Saʿīd narrated to us, from Mujālid, he said: Abū al-Wadāk narrated to me, from Abū Saʿīd, from the Prophet ﷺ, about ʿazl, he said: “Do as seems right to you; if Allah decrees something, it will be.”
items.ma-11278: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Hammām narrated to us, from Qatādah, from Abū ʿĪsā al-Uswārī, from Abū Saʿīd al-Khudrī, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ sternly forbade a man to drink standing.
items.ma-11948: Hushaym narrated to us, ʿUbayd Allāh ibn Abī Bakr ibn Anas informed us, from his grandfather Anas ibn Mālik, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “When the People of the Book give you the greeting of salām, say: And upon you.”
