items.ma-11950: Hushaym narrated to us, ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz ibn Ṣuhayb informed us, and Ismāʿīl, from ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz, from Anas, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Eat the suḥūr, for in the suḥūr there is blessing.”
items.ma-11984: Ismāʿīl narrated to us, ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz ibn Ṣuhayb narrated to us, from Anas ibn Mālik, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to sacrifice two rams. Anas said: And I sacrifice two rams.
items.ma-11987: Ismāʿīl narrated to us, ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz narrated to us, from Anas ibn Mālik, he said: The prayer was established while the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was in private converse with a man in the mosque, and he did not stand for the prayer until the people had slept.
items.ma-12179: Wakīʿ narrated to us, from Shuʿbah and al-Dastuwāʾī, from Qatādah, from Anas, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “There is no ṭiyarah, and al-faʾl pleases me.” He said: “And al-faʾl is the good, pleasant word.”
items.ma-12186: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Hishām al-Dastuwāʾī narrated to us, from Abū ʿIṣām, from Anas, he said: The Prophet ﷺ used to breathe in the vessel three [times], and would say: “This is more pleasant, more wholesome, and more healthful.”
items.ma-12263: ʿAbd al-Ṣamad narrated to us, Hammām narrated to us, Isḥāq ibn ʿAbd Allāh narrated to us, from Anas ibn Mālik: that the Prophet ﷺ would not come to his family by night; he would enter in the morning or the evening.
items.ma-12293: Abū ʿUbaydah narrated to us, from Sallām Abū al-Mundhir, from Thābit, from Anas, that the Prophet ﷺ said: “Women and perfume were made beloved to me, and the delight of my eye was placed in the prayer.”
items.ma-12646: ʿAbd al-Razzāq narrated to us, Maʿmar narrated to us, from Thābit al-Bunānī, from Anas, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Take care of these rows, for I see you from behind me.”
items.ma-12693: ʿAbd al-Razzāq narrated to us, Maʿmar narrated to us, from Ashʿath ibn ʿAbd Allāh, from Anas ibn Mālik, he said: The hair of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ reached the middle of his ears.
items.ma-12758: Muḥammad ibn Jaʿfar narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, from Khālid, from one who heard Anas ibn Mālik, he said: When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ prostrated, the whiteness of his armpits was seen – or, I saw the whiteness of his armpits.
items.ma-12773: Ḥajjāj and Yazīd ibn Hārūn narrated to us, both said: Shuʿbah informed us, from Qatādah, he said: I heard Anas ibn Mālik say: The Prophet ﷺ was among the lightest of people in prayer, with completeness.
items.ma-12877: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from Ḥumayd, from Anas: that the Prophet ﷺ heard the crying of a child in the prayer, and shortened it; and we thought that he shortened it because of the child's mother in the prayer, out of mercy for the child.
items.ma-12907: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān narrated to us, from Sufyān, from al-Mukhtār ibn Fulful, he said: I heard Anas ibn Mālik say: A man said to the Prophet ﷺ: O best of creation. He said: “That is Ibrāhīm.”
items.ma-12921: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, from ʿAttāb, he said: I heard Anas ibn Mālik say: I gave the pledge to the Prophet ﷺ to hear and obey, in what I was able.
items.ma-13057: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid Abū ʿUbaydah narrated to us, from Sallām Abū al-Mundhir, from Thābit, from Anas, that the Prophet ﷺ said: “Women and perfume were made beloved to me, and the delight of my eye was placed in the prayer.”
items.ma-13062: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid narrated to us, Hammām narrated to us, from Qatādah, from Anas: that the Prophet ﷺ sternly forbade drinking standing. He said: So Anas was asked: And eating? He said: That is more severe – or, more evil.
items.ma-13098: ʿAffān narrated to us, Khālid ibn al-Ḥārith narrated to us, Hishām ibn Ḥassān narrated to us, from ʿUbayd Allāh ibn Dihqān, from Anas: that the Prophet ﷺ forbade a man to eat with his left hand.
items.ma-13222: Sulaymān ibn Ḥarb narrated to us, Bisṭām ibn Ḥurayth narrated to us, from Ashʿath al-Ḥuddānī, from Anas ibn Mālik, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “My intercession is for the people of the major sins among my ummah.”
items.ma-13274: Abū Qaṭan narrated to us, Hishām narrated to us, from Qatādah, from Anas, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ performed qunūt for a month after bowing, supplicating against clans among the clans of the Arabs; then he abandoned it.
items.ma-13345: Muḥammad ibn Muṣʿab narrated to us, Mālik ibn Anas narrated to us, from al-Zuhrī, from Anas ibn Mālik, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ entered Makkah in the year of the Conquest with a helmet on his head.
items.ma-13358: Muʿāwiyah ibn ʿAmr narrated to us, ʿAbd Allāh ibn Wahb narrated to us, from Yūnus, from al-Zuhrī, from Anas, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ had a ring of silver, its stone Abyssinian.
items.ma-13648: ʿAffān narrated to us, Ḥammād narrated to us, he said: Thābit informed me, from Anas: that the Prophet ﷺ went around to his wives in one whole night. And Ḥammād sometimes said: in one day.
items.ma-13726: Aswad ibn ʿĀmir narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, from Thābit, from Anas, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to raise his hands in supplication until the whiteness of his armpits was seen.
items.ma-13833: ʿAffān narrated to us, Ḥammād narrated to us, Thābit informed us, from Anas, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “The Hour will not be established until it is no longer said on the earth: There is no deity except Allah.”
items.ma-13838: ʿAffān narrated to us, Ḥammād narrated to us, from Thābit, from Anas, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Straighten, straighten! By Allah, I see you from behind me, just as I see you from before me.”
items.ma-13859: ʿAffān narrated to us, Abān ibn Yazīd narrated to us, Qatādah narrated to us, from Anas ibn Mālik: that no morning meal and no evening meal of bread and meat was ever gathered for the Messenger of Allah ﷺ except upon ḍafaf.
items.ma-13939: Abū Dāwūd narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, Qatādah narrated to us, from Anas, that the Prophet ﷺ said: “Allah says: I am as My servant thinks of Me, and I am with him when he calls upon Me.”
items.ma-13982: Ibrāhīm ibn Khālid narrated to us, Rabāḥ narrated to us, from Maʿmar, from Thābit, from Anas: that the Prophet ﷺ set Ṣafiyyah bint Ḥuyayy free, and made her freeing her ṣadāq.
items.ma-14007: Muḥammad ibn Jaʿfar narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, from Qatādah, from Anas, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Whoever forgets a prayer or sleeps through it, its kaffārah is that he pray it when he remembers it.”
items.ma-14127: ʿAbd al-Razzāq and Rawḥ narrated to us, both said: Mālik narrated to us, from Abū al-Zubayr, from Jābir, he said: We performed naḥr at al-Ḥudaybiyyah with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ: the badanah on behalf of seven, and the cow on behalf of seven.
items.ma-14172: Muḥammad ibn Jaʿfar narrated to us, Saʿīd narrated to us, from Qatādah, from ʿAṭāʾ, from Jābir ibn ʿAbd Allāh, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “The ʿumrā is permitted for its people” – or – “an inheritance for its people.”
items.ma-14255: Hushaym narrated to us, Abū al-Zubayr informed us, from Jābir, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Whoever lies about me deliberately, let him take his seat in the Fire.”
items.ma-14262: Hushaym narrated to us, from ʿAlī ibn Zayd, from Muḥammad ibn al-Munkadir, from Jābir, he said: I ate bread and meat with the Prophet ﷺ, Abū Bakr and ʿUmar, and they prayed and did not perform wuḍūʾ.
items.ma-14292: Sufyān narrated to us, from Abū al-Zubayr, from Jābir, from the Prophet ﷺ: “Whichever of you has land or date palms, let him not sell it until he offers it to his partner.”
items.ma-14354: Ibn Idrīs narrated to us, Ibn Jurayj informed us, from Abū al-Zubayr, from Jābir, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ threw the first jamrah on the day of naḥr in the forenoon, and threw it after that at the decline of the sun.
items.ma-14421: Isḥāq ibn Yūsuf narrated to us, ʿAbd al-Malik narrated to us, from ʿAṭāʾ, from Jābir ibn ʿAbd Allāh, he said: I was present with the Prophet ﷺ on a day of ʿīd, and he began with the prayer before the khuṭbah; and he mentioned its meaning.
items.ma-14608: Ḥasan narrated to us, Ibn Lahīʿah narrated to us, Abū al-Zubayr narrated to us, from Jābir, that he said: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: “When one of you relieves himself, let him wipe three times.”
items.ma-14617: Ḥasan narrated to us, Ibn Lahīʿah narrated to us, Abū al-Zubayr narrated to us, from Jābir, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Say takbīr over your dead, by night and by day, four takbīrs.”
items.ma-14727: Mūsā narrated to us, Ibn Lahīʿah narrated to us, from Abū al-Zubayr, that he said: I asked Jābir: Did the Prophet ﷺ say: “The best jihād is that of one whose fine horse is hamstrung and whose blood is shed”? Jābir said: Yes.
items.ma-14849: ʿAlī ibn Thābit narrated to us, ʿAbd Allāh ibn al-Muʾammal narrated to me, from Abū al-Zubayr, from Jābir, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “The water of Zamzam is for what it is drunk for.”
items.ma-15032: Yaḥyā ibn Saʿīd al-Umawī narrated to us, Ibn Jurayj informed us, from ʿAṭāʾ, that he heard Jābir, when he was asked about ʿazl, and he said: We used to do it in the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ.
items.ma-15084: Yaḥyā ibn Zakariyyā ibn Abī Zāʾidah narrated to us, Ḥajjāj narrated to us, from ʿAṭāʾ and from Abū al-Zubayr, from Jābir: that the Prophet ﷺ forbade that what is on the tops of the date palms be sold for measured dates.
items.ma-15141: Ḥasan narrated to us, Zuhayr narrated to us, from Abū al-Zubayr, from Jābir, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “A town-dweller is not to sell for a desert-dweller. Leave the people; Allah provides for some of them from others.”
items.ma-15164: Muʾammal narrated to us, Sufyān narrated to us, from Abū al-Zubayr, from Jābir, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “If I live – if Allah wills – I will forbid that [anyone] be named Barakah and Yasār.”
items.ma-15238: Ḥasan narrated to us, Ibn Lahīʿah narrated to us, Abū al-Zubayr narrated to us, from Jābir, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Avoid the major sins, aim for what is right, and receive glad tidings.”
items.ma-15255: Mūsā ibn Dāwūd narrated to us, Zuhayr narrated to us, from Abū al-Zubayr, from Jābir, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade the sale of fruit until it becomes good. Abū al-Naḍr narrated it to us.
items.ma-15368: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Mahdī narrated to us, from Sufyān, from Manṣūr, from Abū Saʿīd al-Khuzāʿī, from Ibn Abzā: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to point with his index finger in the prayer.
items.ma-15515: Yaḥyā ibn Saʿīd narrated to us, he said: Ismāʿīl narrated to us, he said: Qays narrated to us, from his father, he said: He came while the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was delivering the khuṭbah, and he stood in the sun; so he commanded concerning him, and he was moved to the shade.
items.ma-16158: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from Shuʿbah, he said: Yaʿlā narrated to me, from his father, from Aws ibn Abī Aws, he said: I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ perform wuḍūʾ and wipe over his sandals, then stand for the prayer.
items.ma-16315: Yazīd ibn Hārūn narrated to us, he said: Shuʿbah informed us, from Qatādah, from Muṭarrif, from his father, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Whoever fasts perpetually has not fasted and has not broken his fast; he has not fasted and has not broken his fast.”
items.ma-16533: Ṣafwān narrated to us, he said: Yazīd ibn Abī ʿUbayd narrated to us, he said: I said to Salamah ibn al-Akwaʿ: Upon what did you pledge to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ on the day of al-Ḥudaybiyyah? He said: We pledged to him upon death.
items.ma-17352: And he said: Ibn Wahb narrated to us: ʿĀṣim ibn Ḥakīm narrated to me, from Yaḥyā ibn Abī ʿAmr al-Saybānī, from his father, from ʿUqbah ibn ʿĀmir al-Juhanī, from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, with that.
items.ma-17531: ʿAbd Allāh narrated to us, al-Warakānī narrated to us, Abū al-Aḥwaṣ informed us, from Mughīrah, from Shibāk, from al-Shaʿbī, from a man of Thaqīf, from the Prophet ﷺ, like it.
items.ma-17578: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Ismāʿīl narrated to us, from Qays, from Dukayn ibn Saʿīd al-Khathʿamī, he said: We came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and we were four hundred and forty, and he mentioned the ḥadīth.
items.ma-17682: Ḥasan ibn Mūsā narrated to us, Ḥarīz narrated to us, he said: I said to ʿAbd Allāh ibn Busr, and we were boys who did not understand knowledge: Was the Messenger of Allah ﷺ an old man? He said: There were a few white hairs in the hair beneath his lower lip.
items.ma-18375: Abū Nuʿaym narrated to us, Zakariyyā narrated to us, he said: I heard ʿĀmir say: I heard al-Nuʿmān ibn Bashīr say: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “The likeness of the believers” – and he mentioned the ḥadīth.
items.ma-18501: Bahz narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, from ʿAdī ibn Thābit, from al-Barāʾ ibn ʿĀzib, that the Prophet ﷺ was carrying al-Ḥasan, and said: “Indeed I love him, so love him.”
items.ma-18734: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Musāwir al-Warrāq narrated to us, from Jaʿfar ibn ʿAmr ibn Ḥurayth, from his father: that the Prophet ﷺ gave a khuṭbah to the people while wearing a black turban.
items.ma-18758: Ḥajjāj narrated to us, Sharīk narrated to us, from Abū Isḥāq, from Wahb – and he is Abū Juḥayfah – he said: The Prophet ﷺ led us in prayer at Minā, and planted a short spear of his in front of him, and prayed two rakʿahs with us.
items.ma-18766: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Mahdī narrated to us, from Sufyān, from ʿAlī ibn al-Aqmar, he said: I heard Abū Juḥayfah say: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “I do not eat reclining.”
items.ma-18771: And Abū al-Jawwāb narrated it to us, ʿAmmār narrated to us, from al-Aʿmash, from Abū Khālid, from Jābir, he said: I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and he was saying: “I was sent from the Hour like this from this.”
items.ma-18792: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān narrated to us, Sufyān narrated to us, from al-Aʿmash, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Sinān, from Ḍirār ibn al-Azwar, that the Prophet ﷺ passed by him while he was milking, and said: “Leave the caller of the milk.”
items.ma-18818: Jarīr ibn ʿAbd al-Ḥamīd narrated to us, from Manṣūr, from Hilāl, from Salamah ibn Qays, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “When you perform wuḍūʾ, snort water out; and when you perform istijmār, make it odd.”
items.ma-18845: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Sufyān narrated to us, from ʿĀṣim ibn Kulayb, from his father, from Wāʾil al-Ḥaḍramī, that he saw the Prophet ﷺ when he prostrated, and his hands were close to his ears.
items.ma-18959: Wakīʿ narrated to us, from Sufyān, from Abū Isḥāq, from Numayr ibn ʿArīb, from ʿĀmir ibn Masʿūd al-Jumaḥī, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Fasting in the winter is the cold spoil.”
items.ma-19198: Muḥammad ibn Abī ʿAdī narrated to us, from Dāwūd, from al-Shaʿbī, from Jarīr, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Let the collector [of ṣadaqah] depart from you while he is satisfied.”
items.ma-19199: Sufyān narrated to us, Ziyād ibn ʿIlāqah narrated to us, he said: I heard Jarīr say: I pledged to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ to give sincere counsel to every Muslim. Misʿar said, from Ziyād: So indeed I am one who gives sincere counsel to you.
items.ma-19228: Sufyān narrated to us, from Mujālid, from al-Shaʿbī, from Jarīr, he said: I pledged to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ to establish the prayer, to give the zakāh, to hear and obey, and to give sincere counsel to every Muslim.
items.ma-19490: Hushaym narrated to us, from Mujālid, from al-Shaʿbī, he said: ʿUmar wrote in his will: that no governor of mine be kept for more than a year, and keep al-Ashʿarī – meaning Abū Mūsā – for four years.
items.ma-19571: And he said: A house in al-Madīnah burned down upon its people, and the Prophet ﷺ was told of their affair, and he said: “This fire is only an enemy to you, so when you sleep, extinguish it from yourselves.”
items.ma-19620: Ismāʿīl narrated to us, Ghālib al-Tammār narrated to us, from Masrūq ibn Aws, from Abū Mūsā al-Ashʿarī, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “In the fingers, ten, ten.”
items.ma-19736: Abū Aḥmad – meaning al-Zubayrī – narrated to us, he said: Isrāʾīl narrated to us, from Abū Isḥāq, from Abū Burdah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, and he mentioned its meaning, and he did not make it musnad.
items.ma-19824: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān narrated to us, Hammām informed us, from Qatādah, from Abū Murāyah, from ʿImrān ibn Ḥuṣayn, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “There is no obedience in disobedience of Allah.”
items.ma-19989: ʿAffān narrated to us, Ḥammād narrated to us, Thābit narrated to us, from Muṭarrif, from ʿImrān ibn Ḥuṣayn: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade cauterization, but we cauterized, and they did not succeed and did not prosper.
items.ma-20113: Rawḥ narrated to us, Ashʿath narrated to us, from al-Ḥasan, from Samurah ibn Jundub, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “Whoever prays the morning prayer is in the dhimmah of Allah, so do not violate Allah in His dhimmah.”
items.ma-20259: ʿAffān narrated to us, Hammām narrated to us, Qatādah narrated to us, from al-Ḥasan, from Samurah: that the Prophet ﷺ said: “Whoever performs wuḍūʾ on the day of Jumuʿah, then with it – and excellent it is; and whoever performs ghusl, that is better.”
items.ma-20427: Bahz narrated to us, Hammām narrated to us, Qatādah informed us, from al-Ḥasan, from Abū Bakrah, that the Prophet ﷺ said: “Let none of you say: I stood [in prayer] throughout the whole of Ramaḍān.”
items.ma-20476: ʿAbd al-Aʿlā narrated to us, from Maʿmar, from al-Zuhrī, from Ṭalḥah ibn ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿAwf, from Abū Bakrah, he said: The people spoke much concerning Musaylimah, and he mentioned [a ḥadīth] like the ḥadīth of ʿUqayl.
items.ma-20492: Abū Nuʿaym narrated to us, Zuhayr ibn Muʿāwiyah narrated to us, from ʿAlī ibn Zayd, from ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Abī Bakrah, from his father, he said: The Prophet ﷺ was asked: Which people are best? And he mentioned [a ḥadīth] like it.
items.ma-20506: And Abū Bakrah said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Whoever kills a soul under covenant without right will not find the scent of Paradise, though its scent is found from a journey of five hundred years.”
items.ma-20533: ʿAbd Allāh narrated to us, he said: Ibrāhīm ibn al-Ḥajjāj and Muḥammad ibn Abān al-Wāsiṭī narrated it to us, both said: Abān narrated to us, Budayl narrated to us, like it.
items.ma-20611: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān narrated to us, Sufyān narrated to us, from al-Aghar, from Khalīfah ibn Ḥuṣayn, from his grandfather Qays ibn ʿĀṣim: that he became Muslim, and the Prophet ﷺ commanded him to wash with water and lote-leaf.
items.ma-20706: Ismāʿīl narrated to us, Saʿīd informed us; and Ibn Jaʿfar: Saʿīd narrated to us, from Qatādah, from Abū al-Malīḥ ibn Usāmah, from his father: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade the skins of beasts of prey.
items.ma-20855: Aswad ibn ʿĀmir narrated to us, Sharīk narrated to us, from Simāk, from Jābir ibn Samurah, he said: When we came to him – meaning the Prophet ﷺ – one of us would sit where [the gathering] ended.
items.ma-20882: ʿAbd Allāh narrated to us, Dāwūd ibn ʿAmr al-Ḍabbī narrated to us, Sallām Abū al-Aḥwaṣ narrated to us, from Simāk, from Jābir ibn Samurah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to delay the ʿIshāʾ [prayer].
items.ma-20904: ʿAbd Allāh narrated to us, Suwayd ibn Saʿīd narrated to me, Sharīk narrated to us, from Simāk, from Jābir ibn Samurah: that the Prophet ﷺ did not pray over a man who killed himself.
items.ma-20952: Bahz ibn Asad narrated to us, Ḥammād ibn Salamah narrated to us, from Simāk, he said: I heard Jābir ibn Samurah say: I heard the Prophet ﷺ say: “Before the Hour there will be liars.”
items.ma-21102:
Khalaf ibn al-Walīd narrated to us, Ibn al-Mubārak narrated to us, from Yūnus, from al-Zuhrī, from Sahl, from Ubayy, like it.
Ibn al-Mubārak said: And Maʿmar informed me, with this isnād, like it.
items.ma-21613: Yaḥyā ibn Isḥāq narrated to us, Ibn Lahīʿah narrated to us, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Hubayrah, from Qabīṣah ibn Dhuʾayb, from ʿĀʾishah: that she informed the family of al-Zubayr, and he mentioned its meaning.
items.ma-21627: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān narrated to us, Mālik narrated to us, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, from Zayd ibn Thābit: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ permitted the owner of the ʿariyyah to sell it for its estimate.
items.ma-21638: Muḥammad ibn ʿUbayd narrated to us, ʿUbayd Allāh narrated to us, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, from Zayd ibn Thābit: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ permitted the sale of the ʿarāyā for their estimate, by measure.
items.ma-21714: Surayj narrated to us, Abū Shihāb narrated to us, from al-Ḥajjāj, from Yaʿlā ibn Nuʿmān, from Bilāl ibn Abī al-Dardāʾ, from his father, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ sacrificed two jadhaʿ rams, castrated.
items.ma-21813: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān narrated to us, Mālik narrated to us, from al-Zuhrī, from ʿAlī ibn Ḥusayn, from ʿUmar ibn ʿUthmān, from Usāmah ibn Zayd, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “A Muslim does not inherit from a disbeliever.”
items.ma-22358: Muḥammad ibn Jaʿfar narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, from Sulaymān, he said: I heard Abū ʿAmr al-Shaybānī, and he mentioned it, and he did not doubt; he said: “You will surely come.”
items.ma-22870: Isḥāq ibn ʿĪsā narrated to us, Mālik informed me, from Abū Ḥāzim, from Sahl ibn Saʿd, that the Prophet ﷺ said: “The people will continue to be in good so long as they hasten the breaking of the fast.”
items.ma-23297: Ḥusayn ibn Muḥammad narrated to us, Sharīk narrated to us, from Abū Isḥāq, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Ghālib, from Ḥudhayfah, he said: The master of the children of Ādam on the Day of Resurrection is Muḥammad ﷺ.
items.ma-23620: Bahz narrated to us, Ibrāhīm ibn Saʿd narrated to me, Ibn Shihāb narrated to us, from Maḥmūd ibn Rabīʿ – and he had retained a spurt of water that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ spurted in his face from a bucket from a well of theirs.
items.ma-23799: Thābit ibn al-Walīd ibn ʿAbd Allāh ibn Jumayʿ narrated to us, my father narrated to me, he said: Abū al-Ṭufayl said to me: I reached eight years of the life of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and I was born in the year of Uḥud.
items.ma-24088: Sufyān narrated to us, from al-Zuhrī, from ʿUrwah, from ʿĀʾishah: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to pray his night prayer while I was lying across between him and the qiblah, as the funeral bier lies across.
items.ma-24093: Sufyān narrated to us, from al-Zuhrī, from ʿUrwah, from ʿĀʾishah: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ made ihlāl for Ḥajj, and some people made ihlāl for Ḥajj and ʿumrah, and some people made ihlāl for ʿumrah.
items.ma-24311: Abū Usāmah narrated to us, he said: Hishām informed us, from his father, from ʿĀʾishah: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ entered on the day of the Conquest from Kadāʾ, from the upper part of Makkah, and entered for the ʿumrah from Kudā.
items.ma-24326: Asbāṭ narrated to us, from al-Shaybānī, from ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn al-Aswad, from his father, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ permitted ruqyah for everything with a sting.
items.ma-24727: Abū Salamah al-Khuzāʿī narrated to us, he said: Mālik informed us, from Muḥammad ibn ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Nawfal, he said: ʿUrwah informed me, from ʿĀʾishah: that the Prophet ﷺ entered making ihlāl for Ḥajj.
items.ma-24740: Abū Saʿīd narrated to us, he said: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān narrated to us, he said: I heard my father narrating, from ʿAmrah, from ʿĀʾishah, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “A house in which there are no dates is as though there is no food in it.”
items.ma-24779: Aswad ibn ʿĀmir narrated to us, he said: Isrāʾīl narrated to us, from Abū Isḥāq, from al-Aswad, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to sleep in the first part of the night and rise in the last part of it.
items.ma-24883: Mūsā ibn Dāwūd narrated to us, he said: Ibn Lahīʿah informed us, from Abū al-Aswad, from ʿUrwah, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Whoever develops land that belongs to no one, he is more entitled to it.”
items.ma-24896: ʿAffān narrated to us, he said: Abū ʿAwānah narrated to us, he said: ʿUmar ibn Abī Salamah narrated to us, from his father, from ʿĀʾishah, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “The walāʾ belongs to the one who set free.”
items.ma-25036: Wakīʿ narrated to us, al-Aʿmash narrated to us, from Ibrāhīm, from al-Aswad, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: The Prophet ﷺ used to sleep until he breathed heavily, then he would rise and pray and not perform wuḍūʾ.
items.ma-25119: Yazīd narrated to us, Ḥammād ibn Salamah informed us, from Ibn Sakhbarah, from al-Qāsim ibn Muḥammad, from ʿĀʾishah, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “The greatest of women in blessing are the lightest of them in expense.”
items.ma-25321: Muḥammad ibn Fuḍayl narrated to us, he said: al-Aʿmash narrated to us, from a man, from Masrūq, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: The right hand of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was for his food and his prayer, and his left hand was for what is other than that.
items.ma-25405: Muḥammad ibn Jaʿfar narrated to us, Maʿmar narrated to us, al-Zuhrī informed us, from ʿUrwah, from ʿĀʾishah, that she and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to perform ghusl from one vessel.
items.ma-25481: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān narrated to us, Sufyān narrated to us, from al-Aʿmash, from Abū Wāʾil, from Masrūq, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: I never saw a person on whom pain was more severe than on the Messenger of Allah ﷺ.
items.ma-25553: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Mahdī narrated to us, Sufyān narrated to us, from al-Miqdām ibn Shurayḥ, from his father, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ entered his house, he began with the tooth-stick.
items.ma-25573: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān narrated to us, he said: Sufyān narrated to us, from Manṣūr ibn Ṣafiyyah, from his mother, from ʿĀʾishah, that the Prophet ﷺ used to place his head in her lap and recite the Qurʾān while she was menstruating.
items.ma-25608: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from Hishām, he said: My father informed me, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: I and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to perform ghusl from one vessel; he and I would scoop from it.
items.ma-25687: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Kahmas ibn al-Ḥasan narrated to us, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Shaqīq, he said: I said to ʿĀʾishah: Did the Messenger of Allah ﷺ join surahs together in one rakʿah? She said: The Mufaṣṣal.
items.ma-25736: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Ismāʿīl narrated to us, from al-Shaʿbī, from Masrūq, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: I used to twist the garlands of the hady of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and he would garland them, then send them.
items.ma-25932: Ibn Numayr narrated to us, al-Aʿmash narrated to us, from Ibrāhīm, from al-Aswad, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to practise mubāsharah while fasting, because he had the most control among you over his need.
items.ma-25939: Ibn Numayr narrated to us, Hishām narrated to us, from his father, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Let none of you say: My soul has become foul; but let him say: My soul has become churned.”
items.ma-25996: Yazīd narrated to us, Hishām informed us, from Yaḥyā, from ʿImrān ibn Ḥiṭṭān, that ʿĀʾishah narrated to him: that the Prophet ﷺ did not leave anything in his house in which there was a cross, except that he cut it off.
items.ma-26120: ʿAbd al-Ṣamad narrated to us, Abān narrated to us, he said: Qatādah narrated to us, he said: Ṣafiyyah bint Shaybah narrated to me, from ʿĀʾishah, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to perform ghusl with a ṣāʿ and perform wuḍūʾ with a mudd.
items.ma-26157: Yaḥyā ibn Ādam narrated to us, he said: Ḥasan narrated to us, from Abū Isḥāq, from al-Aswad, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ did not perform wuḍūʾ after the ghusl.
items.ma-26196: Ḥammād ibn Khālid narrated to us, from Ibn Abī Dhiʾb, from Ibn Shihāb and Ṣāliḥ ibn Abī Ḥassān, from Abū Salamah, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to kiss while fasting.
items.ma-26578: ʿAffān narrated to us, Wuhayb narrated to us, he said: Khālid narrated to us, from Abū Qilābah, from one of the children of Umm Salamah, from Umm Salamah, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to pray on the small mat.
items.ma-26634: Ibn Numayr narrated to us, he said: al-Ḥasan ibn ʿAmr informed us, from al-Ḥakam, from Shahr ibn Ḥawshab, he said: I heard Umm Salamah say: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade everything that intoxicates and everything that causes languor.
items.ma-26649: Ibn Jaʿfar narrated to us, he said: Saʿīd narrated to me, from Qatādah, from Saʿīd ibn al-Musayyab, from ʿĀmir ibn Abī Umayyah, the brother of Umm Salamah, and he did not mention Umm Salamah, like it.
items.ma-26825: Aḥmad ibn ʿAbd al-Malik narrated to us, he said: ʿUbayd Allāh ibn ʿAmr narrated to us, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Muḥammad ibn ʿAqīl, from al-Qāsim, from ʿĀʾishah, from the Prophet ﷺ, like it.
items.ma-26849: Muḥammad ibn Jaʿfar narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, from Sulaymān al-Shaybānī, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Shaddād, from his maternal aunt Maymūnah, from the Prophet ﷺ, that he used to pray on the small mat.
items.ma-27210: Yazīd narrated to us, he said: Abū Mālik narrated to us, he said: My father had prayed behind the Messenger of Allah ﷺ when he was sixteen years old, and [behind] Abū Bakr, ʿUmar and ʿUthmān. He said: No, my son – a muḥdith.
items.ma-4372: Yūnus narrated to us, Ḥammād – meaning Ibn Salamah – narrated to us, from ʿĀṣim, from Zirr, from Ibn Masʿūd, he said: I took seventy sūrahs from the mouth of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, with no one disputing me concerning them.
items.ma-4502: Ismāʿīl narrated to us, Ayyūb informed us, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Whoever sells a date palm that has been pollinated, its fruit belongs to the seller, unless the buyer stipulates [otherwise].”
items.ma-4534: Al-Walīd narrated to us, al-Awzāʿī narrated to us, al-Muṭṭalib ibn ʿAbd Allāh ibn Ḥanṭab narrated to me, that Ibn ʿUmar used to perform wuḍūʾ three times each, and he would attribute that to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ.
items.ma-4581: Sufyān narrated to us, from Ayyūb, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, attributing it to the Prophet ﷺ: “Whoever swears an oath and says: If Allah wills, has made an exception.”
items.ma-4686: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from Ibn Abī Rawwād, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, that the Prophet ﷺ would not fail to touch the Stone and the Yamānī Corner in every circuit of ṭawāf.
items.ma-4863: Yazīd narrated to us, Muḥammad ibn ʿAmr informed us, from Abū Salamah, from Ibn ʿUmar, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Every intoxicant is khamr, and every intoxicant is forbidden.”
items.ma-4921: ʿAbd al-Razzāq narrated to us, Maʿmar narrated to us, from Ayyūb, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to pray two rakʿahs at his house after the Jumuʿah [prayer].
items.ma-5098: ʿAbd Allāh ibn al-Walīd narrated to us, Sufyān narrated to us, Jābir informed me, from Sālim, from Ibn ʿUmar, from the Prophet ﷺ: that he did that; like the narration of Yaḥyā ibn Saʿīd concerning raising the hands.
items.ma-5107: He said: And the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, meaning: “Five [creatures] — there is no blame on him, and it is forbidden for him, to kill them: the snake, the scorpion, the mouse, the biting dog, and the kite.”
items.ma-5138: Muʾammal narrated to us, Sufyān narrated to us, from ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn ʿAlqamah, I heard Ibn ʿUmar say: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ commanded that the beards be let grow, and that the moustaches be trimmed.
items.ma-5242: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Ḥammād ibn Salamah narrated to us, from Farqad al-Sabakhī, from Saʿīd ibn Jubayr, from Ibn ʿUmar, that the Prophet ﷺ used to anoint himself with oil that was not muqattat at the time of iḥrām.
items.ma-5264: Wakīʿ narrated to us, from Ḥammād, from Bishr ibn Ḥarb, I heard Ibn ʿUmar say: “Indeed, your raising your hands is an innovation. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ did not add to this” — meaning, to the chest.
items.ma-5287: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān narrated to us, from Mālik, from al-Zuhrī, from Sālim, from Ibn ʿUmar: that the Prophet ﷺ prayed the Maghrib and the ʿIshāʾ together at al-Muzdalifah.
items.ma-5306: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān narrated to us, from Mālik, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “Whoever sells a date palm that has been pollinated, its fruit belongs to the seller, unless the buyer stipulates [otherwise].”
items.ma-5450: ʿAffān narrated to us, ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz ibn Muslim narrated to us, ʿAbd Allāh ibn Dīnār narrated to us, from Ibn ʿUmar, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “When you come to the Jumuʿah [prayer], perform ghusl.”
items.ma-5496: Muḥammad ibn Jaʿfar narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, ʿAbd Allāh ibn Dīnār narrated to us, he said: I heard Ibn ʿUmar say: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade the sale of walāʾ and its gifting.
items.ma-5633: Yaḥyā ibn Ādam narrated to us, Sharīk narrated to us, from ʿUbayd Allāh, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, he said: The grey hair of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was about twenty hairs.
items.ma-5681: Abū al-Naḍr narrated to us, Isḥāq ibn Saʿīd narrated to us, from his father, from Ibn ʿUmar, from the Prophet ﷺ, that he said: “A person will not cease to have latitude in his religion so long as he has not shed forbidden blood.”
items.ma-5768: ʿAffān narrated to us, Ḥammād ibn Salamah narrated to us, Ayyūb narrated to us, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Good is tied to the forelocks of horses until the Day of Resurrection.”
items.ma-5780: Muḥammad ibn ʿUbayd narrated to us, ʿUbayd Allāh narrated to us, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Whoever misses the ʿAṣr prayer, it is as though his family and his property have been taken from him.”
items.ma-5946: Surayj narrated to us, ʿAbd Allāh narrated to us, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, he said: We went out with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ as pilgrims, and we did not come out of iḥrām in respect of anything until we came out of iḥrām on the Day of Sacrifice.
items.ma-5948: Surayj narrated to us, ʿAbd Allāh narrated to us, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, he said: I never fasted ʿArafah, nor did the Messenger of Allah ﷺ fast it, nor Abū Bakr, nor ʿUmar.
items.ma-5964: Al-Faḍl ibn Dukayn narrated to us, Zamʿah narrated to us, from Ibn Shihāb, from Sālim, from Ibn ʿUmar, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “The believer is not stung twice from the same hole.”
items.ma-6089: Yūnus narrated to us, Ḥammād – meaning Ibn Salamah – narrated to us, from Farqad al-Sabakhī, from Saʿīd ibn Jubayr, from Ibn ʿUmar: that the Prophet ﷺ anointed himself with oil that was not muqattat, while he was in iḥrām.
items.ma-6218: ʿAlī ibn Isḥāq narrated to us, ʿAbd Allāh informed us, Muḥammad ibn ʿAjlān informed us, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “Every intoxicant is forbidden, and every intoxicant is khamr.”
items.ma-6337: ʿAbd al-Razzāq narrated to us, Maʿmar narrated to us, from Ayyūb, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “When one of you invites his brother, let him answer him, whether it is a wedding feast or the like.”
items.ma-6354: ʿAbd al-Razzāq narrated to us, Maʿmar narrated to us, from al-Zuhrī, from Sālim, from Ibn ʿUmar, he said: When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was hurrying on a journey, he would combine the Maghrib and the ʿIshāʾ.
items.ma-6432: Asbāṭ ibn Muḥammad narrated to us, Muḥammad ibn ʿAjlān narrated to us, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to come to the Mosque of Qubāʾ riding and walking.
items.ma-6665: Ibn Numayr narrated to us, from Ḥajjāj, from ʿAmr ibn Shuʿayb, from his father, from his grandfather, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “When a man marries a virgin, he stays with her three days.”
items.ma-6686: Hushaym narrated to us, Ḥajjāj informed us, from ʿAmr ibn Shuʿayb, from his father, from his grandfather: that the Prophet ﷺ performed ʿumrah three times, every one of them in Dhū al-Qaʿdah, saying the talbiyah until he touched the Stone.
items.ma-6814: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Zakariyyā narrated to us, from ʿĀmir, from ʿAbd Allāh, he said: A man came to the Prophet ﷺ and said: O Messenger of Allah, who is the muhājir? He said: “The one who forsakes what Allah has forbidden.”
items.ma-6906: Naṣr ibn Bāb narrated to us, from Ḥajjāj, from ʿAmr ibn Shuʿayb, from his father, from his grandfather, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ combined the two prayers on the day he raided Banū al-Muṣṭaliq.
items.ma-7176: Muḥammad ibn Salamah narrated to us, from Hishām, from Muḥammad, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “When one of you stands to pray at night, let him begin with two short rakʿahs.”
items.ma-7221: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān narrated to us, Mālik narrated to us, from al-Zuhrī, from Abū Idrīs, from Abū Hurayrah, that the Prophet ﷺ said: “Whoever performs wuḍūʾ, let him blow his nose; and whoever uses stones [for cleaning], let him use an odd number.”
items.ma-7246: Sufyān narrated to us, from al-Zuhrī, from Saʿīd, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “When the heat becomes intense, delay the prayer until it is cooler, for the intensity of the heat is from the blast of Jahannam.”
items.ma-7542: ʿAbd al-Aʿlā narrated to us, from Maʿmar, from al-Zuhrī, from Abū Salamah, from Abū Hurayrah, that the Prophet ﷺ said: “Indeed, the Jews and the Christians do not dye [their hair], so be different from them.”
items.ma-7651: ʿAbd al-Razzāq narrated to us, Maʿmar narrated to us, from Ibn Ṭāwūs, from his father, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ, like it, except for his saying: And Maryam did not ride a camel.
items.ma-7731: ʿAbd al-Razzāq narrated to us, Maʿmar narrated to me, from Ayyūb, from Ibn Sīrīn, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Indeed, Allah is Witr, Yuḥibbu the witr.”
items.ma-8132: And the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “For every prophet there is a supplication that is answered for him, and I wish, if Allah wills, to postpone my supplication as an intercession for my ummah until the Day of Resurrection.”
items.ma-8212: And the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Let none of you walk to his brother with a weapon, for none of you knows — perhaps Shayṭān will pull at his hand, and he will fall into a pit of Fire.”
items.ma-8218: And the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “When any of you leads the people, let him shorten the prayer, for among them are the old, the weak and the sick; and when he stands alone, let him lengthen his prayer as he wishes.”
items.ma-8237: And the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Let none of you say: O Allah, forgive me if You will, or have mercy on me if You will, or provide for me. Let him be resolute in his request, for He does what He wills; there is none to compel Him.”
items.ma-8285: ʿAbd Allāh narrated to us, Dāwūd ibn ʿAmr al-Ḍabbī narrated to us, ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Abī al-Zinād narrated to us, from his father, from al-Aʿraj, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ, like it.
items.ma-8359: Abū ʿĀṣim narrated to us, Ibn ʿAjlān narrated to us, from his father, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Whoever carries arms against us is not of me.”
items.ma-8686: Sulaymān narrated to us, Ismāʿīl informed us, Muḥammad ibn ʿAmr narrated to me, from Abū Salamah, from Abū Hurayrah, that the Prophet ﷺ said: “There is no ʿumrā; whoever is given something as an ʿumrā, it belongs to him.”
items.ma-8851: Sulaymān narrated to us, Ismāʿīl informed us, al-ʿAlāʾ informed me, from his father, from Abū Hurayrah, that the Prophet ﷺ said: “The bell is the pipes of Shayṭān.”
items.ma-9029: ʿAffān narrated to us, Abū ʿAwānah narrated to us, ʿUmar ibn Abī Salamah narrated to us, from his father, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “When one of you uses stones [for cleaning], let him use an odd number.”
items.ma-9089: Aswad ibn ʿĀmir narrated to us, Sharīk narrated to us, from Suhayl, from his father, from Abū Hurayrah, raising it, he said: “The angels do not accompany a company in which there is a bell.”
items.ma-9284: ʿAffān narrated to us, Hammām narrated to us, Qatādah narrated to us, he said: A companion of ours narrated to us, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ: that he forbade fasting on the day of Jumuʿah, except as part of a consecutive fast.
items.ma-9371: ʿAffān narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, Muḥammad ibn ʿAmr narrated to us, from Abū Salamah, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ, like this, except that he said: “al-rakāʾiz.”
items.ma-9597: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from Ibn ʿAjlān, he said: I heard my father, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “When Allah created the creation, He wrote with Yadihi upon Nafsihi: Indeed, My Raḥmah overcomes My Ghaḍab.”
items.ma-9600: Yaḥyā ibn Saʿīd narrated to us, from Ibn ʿAjlān, from Saʿīd, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “Let not the people of the desert overcome you concerning the name of your prayer.”
items.ma-9601: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from Ibn Abī Dhiʾb, he said: Ṣāliḥ, the mawlā of al-Tawʾamah, narrated to me, he said: I heard Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “Whoever washes a dead person, let him perform ghusl.”
items.ma-9622: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from Ibn ʿAjlān, he said: I heard my father narrate, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “Ibrāhīm was circumcised when he was eighty years old; he was circumcised with the adze.”
items.ma-9669: Ibn Numayr narrated to us, he said: Hishām narrated to us, from his father, from Abū Hurayrah, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “A man was forgiven who removed a thorny branch from the people’s road.”
items.ma-9715: Wakīʿ narrated to us, from al-Aʿmash, from Abū Razīn and Abū Ṣāliḥ, from Abū Hurayrah, he said — and al-Aʿmash raises it —: “When the strap of one of your sandals snaps, let him not walk in the one sandal.”
items.ma-9951: I read to ʿAbd al-Raḥmān: Mālik, from Muḥammad ibn Yaḥyā ibn Ḥabbān, from al-Aʿraj, from Abū Hurayrah, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Let none of you propose upon the proposal of his brother.”
items.ma-9994: Aswad ibn ʿĀmir narrated to us, he said: Ḥammād ibn Salamah narrated to us, from ʿAmmār ibn Abī ʿAmmār and Muḥammad ibn Ziyād, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ, like it.
items.ma-10099: Wakīʿ narrated to us, al-Aʿmash narrated to us, from Abū Ṣāliḥ, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Be brief in the prayer, for among them are the weak, the old and the one in need.”
items.ma-10182: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Ḥammād ibn Salamah narrated to us, from Muḥammad ibn Ziyād, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “If you knew what I know, you would laugh little and weep much.”
items.ma-10250: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Ḥammād narrated to us, Muḥammad narrated to us, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “The ʿajmāʾ is jubār, the well is jubār, the mine is jubār, and in the rikāz is the khumus.”
items.ma-10328: Ḥusayn ibn Muḥammad narrated to us, he said: Jarīr ibn Ḥāzim narrated to us, from Muḥammad, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “The people of Yemen have come,” and he mentioned the like of it.
items.ma-10482: ʿAlī ibn ʿĀṣim narrated to us, Khālid and Hishām informed us, from Ibn Sīrīn, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Name yourselves with my name, but do not use my kunyah.”
items.ma-10558: Yazīd narrated to us, Ibn ʿAwn informed us, from Muḥammad, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “The angels curse any of you who points with a piece of iron, even if he is his brother by his father and mother.”
items.ma-10718: ʿUthmān narrated to us, Yūnus informed us, from al-Zuhrī, from Abū Idrīs, from Abū Hurayrah, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Whoever performs wuḍūʾ, let him blow out his nose; and whoever performs istinjāʾ, let him use an odd number.”
items.ma-10941: Hāshim and Abū Kāmil narrated to us, they both said: Zuhayr narrated to us, Suhayl narrated to us, from his father, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “The angels do not accompany a company in which there is a dog or a bell.”
items.ma-11312: Yaḥyā ibn Ādam narrated to us, Fuḍayl narrated to us, from ʿAṭiyyah, from Abū Saʿīd, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to pray the Ḍuḥā until we would say: He will not leave it; and he would leave it until we would say: He will not pray it.
items.ma-11362: Muʿāwiyah narrated to us, Shaybān narrated to us, from Firās, from ʿAṭiyyah, from Abū Saʿīd, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “Indeed, whoever does not show mercy to people, Allah lā Yarḥamuhu.”
items.ma-11563: Yaʿlā narrated to us, al-Aʿmash narrated to us, from Abū Sufyān, from Jābir, he said: Abū Saʿīd narrated to me, he said: I entered upon the Messenger of Allah ﷺ while he was praying on a mat.
items.ma-11947: Hushaym narrated to us, from ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz, from Anas: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, when he entered the privy, would say: “O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the khubuth and the khabāʾith.”
items.ma-12055: Ibn Abī ʿAdī narrated to us, from Ḥumayd, from Anas, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ was in his house, and a man peered in at him, so he reached toward him with a broad arrowhead that he had, and the man drew back.
items.ma-12082: Sufyān narrated to us, from Yaḥyā, from Anas, he said: A Bedouin came and urinated in the mosque, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Pour over it a large bucket – or a pail – of water.”
items.ma-12110: Abū Muʿāwiyah narrated to us, ʿĀṣim al-Aḥwal narrated to us, from Anas ibn Mālik, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Whoever lies about me deliberately, let him take his seat in the Fire.”
items.ma-12126: Yaḥyā ibn Saʿīd narrated to us, from Shuʿbah, Abū al-Tayyāḥ narrated to me, from Anas, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Hear and obey, even if an Abyssinian is appointed over you, as though his head were a raisin.”
items.ma-12220: Yazīd ibn Hārūn narrated to us, Ḥumayd informed us, from Anas, he said: Among the supplications of the Prophet ﷺ on the day of Ḥunayn was: “O Allah, if You will that You not be worshipped after today.”
items.ma-12282: Yaḥyā ibn Ādam narrated to us, Sufyān narrated to us, from ʿĀṣim, from Yūsuf ibn ʿAbd Allāh ibn al-Ḥārith, from Anas, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ permitted the ruqyah for the evil eye, the venomous sting, and the namlah.
items.ma-12377: Bahz and ʿAffān narrated to us, they both said: Hammām narrated to us, Qatādah narrated to us, he said: I said to Anas: Which garment was most pleasing – ʿAffān said: or most beloved – to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ? He said: The ḥibarah.
items.ma-12428: Muḥammad ibn Bishr narrated to us, Saʿīd narrated to us, from Qatādah, from Anas, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Let the adhān of Bilāl not prevent you from the pre-dawn meal, for there is something in his eyesight.”
items.ma-12596: Yūnus narrated to us, Ḥarb narrated to us, he said: I heard ʿImrān al-ʿAmmī say: I heard Anas say: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Indeed, Allah, when He created the disease, created the cure; so seek treatment.”
items.ma-12729: ʿAbd al-Ṣamad narrated to us, Zāʾidah narrated to us, al-Aʿmash narrated to us, he said: It was narrated to me from Anas, from the Prophet ﷺ, that he said: “The longest of people in necks on the Day of Resurrection will be the muʾadhdhins.”
items.ma-12841: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, from Qatādah, from Anas ibn Mālik, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Straighten your rows, for straightening the row is part of the excellence of the prayer.”
items.ma-12913: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān narrated to us, from Ḥammād, from Qatādah, from Anas, he said: The Prophet ﷺ would come upon a date and say: “Were I not afraid that it is from the ṣadaqah, I would eat it.”
items.ma-12920: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān narrated to us, Sufyān narrated to us, from Rabīʿah, he said: I heard Anas ibn Mālik say: There were not twenty white hairs in the head and beard of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ.
items.ma-12965: Ismāʿīl ibn Ibrāhīm narrated to us, from Saʿīd ibn Yazīd – and he is Abū Maslamah – he said: I said to Anas: Did the Prophet ﷺ pray in his sandals? He said: Yes.
items.ma-13108: Yazīd ibn Hārūn narrated to us, Hammām informed us, from Qatādah, from Anas, from the Prophet ﷺ, like the narration of Shuʿbah, except that Qatādah said in his narration: And the Jew confessed.
items.ma-13155: Yūnus narrated to us, Shaybān narrated to us, from Qatādah, Anas ibn Mālik narrated to us that the Prophet of Allah ﷺ said: “Indeed, in Paradise there is a tree in whose shade a rider travels a hundred years without crossing it.”
items.ma-13174: Rawḥ narrated to us, Ḥammād narrated to us, from Thābit, from Anas ibn Mālik: that the Prophet ﷺ used to fast until it was said: He has fasted; and he would break his fast until it was said: He has broken his fast.
items.ma-13179: Rawḥ narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, from Qatādah, from Anas ibn Mālik, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Do not sever ties with one another, do not hate one another, and do not envy one another; and be servants of Allah, brothers.”
items.ma-13454: ʿAbd al-Wahhāb narrated to us, from Saʿīd, Qatādah said: And Anas ibn Mālik narrated to us: that the Prophet of Allah ﷺ said, while the bier of Saʿd was laid down: “The ʿArsh of al-Raḥmān shook for it.”
items.ma-13464: Sulaymān ibn Dāwūd al-Hāshimī narrated to us, Ismāʿīl informed us, Ḥumayd informed me, from Anas, he said: There were young men of the Anṣār who were called the Qurrāʾ. And he mentioned the meaning of the narration of ʿAbīdah.
items.ma-13611: ʿAffān narrated to us, Wuhayb narrated to us, Ayyūb narrated to us, from Abū Qilābah, from Anas, that the Prophet ﷺ said: “When one of you becomes drowsy while he is in prayer, let him leave and sleep.”
items.ma-13725: Aswad narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, from Qatādah, from Anas: that the Prophet ﷺ performed qunūt for a month, supplicating, cursing Riʿl, Dhakwān and ʿUṣayyah, who disobeyed Allah and His Messenger.
items.ma-13752: Abū Nuʿaym narrated to us, Hishām narrated to us, from Qatādah, from Anas, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ performed qunūt for a month after the rukūʿ, supplicating against a tribe among the tribes of the Arabs, then he abandoned it.
items.ma-13937: Abū Dāwūd narrated to us, Shuʿbah informed us, from Qatādah, he said: I asked Anas about the nabīdh of the jar, and he said: I did not hear anything about it from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. He said: And Anas disliked it.
items.ma-13951: Al-Aswad ibn ʿĀmir narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, from Qatādah, from Anas: that the Prophet ﷺ performed qunūt for a month, cursing Riʿl, Dhakwān and ʿUṣayyah, who disobeyed Allah and His Messenger.
items.ma-13993: Muḥammad ibn Jaʿfar narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, from ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz, from Anas ibn Mālik, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Eat the pre-dawn meal, for in the pre-dawn meal there is blessing.”
items.ma-14030: ʿAffān narrated to us, Ḥammād narrated to us, he said: Thābit and Ḥumayd informed us, from Anas ibn Mālik, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Paradise is surrounded by disliked things, and the Fire is surrounded by desires.”
items.ma-14105: Bahz narrated to us, Hammām narrated to us, from Qatādah, from Anas ibn Mālik: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade drinking while standing. Qatādah said: So we asked Anas about eating. He said: Eating is worse.
items.ma-14230: Wakīʿ narrated to us, from Sufyān, from Abū al-Zubayr, from Jābir, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Keep your property for yourselves and do not give it as ʿumrā; for if a ʿumrā is given, it takes the course of inheritance.”
items.ma-14266: Bishr ibn al-Mufaḍḍal narrated to us, from Dāwūd, from Abū al-Zubayr, from Jābir, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Upon every Muslim there is a ghusl once in seven days, every Jumuʿah.”
items.ma-14309: Sufyān narrated to us, from ʿAmr, he heard Jābir: A man entered on the day of Jumuʿah while the Prophet ﷺ was delivering the khuṭbah, and the Prophet ﷺ said to him: “Have you prayed?” He said: No. He said: “Pray two rakʿahs.”
items.ma-14363: Abū Muʿāwiyah narrated to us, al-Aʿmash narrated to us, from Sālim, from Jābir, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Name yourselves with my name, but do not use my kunyah, for I have been made a distributor; I distribute among you.”
items.ma-14368: Abū Muʿāwiyah, Yaʿlā and Wakīʿ narrated to us, they said: al-Aʿmash narrated to us, from Abū Sufyān, from Jābir, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ was asked: Which prayer is best? He said: “The length of the qunūt.”
items.ma-14372: Abū Muʿāwiyah narrated to us, from al-Aʿmash, from Abū Sufyān, from Jābir, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “There is no breathing soul upon which a hundred years come…”
items.ma-14398: Abū Muʿāwiyah narrated to us, al-Aʿmash narrated to us, from Abū Sufyān, from Jābir, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ drove seventy sacrificial camels in the year of al-Ḥudaybiyyah. He said: And he sacrificed a camel for seven.
items.ma-14400: Abū Muʿāwiyah narrated to us, al-Aʿmash narrated to us, from Abū Sufyān, from Jābir, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “The ʿArsh of Allah shook at the death of Saʿd ibn Muʿādh.”
items.ma-14510: Zayd ibn al-Ḥubāb narrated to us, Ḥusayn ibn Wāqid informed us, from Abū al-Zubayr, that he heard Jābir say: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “When you buy food, do not sell it until you take possession of it.”
items.ma-14587: Yūnus ibn Muḥammad and Ḥujayn narrated to us, they both said: Layth narrated to us, from Abū al-Zubayr, from Jābir, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Do not eat with the left [hand], for Shayṭān eats with the left.”
items.ma-14778: Ḥujayn and Yūnus narrated to us, they both said: al-Layth ibn Saʿd narrated to us, from Abū al-Zubayr, from Jābir, from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, that he said: “None of those who pledged allegiance under the tree will enter the Fire.”
items.ma-14807: Muḥammad ibn Yazīd narrated to us, from Ḥajjāj ibn Abī Zaynab, from Abū Sufyān, from Jābir, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “How excellent a condiment vinegar is; a house with vinegar in it has not been left bare.”
items.ma-14897: ʿAffān narrated to us, Ḥammād ibn Salamah narrated to us, Abū al-Zubayr informed us, from Jābir ibn ʿAbd Allāh, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade us from any one of us walking in a single sandal.
items.ma-15054: Yazīd narrated to us, Ḥajjāj narrated to us, from Abū al-Zubayr, from Jābir: that Abū Saʿīd al-Khudrī entered upon the Messenger of Allah ﷺ while he was praying in a single garment.
items.ma-15153: Ḥasan narrated to us, Ibn Lahīʿah narrated to us, Abū al-Zubayr narrated to us, from Jābir: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade a man to eat with his left [hand], for Shayṭān eats with his left.
items.ma-15157: Abū Salamah al-Khuzāʿī narrated to us, Sharīk narrated to us, from ʿAmmār al-Duhnī, from Abū al-Zubayr, from Jābir: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ entered Makkah on the day of the Conquest wearing a black turban.
items.ma-15337: Ismāʿīl ibn Ibrāhīm narrated to us, Maʿmar narrated to us, from al-Zuhrī, from al-Rabīʿ ibn Sabrah, from his father, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade the mutʿah of women on the day of the Conquest.
items.ma-15384: Jarīr narrated to us, from Manṣūr, from Mujāhid, from Abū al-Ḥakam or al-Ḥakam ibn Sufyān al-Thaqafī, he said: I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ urinate, then perform wuḍūʾ and sprinkle [water on] his private part.
items.ma-15546: Yaḥyā ibn Saʿīd narrated to us, from ʿUbayd Allāh – meaning Ibn ʿUmar – he said: Nāfiʿ informed me that he heard Abū Lubābah informing Ibn ʿUmar that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade the killing of the jinnān.
items.ma-15871: Yazīd narrated to us, he said: Dāwūd – meaning Ibn Abī Hind – informed us, from ʿĀmir, from Muḥammad ibn Ṣafwān: that he passed by the Messenger of Allah ﷺ carrying two hares hanging; and he mentioned its meaning.
items.ma-16159: Wakīʿ narrated to us, he said: Shuʿbah narrated to us, from al-Nuʿmān ibn Sālim, from Ibn Abī Aws, from his grandfather, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ prayed in his sandals, and let [the water] drip three times.
items.ma-16449: Sufyān narrated to us, from al-Zuhrī, from ʿAbbād ibn Tamīm, from his paternal uncle: he saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ in the mosque lying on his back, placing one of his legs on the other.
items.ma-16790: Yaḥyā ibn Saʿīd narrated to us, he said: Kahmas narrated to us, he said: ʿAbd Allāh ibn Buraydah narrated to us, from Ibn Mughaffal, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “Between every two adhāns there is a prayer, for whoever wishes.”
items.ma-17410: Abū ʿAbd al-Raḥmān narrated to us, Ibn Lahīʿah narrated to us, Abū al-Muṣʿab narrated to me, he said: I heard ʿUqbah say: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: “Most of the hypocrites of this ummah are its reciters.”
items.ma-17514: ʿAbd al-Ṣamad narrated to us, Hammām narrated to us, Anas ibn Sīrīn narrated to us, from ʿAbd al-Malik ibn Qatādah ibn Milḥān al-Qaysī, from his father, he said: The Prophet ﷺ used to command fasting, and he mentioned it.
items.ma-17761: Yaḥyā ibn Saʿīd narrated to us, from al-Aʿmash, he said: I heard Abū Ṣāliḥ, from ʿAmr ibn al-ʿĀṣ, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade us to enter upon women whose husbands are away.
items.ma-17952: ʿAbd Allāh ibn al-Walīd narrated to us, he said: Sufyān narrated to us, from Ibn Jurayj, from a man, from Ibn Yaʿlā, from Yaʿlā, he said: I saw the Prophet ﷺ performing iḍṭibāʿ with a Ḥaḍramī cloak.
items.ma-18152: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Maslamah ibn Nawfal narrated to me, from a man from the children of al-Mughīrah ibn Shuʿbah, from al-Mughīrah ibn Shuʿbah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade mutilation.
items.ma-18633: Yazīd narrated to us, Sharīk ibn ʿAbd Allāh informed us, from Abū Isḥāq, from al-Barāʾ ibn ʿĀzib, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ considered me and Ibn ʿUmar too young, so we were sent back on the day of Badr.
items.ma-18791: ʿAffān narrated to us, Abū ʿAwānah narrated to us, from Manṣūr, from ʿUbayd Allāh ibn ʿUrfuṭah al-Sulamī, from Khidāsh Abū Salāmah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “I advise a man…” And he mentioned its meaning.
items.ma-18809: Wakīʿ narrated to us, from Misʿar, from ʿAbd al-Malik ibn ʿUmayr, from Jundab al-ʿAlaqī – he heard him say: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “I am your forerunner at the Ḥawḍ.”
items.ma-18813:
Sufyān ibn ʿUyaynah narrated to us, from ʿAbd al-Malik ibn ʿUmayr, he heard it from Jundab, that the Prophet ﷺ said: “I am your forerunner at the Ḥawḍ.”
Sufyān said: The forerunner is the one who goes ahead.
items.ma-18903: Yaʿlā narrated to us, Misʿar narrated to us, from Ziyād ibn ʿIlāqah, from his paternal uncle Quṭbah ibn Mālik, he said: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ reciting in the Fajr [prayer]: {and the lofty palm trees} [Qāf: 10].
items.ma-18982: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān narrated to us, Sufyān narrated to us, from al-Aʿmash, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Sinān, from Ḍirār ibn al-Azwar, that the Prophet ﷺ passed by him while he was milking, and said: “Leave the caller of the milk.”
items.ma-19050: Aswad ibn ʿĀmir narrated to us, Sharīk narrated to us, from Yazīd, from Ibn Sābiṭ, from al-Muṭṭalib, or from al-ʿAyyāsh ibn Abī Rabīʿah, he said: I heard the Prophet ﷺ, and he mentioned the like of it.
items.ma-19171: Muḥammad ibn ʿUbayd narrated to us, al-Aʿmash narrated to us, from Zayd ibn Wahb, from Jarīr, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Whoever does not show mercy to people, Allah ﷿ lā Yarḥamuhu.”
items.ma-19247: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from Ismāʿīl, Qays narrated to us, Jarīr narrated to us, he said: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: “Whoever does not show mercy to people, Allah ﷿ lā Yarḥamuhu.”
items.ma-19248: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from Ismāʿīl, Qays narrated to us, Jarīr ibn ʿAbd Allāh narrated to me, he said: I pledged allegiance to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ to establish the prayer, to give the zakāh, and to give sincere advice to every Muslim.
items.ma-19297: ʿAbd Allāh said: ʿUbayd Allāh ibn Muʿādh narrated to us, he said: My father narrated to us, he said: Shuʿbah narrated to us, from ʿAmr ibn Murrah, from Abū Ḥamzah, from Zayd ibn Arqam, from the Prophet ﷺ, similar to it.
items.ma-19346: Abū Aḥmad narrated it to us, Khālid ibn Ṭahmān Abū al-ʿAlāʾ narrated to us, from ʿAṭiyyah al-ʿAwfī, from Abū Saʿīd al-Khudrī, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said; and he mentioned its meaning.
items.ma-19385: Yazīd narrated to us, Hishām informed us, from Muḥammad, from Abū ʿUbaydah, from a man, he said: I said to ʿAdī ibn Ḥātim: A ḥadīth has reached me from you that I would love to hear from you. And he mentioned the ḥadīth.
items.ma-19629: Muḥammad ibn Jaʿfar narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, from Sulaymān, from Abū Wāʾil, from ʿAbd Allāh, from the Prophet ﷺ, that he said: “A person is with whom he loves.”
items.ma-19858: Abū Kāmil narrated to us, Ḥammād narrated to us, from Ḥumayd, from al-Ḥasan, from ʿImrān ibn Ḥuṣayn, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ never delivered a khuṭbah to us without commanding us to give ṣadaqah and forbidding us from mutilation.
items.ma-19950: Hāshim ibn al-Qāsim narrated to us, al-Mubārak narrated to us, from al-Ḥasan, ʿImrān ibn Ḥuṣayn informed me, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ commanded ṣadaqah and forbade mutilation.
items.ma-20003: ʿAbd al-Ṣamad narrated to us, Ḥammād narrated to us, Ḥumayd narrated to us, from al-Ḥasan, from ʿImrān ibn Ḥuṣayn, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Whoever plunders plunder is not of us.”
items.ma-20073: Yazīd narrated to us, Bahz informed us, from his father, from his grandfather, he said: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: “Woe to the one who speaks and lies in order to make the people laugh; woe to him, woe to him.”
items.ma-20260: ʿAffān narrated to us, Hammām narrated to us, from Qatādah, from al-Ḥasan, from Samurah: that the day of Ḥunayn was a rainy day, so the Prophet ﷺ commanded his caller [to announce] that the prayer is in the riḥāl.
items.ma-20703: Bahz narrated to us, Abān narrated to us, Qatādah narrated to us, Abū al-Malīḥ narrated to us, from his father: that the Prophet of Allah ﷺ said on the day of Ḥunayn, on a rainy day: “The prayer is in the riḥāl.”
items.ma-20911: ʿAbd Allāh narrated to us, ʿUthmān ibn Muḥammad narrated to me, Wakīʿ narrated to us, from Isrāʾīl, from Simāk, from Jābir ibn Samurah, he said: I entered upon the Prophet ﷺ and saw him reclining on a cushion.
items.ma-20914: ʿAbd Allāh narrated to us, Khalaf ibn Hishām narrated to us, Sharīk narrated to us, from Simāk, from Jābir ibn Samurah: that the Prophet ﷺ stoned a Jewish man and a Jewish woman.
items.ma-20961: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from Shuʿbah, Simāk narrated to me, he said: I said to Jābir ibn Samurah: What did the Prophet ﷺ do when he had prayed the Fajr? He said: He would sit in his place of prayer until the sun rose.
items.ma-20975: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Isrāʾīl narrated to us, from Simāk, from Jābir ibn Samurah, he said: I entered upon the Messenger of Allah ﷺ in his house and saw him reclining on a pillow.
items.ma-21032: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Sufyān narrated to us, from Simāk ibn Ḥarb, from Jābir ibn Samurah: that the Prophet ﷺ would sit in his place of prayer, when he had prayed the Ghadāh [prayer], until the sun rose, beautiful.
items.ma-21091: ʿAffān narrated to us, he said: Ḥammād narrated to us, he said: Ḥumayd informed us, from Anas, from ʿUbādah, that Ubayy ibn Kaʿb said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “The Qurʾān was sent down upon seven aḥruf.”
items.ma-21127: Ḥajjāj and Abū Qaṭan ʿAmr ibn al-Haytham narrated to us, they both said: Ḥamzah narrated to us, from Abū Isḥāq, from Saʿīd ibn Jubayr, from Ibn ʿAbbās, from Ubayy ibn Kaʿb, from the Prophet ﷺ, its meaning.
items.ma-21386: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from al-Ajlaḥ, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Buraydah, from Abū al-Aswad, from Abū Dharr, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “Indeed, the best thing with which grey hair is changed is henna and katam.”
items.ma-21433: Muḥammad ibn Jaʿfar narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, from Wāṣil al-Aḥdab, from al-Maʿrūr, he said: I heard Abū Dharr narrate from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “Jibrīl came to me and gave me glad tidings.”
items.ma-21591: Yaḥyā ibn Saʿīd narrated to us, from Ibn Abī Dhiʾb, from Yazīd ibn Qusayṭ, from ʿAṭāʾ ibn Yasār, from Zayd ibn Thābit, he said: I recited al-Najm to the Prophet ﷺ, and he did not prostrate.
items.ma-21695: ʿIṣām ibn Khālid narrated to us, Abū Bakr ibn ʿAbd Allāh narrated to me, from Ḍamrah, from Abū al-Dardāʾ, from the Prophet ﷺ, that he said: “Part of a man’s understanding is his gentleness in his livelihood.”
items.ma-21738: Yaḥyā ibn Isḥāq narrated it to us, doubting in it, he said: I heard Abū Dharr or Abū al-Dardāʾ. Yaḥyā said: Then he says: “And I recognise them, that their light runs before them, and on their right.”
items.ma-21838: Wakīʿ narrated to us, from Sufyān, from Salm ibn ʿAbd al-Raḥmān, from Ziyād ibn Kulayb, from al-Ashʿath ibn Qays, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “He does not thank Allah who does not thank people.”
items.ma-22349: Abū Nuʿaym narrated it to us, Sufyān narrated to us, from Salamah, from a man, from his father – Sufyān said: I think he is ʿIyāḍ ibn ʿIyāḍ – from Abū Masʿūd, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ gave us a khuṭbah, and he mentioned its meaning.
items.ma-22416: ʿAbd al-Jabbār ibn Muḥammad – meaning al-Khaṭṭābī – narrated to us, Baqiyyah narrated to us, from Ḥabīb ibn Ṣāliḥ, from Yazīd ibn Shurayḥ, and he mentioned its meaning with its isnād.
items.ma-22599: Hāshim narrated to us, al-Mubārak narrated to us, from Bakr ibn ʿAbd Allāh, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Rabāḥ, from Abū Qatādah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “The one who serves drink to the people is the last of them.”
items.ma-22682: Ḥajjāj narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, from Manṣūr, from Hilāl ibn Yisāf, from Abū al-Muthannā, from the son of the wife of ʿUbādah ibn al-Ṣāmit, from the Prophet ﷺ, and he mentioned the like of it.
items.ma-22773: He said: I heard Sufyān ibn ʿUyaynah naming the naqībs, and he named ʿUbādah ibn al-Ṣāmit among them. Sufyān said: ʿUbādah was ʿAqabī, Uḥudī, Badrī, Shajarī, and he is a naqīb.
items.ma-23078: Wakīʿ narrated to us, ʿĀṣim narrated to us, from Rajāʾ ibn Ḥaywah, from his father, from the envoy who asked the Prophet ﷺ about the hijrah, and he said: “It does not cease so long as the enemy is fought.”
items.ma-23089: Wakīʿ narrated to us, from Abū Khaldah, from Abū al-ʿĀliyah, from a man from the Companions of the Prophet ﷺ, he said: I have memorised for you that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ performed wuḍūʾ in the mosque.
items.ma-23531: Sufyān narrated to us, from ʿAmr, from ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn al-Sāʾibah, from ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Suʿād, from Abū Ayyūb, that the Prophet ﷺ said: “Water is from water.”
items.ma-23918: ʿAffān narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, al-Ḥakam informed me, he said: I heard Ibn Abī Laylā, from Bilāl, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to wipe over the khuffs and the head-covering.
items.ma-24024: Muʿtamir narrated to us, from Isḥāq – meaning Ibn Suwayd – from Muʿādhah, from ʿĀʾishah, from the Prophet ﷺ: he forbade the naqīr, the pitch-coated vessel, the gourd and the ḥantam.
items.ma-24281: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from Zakariyyā, from ʿĀmir, from Abū Salamah, from ʿĀʾishah, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Indeed, Jibrīl ﵇ recites the salām to you.” She said: And upon him [be peace], and the mercy of Allah.
items.ma-24345: Wakīʿ narrated to us, from Misʿar and Sufyān, from Maʿbad ibn Khālid, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Shaddād, from ʿĀʾishah: that the Prophet ﷺ commanded her to seek ruqyah for the evil eye.
items.ma-24579: Yūnus narrated to us, he said: Layth narrated to us, from Yazīd – meaning Ibn al-Hād – from Ibn Shihāb, from ʿUrwah, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: The Prophet ﷺ used to supplicate in the prayer. And he mentioned the like of it.
items.ma-24722: Yaḥyā ibn Isḥāq narrated to us, he said: Abū ʿAwānah informed us, from ʿUmar ibn Abī Salamah, from his father, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Walāʾ belongs to the one who frees.”
items.ma-24943: ʿAffān narrated to us, he said: Khālid ibn al-Ḥārith narrated to me, he said: Ashʿath narrated to us, from al-Ḥasan, from Saʿd ibn Hishām, from ʿĀʾishah: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade tabattul.
items.ma-24963: ʿAbd al-Razzāq narrated to us, he said: Sufyān informed us, from Manṣūr ibn Ṣafiyyah, from his mother, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ died, and we had been satisfied with the two black things: dates and water.
items.ma-24981: ʿAffān narrated to us, he said: Ḥammād ibn Salamah narrated to us, he said: ʿAlī ibn Zayd informed us, from Abū Salamah ibn ʿAbd al-Raḥmān, that ʿĀʾishah said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ raced me, and I beat him.
items.ma-25015: Al-Naḍr ibn Ismāʿīl Abū al-Mughīrah narrated to us, he said: Ibn Abī Laylā narrated to us, from ʿAṭāʾ, he said: ʿĀʾishah said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to perform wuḍūʾ with a mudd and perform ghusl with a ṣāʿ.
items.ma-25135: Hushaym narrated to us, from Ismāʿīl ibn Abī Khālid, from Abū Isḥāq, from al-Aswad, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to sleep while in janābah, without touching water.
items.ma-25163: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān narrated to us, Ḥammād ibn Salamah narrated to us, from al-Azraq ibn Qays, from Dhakwān, from ʿĀʾishah: that the Prophet ﷺ used to pray on the khumrah.
items.ma-25353: ʿAbd al-Razzāq narrated to us, Ibn Jurayj informed us, he said: ʿAṭāʾ informed me, from ʿĀʾishah, that she reported about the Prophet ﷺ and about herself: that the two of them entered together, both in janābah, into one vessel.
items.ma-25373: Hushaym narrated to us, he said: Mughīrah informed us, from Ibrāhīm, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to empty his right [hand] for his food and his need, and empty his left for istinjāʾ and what is there.
items.ma-25483: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān narrated to us, from Mālik, from al-Zuhrī, from ʿUrwah, from ʿĀʾishah, from the Prophet ﷺ: that when he fell ill he would recite the Muʿawwidhāt over himself, and would blow [lightly].
items.ma-25583: Yaḥyā narrated to us, he said: Sufyān narrated to us, from Manṣūr, from Ibrāhīm, from al-Aswad, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ and I used to perform ghusl from one vessel, both of us in janābah.
items.ma-25614: Yaḥyā narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, from al-Ḥakam, from Ibrāhīm, from Hammām ibn al-Ḥārith, from ʿĀʾishah, that the Prophet ﷺ, like this – meaning, concerning rubbing off semen.
items.ma-25629: ʿAbd al-Razzāq narrated to us, Sufyān informed us, from Manṣūr ibn Ṣafiyyah, from his mother, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ died, and we had been satisfied with the two black things: dates and water.
items.ma-25634: ʿAbd al-Razzāq narrated to us, Maʿmar and Ibn Jurayj narrated to us, from al-Zuhrī, from ʿUrwah, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ and I used to perform ghusl from one vessel, in which was the amount of a faraq.
items.ma-25738: Wakīʿ narrated to us, ʿAlī ibn Mubārak narrated to us, from Yaḥyā ibn Abī Kathīr, from al-Qāsim, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Whoever vows to disobey Allah, let him not disobey Him.”
items.ma-25756: Wakīʿ narrated to us, from Hishām, from his father, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ was never given a choice between two matters except that he chose the easier of them, so long as there was no sin in it.
items.ma-25938: Ibn Numayr narrated to us, he said: Hishām narrated to us, from his father, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Kill the one with the two stripes, for it seeks out the sight and strikes the pregnancy.”
items.ma-25943: Ibn Numayr narrated to us, he said: Hishām narrated to us, from his father, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ commanded Abū Bakr to lead the people in prayer during his illness, so he used to lead them in prayer.
items.ma-26093: ʿUthmān ibn ʿUmar narrated to us, he said: Mālik narrated to us, from al-Zuhrī, from ʿUrwah, from ʿĀʾishah: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “The child belongs to the bed, and for the adulterer is the stone.”
items.ma-26276: Miskīn ibn Bukayr narrated to us, from Saʿīd – meaning Ibn ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz – he said: Makḥūl narrated to me, from ʿUrwah, from ʿĀʾishah: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was shrouded in three Yamanī rayṭahs.
items.ma-26445: Sufyān narrated to us, from Manṣūr, from Abū al-Ḍuḥā, from Shutayr ibn Shakal, from Ḥafṣah, that the Prophet ﷺ used to take from the face of some of his wives while he was fasting.
items.ma-26670: ʿAffān narrated to us, Jaʿfar ibn Sulaymān narrated to us, from Thābit, he said: ʿUmar ibn Abī Salamah narrated to me. And Sulaymān ibn al-Mughīrah said: Ibn ʿUmar ibn Abī Salamah. Mursal.
items.ma-26705: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān narrated to us, Sufyān narrated to us, from ʿAmmār al-Duhnī, from Abū Salamah, from Umm Salamah, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “The legs of the minbar are fixed in Paradise.”
items.ma-26867: ʿAffān narrated to us, Ḥammād – meaning Ibn Salamah – narrated to us, he said: Thābit narrated to us, from Sumayyah, from ʿĀʾishah, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was on a journey, and a camel of Ṣafiyyah broke down, and he mentioned the like of it.
items.ma-26868: Sufyān ibn ʿUyaynah narrated to us, from al-Zuhrī, from ʿUbayd Allāh, from Ibn ʿAbbās, from his mother: that she heard the Prophet ﷺ reciting in the Maghrib [prayer] {By those sent forth in succession}.
items.ma-27072: Yaḥyā ibn Saʿīd narrated to us, from Muḥammad ibn Abī Yaḥyā, he said: My mother narrated to me, from Umm Bilāl, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Sacrifice the jadhaʿ of sheep, for it is acceptable.”
items.ma-27191: Zakariyyā ibn ʿAdī narrated to us, he said: ʿUbayd Allāh – meaning Ibn ʿAmr – informed us, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Muḥammad ibn ʿAqīl, from ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn, and he mentioned it with its isnād and its meaning.
items.ma-27399: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from Ibn Abī Dhiʾb, he said: al-Zuhrī narrated to me, from Abū Salamah, from Abū Sufyān ibn Saʿīd, from Umm Ḥabībah, from the Prophet ﷺ: “Perform wuḍūʾ from what fire has touched.”
items.ma-4451: Hushaym narrated to us, Yaḥyā ibn Saʿīd informed us, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Whoever frees his share in a slave is charged with completing his emancipation at a just value.”
items.ma-4520: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān narrated to us, from Mālik, from ʿAmr ibn Yaḥyā, from Saʿīd ibn Yasār, from Ibn ʿUmar, he said: I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ praying on a donkey while he was heading toward Khaybar.
items.ma-4527: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān narrated to us, from Mālik, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, that a man performed liʿān against his wife and disowned her child, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ separated them and attached the child to the woman.
items.ma-4646: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from ʿUbayd Allāh, Nāfiʿ informed us, from Ibn ʿUmar, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “A prayer in my mosque is better than a thousand prayers in any other than it, except al-Masjid al-Ḥarām.”
items.ma-4648: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from ʿUbayd Allāh, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “For the treacherous one a banner will be raised on the Day of Resurrection; it will be said: This is the treachery of so-and-so, son of so-and-so.”
items.ma-4719: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from ʿUbayd Allāh, Nāfiʿ narrated to me, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿUmar, from the Prophet ﷺ: “Fever is from the fayḥ of Jahannam, so cool it with water.”
items.ma-4892: ʿAbd al-Razzāq narrated to us, Maʿmar informed us, from al-Zuhrī, from Sālim, from Ibn ʿUmar, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ permitted the weak among the people to leave al-Muzdalifah by night.
items.ma-4952: Yaḥyā ibn Zakariyyā ibn Abī Zāʾidah narrated to us, ʿUbayd Allāh narrated to me, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, that the Prophet ﷺ said: “Forestall the Ṣubḥ with the Witr.”
items.ma-4954: Yaḥyā ibn Zakariyyā narrated to us, ʿĀṣim al-Aḥwal informed me, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Shaqīq, from Ibn ʿUmar, that the Prophet ﷺ said: “Forestall the Ṣubḥ with the Witr.”
items.ma-5162: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from ʿUbayd Allāh, Nāfiʿ informed me, from Ibn ʿUmar, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “Any date-palm whose roots are sold, its fruit belongs to the one who pollinated it, unless the buyer stipulates [otherwise].”
items.ma-5210: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Sufyān narrated to us, from Abū Isḥāq, from Yaḥyā ibn Waththāb, from Ibn ʿUmar, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Whoever comes to the Jumuʿah, let him bathe.”
items.ma-5214: Wakīʿ narrated to us, al-ʿUmarī narrated to us, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar: that the Prophet ﷺ, Abū Bakr, ʿUmar and ʿUthmān – at the beginning of his leadership – prayed two rakʿahs at Minā.
items.ma-5251: Wakīʿ narrated to us, al-ʿUmarī narrated to us, from Saʿīd al-Maqburī and Nāfiʿ: that Ibn ʿUmar used to wear the tanned-leather sandals and perform wuḍūʾ in them, and he mentioned that the Prophet ﷺ used to do it.
items.ma-5253: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Ḥanẓalah narrated to us, from Sālim, from his father, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Whoever keeps a dog, except a hunting dog or a livestock dog, two qīrāṭs are deducted from his deeds every day.”
items.ma-5444: ʿAffān narrated to us, Wuhayb narrated to us, ʿUbayd Allāh ibn ʿUmar narrated to us, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ performed ramal in the first three circuits around the House.
items.ma-5622: ʿAbd al-Razzāq narrated to us, Maʿmar informed us, from al-Zuhrī, from Sālim, from Ibn ʿUmar: that the Prophet ﷺ used to touch the Yemeni corner, and did not touch the other two.
items.ma-5774: Muḥammad ibn ʿUbayd narrated to us, ʿUbayd Allāh ibn ʿUmar narrated to us, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to come to Qubāʾ riding and walking.
items.ma-5782: Muḥammad ibn ʿUbayd narrated to us, ʿUbayd Allāh narrated to us, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar: that ʿUmar said: O Messenger of Allah, may one of us sleep while he is junub? He said: “Yes, if he performs wuḍūʾ.”
items.ma-5881: [ʿAbd Allāh ibn Aḥmad said]: Sawwār ibn ʿAbd Allāh narrated to us, Muʿādh ibn Muʿādh narrated to us, from Ibn ʿAwn, he said: I myself saw Ghaylān – meaning al-Qadarī – crucified at the gate of Damascus.
items.ma-6012: Hāshim narrated to us, Abū Khaythamah narrated to us, Abū al-Zubayr narrated to us, from Jābir and ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿUmar: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade the naqīr, the pitch-coated vessel and the gourd.
items.ma-6121: Muḥammad ibn Yazīd narrated to us, from ʿĀṣim ibn Muḥammad ibn Zayd, from his father, from Ibn ʿUmar, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “This matter will continue to be in Quraysh as long as two [persons] remain among the people.”
items.ma-6219: ʿAlī ibn Isḥāq narrated to us, he said: ʿAbd Allāh informed us, he said: Muḥammad ibn ʿAjlān informed us, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, from the Prophet ﷺ, like it.
items.ma-6334: ʿAbd al-Razzāq narrated to us: I heard Mālik ibn Anas and ʿUbayd Allāh ibn ʿUmar narrating, from Ibn Shihāb, from Abū Bakr ibn ʿUbayd Allāh, from Ibn ʿUmar, from the Prophet ﷺ, like it.
items.ma-6361: Yaʿqūb narrated to us, my father narrated to us, from Ṣāliḥ, Ibn Shihāb said: Sālim ibn ʿAbd Allāh informed me that ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿUmar said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ set out toward Ibn Ṣayyād, and he mentioned it.
items.ma-6409: Sulaymān ibn Dāwūd narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Dīnār, he heard Ibn ʿUmar, he heard the Prophet ﷺ saying: “Ghifār – Allah has forgiven them; and Aslam – Allah has made them safe.”
items.ma-6457: Ḥammād ibn Khālid narrated to us, ʿAbd Allāh narrated to us, from Nāfiʿ, that Ibn ʿUmar used to throw the jamarāt after the Day of Sacrifice walking, and claimed that the Prophet ﷺ used to do that.
items.ma-6461: Ḥammād narrated to us, ʿAbd Allāh narrated to us, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to teach us the Qurʾān, and when he passed a prostration of the Qurʾān he prostrated and we prostrated with him.
