items.ma-6900: Naṣr ibn Bāb narrated to us, from al-Ḥajjāj, from ʿAmr ibn Shuʿayb, from his father, from his grandfather, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “There is no cutting off [of the hand] for less than ten dirhams.”
items.ma-6943: Yazīd ibn Hārūn narrated to us, al-Ḥajjāj informed us, from ʿAmr ibn Shuʿayb, from his father, from his grandfather, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “One who takes back his gift is like the dog that returns to its vomit.”
items.ma-7130: Hushaym narrated to us, from Hishām, from Ibn Sīrīn, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “The intensity of the heat is from the fayḥ of Jahannam, so cool [it] with the prayer.”
items.ma-7154: Ismāʿīl narrated to us, Ayyūb narrated to us, from ʿIkrimah, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Let a man not prevent his neighbour from placing his beam – or he said: a beam – in his wall.”
items.ma-7281: Ismāʿīl ibn ʿUmar narrated to us, Ibn Abī Dhiʾb informed us, from Ibn Shihāb, from Abū Salamah, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ encouraging the qiyām of – meaning – Ramaḍān.
items.ma-7316: Sufyān narrated to us, from Abū al-Zinād, from ʿAbd al-Raḥmān al-Aʿraj, from Abū Hurayrah, conveying it to the Prophet ﷺ: “Wealth is not from an abundance of possessions, but wealth is the wealth of the soul.”
items.ma-7345: Sufyān narrated to us, from Abū al-Zinād, from al-Aʿraj, from Abū Hurayrah, raising it: “When one of you uses stones [for cleaning], let him do so an odd number of times, for Allah is Witr, Yuḥibbu al-Witr.”
items.ma-7369:
It was read to Sufyān: from Ibn ʿAjlān, from Saʿīd, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ: “May Allah have mercy on a man who rose in the night.”
Sufyān said: It is not sprinkled in his face; you wipe it.
items.ma-7396: Sufyān narrated to us, Ayyūb ibn Mūsā informed us, from ʿAṭāʾ ibn Mīnāʾ, I heard Abū Hurayrah say: I prostrated with the Prophet ﷺ in {When the sky is split apart} and {Recite in the name of your Rabb}.
items.ma-7732: ʿAbd al-Razzāq narrated to us, Maʿmar narrated to us, from Hammām ibn Munabbih, that he heard Abū Hurayrah say: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Indeed Allah is Witr, Yuḥibbu al-Witr.”
items.ma-7791: ʿAbd al-Razzāq narrated to us, Maʿmar informed us, from Suhayl ibn Abī Ṣāliḥ, from his father, from Abū Hurayrah, that the Prophet ﷺ said: “Woe to the heels from the Fire.”
items.ma-7851: Yaḥyā ibn Zakariyyā narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, from Muḥammad ibn Juḥādah, from Abū Ḥāzim, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade the earnings of slave-women.
items.ma-8302: ʿAbd al-Ṣamad narrated to us, Hammām narrated to us, Farqad narrated to us, from Abū al-ʿAlāʾ, from Abū Hurayrah, that the Prophet ﷺ said: “Indeed the greatest liars among the people are the dyers and the goldsmiths.”
items.ma-8374: Abū al-Naḍr narrated to us, Abū Jaʿfar – meaning al-Rāzī – narrated to us, from Hishām, from Ibn Sīrīn, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The Prophet ﷺ forbade that one of us pray with his hand on his waist.
items.ma-8417: Abū ʿĀmir narrated to us, Zuhayr narrated to us, Mūsā ibn Wardān narrated to me, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “A man is upon the religion of his close friend, so let one of you look at whom he takes as a close friend.”
items.ma-8441: ʿAbd al-Ṣamad narrated to us, Ḥammād narrated to us, from Suhayl, from his father, from Abū Hurayrah, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “When one of you fights his brother, let him avoid the face.”
items.ma-8499: ʿAffān narrated to us with this chain, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “When one of you eats, let him lick his fingers, for he does not know in which of them the blessing lies.”
items.ma-9050: ʿAffān narrated to us, Wuhayb narrated to us, Suhayl narrated to us, from his father, from Abū Hurayrah: that the Prophet ﷺ ate pieces of dried curd, then performed wuḍūʾ from it, then prayed.
items.ma-9059: ʿAffān narrated to us, Abū ʿAwānah narrated to us, from Sulaymān al-Aʿmash, from Abū Ṣāliḥ, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “Indeed most of the punishment of the grave is from urine.”
items.ma-9263: ʿAffān narrated to us, he said: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid narrated to us, he said: Maʿmar narrated to us, from al-Zuhrī, from Abū Salamah, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “One with sick [animals] is not to be brought to one with healthy [animals].”
items.ma-9268: ʿAffān narrated to us, Ḥammād narrated to us, he said: ʿAmmār ibn Abī ʿAmmār informed us, from Abū Hurayrah, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “When a slave obeys his Rabb and his master, he has two rewards.”
items.ma-9384: ʿAffān narrated to us, Ḥammād ibn Salamah narrated to us, he said: Abū al-Muhazzim informed us, from Abū Hurayrah: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ commanded Fāṭimah – or Umm Salamah – to let her hem trail a cubit.
items.ma-9416: And he said: “Beware of wiṣāl.” They said: But you practise wiṣāl, O Messenger of Allah! He said: “I am not like you in this. I spend the night [while] my Rabb feeds me and gives me drink. So undertake what you have the strength for.”
items.ma-9614: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from Shuʿbah, from Suhayl ibn Abī Ṣāliḥ, from his father, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “There is no wuḍūʾ except from ḥadath or wind.”
items.ma-9653: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from Muḥammad, Abū Salamah narrated to us, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “People are mines; the best of them in the Jāhiliyyah are the best of them in Islam, when they gain deep understanding.”
items.ma-9659: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from Ibn ʿAjlān, he said: Saʿīd narrated to me, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “Let not the people of the desert overcome you over the name of your prayer.”
items.ma-9666: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from Ibn ʿAjlān, he said: Saʿīd narrated to me, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “O Allah, I hold it sinful [to infringe] the right of the two weak ones: the orphan and the woman.”
items.ma-9717: Wakīʿ narrated to us, he said: Khalīl ibn Murrah narrated to me, from Muʿāwiyah ibn Qurrah, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Whoever does not pray Witr is not of us.”
items.ma-9973: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Sufyān narrated to us, from Abū al-Zinād, from al-Aʿraj, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “The delay of a wealthy person is wrongdoing, and whoever is referred to a solvent person, let him accept the referral.”
items.ma-10188: Wakīʿ narrated to us, he said: al-Aʿmash narrated to us, from Abū Ṣāliḥ and Abū Razīn, from Abū Hurayrah, raising it, he said: “When the strap of the sandal of one of you breaks, let him not walk in the one sandal.”
items.ma-10213: Muḥammad ibn Jaʿfar narrated to us, he said: Shuʿbah narrated to us, from Sulaymān, from Dhakwān, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ, that he said: “Clapping is for women, and tasbīḥ is for men.”
items.ma-10291: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān narrated to us, he said: Dāwūd ibn Qays narrated to us, from Mūsā ibn Yasār, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “The odour of the mouth of the fasting person is better with Allah than the scent of musk.”
items.ma-10409: Jarīr narrated to us, from Manṣūr, from Abū Ḥāzim, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Whoever performs Ḥajj to the House, and does not engage in obscene speech and does not act wickedly, returns as his mother bore him.”
items.ma-10418: Abū Muʿāwiyah narrated to us, he said: ʿĀṣim narrated to us, from Ibn Sīrīn, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ was asked about prayer in a single garment, and he said: “Does every one of you find two garments?”
items.ma-10585: Yazīd narrated to us, Hishām informed us, from Muḥammad, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “When one of you is invited, let him respond; if he is fasting, let him pray, and if he is not fasting, let him eat.”
items.ma-10628: Rawḥ narrated to us, Hishām narrated to us, from Muḥammad, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “The right of hospitality is three days, and whatever he receives after that is ṣadaqah.”
items.ma-10657: Aswad ibn ʿĀmir narrated to us, Abū Bakr informed us, from ʿĀṣim, from Abū Ṣāliḥ, from Abū Hurayrah, like it, except that he added in it: “[It] is brought to the Ṣirāṭ and slaughtered.”
items.ma-10667: Rawḥ narrated to us, Mālik narrated to us, from al-ʿAlāʾ ibn ʿAbd al-Raḥmān, from his father, from Abū Hurayrah: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade that nabīdh be made in the gourd and the pitch-coated vessel.
items.ma-11036: Sufyān narrated to us, from ʿĀṣim, from Abū al-Mutawakkil, from Abū Saʿīd, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “He performs wuḍūʾ when he has intercourse and when he wants to return.” Sufyān said: Abū Saʿīd reached al-Ḥarrah.
items.ma-11135: Yūnus narrated to us, Fulayḥ narrated to us, from Sālim Abū al-Naḍr, from ʿUbayd ibn Ḥunayn and Busr ibn Saʿīd, from Abū Saʿīd al-Khudrī, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ gave a khuṭbah, and he mentioned the ḥadīth.
items.ma-11442: Wakīʿ narrated to us, from ʿAlī ibn Ṣāliḥ, from al-Aswad ibn Qays, from Nubayḥ al-ʿAnazī, from Abū Saʿīd al-Khudrī, he said: So they will sprout as the saʿdānah sprouts.
items.ma-11523: And with this chain, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Khabbāb, that Abū Saʿīd al-Khudrī mentioned to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ that janābah befalls him and he wants to sleep, so he commanded him to perform wuḍūʾ, then sleep.
items.ma-11612: ʿAffān narrated to us, Abū ʿAwānah narrated to us, Qatādah narrated to us, from Abū Naḍrah, from Abū Saʿīd al-Khudrī, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, and he mentioned the like of it.
items.ma-11994: Muḥammad ibn Fuḍayl narrated to us, from al-Mukhtār ibn Fulful, from Anas ibn Mālik, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “Al-Kawthar is a river in Paradise that my Rabb ﷿ promised me.”
items.ma-12061: Ibn Abī ʿAdī narrated to us, from Ḥumayd, from Anas: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to a man: “Accept Islam.” He said: I find myself unwilling. He said: “Accept Islam even if you are unwilling.”
items.ma-12150: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from Hishām, Qatādah narrated to us, from Anas, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ performed qunūt for a month after the rukūʿ, supplicating against clans from among the clans of the Arabs, then he abandoned it.
items.ma-12159: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from Shuʿbah, from Qatādah, from Anas: that ṣadaqah was given to Barīrah, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “It is ṣadaqah for her, and a gift for us.”
items.ma-12187: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, he said: I said to Muʿāwiyah ibn Qurrah: Did you hear Anas say: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to al-Nuʿmān ibn Muqarrin: “The sister's son of a people is one of them”? He said: Yes.
items.ma-12193: Wakīʿ narrated to us, ʿAzrah ibn Thābit al-Anṣārī narrated to us, Thumāmah ibn ʿAbd Allāh ibn Anas narrated to us, from Anas: that the Prophet ﷺ used to breathe three [times] in the vessel.
items.ma-12198: Wakīʿ narrated to us, he said: Jarīr ibn Ḥāzim narrated to us, from Qatādah, he said: I asked Anas ibn Mālik about the recitation of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. He said: He used to extend his voice with it, extending.
items.ma-12555: Ḥasan narrated to us, Ḥammād ibn Salamah narrated to us, from Ḥumayd, from Anas ibn Mālik, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Strive against the polytheists with your tongues, your selves, your wealth and your hands.”
items.ma-12598: Khalaf ibn al-Walīd narrated to us, he said: Abū Jaʿfar narrated to us, from al-Rabīʿ, from Anas ibn Mālik, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade plundering, and said: “Whoever plunders is not of us.”
items.ma-12653: ʿAbd al-Razzāq narrated to us, Maʿmar narrated to us, from Thābit, from Anas, he said: When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ raised his head from the prostration or the rakʿah, he would stay between them until we said: Has he forgotten?
items.ma-12934: Ismāʿīl narrated to us, Ayyūb narrated to us, from Abū Qilābah, from Anas ibn Mālik: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ prayed the Ẓuhr at Madīnah four [rakʿahs], and prayed the ʿAṣr at Dhū al-Ḥulayfah two rakʿahs.
items.ma-12958: Muḥammad ibn ʿAbd Allāh narrated to us, Ḥumayd narrated to us, from Anas: that Umm Sulaym gave birth to a boy by Abū Ṭalḥah, so she sent him with her son Anas to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and he rubbed his palate.
items.ma-13178: Rawḥ narrated to us, Ḥammād narrated to us, from Thābit, from Anas ibn Mālik, from the Prophet ﷺ, regarding the saying of Him ﷿: {So when his Rabb Tajallā lil-Jabal} [al-Aʿrāf: 143]. He said: He gestured with his little finger. He said: And it sank.
items.ma-13232: ʿAbd al-Malik ibn ʿAmr narrated to us, Hishām narrated to us, from Qatādah, from Anas, that the Prophet ﷺ said: “Be moderate in prostration, and let none of you prostrate spreading his forearms like the dog.”
items.ma-13260: ʿAbd Allāh ibn al-Walīd narrated to us, Sufyān narrated to us, from Ḥumayd, from Anas ibn Mālik, he said: The last prayer that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ prayed, he had a cloak on him, wrapped in it, and he was sitting.
items.ma-13277: Ḥumayd ibn ʿAbd al-Raḥmān al-Ruʾāsī narrated to us, Ḥasan narrated to us, from al-Suddī, he said: I asked Anas about turning away [after the prayer], and he said: I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ turn away to his right.
items.ma-13390: Yūnus narrated to us, Abū ʿAwānah narrated to us, from ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz ibn Ṣuhayb and Qatādah, from Anas, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Eat suḥūr, for in the suḥūr there is blessing.”
items.ma-13435: Muḥammad ibn Yazīd narrated to us, from Hishām al-Dastuwāʾī, from Qatādah, from Anas ibn Mālik, he said: I went to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ with barley bread and rancid fat.
items.ma-13536: Muʾammal narrated to us, Ḥammād narrated to us, Thābit narrated to us, from Anas, he said: I saw the Prophet ﷺ asking for rain; he spread his hands and made the backs of them face the sky.
items.ma-13618: ʿAffān narrated to us, Hammām narrated to us, Qatādah narrated to us, from Anas ibn Mālik: that the Prophet of Allah ﷺ rebuked drinking while standing. He said: I said: And eating? He said: Worse and fouler.
items.ma-13715: Khalaf ibn al-Walīd narrated to us, he said: Khālid informed us, from Ḥumayd, from Anas, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ was dark-complexioned, and I never smelled any musk or ambergris with a sweeter scent than the Messenger of Allah ﷺ.
items.ma-13774: ʿAbd Allāh ibn Bakr narrated to us, Ḥumayd narrated to us, from Anas: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ loved that the Muhājirūn and the Anṣār be next to him, so that they might preserve [it] from him.
items.ma-13853: ʿAffān narrated to us, Ḥammād narrated to us, Thābit narrated to us, from Anas: that when Ruqayyah died, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “No man who was intimate with his wife tonight may enter the grave.”
items.ma-13888: Muḥammad ibn Jaʿfar narrated to us, from Shuʿbah, from Qatādah, from Anas, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Were it not that you would not bury one another, I would have supplicated Allah to let you hear the punishment of the grave.”
items.ma-13898: Hāshim ibn al-Qāsim narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, from Qatādah, he said: I heard Anas ibn Mālik say: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Be moderate in prostration,” and he mentioned it.
items.ma-14075: Bahz narrated to us, Abān ibn Yazīd narrated to us, Qatādah narrated to us, Anas ibn Mālik narrated to us that the Prophet of Allah ﷺ used to say: “Spitting in the mosque is a sin, and its kaffārah is burying it.”
items.ma-14097: Bahz narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, from Qatādah, from Anas, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Be moderate in prostration, and let none of you spread his forearms as the dog spreads [them].”
items.ma-14117: Yaḥyā ibn Ādam and Abū al-Naḍr narrated to us, both said: Zuhayr narrated to us, from Abū al-Zubayr, from Jābir, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “There is no contagion, no bad omen and no ghoul.”
items.ma-14153: He said: And he also informed me that he heard Jābir ibn ʿAbd Allāh say: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say, while the bier of Saʿd ibn Muʿādh was before them: “The ʿArsh of al-Raḥmān shook for it.”
items.ma-14270: Isḥāq narrated to us, Hishām narrated to us, from Yaḥyā ibn Abī Kathīr, from Abū Salamah ibn ʿAbd al-Raḥmān, from Jābir ibn ʿAbd Allāh, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “The ʿumrā belongs to the one to whom it was given.”
items.ma-14348: Ḥasan narrated to us, Zuhayr narrated to us, from Abū al-Zubayr, from Jābir, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Do not slaughter except a musinnah, unless it becomes difficult for you, in which case slaughter a jadhaʿah of the sheep.”
items.ma-14370: Ibn Numayr narrated to us, Ashʿath narrated to us, from Abū al-Zubayr, from Jābir, he said: We performed Ḥajj with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and with us were women and children; so we said the talbiyah on behalf of the children, and we threw [the pebbles] on their behalf.
items.ma-14443: ʿAbd al-Razzāq narrated to us, Ibn Jurayj informed us, Abū al-Zubayr informed us that he heard Jābir ibn ʿAbd Allāh say: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade shighār.
items.ma-14479: ʿAbd al-Ṣamad narrated to us, Ḥammād narrated to us, from ʿĀṣim, from Abū Naḍrah, from Jābir, he said: Two mutʿahs existed in the time of the Prophet ﷺ; then ʿUmar forbade us from them, so we desisted.
items.ma-14545: Abū Aḥmad narrated to us, Sufyān narrated to us, from al-Aʿmash, from Abū Sufyān, from Jābir, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “People are followers of Quraysh in good and in evil.”
items.ma-14603: Ḥasan narrated to us, Ibn Lahīʿah narrated to us, Abū al-Zubayr narrated to us, he said: I asked Jābir: Did the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: “In the rikāz is the khumus”? He said: Yes.
items.ma-14626: Ḥasan narrated to us, Ibn Lahīʿah narrated to us, Abū al-Zubayr narrated to us, from Jābir, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Have many of these sandals, for one of you continues to be riding as long as he is wearing sandals.”
items.ma-14627: ʿAbd Allāh narrated to us, he said: My father said: And in another place: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say in a campaign that he undertook: “Acquire many sandals, for a man continues to be riding as long as he is wearing sandals.”
items.ma-14857: ʿAbd al-Wahhāb narrated to us, Hishām narrated to us, from Abū al-Zubayr, from Jābir, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ had himself cupped while in iḥrām, because of a pain that was in his back or in his hip; Hishām doubted.
items.ma-14999: Azhar ibn al-Qāsim narrated to us, Ṣāliḥ ibn Abī al-Akhḍar narrated to us, from al-Zuhrī, from Abū Salamah, from Jābir: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ ruled for shufʿah as long as [the property] has not been divided or its boundaries fixed.
items.ma-15044: Muḥammad ibn Bakr and Rawḥ narrated to us, both said: Ibn Jurayj informed us, Abū al-Zubayr informed me that he heard Jābir say: The Prophet ﷺ slaughtered a cow on behalf of ʿĀʾishah during his Ḥajj.
items.ma-15063: Yazīd narrated to us, al-Ḥajjāj informed us, from Abū al-Zubayr, from Jābir, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said regarding animals, two for one: “There is no harm in it hand to hand, and it is not right on credit.”
items.ma-15177: ʿAbd al-Razzāq narrated to us, Sufyān informed us, from Abū al-Zubayr, from Jābir, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade dates and raisins, and fresh dates and unripe dates; meaning that the two be made into nabīdh.
items.ma-15564: He said: Sufyān ibn ʿUyaynah narrated to us, from Abū Ḥāzim, from Sahl ibn Saʿd, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “The place of a whip in Paradise is better than the world and what is in it.”
items.ma-15584: ʿAffān narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, from Muʿāwiyah ibn Qurrah, from his father, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said regarding fasting three days of the month: “It is the fasting of a lifetime and the breaking of it.”
items.ma-15686: ʿAbd al-Aʿlā narrated to us, Maʿmar narrated to us, from al-Zuhrī, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿĀmir ibn Rabīʿah, from his father, that he saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ praying on his mount, wherever it turned with him.
items.ma-15767: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān narrated to us, from Sufyān, from Saʿd, from a son of Kaʿb ibn Mālik, from his father, he said: I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ lick his three fingers after the food.
items.ma-15927: Sufyān narrated to us, from Abū al-Naḍr, from Zurʿah ibn Muslim ibn Jarhad, that the Prophet ﷺ saw Jarhad in the mosque wearing a cloak, his thigh uncovered, and said: “The thigh is ʿawrah.”
items.ma-16380: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Sufyān narrated to us, from Abū Hāshim, from ʿĀṣim ibn Laqīṭ ibn Ṣabirah, from his father, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “When you sniff water into your nose, be thorough, unless you are fasting.”
items.ma-16500: Bahz narrated to us, he said: ʿIkrimah ibn ʿAmmār narrated to us, from Iyās ibn Salamah, from his father, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Whoever draws the sword against us is not of us.”
items.ma-16951: Ḥasan narrated to us, he said: Ḥammād ibn Salamah narrated to us, from Dāwūd ibn Abī Hind, from Zurārah ibn Awfā, from Tamīm al-Dārī, from the Prophet ﷺ, like it.
items.ma-17108: Muḥammad ibn Jaʿfar narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, from Manṣūr, he said: I heard Ribʿī ibn Ḥirāsh narrating from Abū Masʿūd al-Anṣārī, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, and he mentioned the like of it.
items.ma-17513: Muḥammad ibn Jaʿfar narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, from Anas ibn Sīrīn, from ʿAbd al-Malik ibn al-Minhāl, from his father, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ commanded us [to fast] the White Days, and it is the fasting of the month.
items.ma-17602: Muḥammad ibn ʿUbayd narrated to us, Ismāʿīl – meaning Ibn Abī Khālid – narrated to us, from Qays ibn ʿĀʾidh, he said: I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ addressing the people on a she-camel, with an Abyssinian holding its halter.
items.ma-18385: Abū Muʿāwiyah narrated to us, Misʿar narrated to us, from Simāk ibn Ḥarb, from al-Nuʿmān ibn Bashīr, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to straighten the rows as spears, or arrows, are straightened.
items.ma-18395: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Sufyān narrated to us, from Jābir, from Abū ʿĀzib, from al-Nuʿmān ibn Bashīr, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “For everything there is an error, except the sword; and for every error there is an arsh.”
items.ma-18661: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Shuʿbah and Sufyān narrated to us, from ʿAmr ibn Murrah, from ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Abī Laylā, from Ibn ʿĀzib: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ performed qunūt in the Fajr [prayer].
items.ma-18844: Wakīʿ narrated to us, al-Masʿūdī narrated to us, from ʿAbd al-Jabbār ibn Wāʾil, the people of my household narrated to me, from my father, that he saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ prostrating between his two palms.
items.ma-18938: ʿAffān narrated to us, he said: Ḥammād ibn Salamah narrated to us this ḥadīth exactly, with all these words and with this chain, and he did not say in it: They used to, when they were alarmed, take refuge in the prayer.
items.ma-18987: Sufyān ibn ʿUyaynah narrated to us, from Manṣūr, from Hilāl ibn Yasāf, from Salamah ibn Qays, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “When you perform wuḍūʾ, blow out [water from your nose], and when you use stones, do so an odd number of times.”
items.ma-19173: Muḥammad ibn ʿUbayd narrated to us, Ismāʿīl narrated to us, from Qays, from Jarīr, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ has not kept me away from him since I became Muslim, and he never saw me except that he smiled.
items.ma-19203: Abū Muʿāwiyah – and he is the blind – narrated to us, al-Aʿmash narrated to us, from Zayd ibn Wahb, from Jarīr ibn ʿAbd Allāh, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Whoever does not show mercy to people, Allah ﷿ lā Yarḥamuhu.”
items.ma-19273: Yaḥyā ibn Saʿīd narrated to us, from Yūsuf ibn Ṣuhayb, from Ḥabīb ibn Yasār, from Zayd ibn Arqam, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “Whoever does not take from his mustache is not of us.”
items.ma-19394: ʿAbd Allāh ibn al-Walīd narrated to us, Sufyān narrated to us, from Manṣūr, from Ibrāhīm, from Hammām, from ʿAdī ibn Ḥātim, he said: I said: O Messenger of Allah. And he mentioned its meaning.
items.ma-19484: Muḥammad ibn Muqātil narrated to us, Ibn al-Mubārak narrated to us, Misʿar informed us, from Ḥammād, he said: Urine, with us, is in the position of blood: as long as it is not the measure of a dirham, there is no harm in it.
items.ma-19519: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Sufyān narrated to us, from Ayyūb, from Abū Qilābah, from Zahdam al-Jarmī, from Abū Mūsā, he said: I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ eating chicken.
items.ma-19592: ʿAbd al-Razzāq narrated to us, Maʿmar narrated to us, from Ayyūb, from Abū Qilābah, from Zahdam al-Jarmī, he said: I was with Abū Mūsā, and food in which there was chicken was brought near to him. And he mentioned its meaning.
items.ma-19793: Wakīʿ narrated to us, from Sufyān, from Khālid, from Abū al-Minhāl, from Abū Barzah: that the Prophet ﷺ used to recite between the sixty and the hundred, meaning in the Ṣubḥ.
items.ma-19904: Yaḥyā ibn Saʿīd narrated to us, from Shuʿbah, Qatādah narrated to us, from Abū Murāyah, from ʿImrān ibn Ḥuṣayn, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “There is no obedience in disobedience to Allah.”
items.ma-19929: Yaḥyā ibn Ādam narrated to us, Zuhayr narrated to us, from Ḥumayd al-Ṭawīl, from al-Ḥasan, from ʿImrān ibn Ḥuṣayn, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Whoever plunders a plunder is not of us.”
items.ma-20092: Bahz narrated to us, Abān narrated to us, Qatādah narrated to us, from al-Ḥasan, from Samurah: that the Prophet ﷺ said on the day of Ḥunayn, on a rainy day: “The prayer is in the riḥāl.”
items.ma-20142: Ismāʿīl narrated to us, Saʿīd narrated to us, from Qatādah, from al-Ḥasan, from Samurah ibn Jundub, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “The two parties to a sale have the option as long as they have not separated.”
items.ma-20167: Yazīd ibn Hārūn narrated to us, Ḥammād ibn Salamah informed us, from Qatādah, from al-Ḥasan, from Samurah, raising it, he said: “Whoever owns a kinsman, he is free.”
items.ma-20348: Ḥajjāj narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to me, from Abū Bishr, he said: I heard ʿAbd Allāh ibn Shaqīq narrating from Rajāʾ ibn Abī Rajāʾ al-Bāhilī, from Miḥjan, a man of Aslam, and he mentioned something like it.
items.ma-20389: Hushaym narrated to us, ʿAbd al-Malik ibn ʿUmayr informed us, from ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Abī Bakrah, from his father, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “A judge must not judge between two while he is angry.”
items.ma-20572: ʿAbd al-Aʿlā narrated to us, Saʿīd narrated to us, from Qatādah, from al-Ḥasan, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Mughaffal, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “The woman, the donkey and the dog cut off the prayer.”
items.ma-20587: Muḥammad ibn Jaʿfar narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, he said: I heard Ḥumayd ibn Hilāl narrating from Muṭarrif, from a Bedouin: that he saw on the Messenger of Allah ﷺ two patched sandals.
items.ma-20977: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Isrāʾīl and Sharīk narrated to us, from Simāk ibn Ḥarb, from Jābir ibn Samurah: that a man killed himself, and the Prophet ﷺ did not pray over him.
items.ma-21026: Wakīʿ narrated to us, al-Aʿmash narrated to us, from al-Musayyab ibn Rāfiʿ, from Tamīm ibn Ṭarafah, from Jābir ibn Samurah, he said: The prayer of the Prophet ﷺ was moderate, and his khuṭbah was moderate.
items.ma-21040: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān narrated to us, Sharīk narrated to us, from Simāk, from Jābir ibn Samurah, he said: When we reached the Prophet ﷺ, each of us would sit where he arrived.
items.ma-21093: Yaḥyā ibn Saʿīd narrated to us, from Ḥumayd, from Anas, that Ubayy said: Nothing has pricked in my chest since I became Muslim, except that I recited a verse; and he mentioned the ḥadīth. And he did not mention ʿUbādah in it.
items.ma-21330: Sufyān narrated to us, from al-Zuhrī, from Abū al-Aḥwaṣ, from Abū Dharr, conveying it to the Prophet ﷺ: “When one of you stands for the prayer, mercy faces him, so let him not wipe away the pebbles.”
items.ma-21537: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from Fiṭr, Yaḥyā ibn Sām narrated to me, from Mūsā ibn Ṭalḥah, from Abū Dharr, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ commanded us to fast the thirteenth, the fourteenth and the fifteenth.
items.ma-21545: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Isrāʾīl narrated to us, from Jābir, from Thābit ibn Saʿd or Saʿīd, from Abū Dharr: that the Prophet ﷺ stoned a woman, and he commanded me to dig for her, so I dug for her up to my navel.
items.ma-21648: ʿAbd al-Razzāq narrated to us, Maʿmar narrated to us, from ʿAmr ibn Dīnār, from Ṭāwūs, from Ḥujr al-Madarī, from Zayd ibn Thābit, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “The ʿumrā belongs to the heir.”
items.ma-22001: Ibn Abī ʿAdī narrated to us, from Ḥabīb ibn al-Shahīd, from Ḥumayd ibn Hilāl, from Hiṣṣān ibn al-Kāhil, from ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Samurah, from Muʿādh, like it, similar to his saying.
items.ma-22170: Wakīʿ narrated to us, he said: I heard al-Aʿmash say: It was narrated to me from Abū Umāmah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “The believer is molded upon all traits except treachery and lying.”
items.ma-22210: Wakīʿ narrated to us, al-Aʿmash narrated to us, from Shimr ibn ʿAṭiyyah, from Shahr ibn Ḥawshab, from Abū Umāmah: {as an extra for you} [al-Isrāʾ: 79]. He said: The extra was only specific to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ.
items.ma-22212: Abū al-Mughīrah narrated to us, Ḥarīz narrated to us, Sulaym ibn ʿĀmir narrated to me that Abū Umāmah narrated to him: that a young lad came to the Prophet ﷺ, and he mentioned it.
items.ma-22653: Wakīʿ narrated to us, from Sufyān, from ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz ibn Rufayʿ, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Abī Qatādah, from his father, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Do not revile al-Dahr, for Allah, He is al-Dahr.”
items.ma-22777: ʿAbd Allāh narrated to us, Yaḥyā ibn ʿUthmān narrated to us, Ismāʿīl ibn ʿAyyāsh narrated to us, from Saʿīd ibn Yūsuf, from Yaḥyā ibn Abī Kathīr, from Abū Sallām, like that.
items.ma-22947: Abū Nuʿaym narrated to us, Bashīr narrated to us, ʿAbd Allāh ibn Buraydah narrated to me, from his father, he said: I heard the Prophet ﷺ say: “I and the Hour were sent together; it nearly preceded me.”
items.ma-23326: ʿAffān narrated to us, Ḥammād narrated to us, ʿĀṣim ibn Bahdalah narrated to us, from Zirr, from Ḥudhayfah, he said: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: “The Qurʾān was sent down upon seven aḥruf.”
items.ma-23404: Wakīʿ narrated to us, from Yūnus, from al-ʿAyzār ibn Ḥurayth, from Ḥudhayfah, he said: I spent the night with the Prophet ﷺ, and he stood and prayed in a garment, one end of it on him and one end of it on his family.
items.ma-23626: Sulaymān ibn Dāwūd narrated to us, Ismāʿīl informed us, ʿAmr ibn Abī ʿAmr informed me, from ʿĀṣim, from Maḥmūd ibn Labīd, that the Prophet ﷺ said, and he mentioned the like of it.
items.ma-23856: ʿAbd al-Razzāq narrated to us, Sufyān narrated to us, from Mukhawwal, from a man, from Abū Rāfiʿ, he said: The Prophet ﷺ forbade that a man pray with his head braided.
items.ma-23920: Muḥammad ibn Jaʿfar narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, from ʿĀṣim al-Aḥwal – Shuʿbah said: He wrote to me –, from Abū ʿUthmān, he said: Bilāl said to the Prophet ﷺ: Do not precede me with āmīn.
items.ma-24083: Sufyān narrated to us, al-Zuhrī informed us, from Abū Salamah, from ʿĀʾishah: that the Prophet ﷺ, when he wanted to sleep while he was junub, would perform wuḍūʾ like his wuḍūʾ for the prayer.
items.ma-24089: Sufyān narrated to us, from al-Zuhrī, from ʿUrwah, from ʿĀʾishah: I used to bathe, I and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, from one vessel, and he used to bathe from the cup; and it is the faraq.
items.ma-24327: Abū Nuʿaym narrated to us, Isrāʾīl narrated to us, from Ibrāhīm ibn Muhājir, from Mujāhid, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “The prayer of the one sitting is half of the prayer of the one standing.”
items.ma-24365: Ḥasan narrated to us, Ibn Lahīʿah narrated to us, ʿUqayl ibn Khālid narrated to us, from Ibn Shihāb, from ʿUrwah, from ʿĀʾishah: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ recited aloud in it, meaning in the eclipse.
items.ma-24802: Aswad ibn ʿĀmir narrated to us, he said: Sharīk narrated to us, from Abū Isḥāq, from al-Bahī, from ʿĀʾishah, or from Ibn ʿUmar – Sharīk doubted –: that the Prophet ﷺ prostrated on the khumrah.
items.ma-24940: Muḥammad ibn Jaʿfar narrated it to us, he said: Shuʿbah narrated to us, from al-Ḥakam, from Ibrāhīm, that Hammām ibn al-Ḥārith was staying with ʿĀʾishah. And he mentioned its meaning.
items.ma-25041: Wakīʿ narrated to us, al-ʿUmarī narrated to us, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar; and from ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn al-Qāsim, from his father, from ʿĀʾishah: that a laḥd was dug for the Prophet ﷺ.
items.ma-25049: Wakīʿ narrated to us, from Sufyān, from ʿAlī ibn al-Aqmar, from Abū Ḥudhayfah, that ʿĀʾishah mimicked a woman in the presence of the Prophet ﷺ, mentioning her shortness, and the Prophet ﷺ said: “You have backbitten her.”
items.ma-25064: Wakīʿ narrated to us, he said: Ṭalḥah ibn Yaḥyā narrated to us, from ʿUbayd Allāh ibn ʿAbd Allāh – he heard it from him –, from ʿĀʾishah: that the Prophet ﷺ prayed wearing a mirṭ, part of it on her, while she was menstruating.
items.ma-25073: Wakīʿ narrated to us, from Sufyān, from Ashʿath ibn Abī al-Shaʿthāʾ, from his father, from Masrūq, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Breastfeeding is only from hunger.”
items.ma-25134:
Hushaym narrated to us, Mughīrah informed us, from al-Shaʿbī, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ found the news slow in coming, he would quote in it a verse of Ṭarafah:
And he will bring you the news, the one whom you did not provision.
items.ma-25377: Hushaym narrated to us, from Ismāʿīl ibn Abī Khālid, from Abū Isḥāq, from al-Aswad, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to sleep while he was junub, and not touch water.
items.ma-25414: Muḥammad ibn Jaʿfar narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us. And Ḥajjāj said: Shuʿbah informed us, from Manṣūr, from Ibrāhīm, from ʿAlqamah, from ʿĀʾishah, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to engage in mubāsharah while he was fasting.
items.ma-25456: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān narrated to us, from Sufyān, from Saʿd – meaning Ibn Ibrāhīm –, from Ṭalḥah, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to kiss me while he was fasting and I was fasting.
items.ma-25501: ʿAbd al-Wahhāb al-Thaqafī narrated to us, he said: Ayyūb narrated to us, from Muḥammad, from ʿĀʾishah: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to wake in the morning junub without a wet dream, then fast.
items.ma-25657: Ḥammād narrated to us, Hishām narrated to us, from his father, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: [Revelation] would indeed come down upon the Messenger of Allah ﷺ on a cold morning, and his forehead would stream with sweat, ﵊.
items.ma-25683: Wakīʿ narrated to us, he said: Sufyān narrated to us, from Manṣūr ibn Ṣafiyyah, from his mother, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to place his head in my lap while I was menstruating, and recite the Qurʾān.
items.ma-25723: Wakīʿ narrated to us, al-Aʿmash narrated to us, from Abū al-Ḍuḥā, from Masrūq, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: It is as if I am looking at the gleam of perfume in the partings of the hair of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ while he was saying the talbiyah.
items.ma-25750: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Sufyān narrated to us, from Manṣūr, from Ibrāhīm, from al-Aswad, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to command me to put on a waist-wrapper while I was menstruating, then he would have physical contact with me.
items.ma-25836: Bahz narrated to us, he said: Ḥammād ibn Salamah narrated to us, he said: Qatādah informed us, from Muʿādhah or Ṣafiyyah, from ʿĀʾishah, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to bathe with the ṣāʿ and perform wuḍūʾ with the mudd.
items.ma-25882: ʿAbd al-Razzāq narrated to us, al-Thawrī narrated to us, from Qays ibn Muslim, from Ḥasan ibn Muḥammad, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: A wishīqah of gazelle was given as a gift to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ while he was in iḥrām, and he did not eat it.
items.ma-25953: ʿAbd al-Razzāq narrated to us, Maʿmar narrated to us, from al-Zuhrī, from Abū Salamah, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to kiss some of his wives while he was fasting.
items.ma-25955: ʿUthmān ibn ʿUmar narrated to us, he said: Yūnus informed us, from al-Zuhrī, from ʿUrwah, from ʿĀʾishah, and he mentioned its meaning – meaning: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ prayed one night in the mosque in the month of Ramaḍān.
items.ma-26036: Yazīd narrated to us, he said: Ismāʿīl ibn Abī Khālid informed us, from al-Shaʿbī, from Masrūq, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ gave us the choice, and we chose him. Was that a divorce?
items.ma-26136: ʿAbd al-Ṣamad narrated to us, Zāʾidah narrated to us, Abū Ḥaṣīn narrated to us, from Abū Ṣāliḥ, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ prayed, with a garment on him, part of it on me.
items.ma-26156: Yaḥyā ibn Ādam narrated to us, he said: Isrāʾīl narrated to us, from Abū Isḥāq, from al-Aswad, from ʿĀʾishah, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to sleep the first of the night and revive its last.
items.ma-26708: Yūnus narrated to us, he said: Layth ibn Saʿd narrated to us, he said: Bukayr narrated to me, from Abū Bakr ibn al-Munkadir, from Abū Salamah, and he mentioned the like of it with its chain.
items.ma-26811: Sufyān narrated to us, from Manbūdh, from his mother – she heard it from Maymūnah –, she said: And one of us would spread the khumrah for the Messenger of Allah ﷺ while she was menstruating, then he would pray on it.
items.ma-26854: Asbāṭ narrated to us, he said: al-Shaybānī narrated to us, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Shaddād ibn al-Hād, from Maymūnah, she said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to have physical contact with his wives above the waist-wrapper while they were menstruating.
items.ma-26905: Wakīʿ narrated to us, he said: Misʿar narrated to us, from Abū al-ʿAlāʾ al-ʿAbdī, from Yaḥyā ibn Jaʿdah, from Umm Hāniʾ, she said: I used to hear the recitation of the Prophet ﷺ at night, while I was on my booth.
items.ma-26985: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Usāmah ibn Zayd narrated to us, from Muḥammad ibn al-Munkadir, from Asmāʾ bint Abī Bakr, she said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Do not store up in a container, lest Allah store up against you.”
items.ma-26988: Rawḥ narrated to us, he said: Ibn Jurayj narrated to us, he said: Ibn Abī Mulaykah informed me that ʿAbbād ibn ʿAbd Allāh ibn al-Zubayr informed him from Asmāʾ bint Abī Bakr, similarly.
items.ma-27251: Hārūn narrated to us, he said: Ibn Wahb narrated to us, he said: ʿAmr informed me that Abū al-Naḍr narrated to him that Busr ibn Saʿīd narrated to him from Maʿmar ibn ʿAbd Allāh, and he mentioned its meaning.
items.ma-4458: Hushaym narrated to us, Yaḥyā ibn Saʿīd informed us, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Abī Salamah, from Ibn ʿUmar, he said: We set out in the morning with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ to ʿArafāt; among us was the one who recited the takbīr, and among us was the one who recited the talbiyah.
items.ma-4511: Ismāʿīl narrated to us, Ayyūb narrated to us, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, he said: Pray in your houses, and do not take them as graves. He said: I think he mentioned it from the Prophet ﷺ.
items.ma-4554: Sufyān narrated to us, from al-Zuhrī, from Sālim, from his father, that the Prophet ﷺ heard a man admonishing his brother about modesty, and he said: “Modesty is part of īmān.”
items.ma-4613: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from ʿUbayd Allāh, Nāfiʿ narrated to me, from Ibn ʿUmar, from the Prophet ﷺ: {On the Day when mankind will stand before the Rabb of the worlds} [al-Muṭaffifīn: 6], “He will stand in his sweat up to the middle of his ears.”
items.ma-4620: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from Ibn ʿAjlān, Nāfiʿ narrated to me, from Ibn ʿUmar: that he used to pray on his mount and pray witr on it, and he would mention that from the Prophet ﷺ.
items.ma-4653: Yaḥyā ibn Saʿīd narrated to us, from ʿUbayd Allāh, from Nāfiʿ, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿUmar, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Make some of your prayer in your houses, and do not take them as graves.”
items.ma-4675: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from Ibn Abī Dhiʾb, ʿUthmān ibn Surāqah narrated to me, I heard Ibn ʿUmar say: I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ not praying before it or after it while travelling.
items.ma-4754: Wakīʿ narrated to us, from Sufyān, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Dīnār, from Ibn ʿUmar, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “The fitnah comes from here, from the East.”
items.ma-4816: Rawḥ narrated to us, ʿUbayd Allāh ibn al-Akhnas narrated to us, from Nāfiʿ, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿUmar, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Good is in the forelocks of horses until the Day of Resurrection.”
items.ma-4900: ʿAbd al-Razzāq narrated to us, Maʿmar informed us, from al-Zuhrī, from Sālim, from Ibn ʿUmar: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade that the meat of the sacrificial animals be eaten after three [days].
items.ma-5049: Muḥammad ibn Jaʿfar narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, from Anas ibn Sīrīn, he heard Ibn ʿUmar [say] that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to pray at night two by two, and would pray witr with one rakʿah at the end of the night.
items.ma-5084: Ismāʿīl narrated to us, Ayyūb informed us, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, he said: The Prophet ﷺ said: “Indeed the one who misses the ʿAṣr [prayer] is as if his family and his wealth have been taken from him.”
items.ma-5213: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Ibn Abī Khālid narrated to us, from Abū Ḥanẓalah, he said: I asked Ibn ʿUmar about the prayer while travelling, and he said: Two rakʿahs, the Sunnah of the Prophet ﷺ.
items.ma-5234: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Fuḍayl ibn Ghazwān narrated to us, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “His seat in Paradise and the Fire is shown to the son of Ādam in the morning and the evening, in his grave.”
items.ma-5259: Wakīʿ narrated to us, from Sufyān, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Dīnār, from Ibn ʿUmar, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Whichever man says to his brother: O disbeliever, then one of them has indeed returned with it.”
items.ma-5403: Abū Salamah narrated to us, Ibn Bilāl narrated to us—meaning Sulaymān—from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Dīnār, from Ibn ʿUmar: that the Prophet ﷺ used to come to Qubāʾ riding and walking.
items.ma-5733: Ibrāhīm ibn Abī al-ʿAbbās narrated to us, Sharīk narrated to us, from Abū Isḥāq, from al-Bahī—Sharīk said: I think it is from ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿUmar—he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to pray on the khumrah.
items.ma-5828: Abū al-Mughīrah narrated to us, al-Awzāʿī narrated to us, Yaḥyā narrated to me, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “When one of you comes to the Jumuʿah, let him perform ghusl.”
items.ma-5842: Wakīʿ narrated to us, from Fuḍayl ibn Marzūq, from ʿAṭiyyah al-ʿAwfī, from Ibn ʿUmar, he said: One prostration of the prostrations of these people is longer than three prostrations of the prostrations of the Prophet ﷺ.
items.ma-5930: Isḥāq narrated to us, Mālik informed me, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “It is not the right of a man who has something concerning which he is to make a bequest to spend two nights except that his bequest is with him, written.”
items.ma-5968: al-Faḍl narrated to us, Sufyān narrated to us, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Dīnār, from Ibn ʿUmar, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “For every treacherous person there will be a banner on the Day of Resurrection by which he is known.”
items.ma-6057: Yūnus narrated to us, Layth narrated to us, from Nāfiʿ, that ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿUmar said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to forbid, when there were three persons, that two converse privately without the third.
items.ma-6143: ʿAbd al-Razzāq narrated to us, Maʿmar informed us, from al-Zuhrī, from Sālim, from his father, he said: The Prophet ﷺ used to relate: “While I was asleep, I saw myself being brought a cup”—and he mentioned it.
items.ma-6438: Ḥammād ibn Khālid narrated to us, from ʿAbd Allāh, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar: that the Prophet ﷺ protected al-Naqīʿ for the horses. Ḥammād said: I said to him: For his horses? He said: No, for the horses of the Muslims.
items.ma-6466: ʿUqbah Abū Masʿūd al-Mujaddar narrated to us, ʿUbayd Allāh narrated to us, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ held a race between the horses, and favoured the quruḥ at the finishing point.
items.ma-6517: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from Shuʿbah, from ʿAṭāʾ ibn al-Sāʾib, from his father, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿAmr: that the Prophet ﷺ prayed two rakʿahs at the eclipse of the sun.
items.ma-6796: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Khalīfah ibn Khayyāṭ narrated to me, from ʿAmr ibn Shuʿayb, from his father, from his grandfather, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “A Muslim is not to be killed for a disbeliever, nor one under a covenant during his covenant.”
items.ma-6924: ʿAbdah ibn Sulaymān narrated to us, from Muḥammad ibn Isḥāq, from ʿAmr ibn Shuʿayb, from his father, from his grandfather, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade plucking grey hair.
items.ma-7009: ʿAbd Allāh ibn Aḥmad narrated to us: al-Qawārīrī ʿUbayd Allāh ibn ʿUmar narrated to us, Yazīd ibn Zurayʿ narrated to us, Rajāʾ Abū Yaḥyā narrated to us, and he mentioned the like of it.
items.ma-7119: Hushaym ibn Bashīr informed us, ʿAbd Allāh ibn Abī Ṣāliḥ Dhakwān informed us, from his father, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Your oath is according to that by which your companion believes you.”
items.ma-7136: Hushaym narrated to us, from Sayyār, from Abū Ḥāzim, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Whoever performs Ḥajj and does not speak obscenely and does not act wickedly will return as on the day his mother bore him.”
items.ma-7347: Sufyān narrated to us, from Abū al-Zinād, from al-Aʿraj, from Abū Hurayrah; Sufyān said: Perhaps it is from the Prophet ﷺ: “When a dog laps in the vessel of one of you, let him wash it seven washings.”
items.ma-7394: And ʿAbd al-Razzāq said: Maʿmar and al-Thawrī informed us, from Ismāʿīl ibn Umayyah, from Abū ʿAmr ibn Ḥurayth, from his father, from Abū Hurayrah, he raises it, and he mentioned the hadith.
items.ma-7408: Yaḥyā ibn Saʿīd narrated to us, from Sufyān, he said: Salm ibn ʿAbd al-Raḥmān narrated to me, from Abū Zurʿah, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to dislike the shikāl among horses.
items.ma-7452: Ribʿī ibn Ibrāhīm narrated to us, ʿAbd al-Raḥmān narrated to us, from Abū al-Zinād, from al-Aʿraj, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “When one of you performs istijmār, let him make [it] an odd number.”
items.ma-7807: ʿAbd al-Razzāq narrated to us, Maʿmar narrated to us, from Ibn Abī Laylā, from ʿAṭāʾ, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ supplicated for blessing in the suḥūr and the tharīd.
items.ma-7962: Muḥammad narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, from Dāwūd ibn Farāhīj, he said: I heard Abū Hurayrah say: We had no food in the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ except the two black ones: dates and water.
items.ma-8118: And the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Beware of suspicion, for suspicion is the most false of speech; and do not envy one another, do not compete with one another, do not hate one another, do not turn away from one another, and be, O servants of Allah, brothers.”
items.ma-8196: And the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “When the maker brings you your food, having spared you the toil of its heat and its smoke, call him so that he eats with you; and if not, then put a morsel in his hand.”
items.ma-8210: And the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “When one of you buys a milch she-camel that is muṣarrāh, or a sheep that is muṣarrāh, he has the better of the two considerations after he milks her: either she [stays with him], or else let him return her and a ṣāʿ of dates.”
items.ma-8447: Manṣūr narrated to us, Sulaymān informed us—meaning Ibn Bilāl—from al-ʿAlāʾ, from his father, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “It is not fitting for a ṣiddīq to be one who curses much.”
items.ma-8582: Muḥammad ibn Jaʿfar narrated to us, Saʿīd—meaning Ibn Abī ʿArūbah—narrated to us, from ʿIsl, from ʿAṭāʾ, from Abū Hurayrah: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade al-sadl.
items.ma-8642: ʿAffān narrated to us, Ḥammād ibn Salamah narrated to us, Muḥammad ibn ʿAmr informed us, from Abū Salamah, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “The two sons of al-ʿĀṣ are believers.”
items.ma-8783: al-Khuzāʿī narrated to us, he said: Sulaymān informed us, from al-ʿAlāʾ, from his father, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “The bell is the flute of Shayṭān.”
items.ma-9026: ʿAffān narrated to us, Abū ʿAwānah narrated to us, ʿUmar ibn Abī Salamah narrated to us, from his father, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Trim the moustaches, and let the beards grow abundant.”
items.ma-9137: Hawdhah narrated to us, ʿAwf narrated to us, from Khilās and Muḥammad, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “Do not revile al-dahr, for Allah, He is al-Dahr.”
items.ma-9165: Sulaymān narrated to us, Ismāʿīl informed us, al-ʿAlāʾ informed me, from his father, from Abū Hurayrah, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “There is no contagion, no ṣafar, no hāmah, and no nawʾ.”
items.ma-9181: Muʿāwiyah narrated to us, he said: Zāʾidah narrated to us, from Hishām ibn Ḥassān, from Muḥammad ibn Sīrīn, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade that a man pray mukhtaṣiran.
items.ma-9402: Qutaybah narrated to us, he said: Yaʿqūb narrated to us, from Suhayl, from his father, from Abū Hurayrah: that he used to say the takbīr whenever he lowered and raised, and he related that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to do that.
items.ma-9735: Wakīʿ narrated to us, he said: Dāwūd al-Zaʿāfirī narrated to us, from his father, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ: {Perhaps your Rabb will raise you to a praised station}, he said: “The intercession.”
items.ma-9782: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Kāmil Abū al-ʿAlāʾ narrated to us, he said: I heard Abū Ṣāliḥ, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Seek refuge with Allah from the head of the seventy, and from the governance of boys.”
items.ma-9971: Wakīʿ narrated to us, from Sufyān, from Abū al-Zinād, from al-Aʿraj, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade withholding the surplus of water, so that pasture be withheld by it.”
items.ma-10012: Wakīʿ narrated to us, al-Muthannā ibn Saʿīd narrated to us, from Qatādah, from Bushayr ibn Kaʿb, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Make the road seven cubits.”
items.ma-10024: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān narrated to us, Ḥammād narrated to us, from Muḥammad, he said: I heard Abū Hurayrah say: Perfect the wuḍūʾ, for I heard Abū al-Qāsim say: “Woe to the heels from the Fire.”
items.ma-10169: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Sufyān narrated to us, from Abū al-Zinād, from al-Aʿraj, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade the sale of munābadhah and mulāmasah.
items.ma-10183: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Saʿdān al-Juhanī narrated to us, from Saʿd Abū Mujāhid al-Ṭāʾī, from Abū Mudillah, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “The supplication of the fasting person is not rejected.”
items.ma-10243: Wakīʿ narrated to us, he said: al-Aʿmash narrated to us, from Abū Ḥāzim, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “If a foreleg were given to me as a gift, I would accept [it], and if I were invited to a trotter, I would respond.”
items.ma-10364: Bahz narrated to us, he said: Ḥammād narrated to us, he said: Muḥammad ibn Wāsiʿ narrated to us, from Shutayr ibn Nahār, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Thinking well is part of excellence in worship.”
items.ma-10382: Muḥammad ibn Jaʿfar narrated to us, he said: ʿAwf narrated to us, from Muḥammad ibn Sīrīn, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, like the hadith of Khilās concerning the gift.
items.ma-10419: Abū Muʿāwiyah narrated to us, from Hishām ibn Ḥassān, from Ibn Sīrīn, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Whoever repents before the sun rises from its place of setting, Allah accepts his repentance.”
items.ma-10487: Muḥammad ibn Yazīd narrated to us, al-Ḥajjāj informed us, from ʿAṭāʾ, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “Whoever conceals knowledge that he knows will come on the Day of Resurrection bridled with a bridle of fire.”
items.ma-10507: Yazīd narrated to us, Muḥammad informed us, from Abū Salamah, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Saddles are not to be fastened except for [travelling to] al-Masjid al-Ḥarām, my mosque, and al-Masjid al-Aqṣā.”
items.ma-10750: ʿAbd al-Ṣamad narrated to us, my father narrated to us, Ayyūb narrated to us, from Muḥammad, from Abū Hurayrah: that the Prophet ﷺ forbade two [kinds of] sales: al-lams and al-nibādh.
items.ma-10845: ʿUthmān ibn ʿUmar narrated to us, Mālik informed us, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Yazīd, from Abū Salamah, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ prostrate at {When the sky is split apart}.
items.ma-10938: Hāshim narrated to us, from Ibn Abī Dhiʾb, from Abū al-Walīd, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “When you lead the people, make it light, for among them are the old, the weak, and the young.”
items.ma-10954: Isḥāq ibn ʿĪsā narrated to us, Layth narrated to us, Ibn Shihāb narrated to me, and he mentioned the like of it, except that he said: Then the woman against whom the ghurrah had been ruled died.
items.ma-11489: Muḥammad ibn ʿUbayd narrated to us, al-Aʿmash narrated to us, from Abū Sufyān, from Jābir, from Abū Saʿīd, he said: I entered upon the Messenger of Allah ﷺ while he was praying on a mat, and prostrating on it.
items.ma-11616: ʿAffān narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, from Khulayd ibn Jaʿfar, from Abū Naḍrah, from Abū Saʿīd al-Khudrī, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “For every treacherous person there is a banner on the Day of Resurrection, at his backside.”
items.ma-11804: Yūnus narrated to us, Ḥammād—meaning Ibn Salamah—narrated to us, from Bishr, from Abū Saʿīd al-Khudrī: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade fasting on the day of al-Fiṭr and the day of al-Aḍḥā.
items.ma-11941: Hushaym narrated to us, Ḥumayd informed us, from Anas ibn Mālik, he said: A slave-girl of the people of al-Madīnah would indeed take hold of the hand of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and go off with him about her need.
items.ma-12088: It was read to Sufyān: I heard ʿĀṣim say: I heard Anas say: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ did not grieve over anything as he grieved over the seventy who were struck down at Biʾr Maʿūnah.
items.ma-12136: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from Ḥumayd, from Anas, he said: We used to pray al-Maghrib with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, then one of us would go to Banū Salimah while he could still see where his arrows fell.
items.ma-12142: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from Shuʿbah, Qatādah narrated to us, from Anas, that the Prophet ﷺ said: “The son of Ādam grows old, and two things remain of him: greed and hope.”
items.ma-12190: Wakīʿ narrated to us, from Sufyān, from Manṣūr, from Ṭalḥah, from Anas: that the Prophet ﷺ found a date and said: “Were it not that you might be from the ṣadaqah, I would have eaten you.”
items.ma-12210: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Sufyān narrated to us, from Sulaymān al-Taymī, from Anas, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “On the night I was taken by night, I passed by Mūsā standing, praying in his grave.”
items.ma-12285: Ḥajjāj narrated to us, Sharīk narrated to us. And Abū Usāmah, he said: Sharīk informed me, from ʿĀṣim al-Aḥwal, from Anas, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to me: “O possessor of the two ears.”
items.ma-12328: Muḥammad ibn Jaʿfar narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, from Jābir, from Ḥumayd ibn Hilāl, from Anas ibn Mālik, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to give me a kunyah after a herb that I used to pick.
items.ma-12341: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Mahdī narrated to us, from Jarīr ibn Ḥāzim, from Qatādah, he said: I asked Anas ibn Mālik about the recitation of the Prophet ﷺ. He said: He used to draw out his voice, drawing it out.
items.ma-12538: ʿAbd al-Ṣamad and ʿAffān narrated to us, they both said: Ḥammād narrated to us, Thābit narrated to us, from Anas: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to say on the day of Uḥud: “O Allah, if You will that You not be worshipped on the earth.”
items.ma-12654: ʿAbd al-Razzāq narrated to us, Maʿmar narrated to us, from Thābit, from Anas, he said: I have not prayed, after the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, a prayer lighter than the prayer of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, in the completeness of bowing and prostration.
items.ma-12848: Wakīʿ narrated to us, from Sufyān, from ʿAbd al-Raḥmān [ibn] al-Aṣamm, he said: I heard Anas ibn Mālik say: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ, Abū Bakr, ʿUmar, and ʿUthmān did not shorten the takbīr.
items.ma-12882: Yaḥyā ibn Saʿīd narrated to us, from Ḥumayd, he said: Anas was asked about the prayer of the Prophet ﷺ at night, and he said: We never wished to see him praying except that we saw him, and not sleeping except that we saw him.
items.ma-12884: Yaḥyā ibn Saʿīd narrated to us, from Ḥumayd, from Anas: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ turned to his Companions and said: “Straighten your rows and press close together, for I see you from behind my back.”
items.ma-12923: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Mahdī narrated to us, Hishām narrated to us, from Abū ʿIṣām, from Anas: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to breathe three times in the vessel, and he would say: “It is more pleasant, more wholesome, and more healthful.”
items.ma-13253: Muḥammad ibn ʿUbayd narrated to us, Misʿar narrated to us, from ʿAmr ibn ʿĀmir al-Anṣārī, he said: I heard Anas ibn Mālik say: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to be cupped, and he would not wrong anyone of his wage.
items.ma-13254: Ḥammād ibn Khālid narrated to us, Mālik narrated to us, Ziyād ibn Saʿd narrated to us, from al-Zuhrī, from Anas, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ let his forelock hang loose for as long as Allah willed that he let it hang loose, and afterwards he parted [it].
items.ma-13328: Muḥammad ibn Jaʿfar narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, he said: I heard Qatādah narrate, from Anas ibn Mālik, he said: When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ wanted to write to the Romans, and he mentioned its meaning.
items.ma-13419: ʿAlī ibn Thābit narrated to us, Jaʿfar ibn Burqān narrated to me, from ʿImrān al-Baṣrī, from Anas ibn Mālik, he said: I served the Messenger of Allah ﷺ for ten years, and he mentioned the like of it.
items.ma-13619: ʿAffān narrated to us, Ḥammād narrated to us, Ḥumayd informed us, from Anas ibn Mālik: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was on a journey, and a vessel of water was brought to him, and he drank in Ramaḍān while the people were looking.
items.ma-13713: ʿAffān narrated to us, Abān narrated to us, Qatādah narrated to us, Anas ibn Mālik narrated to us: that he saw the Prophet ﷺ slaughter his sacrificial animal with his own hand, and say the takbīr over it.
items.ma-13816: ʿAlī ibn ʿAbd Allāh narrated to us, Muʿtamir narrated to us, he said: I heard Ḥumayd say: Anas was asked about cupping for one in iḥrām, and he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ was cupped because of a pain he had.
items.ma-13903: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, from Qatādah, from Anas. And Sufyān, from Ḥumayd, from Anas: that ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn ʿAwf married a woman for the weight of a date-stone of gold.
items.ma-13918: Muḥammad ibn Jaʿfar narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us. And Ḥajjāj, he said: Shuʿbah narrated to me, he said: I heard Qatādah narrate from Anas ibn Mālik that he said: The moon split into two parts.
items.ma-13935: Rawḥ narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, from Qatādah, from Anas, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Do not cut one another off, do not hate one another, do not envy one another, and be, O servants of Allah, brothers.”
items.ma-13943: Yaḥyā ibn Saʿīd narrated to us, from Shuʿbah, Qatādah narrated to me, from Anas: that the Prophet ﷺ forbade drinking while standing. He said: I said: And eating? He said: That is worse.
items.ma-13965: ʿAbd Allāh narrated to us, Abū ʿAbd Allāh al-Sulamī narrated to us, Abū Dāwūd narrated to us, from Shuʿbah, from Qatādah, from Anas, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ was among the lightest of people in prayer, with completeness.
items.ma-14210: Wakīʿ narrated to us, al-Aʿmash narrated to us, from Abū Sufyān, from Jābir, he said: They said: O Messenger of Allah, which jihād is best? He said: “[He] whose steed is hamstrung and whose blood is spilled.”
items.ma-14308: Sufyān narrated to us, he said: ʿAmr heard Jābir ibn ʿAbd Allāh—and once he said: ʿAmr, he heard it from Jābir—say: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “War is deception.”
items.ma-14310: Sufyān narrated to us, he said: I said to ʿAmr: Did you hear Jābir say: A man passed through the mosque with arrows, and the Prophet ﷺ said to him: “Hold them by their arrowheads”? He said: Yes.
items.ma-14454: ʿAbd al-Razzāq narrated to us, Maʿmar narrated to us, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Muḥammad ibn ʿAqīl, from Jābir ibn ʿAbd Allāh, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Indeed, part of the completion of the prayer is the straightening of the row.”
items.ma-14525: Rawḥ narrated to us, Zakariyyā narrated to us, Abū al-Zubayr narrated to us, that he heard Jābir ibn ʿAbd Allāh say: The Prophet ﷺ stood for the funeral of a Jew until it passed beyond him.
items.ma-14569: Rawḥ narrated to us, Ibn Jurayj narrated to us, Abū al-Zubayr informed me, that he heard Jābir ibn ʿAbd Allāh say: The Prophet ﷺ said: “The Dajjāl is one-eyed, and he is the most severe of liars.”
items.ma-14643: Aswad ibn ʿĀmir narrated to us, Ḥasan ibn Ṣāliḥ informed us, from Abū al-Zubayr, from Jābir, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “Whoever has an imām, then his recitation is a recitation for him.”
items.ma-14646: Ḥajjāj narrated to us, Ibn Jurayj narrated to us, Abū al-Zubayr informed me, that he heard Jābir ibn ʿAbd Allāh say: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade that any of the animals be killed ṣabran.
items.ma-14674: Ḥasan narrated to us, Ibn Lahīʿah narrated to us, Abū al-Zubayr narrated to us, he said: And Jābir informed me that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “They will give ṣadaqah and wage jihād when they accept Islam”—meaning Thaqīf.
items.ma-14751: Mūsā narrated to us, Ibn Lahīʿah narrated to us, from Abū al-Zubayr, from Jābir, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ went on expedition six times before the prayer of fear, and the prayer of fear was in the seventh year.
items.ma-14802: Ḥusayn ibn Muḥammad narrated to us, Abū Uways narrated to us, Shuraḥbīl narrated to us, from Jābir, from the Prophet ﷺ: that he forbade the price of a dog, and said: “A food of the Jāhiliyyah.”
items.ma-14878: Qutaybah narrated to us, Ibn Lahīʿah narrated to us, from Abū al-Zubayr, from Jābir, he said: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: “The bird of every person is on his neck.” Ibn Lahīʿah said: Meaning al-ṭiyarah.
items.ma-14914: ʿAffān narrated to us, Ḥammād narrated to us, Qays ibn Saʿd informed us, from ʿAṭāʾ, from Jābir ibn ʿAbd Allāh al-Anṣārī: that the Prophet ﷺ slaughtered the camel on behalf of seven, and the cow on behalf of seven.
items.ma-14945: Abū Aḥmad narrated to us, Sufyān narrated to us, from Abū al-Zubayr, from Jābir, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “People are mines; the best of them in the Jāhiliyyah are the best of them in Islam, when they have gained understanding.”
items.ma-15049: al-Faḍl ibn Dukayn and Abū Aḥmad narrated to us, they both said: Sufyān narrated to us, from al-Aʿmash, from Abū Sufyān, from Jābir, that the Prophet ﷺ said: “People are followers of Quraysh in good and in evil.”
items.ma-15216: Abū Saʿd al-Ṣaghānī narrated to us, Ibn Jurayj narrated to us, from Abū al-Zubayr, from Jābir, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Whoever buys food, let him not sell it until he has received it in full.”
items.ma-15666-4: Then he said: “The rider greets the walker, and the walker the one sitting, and the fewer the more; whoever answers the greeting, it is for him, and whoever does not answer, there is nothing for him.”
items.ma-15726: ʿAlī ibn Isḥāq narrated to us, he said: ʿAbd Allāh informed us, he said: Yūnus ibn Yazīd informed us, from al-Zuhrī, he said: al-Sāʾib ibn Yazīd informed me; and he mentioned the like of it.
items.ma-15727: Abū al-Yamān narrated to us, Shuʿayb narrated to us, from al-Zuhrī, he said: al-Sāʾib ibn Yazīd, the son of the sister of Namir, narrated to me, that the Prophet ﷺ said: “There is no contagion, no ṣafar, and no hāmah.”
items.ma-15804: Yazīd narrated to us, he said: Yaḥyā informed us, from Muḥammad ibn Yaḥyā ibn Ḥabbān, from Rāfiʿ ibn Khadīj, he said: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: “There is no cutting [of the hand] for fruit or for kathar.”
items.ma-15829: Muḥammad ibn Jaʿfar narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, from al-Ḥakam, from Mujāhid, from Rāfiʿ ibn Khadīj, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade al-ḥaql. al-Ḥakam said: And al-ḥaql is the third and the quarter.
items.ma-16102: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān narrated to us, from Sufyān, from Manṣūr, from Mujāhid, from Yūsuf, from Ibn al-Zubayr, that the Prophet ﷺ said to a man: “You are the eldest of your father's children, so perform Ḥajj on his behalf.”
items.ma-16126: Abū Kāmil narrated to us, Ḥammād—meaning Ibn Salamah—narrated to us, from Ayyūb, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn al-Zubayr: that the Prophet ﷺ appointed Qarn as the mīqāt for the people of Najd.
items.ma-17183: al-Ḥakam ibn Nāfiʿ narrated to us, Ibn ʿAyyāsh narrated to us, from Baḥīr ibn Saʿd, from Khālid ibn Maʿdān, from Kathīr ibn Murrah, from ʿUbādah ibn al-Ṣāmit, from the Prophet ﷺ, the like of that.
items.ma-17280: Sufyān ibn ʿUyaynah narrated to us, he said: I heard ʿAmr say: He heard Ibn ʿUmar say: We used to practise mukhābarah and saw nothing wrong in it, until Rāfiʿ claimed that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ had forbidden it, so we left it.
items.ma-17367: Abū Saʿīd narrated to us, Ibn Lahīʿah narrated to us, Mishraḥ narrated to us, from ʿUqbah ibn ʿĀmir, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Most of the hypocrites of my ummah are its reciters.”
items.ma-17371: Qutaybah ibn Saʿīd narrated to us, Ibn Lahīʿah narrated to us, from Abū ʿUshshānah, from ʿUqbah ibn ʿĀmir, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Indeed Allah Yaʿjabu at the young man who has no ṣabwah.”
items.ma-18392: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Sufyān narrated to us, from ʿĀṣim al-Aḥwal, from Abū Qilābah, from al-Nuʿmān ibn Bashīr: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ prayed at the eclipse of the sun something like your prayer, bowing and prostrating.
items.ma-18528: Abū Khālid al-Aḥmar narrated to us, Yaḥyā ibn Saʿīd narrated to us, from ʿAdī ibn Thābit, from al-Barāʾ ibn ʿĀzib, he said: I prayed al-Maghrib behind the Prophet ﷺ, and he recited {By the fig and the olive}.
items.ma-18677: Maʿmar narrated to us, al-Ḥajjāj narrated to us, from Abū Isḥāq, from al-Barāʾ ibn ʿĀzib, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ was asked about al-kalālah, and he said: “The verse of the summer suffices you.”
items.ma-18736: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān narrated to us, Sufyān narrated to us, from al-Suddī, one who heard ʿAmr ibn Ḥurayth narrated to me, he said: I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ praying in two patched sandals.
items.ma-18747: Yaḥyā ibn Ādam narrated to us, Abū Bakr narrated to us, from Abū Isḥāq, from Abū Juḥayfah, he said: I prayed with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ at al-Abṭaḥ the ʿAṣr, two rakʿahs.
items.ma-18753: Ḥasan ibn Mūsā narrated to us, Zuhayr narrated to us, from Abū Isḥāq, from Ibn Abī Juḥayfah, from his father, he said: I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ pray at al-Abṭaḥ the ʿAṣr prayer, two rakʿahs.
items.ma-18811: Muḥammad ibn Jaʿfar narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, from ʿAbd al-Malik ibn ʿUmayr, from Jundab, he said: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: “I am your forerunner at the Ḥawḍ.”
items.ma-19112: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Sufyān narrated to us, from Abū Yaʿfūr al-ʿAbdī, he said: I heard Ibn Abī Awfā say: We fought seven expeditions with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and we used to eat locusts in them.
items.ma-19187: Yazīd ibn Hārūn narrated to us, Dāwūd informed us, from ʿĀmir, from Jarīr ibn ʿAbd Allāh, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Let the ṣadaqah collector depart from you while he is pleased with you.”
items.ma-19281: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, from ʿAmr ibn Murrah, from Abū Ḥamzah, the mawlā of the Anṣār, from Zayd ibn Arqam, he said: The first to accept Islam with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was ʿAlī ﵁.
items.ma-19377: Yaḥyā narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, Abū Isḥāq narrated to us, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Maʿqil, he said: I heard ʿAdī ibn Ḥātim say: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Guard against the Fire, even with half a date.”
items.ma-19379: Yaḥyā ibn Zakariyyā narrated to us, ʿĀṣim al-Aḥwal informed me, from al-Shaʿbī, from ʿAdī ibn Ḥātim, that the Prophet ﷺ said: “When your shot falls into the water and [the animal] drowns, do not eat.”
items.ma-19513: Marwān ibn Muʿāwiyah al-Fazārī narrated to us, Thābit ibn ʿUmārah al-Ḥanafī informed us, from Ghunaym ibn Qays, from al-Ashʿarī, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Every eye commits zinā.”
items.ma-19625: Ibn Idrīs narrated to us, from Burayd, from his grandfather, from Abū Mūsā, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “The believer to the believer is like a building, one part of it strengthening another.”
items.ma-19792: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Ibrāhīm ibn Ṭahmān narrated to me, he said: I heard Abū al-Minhāl, from Abū Barzah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade sleeping before it and talking after it.
items.ma-19905: Yaḥyā narrated to us, Khālid ibn Rabāḥ narrated to us, he said: I heard Abū al-Sawwār, he said: I heard ʿImrān ibn Ḥuṣayn [say], from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “Modesty is entirely good.”
items.ma-20099: ʿAbd al-Wahhāb narrated to us, from Saʿīd, from Qatādah, from al-Ḥasan, from Samurah, that the Prophet of Allah ﷺ said: “Sām is the father of the Arabs, Ḥām is the father of the Abyssinians, and Yāfith is the father of the Romans.”
items.ma-20195: ʿAffān narrated to us, Hammām narrated to us, Qatādah informed us, from al-Ḥasan, from Samurah, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “The neighbour of the house is more entitled to the house than others.”
items.ma-20216: Yaḥyā narrated to us, Ḥusayn al-Muʿallim narrated to us, ʿAbd Allāh ibn Buraydah narrated to us, from Samurah ibn Jundab, he said: The Prophet ﷺ prayed over a woman who had died in her nifās, and he stood at her middle.
items.ma-20700: ʿAffān narrated to us, Hammām narrated to us, Qatādah narrated to us, from Abū al-Malīḥ, from his father: that the day of Ḥunayn was rainy. He said: So the Prophet ﷺ commanded his caller: that the prayer is in the riḥāl.
items.ma-20720: Yūnus narrated to us, Abān narrated to us, from Qatādah, from Abū al-Malīḥ, from his father, that the Prophet ﷺ commanded his caller on the day of Ḥunayn, on a rainy day, and he called: The prayer is in the riḥāl.
items.ma-20758: Surayj narrated to us, Ḥammād—meaning Ibn Zayd—narrated to us, from Ayyūb, from Abū al-ʿAlāʾ, from Abū Muslim, from al-Jārūd, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “The stray of a Muslim is a burning of the Fire.”
items.ma-20867: Bahz and ʿAffān narrated to us, they both said: Ḥammād ibn Salamah narrated to us, from Simāk, from Jābir ibn Samurah: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ stoned Māʿiz ibn Mālik and did not mention flogging.
items.ma-20891: ʿAbd Allāh narrated to us, Dāwūd ibn ʿAmr narrated to us, Abū al-Aḥwaṣ Sallām ibn Sulaym narrated to us, from Simāk, from Jābir ibn Samurah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to delay the ʿIshāʾ [prayer].
items.ma-21016: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Mahdī narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, from Simāk, from Jābir ibn Samurah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to pray al-Ẓuhr when the sun had declined.
items.ma-21029: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Sharīk narrated to us, from Simāk ibn Ḥarb, from Jābir ibn Samurah, he said: The adhān was not called for the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, nor the iqāmah, at the two ʿīds.
items.ma-21067: Abū Muʿāwiyah narrated to us, al-Aʿmash narrated to us. And Ibn Numayr: al-Aʿmash informed us, from ʿUmārah, from Abū Maʿmar, he said: I said to Khabbāb: Did the Messenger of Allah ﷺ—? And he mentioned it.
items.ma-21593: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Sufyān narrated to us, from al-Rukayn al-Fazārī, from al-Qāsim ibn Ḥassān, from Zayd ibn Thābit: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ prayed the prayer of fear, and he mentioned the like of the hadith of Ibn ʿAbbās.
items.ma-21614: Yaʿqūb narrated to us, my father narrated to us, from Ibn Isḥāq, Nāfiʿ narrated to me, from Ibn ʿUmar, from Zayd ibn Thābit, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade muḥāqalah and muzābanah.
items.ma-21665: Surayj narrated to us, Ibn Abī al-Zinād informed us, from his father, from Khārijah ibn Zayd, he said: Zayd ibn Thābit said: Allah ﷿ sent down to His Messenger ﷺ while I was by his side, and he mentioned something like it.
items.ma-21713: Yazīd narrated to us, al-Ḥajjāj ibn Arṭāh narrated to us, from Ibn Nuʿaymān, from Bilāl ibn Abī al-Dardāʾ, from his father, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ sacrificed two jadhaʿ rams, mawjiyyayn.
items.ma-21716: al-Ḥakam ibn Mūsā narrated to us, Ibn ʿAyyāsh narrated to us, from ʿĀṣim ibn Rajāʾ ibn Ḥaywah, from Dāwūd ibn Jamīl, from Kathīr ibn Qays, he said: A man came from al-Madīnah, and he mentioned its meaning.
items.ma-21855: Ibn Abī Zāʾidah narrated to us, al-Ḥajjāj informed us, from ʿAmr ibn Shuʿayb, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Haramī, from Khuzaymah ibn Thābit, from the Prophet ﷺ, the like of it.
items.ma-21981: Wakīʿ narrated to us, from Sufyān, from Simāk ibn Ḥarb, from Qabīṣah ibn Hulb al-Ṭāʾī, from his father, he said: I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ turn away sometimes to his right and sometimes to his left.
items.ma-22019: Sufyān narrated to us, from ʿAmr, from Ṭāwūs: Muʿādh was brought al-waqṣ of cattle and of honey, and he said: The Prophet ﷺ did not command me anything concerning them. Sufyān said: The awqāṣ is what is less than thirty.
items.ma-22478: Abū ʿĀmir narrated to us, ʿAlī narrated to us, from Yaḥyā, from Abū Salamah, Jaʿfar ibn ʿAmr ibn Umayyah informed me, from his father: that he saw the Prophet ﷺ wiping over the two khuffs.
items.ma-22736: al-Walīd ibn Muslim narrated to us, Saʿīd ibn ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz narrated to us, from Ḥayyān Abū al-Naḍr, that he heard it from Junādah narrating it, from ʿUbādah, with the like of it.
items.ma-22866: Abū al-Mundhir narrated to us, Mālik narrated to us, from Abū Ḥāzim, from Sahl ibn Saʿd, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “If there is ill omen, it is in the woman, the horse, and the dwelling.”
items.ma-23094: Yazīd narrated to us, Sulaymān informed us, from Anas, that one of the Companions of the Prophet ﷺ narrated to him: that the Prophet ﷺ, on the night he was taken by night, passed by Mūsā ﵇ while he was standing, praying in his grave.
items.ma-23611: Khalaf ibn al-Walīd narrated to us, Ayyūb ibn ʿUtbah narrated to us, from Yaḥyā ibn Abī Kathīr, from Abū Salamah, from Muʿayqīb, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Woe to the heels from the Fire.”
items.ma-23646: Ismāʿīl narrated to us, Ayyūb informed us, from Nāfiʿ, from a man from the Anṣār, from his father: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade that we face the two qiblahs when urinating or defecating.
items.ma-23884: Abū Muʿāwiyah narrated to us, al-Aʿmash narrated to us, from al-Ḥakam, from ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Abī Laylā, from Kaʿb ibn ʿUjrah, from Bilāl, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ wiped over the two khuffs and the head-covering.
items.ma-23901: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Jaʿfar ibn Burqān narrated to us, from Shaddād, the mawlā of ʿIyāḍ ibn ʿĀmir, from Bilāl: that he came to the Prophet ﷺ to inform him of the prayer, and found him taking the suḥūr in the masjid of his house.
items.ma-24095: Sufyān narrated to us, from al-Zuhrī, from ʿUrwah, from ʿĀʾishah, from the Prophet ﷺ: He used to pray the ʿAṣr while the sun was still up in my chamber, the shade not yet having appeared.
items.ma-24194: Ibn Jaʿfar narrated to us, he said: Shuʿbah narrated to us, from Sulaymān, I heard Abū al-Ḍuḥā, its meaning, meaning when the verses from the end of Sūrat al-Baqarah were revealed.
items.ma-24246: Yaḥyā narrated to us, Hishām narrated to us, he said: My father narrated to us, he said: I heard ʿĀʾishah say: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “When supper is set out and the prayer is established, begin with the supper.”
items.ma-24342: Wakīʿ narrated to us, he said: Isrāʾīl and my father narrated to us, from Abū Isḥāq, from al-Aswad, he said: I asked ʿĀʾishah about the prayer of the Prophet ﷺ at night, and she said: He would sleep in the first part of it and stand in the last part of it.
items.ma-24649: ʿAffān narrated to us, Hammām narrated to us, he said: Qatādah narrated to us, he said: Five women narrated to me, from ʿĀʾishah: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade the nabīdh of the jar.
items.ma-24668: Muḥammad ibn Abī ʿAdī narrated to us, from Ḥumayd, from Bakr, he said: ʿĀʾishah said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to kiss while fasting, and which of you has more control over his need than the Messenger of Allah ﷺ?
items.ma-25061: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Misʿar and Sufyān narrated to us, from Saʿd ibn Ibrāhīm, from Abū Salamah, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: I never met the Prophet ﷺ at the time of saḥar except that he was with me, asleep.
items.ma-25123: Yazīd narrated to us, he said: Hammām ibn Yaḥyā informed us, from Qatādah, from Muʿādhah, from ʿĀʾishah: that the Prophet ﷺ used to pray al-Ḍuḥā four [rakʿahs], and would add whatever Allah willed.
items.ma-25130: Muḥammad ibn Jaʿfar narrated to us, Saʿīd narrated to us, from Qatādah, from ʿAṭāʾ, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ would indeed pray while I was on his right and on his left, lying down.
items.ma-25246: Abū al-Naḍr narrated to us, Dāwūd narrated to us, Manṣūr narrated to us, from his mother, from ʿĀʾishah, that she said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to recline in my lap while I was menstruating, reciting the Qurʾān.
items.ma-25249: Abū al-Naḍr narrated to us, Isḥāq ibn Saʿīd narrated to us, from his father, from ʿĀʾishah, that the Prophet ﷺ entered upon her and said: “Were it not that Quraysh would grow insolent, I would have informed it of what it has with Allah ﷿.”
items.ma-25304: ʿAbd al-Razzāq narrated to us, Maʿmar narrated to us, from al-Zuhrī, from ʿAmrah, from ʿĀʾishah: that the Prophet ﷺ said: “The hand of the thief is cut off for a quarter of a dīnār and upward.”
items.ma-25323: ʿAbd Allāh ibn Idrīs narrated to us, he said: Hishām narrated to us, from his father, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ was shrouded in three Saḥūlī garments, in which there was no shirt and no turban.
items.ma-25479: ʿUmar ibn Saʿd narrated to us, from Sufyān, from Ibn al-Aṣbahānī, from Mujāhid ibn Wardān, from ʿUrwah, from ʿĀʾishah: So the Prophet ﷺ gave his inheritance to the people of his village.
items.ma-25488: Yazīd narrated to us, he said: Ḥammād ibn Salamah informed us, from ʿAlī ibn Zayd, from al-Qāsim ibn Muḥammad, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: I raced the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and I beat him.
items.ma-25572: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān narrated to us, from Mālik ibn Anas, from al-Zuhrī, from Abū Salamah, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ was asked about al-bitʿ, and he said: “Every drink that intoxicates is ḥarām.”
items.ma-25578: Yaḥyā narrated to us, he said: Shuʿbah narrated to us, he said: Manṣūr and Sulaymān narrated to me, from Ibrāhīm, from al-Aswad, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: We went out with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, thinking it was nothing but Ḥajj.
items.ma-25656: Ḥammād ibn Usāmah narrated to us, he said: Hishām informed us, from his father, from ʿĀʾishah, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ entered in the year of the Conquest from Kadāʾ, and entered for the ʿumrah from Kudā.
