items.ma-25690: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Hishām narrated to us. And Ibn Numayr, from Hishām, from his father, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Seek out the Night of al-Qadr in the last ten [nights] of Ramaḍān.”
items.ma-25704: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Ibn Jurayj narrated to us, from Ibn Abī Mulaykah, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Indeed the most hated of men to Allah ﷿ is the most obstinate in dispute, the quarrelsome.”
items.ma-25941: Ibn Numayr narrated to us, he said: Hishām narrated to us, from his father, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: I and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to bathe—we would bathe from janābah from one vessel, scooping from it together.
items.ma-26098: ʿUthmān ibn ʿUmar narrated to us, Yūnus narrated to us, from al-Zuhrī, from Abū Salamah, from ʿĀʾishah, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “There is no vow in disobedience to Allah, and its kaffārah is the kaffārah of an oath.”
items.ma-26162: Yaḥyā ibn Ādam narrated to us, he said: Sufyān narrated to us, from Manṣūr, from Ibrāhīm, from al-Aswad, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: I saw the gleam of perfume in the parting of the hair of the Prophet ﷺ while he was in iḥrām.
items.ma-26252: Yūnus narrated to us, Ḥammād—meaning Ibn Salamah—narrated to us, from Hishām ibn ʿUrwah, from his father, and from Abū Salamah, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: I raced the Prophet ﷺ, and I beat him.
items.ma-26380: ʿĀmir ibn Ṣāliḥ narrated to us, he said: Yūnus ibn Yazīd narrated to me, from Ibn Shihāb, from ʿUrwah, from ʿĀʾishah, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to observe iʿtikāf in the last ten of Ramaḍān.
items.ma-26394: Ḥasan narrated to us, he said: I heard Shaybān, from Layth, from Mujāhid, from al-Aswad ibn Yazīd, from ʿĀʾishah, that she said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Indeed the black dog, the solid black one, is a Shayṭān.”
items.ma-26476: Sufyān narrated to us, from ʿAmmār—meaning al-Duhnī—he heard Abū Salamah informing from Umm Salamah, from the Prophet ﷺ: “The legs of my minbar are fixed in Paradise.”
items.ma-26732: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Hārūn al-Naḥwī narrated to us, from Thābit, from Shahr ibn Ḥawshab, from Umm Salamah, from the Prophet ﷺ: that he recited: {Indeed, he did an unrighteous deed} [Hūd: 46].
items.ma-26914: Yūnus narrated to us, he said: Layth—meaning Ibn Saʿd—narrated to us, from Hishām, from his father, from Asmāʾ, the like of it. And he said: And she was a polytheist, during the covenant of Quraysh and their term, when they made a covenant with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ.
items.ma-27180: Sufyān narrated to us, from Ibrāhīm ibn Maysarah, from ʿAmr ibn al-Sharīd, from Abū Rāfiʿ, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “The neighbour is more entitled to his ṣaqab, or his saqab.”
items.ma-27343: Yaḥyā ibn Zakariyyā ibn Abī Zāʾidah narrated to us, from Mujālid, from ʿĀmir, from Fāṭimah bint Qays, that the Prophet ﷺ said to her during her ʿiddah: “Do not marry until you inform me.”
items.ma-27400: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from ʿUbayd Allāh, he said: Nāfiʿ informed me, from Sālim, from Abū al-Jarrāḥ, from Umm Ḥabībah, from the Prophet ﷺ: “The angels do not accompany a company in which there is a bell.”
items.ma-27450: Rawḥ narrated to us, Mālik informed us, from Zayd ibn Aslam, from Ibn Bujayd al-Anṣārī, from his grandmother, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Return the beggar, even with a burnt hoof.”
items.ma-27548: Muḥammad ibn Muṣʿab narrated to us, Abū Bakr narrated to us, from Khālid ibn Muḥammad, from Bilāl ibn Abī al-Dardāʾ, from his father, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “Your love for a thing blinds and deafens.”
items.ma-4369: Aswad narrated to us, Isrāʾīl narrated to us, from Manṣūr … then he mentioned it with its chain of narration and its meaning, and he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ laughed until his molar showed, in confirmation of his saying.
items.ma-4432: Muḥammad ibn Jaʿfar narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, from Mughīrah, from Ibrāhīm, he said: ʿAbd Allāh said: It is as if I am looking at the whiteness of the cheek of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ at his left salām.
items.ma-4546: Sufyān narrated to us, from al-Zuhrī, from Sālim, from his father, by way of narration, and once he said: attributing it to the Prophet ﷺ: “Do not leave the fire in your houses when you sleep.”
items.ma-4549: Sufyān narrated to us, from al-Zuhrī, from Sālim, from his father: that the Prophet ﷺ said: “Whoever keeps a dog, except a dog of hunting or of livestock, two qīrāṭs are deducted from his reward every day.”
items.ma-4578: Sufyān narrated to us, from Ayyūb, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar: that: It is a duty upon every Muslim who has something to make a bequest about not to spend two nights except that his will is written down with him.
items.ma-4666: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from ʿUbayd Allāh, Nāfiʿ informed me, from Ibn ʿUmar: that two Jews committed zinā, and they were brought to the Prophet ﷺ, and he ordered that they be stoned. He said: And I saw the man shielding her with himself.
items.ma-4739: Ibn Numayr narrated to us, ʿUbayd Allāh narrated to us, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saw, in one of his expeditions, a woman who had been killed, and he forbade the killing of women and children.
items.ma-4742: Abū Usāmah narrated to us, ʿUbayd Allāh narrated to us, from Abū Bakr ibn Sālim, from his father, from his grandfather: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Indeed, he who lies about me, a house is built for him in the Fire.”
items.ma-4756: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Qudāmah ibn Mūsā narrated to us, from a shaykh, from Ibn ʿUmar, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “There is no prayer after the rising of the dawn except two rakʿahs.”
items.ma-4762: Wakīʿ narrated to us, al-ʿUmarī narrated to us, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar. And from ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn al-Qāsim, from his father, from ʿĀʾishah: that a laḥd was made for the Prophet ﷺ.
items.ma-4769: Wakīʿ narrated to us, ʿAbd Allāh ibn Nāfiʿ narrated to us, from his father, from Ibn ʿUmar, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade the castration of horses and animals, and Ibn ʿUmar said: In them is the increase of creation.
items.ma-4878: Yazīd narrated to us, Hishām narrated to us, from Muḥammad, from Ibn ʿUmar, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “The night prayer is two by two, and the witr is one rakʿah from the end of the night.”
items.ma-4898: ʿAbd al-Razzāq narrated to us, ʿUbayd Allāh informed us, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ made the ifāḍah on the Day of Sacrifice, then returned and prayed the Ẓuhr prayer at Minā.
items.ma-4901: ʿAbd al-Razzāq narrated to us, Maʿmar narrated to us, from al-Zuhrī, from Sālim, from Ibn ʿUmar: that the Prophet ﷺ said: “Whoever frees his share in a slave, what remains is valued in his property.”
items.ma-4942: Sufyān narrated to us, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Dīnār, he heard Ibn ʿUmar say: I heard the Prophet ﷺ say on the minbar: “Whoever of you comes to the Jumuʿah, let him perform ghusl.”
items.ma-5153: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from ʿUbayd Allāh, Nāfiʿ informed me, from Ibn ʿUmar, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “A prayer in my mosque is better than a thousand prayers in any other, except al-Masjid al-Ḥarām.”
items.ma-5161: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from ʿUbayd Allāh, Nāfiʿ informed me, from Ibn ʿUmar, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “Whoever misses the ʿAṣr prayer, it is as though his family and his property have been taken from him.”
items.ma-5244: Wakīʿ narrated to us, from Sufyān, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Dīnār, from Ibn ʿUmar, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade that the muḥrim wear a garment that wars or saffron has touched.
items.ma-5347: He said: And he informed us, from Sālim, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿUmar, he said: Most often the Messenger of Allah ﷺ would swear by this oath, saying: “No, by Muqallib al-qulūb.”
items.ma-5400: Abū Salamah al-Khuzāʿī narrated to us, Mālik informed us, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ performed liʿān between a man and his wife, and attached the child to its mother, and he had disowned her child.
items.ma-5596: He said: And he said: Nāfiʿ narrated to us that ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿUmar informed him: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ prayed where the small mosque is, which is below the mosque that overlooks al-Rawḥāʾ.
items.ma-5918: Isḥāq narrated to us, I heard Mālik narrating, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Good is tied in the forelocks of horses until the Day of Resurrection.”
items.ma-6060: Yūnus narrated to us, Layth narrated to us, from Nāfiʿ, from ʿAbd Allāh, from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, that he said: “Some of you shall not sell over the sale of others, nor propose over the proposal of others.”
items.ma-6210: Mūsā ibn Dāwūd narrated to us, ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz ibn Abī Salamah narrated to us, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Dīnār, from Ibn ʿUmar, he said: The Prophet ﷺ said: “Injustice is darknesses on the Day of Resurrection.”
items.ma-6237: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Mahdī narrated to us, Zuhayr narrated to us, from Zayd ibn Aslam, from Ibn ʿUmar, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “People are only like a hundred camels, among which you would hardly find a single riding camel.”
items.ma-6446: Abū Saʿīd narrated to us, ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz narrated to us, ʿAbd Allāh ibn Dīnār narrated to us, from Ibn ʿUmar: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Injustice is darknesses on the Day of Resurrection.”
items.ma-6522: Ibn Numayr narrated to us, he said: Ḥajjāj narrated to us, from Qatādah, from Abū Qilābah, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿAmr, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “Whoever is killed defending his property is a shahīd.”
items.ma-6562: Abū Kāmil narrated to us, Ḥammād narrated to us, from Thābit, from Shuʿayb ibn ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿAmr, from his father, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ was never seen eating reclining, nor would two men tread on his heels.
items.ma-6827: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Khalīfah ibn Khayyāṭ narrated to us, from ʿAmr ibn Shuʿayb, from his father, from his grandfather, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “A believer is not to be killed for a disbeliever, nor one under a covenant during his covenant.”
items.ma-7100: [ʿAbd Allāh ibn Aḥmad said]: Yaḥyā ibn Maʿīn narrated to us, al-Muʿtamir narrated to us, from his father, from al-Ḥaḍramī, from al-Qāsim ibn Muḥammad, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿAmr, like it.
items.ma-7104: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Sufyān narrated to us, from Iyād ibn Laqīṭ al-Sadūsī, from Abū Rimthah al-Taymī, he said: I went out with my father until we came to the Prophet ﷺ, and I saw on his head a stain of henna.
items.ma-7284: Sufyān narrated to us, from al-Zuhrī, from Abū Salamah, from Abū Hurayrah, attributing it to the Prophet ﷺ: “And whoever catches one rakʿah of a prayer has caught it.”
items.ma-7293: Sufyān narrated to us, from al-ʿAlāʾ ibn ʿAbd al-Raḥmān, from his father, from Abū Hurayrah, attributing it to the Prophet ﷺ: “The false oath is a means of selling the goods, a means of wiping out the earnings.”
items.ma-7295: Sufyān narrated to us, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Dīnār, from Sulaymān ibn Yasār, from ʿIrāk, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ: “There is no ṣadaqah upon a Muslim for his horse or his slave.”
items.ma-7440: Muʿāwiyah ibn ʿAmr narrated to us, Zāʾidah narrated to us, from al-Aʿmash, from Abū Ṣāliḥ, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “until he washes it once or twice.”
items.ma-7541: ʿAbd al-Aʿlā narrated to us, from Maʿmar, from Hammām ibn Munabbih, the brother of Wahb, that he heard Abū Hurayrah say: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “The procrastination of the wealthy is injustice.”
items.ma-7566: Abū Kāmil narrated to us, Zuhayr narrated to us, Suhayl narrated to us, from his father, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “The angels do not accompany a company of travellers in which there is a dog or a bell.”
items.ma-7934: Yazīd and Abū Kāmil narrated to us; both said: Ḥammād ibn Salamah narrated to us, from ʿIsl ibn Sufyān, from ʿAṭāʾ, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ: that he forbade sadl in the prayer.
items.ma-8177: And the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “While a man was swaggering in two cloaks – and he was pleased with himself – the earth was made to swallow him, and he goes on sinking down in it until the Day of Resurrection.”
items.ma-8206: And the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “By Allah, I return to my family and find a date lying on my bed or in my house, and I pick it up to eat it, then I fear that it may be ṣadaqah, so I throw it down.”
items.ma-8279: ʿAlī ibn Ḥafṣ narrated to us, Warqāʾ informed us, from Abū al-Zinād, from al-Aʿraj, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “May Allah forgive Lūṭ; indeed he took refuge in a strong support.”
items.ma-8318: al-Aswad narrated to us, he said: Abū Bakr informed us, from Hishām, from Ibn Sīrīn, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “A woman is not to have direct bodily contact with a woman, nor a man with a man.”
items.ma-8400: Yazīd – meaning Ibn Hārūn – narrated it to us, Muḥammad ibn ʿAmr informed us, from Abū Salamah, from Ṭalḥah ibn ʿUbayd Allāh: that two men from Balī – and they are a clan of Quḍāʿah – … then he mentioned it.
items.ma-8612: Yaḥyā ibn Isḥāq narrated to us, Ibn Lahīʿah narrated to us, from al-Aʿraj, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “When one of you applies kohl, let him apply kohl an odd [number of times].”
items.ma-8782: al-Khuzāʿī narrated to us, Sulaymān narrated to us, from al-ʿAlāʾ, from his father, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “It is not fitting for a ṣiddīq to be one who curses much.”
items.ma-8907: Aswad ibn ʿĀmir narrated to us, Abū Bakr informed us, from ʿĀṣim, from Abū Ṣāliḥ, from Abū Hurayrah, like it, except that he added in it: “Then he is brought upon the Ṣirāṭ and is slaughtered.”
items.ma-8919: Qutaybah narrated to us, ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz ibn Muḥammad narrated to us, from al-ʿAlāʾ ibn ʿAbd al-Raḥmān, from his father, from Abū Hurayrah: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “There is no hijrah after three.”
items.ma-9094: Ḥusayn narrated to us, Jarīr narrated to us, from Muḥammad, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ: that he used to say: “Name yourselves with my name, and do not give yourselves kunyahs with my kunyah.”
items.ma-9560: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from Shuʿbah, he said: ʿAṭāʾ ibn Abī Maymūnah narrated to me, from Abū Rāfiʿ, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The name of Zaynab was Barrah, so the Prophet ﷺ named her Zaynab.
items.ma-9563: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from Ibn Abī Dhiʾb, he said: My maternal uncle al-Ḥārith narrated to me, from Abū Salamah, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ: “Allah has written for every soul its share of zinā.”
items.ma-9578: Yaḥyā narrated to us, he said: Khuthaym ibn ʿIrāk narrated to us, he said: My father narrated to me, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ: “There is no ṣadaqah upon a Muslim for his horse or his slave.”
items.ma-9628: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from ʿUbayd Allāh, from Abū al-Zinād, from al-Aʿraj, from Abū Hurayrah: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade the sale of the pebble and the sale of gharar.
items.ma-9640: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from Shuʿbah, he said: Muḥammad ibn Juḥādah narrated to me, from Abū Ḥāzim, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade the earnings of slave-women.
items.ma-9660: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from Ibn ʿAjlān, he said: I heard my father, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “The lightest of the people of the Fire in punishment is a man for whom two sandals are made, from which his brain boils.”
items.ma-9774: Wakīʿ narrated to us, from Sufyān, from Suhayl, from his father, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “When a man rises from his sitting place and then returns, he has more right to it.”
items.ma-9977: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Sufyān narrated to us, from Abū al-Zinād, from al-Aʿraj, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Do not call grapes al-karm, for al-karm is only the Muslim man.”
items.ma-10077: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān narrated to us, he said: Salīm ibn Ḥayyān narrated to me, from his father, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Name yourselves with my name, and do not give yourselves kunyahs with my kunyah.”
items.ma-10109: Yaḥyā and Ibn Jaʿfar narrated to us, from Hishām, from Muḥammad, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “Whoever sees me in a dream has seen me; indeed Shayṭān does not imitate me.”
items.ma-10147: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from Muḥammad, Abū Salamah narrated to me, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “The wound caused by a dumb beast is jubār, and the well is jubār, and the mine is jubār, and in the rikāz is the khumus.”
items.ma-10424: Ibn Numayr narrated to us, he said: al-Aʿmash narrated to us, from Abū Ṣāliḥ, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Do not fast on the day of Friday, unless a day precedes it or a day follows it.”
items.ma-10489: Muḥammad ibn Yazīd narrated to us, from Ḥajjāj, from ʿAṭāʾ, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ: that he forbade the price of a dog, the mahr of a prostitute, and the stud-fee of the male.
items.ma-10508: Yazīd narrated to us, Muḥammad informed us, from Abū Salamah, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Whoever loves the Anṣār, Aḥabbahu Allāh, and whoever hates the Anṣār, Abghaḍahu Allāh.”
items.ma-10591: Yazīd narrated to us, Hishām informed us, from Muḥammad, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “Tasbīḥ is for men, and clapping is for women, in the prayer.”
items.ma-10597: Muḥammad ibn Yazīd narrated to us, al-Ḥajjāj informed us, from ʿAṭāʾ, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “Whoever conceals knowledge that he knows will come on the Day of Resurrection bridled with a bridle of fire.”
items.ma-10745: I heard Ibrāhīm ibn Saʿd say: I bear witness against Sufyān that I asked him, or he was asked, about nabīdh, and he said: Eat dates and drink water; it becomes nabīdh in your stomach.
items.ma-10858: ʿAlī narrated to us, Warqāʾ informed us, from Abū al-Zinād, from al-Aʿraj, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “The Hour will not be established until the people vie with one another in the height of buildings.”
items.ma-11072: Abū Muʿāwiyah narrated to us, al-Aʿmash narrated to us, from Abū Sufyān, from Jābir, from Abū Saʿīd al-Khudrī, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ prayed in a single garment, placing its two ends on his shoulders.
items.ma-11199: Abū Khālid al-Aḥmar narrated it to us, from Ibn Abī Dhiʾb; he mentioned it with its chain of narration and its meaning, and added in it: He said: And that was before the prayer of fear was revealed: {then on foot or riding} [al-Baqarah: 239].
items.ma-11311: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Mahdī narrated to us, al-Mustamirr ibn al-Rayyān narrated to us, from Abū Naḍrah, from Abū Saʿīd, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “The best of perfumes is musk.”
items.ma-11562: Yaʿlā narrated to us, al-Aʿmash narrated to us, from Abū Sufyān, from Jābir: Abū Saʿīd al-Khudrī narrated to me, he said: I entered upon the Messenger of Allah ﷺ while he was praying in a single garment, wrapped in it.
items.ma-11692: ʿAbd al-Razzāq narrated to us, Sufyān narrated to us, from al-Aʿmash, from Dhakwān, from Abū Saʿīd al-Khudrī, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Let no man who believes in Allah and His Messenger hate the Anṣār.”
items.ma-11798: Bahz and ʿAffān narrated to us; both said: Hammām narrated to us, Qatādah narrated to us, from Abū al-Khalīl, from Abū ʿAlqamah al-Hāshimī, from Abū Saʿīd; he mentioned its meaning, except that he said: women.
items.ma-11810: ʿAlī ibn ʿĀṣim narrated to us, he said: Suhayl ibn Abī Ṣāliḥ informed me, from his father, from Abū Saʿīd al-Khudrī, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Whoever follows a funeral procession, let him not sit until it is set down.”
items.ma-12083: Sufyān narrated to us, from Ayyūb, from Abū Qilābah, from Anas, he said: I prayed with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ the Ẓuhr in al-Madīnah, four [rakʿahs], and the ʿAṣr at Dhū al-Ḥulayfah, two rakʿahs.
items.ma-12089: It was read to Sufyān: I heard ʿĀṣim, from Anas, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ made a pact between the Muhājirūn and the Anṣār in our house. Sufyān said: It is as though he was saying: he made them brothers.
items.ma-12116: Ismāʿīl ibn ʿUlayyah narrated to us, from Ḥumayd, from Anas, he said: The prayer of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was moderate [in length], and the prayer of Abū Bakr [likewise], until ʿUmar lengthened the Fajr prayer.
items.ma-12317: Muḥammad ibn Jaʿfar narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, from Thābit, he said: I heard Anas ibn Mālik say: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Patience is at the first shock.”
items.ma-12460: Wahb ibn Jarīr narrated to us, my father narrated to us, he said: I heard Ḥumayd al-Ṭawīl narrating from Anas, he said: I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ combining fresh dates with melon.
items.ma-12649: ʿAbd al-Razzāq narrated to us, Maʿmar narrated to us, from Thābit, from Anas, he said: When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ arrived in al-Madīnah, the Abyssinians played with their spears at his arrival, in joy at that.
items.ma-12724: Ḥajjāj narrated to us, from Sulaymān ibn al-Mughīrah, from Thābit al-Bunānī, from Anas: that the Prophet ﷺ came upon boys while they were playing, and gave them the salām.
items.ma-12767: Muḥammad ibn Jaʿfar narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, from Qatādah, from Anas, from the Prophet ﷺ; he mentioned its meaning, except that he said: “So I wanted to win their hearts and to mend them.”
items.ma-12839: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Sharīk narrated to us, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿĪsā, from Ibn Jabr ibn ʿAtīk, from Anas, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “Two raṭls of water suffice for wuḍūʾ.”
items.ma-12845: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, from Qatādah, from Anas, he said: I prayed behind the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and behind Abū Bakr, ʿUmar and ʿUthmān, and they did not recite aloud: In the name of Allah, al-Raḥmān, al-Raḥīm.
items.ma-12902: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Ḥammād ibn Salamah narrated to us, from Hishām, from Anas ibn Mālik, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “If the Resurrection is established upon one of you while in his hand is a sapling, let him plant it.”
items.ma-12968: Ismāʿīl narrated to us, Saʿīd narrated to us, from Qatādah, from Anas, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to sacrifice two horned rams, placing his foot on their sides, and he would slaughter them with his hand, saying the name [of Allah] and the takbīr.
items.ma-13124: Muʿādh narrated to us, Ibn ʿAwn narrated to us, from Muḥammad, he said: When Anas ibn Mālik narrated a ḥadīth from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and finished it, he would say: Or as the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said.
items.ma-13131: Ibn Abī ʿAdī narrated to us, from Ḥumayd, from Anas, he said: We used to pray the Maghrib prayer in the mosque of the Prophet ﷺ, then we would come to Banū Salimah, and one of us could see the places where his arrows fell.
items.ma-13175: Rawḥ narrated to us, he said: Shuʿbah narrated to us, I heard Abū al-Tayyāḥ, he said: I heard Anas ibn Mālik narrating from the Prophet ﷺ that he said: “Make things easy and do not make them difficult; give calm and do not make [people] flee.”
items.ma-13192: Sulaymān narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, Qatādah narrated to us, from Anas ibn Mālik: that the Prophet ﷺ said: “Allah says: I am as My servant thinks of Me, and I am with him when he calls upon Me.”
items.ma-13463: Aswad ibn ʿĀmir narrated to us, he said: Abū Bakr narrated to us, from Ḥumayd al-Ṭawīl, from Anas, he said: There were youths in al-Madīnah who were called: the Qurrāʾ; then he mentioned its meaning.
items.ma-13513: al-Hāshimī narrated to us, Ismāʿīl – meaning Ibn Jaʿfar – informed us, he said: ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Maʿmar ibn Ḥazm narrated to us, that he heard Anas ibn Mālik; then he mentioned its meaning.
items.ma-13606: ʿAffān narrated to us, Ḥammād ibn Salamah narrated to us, Ḥumayd informed us, from Anas ibn Mālik, he said: The hair of the Prophet ﷺ did not pass the lobes of his ears.
items.ma-13609: ʿAffān narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, from Abū al-Tayyāḥ, he said: I heard Anas say: The Anṣār said on the Day of the Conquest of Makkah, while he gave to Quraysh: Indeed, this is astonishing; then he mentioned its meaning.
items.ma-13631: ʿAffān narrated to us, Hammām narrated to us, Qatādah narrated to us, Anas ibn Mālik informed us: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “If you knew what I know, you would laugh little and weep much.”
items.ma-13941: Yaḥyā ibn Saʿīd narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, Qatādah narrated to us, he said: I heard Anas ibn Mālik say: The Companions of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to sleep, then pray and not perform wuḍūʾ.
items.ma-13980: Hāshim narrated to us, ʿĪsā ibn Ṭahmān narrated to us, he said: I heard Anas ibn Mālik say: I heard the Prophet ﷺ say: “Whoever lies about me deliberately, let him take his seat in the Fire.”
items.ma-14175: Muḥammad ibn Jaʿfar narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, he said: I heard Qatādah narrating from ʿAṭāʾ ibn Abī Rabāḥ, from Jābir ibn ʿAbd Allāh, from the Prophet ﷺ that he said: “The ʿumrā is permitted.”
items.ma-14219: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Sufyān narrated to us, from Abū al-Zubayr, from Jābir: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Let my ummah take its rites, and throw with the like of the pebbles of khadhf.”
items.ma-14229: Wakīʿ narrated to us, ʿAzrah ibn Thābit narrated to us, from Abū al-Zubayr, from Jābir, he said: We performed Ḥajj with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and we sacrificed the camel for seven, and the cow for seven.
items.ma-14232: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Sufyān narrated to us, from Muḥārib, from Jābir, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade that a man come to his family at night: that he accuse them of betrayal, or seek out their slips.
items.ma-14257: Muḥammad ibn Jaʿfar narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, I heard Sulaymān, I heard Abū Sufyān say: I heard Jābir; then he mentioned the ḥadīth, except that he said: So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ cauterized him.
items.ma-14265: Hushaym narrated to us, ʿAbd al-Malik informed us, from ʿAṭāʾ, from Jābir ibn ʿAbd Allāh, he said: We used to perform tamattuʿ in the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, slaughtering a cow for seven, sharing in it.
items.ma-14364: Abū Muʿāwiyah narrated to us, al-Aʿmash narrated to us, from Abū Sufyān, from Jābir, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Name yourselves with my name, and do not give yourselves kunyahs with my kunyah.”
items.ma-14423: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from Ibn Jurayj, Abū al-Zubayr informed me, he said: I heard Jābir ibn ʿAbd Allāh say: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade that any of the animals be killed ṣabran.
items.ma-14516: Rawḥ narrated to us, Zakariyyā narrated to us, Abū al-Zubayr narrated to us, from Jābir; he mentioned its like, except that he said: His women were around him, dejected. And he said: “He did not send me as one who is harsh or one who causes fitnah.”
items.ma-14543: Abū Aḥmad narrated to us, Sufyān narrated to us, from al-Aʿmash, from Abū Sufyān, from Jābir, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Every servant will be resurrected upon that on which he died.”
items.ma-14544: He said: And the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Indeed, in the night there is an hour that no Muslim servant coincides with, asking Allah for something in it, except that He gives it to him; and it is in every night.”
items.ma-14681: Ḥasan narrated to us, Ibn Lahīʿah narrated to us, Abū al-Zubayr narrated to us, Jābir informed me that he heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: “The dream of the believing man is a part of prophethood.”
items.ma-14848: Yaḥyā ibn Isḥāq narrated to us, Ibn Lahīʿah narrated to us, from Abū al-Zubayr, from Jābir, he said: One who saw the Prophet ﷺ praying in a single garment, having crossed its two ends, informed me.
items.ma-14950: Abū Aḥmad al-Zubayrī narrated to us, Sharīk narrated to us, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Muḥammad ibn ʿAqīl, from Jābir, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “Whoever wants to fast, let him take suḥūr with something.”
items.ma-14958: Muḥammad ibn Jaʿfar narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, from ʿAmr ibn Dīnār, he said: I heard Jābir narrating: that a man freed a slave of his ʿan dubur minhu, so the Prophet ﷺ called for him and sold him.
items.ma-14983: Abū Dāwūd narrated to us, Rabāḥ al-Makkī narrated to us, from Abū al-Zubayr, from Jābir ibn ʿAbd Allāh: that the Prophet ﷺ commanded them to throw at the Jamarāt with the like of khadhf pebbles.
items.ma-14989: Muḥammad ibn ʿUbayd narrated to us, al-Aʿmash narrated to us, from Abū Sufyān, from Jābir, he said: Ubayy ibn Kaʿb fell ill with an illness, so the Prophet ﷺ sent a physician to him, and he cauterized him on his akḥal.
items.ma-15077: Sufyān narrated to us, from ʿAmr, from Sulaymān ibn Yasār: that a governor in al-Madīnah, who was called Ṭāriq, ruled that the ʿumrā belongs to the heir, from the statement of Jābir ibn ʿAbd Allāh, from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ.
items.ma-15085: ʿAbdah ibn Sulaymān narrated to us, ʿAbd al-Malik narrated to us, from ʿAṭāʾ, from Jābir, he said: I witnessed the Prophet ﷺ on a day of ʿīd; he began with the prayer before the khuṭbah, without adhān or iqāmah.
items.ma-15100: Rawḥ narrated to us, Ibn Jurayj narrated to us, Abū al-Zubayr informed me, that he heard Jābir ibn ʿAbd Allāh say: The Prophet ﷺ gave a concession in the ruqyah for the venomous sting for Banū ʿAmr.
items.ma-15475: Ḥusayn ibn Muḥammad and Yaḥyā ibn Abī Bukayr narrated to us, from Sufyān ibn ʿUyaynah, from al-Zuhrī, from Ibn Abī Khuzāmah, from his father. My father said: And that is the correct one; thus said al-Zubaydī.
items.ma-16264: ʿAffān narrated to us, he said: I heard Jarīr ibn Ḥāzim narrating this ḥadīth, from Ḥumayd ibn Hilāl – and he added in it – from Saʿd ibn Hishām, and he added in it: “and dig deep.”
items.ma-16313: Ismāʿīl ibn Ibrāhīm narrated to us, from al-Jurayrī, from Abū al-ʿAlāʾ ibn al-Shikhkhīr, from his father: that he prayed with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and he spat phlegm, and rubbed it with his left sandal.
items.ma-17080: Yaḥyā ibn Zakariyyā narrated to us, Ismāʿīl ibn Abī Khālid narrated to us, he said: I heard al-Shaʿbī say: Neither the grey-haired nor the young men have heard a khuṭbah like it.
items.ma-17168: Abū al-Naḍr narrated to us, he said: ʿAbd al-Ḥamīd narrated to us, he said: Shahr ibn Ḥawshab narrated to me, from Ibn ʿAbbās, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade the kinds of women. And he mentioned the ḥadīth.
items.ma-17248: Abū ʿĀmir narrated to us, Fulayḥ narrated to us, from al-Zuhrī, he said: Jaʿfar ibn ʿAmr ibn Umayyah narrated to me, from his father: that he saw the Prophet ﷺ eat a limb, then pray and not perform wuḍūʾ.
items.ma-17460: Isḥāq ibn ʿĪsā narrated to us, Ibn Lahīʿah informed us, from ʿAmr ibn al-Ḥārith, from Abū ʿUshshānah, from ʿUqbah ibn ʿĀmir, from the Prophet ﷺ: “Whoever goes out from his house,” then he mentioned the like of it.
items.ma-17863: Wahb ibn Jarīr narrated to us, he said: Shuʿbah narrated to us, from ʿĀṣim al-Aḥwal, from Abū Ḥājib, from al-Ḥakam ibn ʿAmr: that the Prophet ﷺ forbade that a man perform wuḍūʾ with the leftover of a woman.
items.ma-17956: Wakīʿ narrated to us, he said: Sufyān narrated to us, from Ibn Jurayj, from Ibn Yaʿlā, from his father: that the Prophet ﷺ, when he arrived, performed ṭawāf of the House while muḍṭabiʿ in a Ḥaḍramī cloak of his.
items.ma-18272: Muḥammad ibn Jaʿfar narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, from Abū Isḥāq, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Maʿqil, from ʿAdī ibn Ḥātim, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Guard yourselves against the Fire, even with half of a date.”
items.ma-18376: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Misʿar narrated to us, from Simāk ibn Ḥarb, from al-Nuʿmān ibn Bashīr, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to straighten the rows as arrows are straightened, or spears.
items.ma-18453: Wakīʿ narrated to us, al-Masʿūdī narrated to us, from Ziyād ibn ʿIlāqah, from Usāmah ibn Sharīk, he said: I came to the Prophet ﷺ, and behold, his Companions were as though birds were upon their heads.
items.ma-18541: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from Shuʿbah, Ḥabīb narrated to me, from Abū al-Minhāl, he said: I heard Zayd ibn Arqam and al-Barāʾ ibn ʿĀzib say: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade the sale of gold for silver on credit.
items.ma-18571: Muʿāwiyah narrated to us, Abū Isḥāq narrated to us, from Sufyān, from Abū Isḥāq, from al-Barāʾ ibn ʿĀzib, he said: I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ on the day of the Trench, and he was carrying earth. Then he mentioned its like.
items.ma-18745: Yazīd narrated to us, Ismāʿīl – meaning Ibn Khālid – informed us, Abū Juḥayfah narrated to me: that he saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and the one who most resembled him among the people was al-Ḥasan ibn ʿAlī.
items.ma-18851: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Misʿar narrated to us, he said: I heard ʿAbd al-Jabbār ibn Wāʾil mention from his father that the Prophet ﷺ was brought a bucket of water, and he drank from it, then he spat [it] out.
items.ma-19127: Abū Muʿāwiyah narrated to us, Abū Isḥāq – meaning al-Shaybānī – narrated to us, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Abī Awfā ﵁, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade the eating of the flesh of domestic donkeys.
items.ma-19169: Ibn Numayr narrated to us, al-Aʿmash narrated to us, from Zayd ibn Wahb, he said: I heard Jarīr say: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Whoever does not show mercy to the people, Allah ﷿ Lā Yarḥamuhu.”
items.ma-19661: He said: And the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “The heart is only named from its turning over. The likeness of the heart is only as a feather hung at the base of a tree, which the wind turns over, back to belly.”
items.ma-19732: ʿAbd al-Ṣamad narrated to us, he said: Abū Dāris, the companion of al-Jawr, narrated to us, he said: Abū Burdah ibn Abī Mūsā narrated to us, from Abū Mūsā, that he saw the Prophet ﷺ praying two rakʿahs after the ʿAṣr.
items.ma-19803: He said: And I killed ʿAbd al-ʿUzzā ibn Khaṭal while he was clinging to the covering of the Kaʿbah, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said on the Day of the Conquest of Makkah: “The people are safe, except ʿAbd al-ʿUzzā ibn Khaṭal.”
items.ma-19853: ʿAbd al-Ṣamad narrated to us, Salm ibn Zarīr narrated to us, Abū Rajāʾ narrated to us, from ʿImrān ibn Ḥuṣayn, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “I looked down”; then he mentioned its like.
items.ma-19916: Yazīd narrated to us, Ḥammād ibn Salamah informed us, from Abū al-Tayyāḥ al-Ḍubaʿī, from Muṭarrif, from ʿImrān ibn Ḥuṣayn, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “The fewest of the dwellers of Paradise are women.”
items.ma-20111: Ḥasan ibn Mūsā narrated to us, Saʿīd ibn Bashīr narrated to us, Qatādah narrated to us, from al-Ḥasan, from Samurah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ commanded us to sit evenly, and not to sit hastily.
items.ma-20137: Hushaym narrated to us, Shuʿbah and another reported to us, from Qatādah, from al-Ḥasan, from Samurah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Whoever kills his slave, we will kill him; and whoever mutilates him, we will mutilate him.”
items.ma-20204: Yazīd narrated to us, Ḥammād ibn Salamah informed us, from Qatādah, from al-Ḥasan, from Samurah ibn Jundub, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “Whoever owns a kinsman, he is free.”
items.ma-20225: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Yazīd – meaning Ibn Ibrāhīm – narrated to us, from al-Ḥasan, from Samurah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ never gave us a khuṭbah except that he forbade us mutilation and commanded us to give ṣadaqah.
items.ma-20421: Muʾammal narrated to us, Ḥammād – meaning Ibn Salamah – narrated to us, ʿAlī ibn Zayd narrated to us, from al-Ḥasan, from Abū Bakrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “I am your forerunner at the Ḥawḍ.”
items.ma-20477: Yazīd ibn Hārūn narrated to us, ʿUyaynah informed us, from his father, from Abū Bakrah, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “A people who entrust their affair to a woman will not succeed.”
items.ma-20598: ʿAbd al-Ṣamad narrated to us, ʿUmar ibn Farrūkh narrated to me, Bisṭām narrated to me, from a Bedouin who had been a guest of theirs: that he prayed with the Prophet ﷺ and he gave two salāms.
items.ma-20823: ʿAffān narrated to us, Abū ʿAwānah narrated to us, from Simāk, from Jābir ibn Samurah, he said: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: “Before the Hour there are liars.”
items.ma-20916: ʿAbd Allāh narrated to us, Khalaf ibn Hishām narrated to us, Abū al-Aḥwaṣ narrated to us, from Simāk, from Jābir ibn Samurah, he said: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: “Indeed, Allah named al-Madīnah Ṭābah.”
items.ma-20960: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from Shuʿbah, Simāk narrated to me, from Jābir ibn Samurah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to give the khuṭbah on the day of Jumuʿah standing, then sit, then stand.
items.ma-21043: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān narrated to us, from Isrāʾīl, from Manṣūr, from Abū Khālid al-Wālibī, from Jābir ibn Samurah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “I was sent, I and the Hour, like these two.”
items.ma-21099: ʿAbd Allāh narrated to us, Ḥajjāj ibn Yūsuf narrated to me, Shabābah narrated to us, from Shuʿbah, from al-Aʿmash, from Abū Sufyān, from Jābir, from Ubayy ibn Kaʿb: that the Prophet ﷺ cauterized him.
items.ma-21357: Muʾammal narrated to us, Sufyān narrated to us, from Manṣūr, from Ribʿī, from a man, from Abū Dharr, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Indeed, Allah Yubghiḍu” – then he mentioned the ḥadīth.
items.ma-21586: Sufyān narrated to us, from ʿAmr, from Ṭāwūs, from Ḥujr al-Madarī, from Zayd ibn Thābit: that the Prophet ﷺ made the ʿumrā for the heir. And once he said: He ruled concerning the ʿumrā.
items.ma-21685: Yazīd narrated to us, Ibn Abī Dhiʾb informed us, from a mawlā of Juhaynah, from ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Zayd ibn Khālid, from his father: that he heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbidding plundering and snatching.
items.ma-21921: Isḥāq ibn ʿĪsā narrated to us, Ḥammād ibn Zayd narrated to us, from Saʿīd ibn Jumhān, from Safīnah: that he was carrying a great deal, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to him: “You are Safīnah.”
items.ma-22445: Ismāʿīl narrated to us, Ayyūb narrated to us, from Abū Qilābah, from the one who narrated to him, from Thawbān, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “The visitor of the sick is in the makhrafah of Paradise until he returns.”
items.ma-22613: Yūnus narrated to us, Abān narrated to us, from Yaḥyā ibn Abī Kathīr, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Abī Qatādah, from his father: that the Prophet ﷺ said: “When the prayer is established, do not stand until you see me.”
items.ma-22667: Muʿtamir ibn Sulaymān narrated to us, from Ḥumayd, from Anas, from ʿUbādah ibn al-Ṣāmit: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Seek it in the ninth and the seventh and the fifth” – meaning Laylat al-Qadr.
items.ma-22804: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Jarīr ibn Ḥāzim narrated to us, from al-Ḥasan. And Sufyān, from Abū Ḥāzim, from Sahl ibn Saʿd; both said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “The people will continue to be in good so long as they hasten the breaking of the fast.”
items.ma-22959: Ḥasan ibn Mūsā narrated to us, Shaybān narrated to us, from Yaḥyā, from Abū Qilābah, from Abū Malīḥ, from Buraydah: that the Prophet ﷺ said: “Whoever abandons the ʿAṣr prayer, his deeds have become void.”
items.ma-23256: Wakīʿ narrated to us, al-Aʿmash narrated to us, from Zayd ibn Wahb, from Ḥudhayfah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ narrated to us two ḥadīths; I have seen one of them and I am waiting for the other; then he mentioned its meaning.
items.ma-23295: Wakīʿ narrated to us, from Isrāʾīl, he said: Abū Isḥāq said, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Ghālib, from Ḥudhayfah, he said: The master of the children of Ādam on the Day of Resurrection is Muḥammad ﷺ.
items.ma-23400: Wakīʿ narrated to us, from Sufyān, from ʿĀṣim, from Zirr, he said: I said to Ḥudhayfah: At what hour did you take suḥūr with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ? He said: It was the day, except that the sun had not risen.
items.ma-23638: ʿAbd al-Razzāq narrated to us, Maʿmar narrated to us, from al-Zuhrī, Maḥmūd ibn Labīd narrated to me: that he remembered the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and remembered a squirt of water that the Prophet ﷺ spat out from a bucket that was in their house.
items.ma-23802: Yaḥyā ibn Ādam narrated to us, Ibn al-Mubārak narrated to us, from ʿUbayd Allāh ibn Abī Ziyād, he said: I heard Abū al-Ṭufayl narrating: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ performed ramal from the Stone to the Stone.
items.ma-24084: Sufyān narrated to us, from al-Zuhrī, from ʿUrwah, from ʿĀʾishah: I used to twist the garlands of the hady of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ with my hands, then he would not avoid anything of what the muḥrim avoids.
items.ma-24104: Sufyān narrated to us, from Sumayy, from Abū Bakr ibn ʿAbd al-Raḥmān, from ʿĀʾishah: that the dawn would overtake the Prophet ﷺ while he was in a state of janābah, and he would perform ghusl and fast.
items.ma-24146: Abū Muʿāwiyah narrated to us, he said: al-Aʿmash narrated to us, from Ibrāhīm, from al-Aswad, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ bought food from a Jew on deferred payment, and gave him a coat of mail of his as a pledge.
items.ma-24147: Abū Muʿāwiyah and Yaʿlā narrated to us; both said: al-Aʿmash narrated to us, from Ibrāhīm, from al-Aswad, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: I never saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ fasting in the ten.
items.ma-24224: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from Ibn Abī Dhiʾb, he said: Makhlad ibn Khufāf ibn Īmāʾ narrated to me, from ʿUrwah, from ʿĀʾishah, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “The yield is by liability.”
items.ma-24229: Ibn Numayr narrated to us, Hishām narrated to us, from his father, from ʿĀʾishah: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Fever is from the blast of Jahannam, so cool it with water.”
items.ma-24235: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from Hishām, he said: My father informed me, he said: ʿĀʾishah said to me: O son of my sister, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ never left the two prostrations after the ʿAṣr, when with me.
items.ma-24286: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from Sufyān, from ʿĀṣim ibn ʿUbayd Allāh, from al-Qāsim, from ʿĀʾishah: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ kissed ʿUthmān ibn Maẓʿūn while he was dead, until I saw the tears flowing on his face.
items.ma-24377: Surayj narrated to us, Abū Maʿshar narrated to us, from Hishām ibn ʿUrwah, from his father, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: When ten of Ramaḍān remained, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ would tighten his waist-wrapper and keep apart from his family.
items.ma-25068: Wakīʿ narrated to us, he said: Sufyān and Misʿar narrated to us, from Maʿbad ibn Khālid, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Shaddād, from ʿĀʾishah: that the Prophet ﷺ commanded her to seek ruqyah for the evil eye.
items.ma-25072: Wakīʿ narrated to us, from ʿAlī – meaning Ibn Mubārak – from Yaḥyā, from Abū Salamah, from ʿĀʾishah: that the Prophet ﷺ used to pray the two rakʿahs between the adhān and the iqāmah.
items.ma-25199: ʿAbd al-Razzāq narrated to us, Maʿmar narrated to us. And ʿAbd al-Aʿlā, from Maʿmar, from al-Zuhrī, from Abū Salamah, from ʿĀʾishah: that the Prophet ﷺ was covered in a ḥibarah cloak.
items.ma-25226: Yaḥyā said: Abū Salamah said: When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ rose at night, he would say: “O Allah, I seek refuge with You from Shayṭān, the accursed, from his goading, his blowing and his puffing.”
items.ma-25230: Hāshim narrated to us, Isrāʾīl narrated to us, from Jābir, from ʿĀmir, from Masrūq, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to kiss while fasting, but he was the one among you with the most control over his need.
items.ma-25232: Abū al-Naḍr narrated to us, al-Mubārak – meaning Ibn Faḍālah – narrated to us, my mother informed me, from Muʿādhah, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: The Prophet ﷺ prayed in my house four rakʿahs of the Ḍuḥā.
items.ma-25371: Hushaym narrated to us, Mughīrah narrated to us, from Ibrāhīm, from ʿĀʾishah, that she said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “In place of cauterization is the hot compress, and in place of ʿalāq is nasal medicine, and in place of blowing is oral medicine.”
items.ma-25525: Rawḥ narrated to us, he said: Mālik, Ṣakhr and Ḥammād narrated to us, from ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn al-Qāsim, from his father, from ʿĀʾishah, with the like of it, except that they said: for his ḥurm before he assumed iḥrām.
items.ma-25590: Yaḥyā ibn Saʿīd narrated to us, from Ḥabīb ibn Shahīd, from ʿIkrimah, from ʿĀʾishah: that the Prophet ﷺ used to kiss while fasting, and you have in the Messenger of Allah a good example.
items.ma-25666: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from Ismāʿīl, he said: ʿĀmir informed me, from Masrūq, he said: I asked ʿĀʾishah about the choice? She said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ gave us the choice; was it a divorce?
items.ma-25684: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Isrāʾīl narrated to us, from Abū Isḥāq, from Abū Maysarah, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to have direct bodily contact with me while I was menstruating; he was the one among you with the most control over his need.
items.ma-25698: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Misʿar and Sufyān narrated to us, from Saʿd ibn Ibrāhīm, from Abū Salamah, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: I never found the Prophet ﷺ at the end of the pre-dawn except that he was asleep with me.
items.ma-25702: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Hishām ibn ʿUrwah narrated to us, from his father, from ʿĀʾishah: that the Prophet ﷺ used to pray witr with five rakʿahs, not sitting except at the end of them.
items.ma-25740: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Hishām narrated to us, from his father, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: The Prophet ﷺ used to say: “Wipe away the harm, Rabb of the people; in Your Yad is the cure; there is none to remove it except You.”
items.ma-25773: ʿAbd al-Quddūs ibn Bakr narrated to us, he said: Hishām informed us, from his father, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: The bedding of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ on which he and his family used to lie was of tanned leather stuffed with fibre.
items.ma-25946: Ibn Numayr narrated to us, Hishām narrated to us, from his father, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Let the muḥrim kill the mouse, the crow, the kite, the biting dog, and the scorpion.”
items.ma-26020: Yazīd narrated to us, Ḥajjāj informed us, from Qatādah, from Ṣafiyyah bint Shaybah, from ʿĀʾishah: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Indeed, every people has a reinforcement, and the reinforcement of Quraysh is their mawālī.”
items.ma-26056: Rawḥ narrated to us, ʿAwf narrated to us, from Awfā ibn Dalham al-ʿAdawī, from Muʿādhah, from ʿĀʾishah: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to take something from our faces while he was fasting.
items.ma-26220: Yūnus narrated to us, he said: Ayyūb – meaning Ibn Thābit – narrated to us, he said: Umm Dāwūd narrated to me, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: I used to perfume the Prophet ﷺ for his Ḥajj and his ʿumrah with the finest I could find.
items.ma-26281: Muʿāwiyah ibn ʿAmr narrated to us, he said: Zāʾidah narrated to us, from Ziyād ibn ʿIlāqah, from ʿAmr ibn Maymūn, from ʿĀʾishah: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to kiss while he was fasting.
items.ma-26519: Wakīʿ narrated to us, from ʿAbd al-Ḥamīd ibn Bahrām, from Shahr ibn Ḥawshab, from Umm Salamah: that the Prophet ﷺ used to say: “O Muqallib al-qulūb, make my heart firm upon Your religion.”
items.ma-26846: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Mahdī narrated to us, from Sufyān, from al-Shaybānī, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Shaddād, from Maymūnah: that the Prophet ﷺ used to have direct bodily contact with her while she was menstruating, over the wrapper.
items.ma-26919: Abū Muʿāwiyah narrated to us, he said: Hishām ibn ʿUrwah narrated to us, from Fāṭimah bint al-Mundhir, from Asmāʾ bint Abī Bakr, she said: We slaughtered a horse in the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and we ate from it.
items.ma-26982: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Mughīrah ibn Ziyād narrated to us, from Abū ʿUmar, the mawlā of Asmāʾ, he said: Asmāʾ said: O girl, hand me the jubbah of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. He said: So she brought out a jubbah of ṭayālisah.
items.ma-27204: ʿAbd al-Aʿlā ibn Ḥammād narrated to us, he said: Wuhayb narrated to us, from Mūsā ibn ʿUqbah, from Abū Salamah, from al-Aqraʿ – and once he said: that al-Aqraʿ – then he mentioned its like.
items.ma-27566: [ʿAbd Allāh narrated to us], Muḥammad ibn Bakkār narrated to us, ʿAbd al-Ḥamīd ibn Bahrām al-Fazārī narrated to us, from Shahr ibn Ḥawshab, from Asmāʾ bint Yazīd, like it.
items.ma-4344: Abū ʿAbd al-Raḥmān said: Shaybān narrated to us, Jarīr ibn Ḥāzim narrated to us, from al-Aʿmash, from Ibrāhīm, from ʿAlqamah, from ʿAbd Allāh, from the Prophet ﷺ … like it.
items.ma-4358: Abū Muʿāwiyah narrated to us, al-Aʿmash narrated to us, from Ibrāhīm, from ʿAlqamah, from ʿAbd Allāh: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ forgot in the prayer, so he performed the two prostrations of forgetfulness after speaking.
items.ma-4463: Hushaym narrated to us, ʿUbayd Allāh informed us, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, he said: “I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ touching the Black Stone, so I do not leave touching it, in hardship or in ease.
items.ma-4566: Sufyān narrated to us, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Dīnār, he said: I heard ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿUmar say: I heard the Prophet ﷺ say: “The two parties to a sale have the option as long as they have not separated, or unless it is a sale with an option.”
items.ma-4573: Sufyān narrated to us, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Dīnār, from Ibn ʿUmar; and Hishām, from his father: that the Prophet ﷺ was asked about the ḍabb. He said: “I do not eat it, and I do not forbid it.”
items.ma-4585: Sufyān narrated to us, from ʿAṭāʾ ibn al-Sāʾib, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿUbayd ibn ʿUmayr, from Ibn ʿUmar, attributing it to the Prophet ﷺ: “Indeed, touching the two corners wipes away sins.”
items.ma-4602: ʿAbdah narrated to us, ʿUbayd Allāh narrated to us, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, Abū Bakr and ʿUmar used to begin with the prayer before the khuṭbah on the ʿĪd.
items.ma-4702: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from Sufyān, Ibn Dīnār narrated to me, I heard Ibn ʿUmar say: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Aslam – Allah has made them safe; and Ghifār – Allah has forgiven them; and ʿUṣayyah disobeyed Allah and His Messenger.”
items.ma-4755: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Abū Janāb narrated to us, from his father, from Ibn ʿUmar, he said: The Prophet ﷺ was by this pillar, which on that day was the trunk of a date-palm, meaning he was delivering the khuṭbah.
items.ma-4844: Muḥammad ibn ʿUbayd narrated to us, ʿUbayd Allāh narrated to us, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, when he performed ṭawāf around the House, the first ṭawāf, would perform ramal for three [circuits] and walk four.
items.ma-4848: Yazīd narrated to us, Sulaymān al-Taymī informed us, from Ṭāwūs, from Ibn ʿUmar, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “The night prayer is two by two, and if you fear the Ṣubḥ, then pray witr with one.”
items.ma-4969: Ḥusayn ibn ʿAlī narrated to us, from Zāʾidah, from Simāk, from Muṣʿab ibn Saʿd, from Ibn ʿUmar, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “No ṣadaqah is accepted from ghulūl, and no prayer without purification.”
items.ma-5083: Ismāʿīl narrated to us, Ayyūb informed us, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, he said: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: “When one of you comes to the Jumuʿah, let him perform ghusl.”
items.ma-5102: ʿAbd al-Wahhāb ibn ʿAṭāʾ narrated to us, from Ibn ʿAwn, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “Good is tied to the forelocks of horses until the Day of Resurrection.”
items.ma-5136: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān narrated to us, Sufyān narrated to us, from Mūsā ibn ʿUqbah, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ cut down the date-palms of Banū al-Naḍīr, and burned [them].
items.ma-5220: Wakīʿ narrated to us, from ʿAlī ibn Ṣāliḥ, from Yazīd ibn Abī Ziyād, from ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Abī Laylā, from Ibn ʿUmar, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “I am the fiʾah of the Muslims.”
items.ma-5283: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān narrated to us, from Sufyān, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Dīnār, I heard Ibn ʿUmar say: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ was asked about Laylat al-Qadr, and he said: “Seek it in the last seven.”
items.ma-5298: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān narrated to us, from Mālik, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, that he went out during the fitnah of Ibn al-Zubayr, and said: If we are prevented from the House, we will do as the Prophet ﷺ did.
items.ma-5448: ʿAffān narrated to us, Wuhayb narrated to us, ʿUbayd Allāh ibn ʿUmar narrated to us, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to pray two rakʿahs after the Jumuʿah.
items.ma-5520: ʿAbd al-Razzāq narrated to us, Sufyān informed us, from Mūsā ibn ʿUqbah, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, he said: The Prophet ﷺ cut down the date-palms of Banū al-Naḍīr and burned [them].
items.ma-5607: Abū Kāmil narrated to us, Sharīk narrated to us, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿIṣam, from Ibn ʿUmar, he said: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: “Indeed, among Thaqīf there is a great liar and a destroyer.”
items.ma-5652: Abū Nūḥ Qurād narrated to us, Mālik informed us, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, from the Prophet ﷺ: that he forbade meeting the goods [of traders] until they are brought down to the markets.
items.ma-5783: Muḥammad ibn ʿUbayd narrated to us, ʿUbayd Allāh narrated to us, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Good is in the forelocks of horses always, until the Day of Resurrection.”
items.ma-6122: ʿAbd al-Wahhāb ibn ʿAṭāʾ narrated to us, ʿAbd Allāh informed us, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, he said: The most beloved of names to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ were ʿAbd Allāh and ʿAbd al-Raḥmān.
items.ma-6303: Ibn Numayr narrated to us, Ḥanẓalah narrated to us, I heard Sālim say: I heard Ibn ʿUmar say: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: “When your women ask your permission to go to the mosques, then give them permission.”
items.ma-6394: ʿAbd al-Razzāq narrated to us, Sufyān informed us, from ʿUbayd Allāh ibn ʿUmar, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar: that the Prophet ﷺ assigned two shares to the horse, and one share to the man.
items.ma-6481: Isḥāq ibn ʿĪsā narrated to us, Ibn Lahīʿah narrated to me, from Yazīd ibn ʿAmr, from Abū ʿAbd al-Raḥmān al-Ḥubulī, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿAmr, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Whoever remains silent is saved.”
items.ma-6719: Abū al-Naḍr narrated to us, Muḥammad narrated to us, from Sulaymān, from ʿAmr ibn Shuʿayb, from his father, from his grandfather: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ ruled: whoever is killed by mistake, his blood-money is one hundred of the camels.
items.ma-6723: Isḥāq ibn ʿĪsā narrated to us, Mālik informed me, the trustworthy one informed me, from ʿAmr ibn Shuʿayb, from his father, from his grandfather, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade the sale of ʿurbān.
items.ma-6819: Wakīʿ narrated to us, al-Aʿmash narrated to us, from Abū Isḥāq, from Wahb ibn Jābir, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿAmr, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “It is enough sin for a man that he neglects those whom he is responsible for feeding.”
items.ma-7173: Muḥammad ibn Fuḍayl narrated to us, my father narrated to us, from ʿUmārah ibn al-Qaʿqāʿ, from Abū Zurʿah, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “O Allah, make the provision of the family of my house sustenance.”
items.ma-7220: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān narrated to us, Mālik narrated to us, from al-Zuhrī, from Abū Salamah: that Abū Hurayrah used to say the takbīr whenever he lowered and raised, and would say: Indeed, I am the most similar of you in prayer to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ.
items.ma-7285: Sufyān narrated to us, he said: I heard al-Zuhrī, from Abū Salamah, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ: “Glorification is for the men, and clapping is for the women.”
items.ma-7320: Sufyān narrated to us, from Abū al-Zinād, from al-Aʿraj, from Abū Hurayrah, attributing it to the Prophet ﷺ: “The food of two is sufficient for three, and the food of three is sufficient for four.”
items.ma-7323: Sufyān narrated to us, from Abū al-Zinād, from al-Aʿraj, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ: “When one of you strikes, let him avoid the face, for Allah created Adam ʿalā ṣūratihi.”
items.ma-7337: It was read to Sufyān: I heard Abū al-Zinād, from al-Aʿraj, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ; then I heard Sufyān say: “Beware of suspicion, for suspicion is the most false of speech.”
items.ma-7366: It was read to Sufyān: I heard Ibn ʿAjlān, from Bukayr ibn ʿAbd Allāh, from ʿAjlān, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ: “We have not been at peace with them since we fought them” – meaning the snakes.
items.ma-7573: Abū Kāmil narrated to us, Ḥammād narrated to us, from Abū al-Muhazzim, from Abū Hurayrah: that the Prophet ﷺ commanded Fāṭimah or Umm Salamah to let her hem trail a cubit.
items.ma-7654: ʿAbd al-Razzāq narrated to us, Maʿmar narrated to us, from Ayyūb, from Ibn Sīrīn, from Abū Hurayrah, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Name yourselves with my name, but do not use my kunyah.”
items.ma-8128: And the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Fasting is a shield, so when one of you is fasting on a day, let him not behave ignorantly, nor speak obscenely; and if a person fights him or insults him, let him say: Indeed, I am fasting, indeed, I am fasting.”
items.ma-8182: And the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “When one of you wakes from his sleep, let him not put his hand into the water for wuḍūʾ until he has washed it, for none of you knows where his hand spent the night.”
items.ma-8337: ʿAbd al-Ṣamad narrated to us, Ḥammād narrated to us, from Suhayl, from his father, from Abū Hurayrah, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “The angels do not accompany a party of travellers in which there is a bell.”
items.ma-8405: ʿAbd Allāh narrated to us, al-Haytham ibn Khārijah narrated to us, Yaḥyā ibn Yazīd ibn ʿAbd al-Malik narrated to us, from his father, from Saʿīd al-Maqburī, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ, like it.
items.ma-8532: ʿAffān narrated to us, Wuhayb narrated to us, Suhayl narrated to us, from al-Ḥārith ibn Mukhallad, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “Lā yanẓuru Allāh ilā a man who has intercourse with his wife in her rear.”
items.ma-8613: Ḥasan narrated to us, Ibn Lahīʿah narrated to us, Abū Yūnus narrated to us, from Abū Hurayrah, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “When there are three together, let two not converse privately without the third.”
items.ma-8891: Abū Saʿd narrated to us, he said: Ibn Jurayj narrated to us, from ʿAṭāʾ, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Glorification is for the men, and clapping is for the women.”
items.ma-8993: ʿAffān narrated to us, Ḥammād narrated to us, from Muḥammad ibn ʿAmr, from Abū al-Ḥakam, from Abū Hurayrah, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “There is no prize in racing except in [the contest of] the sole or the hoof.”
items.ma-9005: Bahz narrated to us, Ḥammād narrated to us, from Muḥammad, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “A dumb beast is jubār, a well is jubār, a mine is jubār, and in the rikāz is the khumus.”
items.ma-9045: ʿAffān narrated to us, Wuhayb narrated to us, Suhayl narrated to us, from his father, from Abū Hurayrah, that the Prophet ﷺ said: “No servant conceals a servant in this world except that Allah will conceal him on the Day of Resurrection.”
items.ma-9397: And he said: “Whoever buys a muṣarrāh ewe has the choice regarding it for three days: if he wishes he keeps it, and if he wishes he returns it and returns with it a ṣāʿ of dates.”
items.ma-9552: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from ʿAwf, he said: Khilās narrated to us, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “The likeness of the one who takes back his gift is the likeness of the dog: when it has eaten its fill it vomits, then returns to its vomit.”
items.ma-9645: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from Muḥammad ibn ʿAmr, he said: Abū Salamah narrated to us, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “Do not prevent the maidservants of Allah from the mosques of Allah, and let them go out unperfumed.”
items.ma-9704: ʿAmmār ibn Muḥammad narrated to us, from al-Ṣalt ibn Quwayd, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: I heard my Khalīl Abū al-Qāsim ﷺ say: “The Hour will not be established until a horned one does not butt a hornless one.”
items.ma-9719: Wakīʿ narrated to us, he said: Abū Malīḥ al-Madanī narrated to us, he heard it from Abū Ṣāliḥ, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Whoever does not supplicate Allah, Ghaḍiba Allāh ʿalayhi.”
items.ma-9756: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Yūnus ibn Abī Isḥāq narrated to us, from Mujāhid, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade the foul medicine, meaning poison.
items.ma-9814: Yazīd narrated to us, Muḥammad ibn ʿAmr informed us, from Abū Salamah, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Whoever leaves property, it is for his family, and whoever leaves behind dependents, [they come] to me.”
items.ma-10018: Muʿāwiyah ibn ʿAmr narrated to us, Zāʾidah narrated to us, from al-Aʿmash, from Abū Ṣāliḥ, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ, like it, except that he said: “what he has made known to you of it.”
items.ma-10125: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from Ismāʿīl, from his father, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “When the servant of one of you brings his food, let him seat him with him; and if he does not seat him, let him hand him some of it.”
items.ma-10170: Wakīʿ narrated to us, ʿAlī ibn Ṣāliḥ narrated to us, from Salamah ibn Kuhayl, from Abū Salamah, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “The best of you are those best of you in repaying.”
items.ma-10229: Wakīʿ narrated to us, he said: Shuʿbah narrated to us, from Muḥammad ibn Juḥādah al-Azdī, from Abū Ḥāzim al-Ashjaʿī, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade the earnings of slave-women.
items.ma-10352: Muḥammad ibn Jaʿfar narrated to us, he said: ʿAwf narrated to us, from Khilās, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, like a ḥadīth that was mentioned from al-Ḥasan, from the Prophet ﷺ; then he mentioned the meaning of the ḥadīth of Abū ʿUmar.
items.ma-10479: ʿAlī ibn ʿĀṣim narrated to us, Khālid and Hishām informed us, from Ibn Sīrīn, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Do not curse al-Dahr, for Allah is al-Dahr.”
items.ma-10541: Yazīd narrated to us, Muḥammad informed us, from Abū Salamah, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Whoever drags his garment out of arrogance, Lam yanẓur Allāh ilayhi on the Day of Resurrection.”
items.ma-10603: Yazīd narrated to us, Hishām ibn Ḥassān informed us, from Muḥammad ibn Sīrīn, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Let none of you say: ‘My servant, my maidservant,’ but let him say: ‘My young man and my young woman.’”
items.ma-10834: Muḥammad ibn ʿUbayd narrated to us, Muḥammad ibn ʿAmr narrated to us, from Abū Salamah, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Disputation about the Qurʾān is kufr.”
items.ma-10838: Muḥammad ibn ʿUbayd narrated to us, al-Aʿmash narrated to us, from Abū Ṣāliḥ, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “When the strap of the sandal of one of you breaks, let him not walk in the [other] sandal until he repairs it.”
items.ma-11020-2: ʿAbd Allāh said: ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿAwn al-Kharrāz and Muṣʿab al-Zubayrī narrated it to us, both said: Mālik ibn Anas narrated to us, from al-Zuhrī, and he mentioned the like of it exactly.
items.ma-11068: Abū Muʿāwiyah narrated to us, al-Aʿmash narrated to us, from Abū Ṣāliḥ, from Abū Saʿīd, from the Prophet ﷺ, concerning His saying ﷿: {And thus We have made you a middle ummah} [al-Baqarah: 143], he said: “Just.”
items.ma-11088: Mūsā ibn Dāwūd narrated to us, Ibn Lahīʿah narrated to us, from Abū al-Zubayr, he said: I asked Jābir about the man who drinks while standing. Jābir said: We used to dislike that.
items.ma-11343: Abū ʿUbaydah narrated to us, Yūnus ibn Abī Isḥāq narrated to us, from Abū al-Waddāk Jabr ibn Nawf, from Abū Saʿīd al-Khudrī, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “The slaughter of the fetus is the slaughter of its mother.”
items.ma-11444: Wakīʿ narrated to us, from ʿIkrimah ibn ʿAmmār, from ʿĀṣim ibn Shumaykh, from Abū Saʿīd, he said: When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ exerted himself in an oath, he would say: “No, by the One in whose Yad is the soul of Abū al-Qāsim.”
items.ma-11674: Ḥasan narrated to us, Ibn Lahīʿah narrated to us, Darrāj narrated to us, from Abū al-Haytham, from Abū Saʿīd, from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, that he said: “Increase the remembrance of Allah until they say: ‘Mad.’”
items.ma-11848: Ḥasan ibn Mūsā narrated to us, Shaybān narrated to us, from Yaḥyā, that Abū Ibrāhīm al-Anṣārī, of Banū ʿAbd al-Ashhal, said: Indeed Abū Saʿīd said: and he mentioned the ḥadīth.
items.ma-11965: Muʿtamir narrated to us, from Ḥumayd, from Anas, he said: There were not twenty white hairs in the head of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and his beard. And Abū Bakr dyed with ḥinnāʾ and katam, and ʿUmar dyed with ḥinnāʾ.
items.ma-11983: Ismāʿīl narrated to us, ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz narrated to us, from Anas, he said: When the Prophet of Allah ﷺ entered the toilet, he would say: “I seek refuge in Allah from the male and female foul things.”
items.ma-12158: ʿAbd Allāh narrated to us, Yaḥyā ibn Ayyūb narrated to us, Ḥammād ibn Zayd narrated to us in Makkah, ʿUbayd Allāh ibn Abī Bakr ibn Anas Abū Muʿādh narrated to us, from Anas, from the Prophet ﷺ, like it.
items.ma-12284: Ḥajjāj ibn Muḥammad narrated to us, from Jarīr ibn Ḥāzim, from Thābit al-Bunānī, from Anas ibn Mālik, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ would be spoken to about a need after he came down from the minbar.
items.ma-12422: Abū al-Naḍr narrated to us, Abū Jaʿfar narrated to us, from al-Rabīʿ ibn Anas and Ḥumayd, from Anas, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade plunder, and: “Whoever plunders is not of us.”
items.ma-12449: Wahb ibn Jarīr narrated to us, he said: My father narrated to us, he said: I heard Ḥumayd al-Ṭawīl narrating, from Anas, he said: I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ combining fresh dates and watermelon.
items.ma-12684: ʿAbd al-Razzāq narrated to us, Maʿmar informed us; and ʿAbd al-Aʿlā, from Maʿmar, from al-Zuhrī, from Anas ibn Mālik, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade the gourd and the pitch-coated vessel.
items.ma-12804: Ḥajjāj narrated to us, he said: Shuʿbah narrated to me, he said: I heard Qatādah, he said: I heard Anas, he said: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say – and I do not know whether it was something sent down to him –; then he mentioned it.
items.ma-12826: Wakīʿ narrated to us, from Sufyān, from Mukhtār ibn Fulful, he said: I heard Anas say: A man said to the Prophet ﷺ: O best of creation. He said: “That is Ibrāhīm.”
items.ma-12840: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, from Qatādah, from Anas, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Be moderate in prostration, and let none of you stretch out his forearms as a beast of prey stretches out.”
items.ma-12896: Wakīʿ narrated to us, from Ḥubayyib al-Qaysī, from Thābit, from Anas, he said: The Prophet ﷺ passed by us while we were playing, and said: “Peace be upon you, O boys.”
items.ma-12997: ʿAffān narrated to us, Abū ʿAwānah narrated to us, from Qatādah, from Anas ibn Mālik, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “If the son of Ādam had two valleys,” and he mentioned the like of it.
items.ma-13197: ʿAbd al-Ṣamad narrated to us, Hammām narrated to us, Qatādah narrated to us, from Anas, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “If you knew what I know, you would laugh little and weep much.”
items.ma-13212: ʿAbd al-Ṣamad narrated to us, Ḥammād narrated to us, from Ḥumayd, from Anas, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “The people of Yemen have come to you, and they are softer in heart than you.” And they were the first to bring the handshake.
items.ma-13238: ʿAffān narrated to us, Ḥammād narrated to us, from Ḥumayd, that Anas was asked about the hair of the Prophet ﷺ, and he said: “I have not seen hair more like the hair of the Prophet ﷺ than the hair of Qatādah.” So Qatādah was happy on that day.
items.ma-13267: Abū Saʿīd narrated to us, al-Muthannā narrated to us, he said: I heard Anas say: Rarely does a night come upon me but that I see in it my Khalīl ﷺ. And Anas would say that while his eyes shed tears.
items.ma-13325: Hāshim narrated to us, Sulaymān narrated to us, from Thābit, from Anas ibn Mālik, he said: A son of Abū Ṭalḥah had a small bird which he used to play with, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “O Abū ʿUmayr, what did the little bird do?”
items.ma-13581: ʿAffān narrated to us, Ḥammād narrated to us, Thābit narrated to us, from Anas, he said: I gave the Prophet ﷺ to drink from this cup of mine every drink: honey, water and milk.
items.ma-13582: ʿAffān narrated to us, Hammām narrated to us, Qatādah narrated to us, from Anas: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade al-wiṣāl. He said: It was said: Indeed you practise wiṣāl! He said: “Indeed, I spend the night [while] my Rabb feeds me and gives me drink.”
items.ma-13600: ʿAffān narrated to us, Wuhayb narrated to us, Ayyūb narrated to us, from Abū Qilābah, from Anas ibn Mālik, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “When the evening meal is set down and the prayer is due, begin with the evening meal.”
items.ma-13679: Rawḥ narrated to us, Saʿīd narrated to us, from Qatādah, Anas ibn Mālik narrated to us, he said: I heard the Prophet of Allah ﷺ say: “When the people of Paradise see them, they will say: These are the Jahannamiyyūn.”
items.ma-13746: Ḥusayn narrated to us, al-Mubārak narrated to us, from Ismāʿīl ibn ʿAbd Allāh ibn Abī Ṭalḥah, from Anas ibn Mālik, he said: Perfume was never offered to the Prophet ﷺ and he rejected it.
items.ma-14096: Bahz narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, he said: Qatādah informed us, from Anas ibn Mālik, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Straighten your rows, for straightening the row is part of the completion of the prayer.”
items.ma-14128: ʿAbd al-Razzāq narrated to us, Ibn Jurayj narrated to us, Abū al-Zubayr informed me that he heard Jābir ibn ʿAbd Allāh say: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “When one of you performs istijmār, let him make it odd.”
items.ma-14167: ʿAbd al-Razzāq and Muḥammad ibn Bakr narrated to us, both said: Ibn Jurayj informed us: And Sulaymān ibn Mūsā said: Jābir said: The Prophet ﷺ said: “There is no fulfilment of a vow in disobedience to Allah.”
items.ma-14276: Muḥammad ibn Fuḍayl narrated to us, al-Aʿmash narrated to us, from Abū Sufyān, from Jābir, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “When one of you prays, let him not spread out his forearms as a dog spreads them out.”
items.ma-14360: Yaḥyā ibn Saʿīd narrated to us, from Ibn Jurayj, Abū al-Zubayr informed me that he heard Jābir – meaning – that he threw the jamrah with the like of the pebbles of khadhf.
items.ma-14411: ʿAbbād ibn al-ʿAwwām narrated to us, from al-Ḥasan ibn Abī Jaʿfar, from Abū al-Zubayr, from Jābir ibn ʿAbd Allāh, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade the price of a dog, except the trained dog.
items.ma-14568: Rawḥ narrated to us, Ashʿath narrated to us, from al-Ḥasan, from Jābir ibn ʿAbd Allāh, he said: We used to travel with the Prophet ﷺ, and when we went up we said the takbīr, and when we went down we said the tasbīḥ.
items.ma-14601: Ḥasan narrated to us, Ibn Lahīʿah narrated to us, Abū al-Zubayr narrated to us, from Jābir ibn ʿAbd Allāh, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Whoever finds ample means, let him be shrouded in a garment of ḥibarah.”
items.ma-14635: Yūnus narrated to us, Ḥammād – meaning Ibn Zayd – narrated to us, he said: I heard ʿAmr ibn Dīnār say, from Jābir: that the Prophet ﷺ forbade the renting of land.
items.ma-14699: Rawḥ narrated to us, Zakariyyā ibn Isḥāq narrated to us, Abū al-Zubayr narrated to us that he heard Jābir ibn ʿAbd Allāh say: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade us to wipe ourselves with a bone or with dung.
items.ma-14777: Ḥujayn and Yūnus narrated to us, both said: al-Layth ibn Saʿd narrated to us, from Abū al-Zubayr, from Jābir, from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ: that he forbade urinating in standing water.
items.ma-14831: Sulaymān ibn Ḥayyān Abū Khālid – meaning al-Aḥmar – narrated to us, Ibn Jurayj informed us, from Abū al-Zubayr, from Jābir, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ threw with the like of the pebbles of khadhf.
items.ma-14842: Yūnus and ʿAffān narrated to us, both said: Ḥammād narrated to us, ʿAffān said in his narration: Abū al-Zubayr informed us, from Jābir, as I think: that the Prophet ﷺ forbade the sale of water.
items.ma-14886: ʿAffān and Bahz narrated to us, both said: Hammām narrated to us, Qatādah narrated to us, from ʿAṭāʾ, Jābir ibn ʿAbd Allāh narrated to me, that the Prophet ﷺ said: “The ʿumrā is permitted.”
items.ma-14889: ʿAffān narrated to us, Salīm ibn Ḥayyān narrated to us, Saʿīd ibn Mīnāʾ narrated to us, from Jābir ibn ʿAbd Allāh: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ prayed over Aṣḥamah al-Najāshī, and said the takbīr over him four times.
items.ma-14908: ʿAffān narrated to us, Yazīd ibn Ibrāhīm narrated to us, Abū al-Zubayr narrated to us, from Jābir ibn ʿAbd Allāh: that the Prophet ﷺ was cupped while in iḥrām, because of a sprain he had.
items.ma-14997: Azhar ibn al-Qāsim al-Rāsibī narrated to us in Makkah, and Kathīr ibn Hishām, both said: Hishām narrated to us, from Abū al-Zubayr, from Jābir, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade the sale of date-palms until they bear fruit.
items.ma-15009: Sahl ibn Yūsuf narrated to us, from Ḥajjāj, from ʿAṭāʾ, from Jābir ibn ʿAbd Allāh: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and his Companions, when they arrived, did not do more than one ṭawāf.
items.ma-15082: Yaḥyā ibn Zakariyyā narrated to us, Ḥajjāj informed us, from ʿAṭāʾ and from Abū al-Zubayr, from Jābir: that the Prophet ﷺ forbade that what is on the tops of the date-palms be sold for dates by measure.
items.ma-15099: ʿAbdah ibn Sulaymān narrated to us, ʿĀṣim – meaning al-Aḥwal – narrated to us, from ʿĀmir, from Jābir, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade that a woman be married together with her paternal aunt or her maternal aunt.
items.ma-15101: ʿAbdah ibn Sulaymān narrated to us, ʿAbd al-Malik narrated to us, from ʿAṭāʾ, from Jābir, he said: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ on a day of ʿĪd begin with the prayer before the khuṭbah, without adhān or iqāmah.
items.ma-15173: Isḥāq narrated to us, Mālik informed us, from Jaʿfar, from his father, from Jābir ibn ʿAbd Allāh: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ slaughtered some of his sacrificial animals with his own hand, and some of them were slaughtered by another.
items.ma-15202: Muḥammad ibn ʿUbayd narrated to us, al-Aʿmash narrated to us, from Abū Sufyān, from Jābir, he said: A man came to the Prophet ﷺ and said: O Messenger of Allah, what are the two that make [Paradise or the Fire] obligatory? Then he mentioned the ḥadīth.
items.ma-15340: Zayd narrated to us, ʿAbd al-Malik ibn al-Rabīʿ ibn Sabrah informed me, from his father, from his grandfather, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “When one of you prays, let him place a barrier for his prayer, even if it is an arrow.”
items.ma-15707: ʿAbd al-Razzāq narrated to us, Sufyān narrated to us, from Yaḥyā ibn Saʿīd, from Muḥammad ibn Ibrāhīm al-Taymī, he said: Abū Ḥadrad al-Aslamī narrated to us that a man came; then he mentioned the like of it.
items.ma-16309: ʿAbd al-Razzāq narrated to us, Maʿmar narrated to us, from Saʿīd al-Jurayrī, from Abū al-ʿAlāʾ ibn al-Shikhkhīr, from his father, he said: I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ praying in his sandals.
items.ma-16408: Yazīd ibn Hārūn narrated to us, he said: Sallām ibn Miskīn informed us, he said: Shahr ibn Ḥawshab narrated to us, from Muḥammad ibn Yūsuf ibn ʿAbd Allāh ibn Salām, and he mentioned the ḥadīth of the neighbour.
items.ma-17738: ʿAbd al-Razzāq narrated to us, Maʿmar narrated to us, from al-Zuhrī, from Abū Idrīs al-Khawlānī, from Abū Thaʿlabah al-Khushanī, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade the eating of every beast of prey with a fang.
items.ma-17764: ʿAbd Allāh ibn Yazīd narrated to us, he said: Mūsā narrated to us, I heard my father say: I heard ʿAmr ibn al-ʿĀṣ say … then he mentioned it, and said: He raised his gaze toward me.
items.ma-18110: ʿAffān narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn al-Aṣbahānī narrated to us, he said: I heard ʿAbd Allāh ibn Maʿqil say: I sat with Kaʿb in this mosque; then he mentioned its meaning.
items.ma-18520: Ibn Idrīs narrated to us, Shuʿbah informed us, from ʿAmr ibn Murrah, from ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Abī Laylā, from al-Barāʾ ibn ʿĀzib: that the Prophet ﷺ performed qunūt in the Ṣubḥ and in the Maghrib.
items.ma-18527: Ibn Numayr narrated to us, Yaḥyā ibn Saʿīd narrated to us, from ʿAdī ibn Thābit, from al-Barāʾ ibn ʿĀzib: that he prayed the last ʿIshāʾ prayer behind the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and he recited {By the fig and the olive}.
items.ma-18572: ʿAffān narrated to us, he said: Shuʿbah narrated to us, he said: Abū Isḥāq narrated to us, from al-Barāʾ, he said: I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ on the day of the Trench, and he was carrying earth. Then he mentioned the like of it.
items.ma-18586: Muḥammad ibn ʿAbd Allāh narrated to us, Isrāʾīl narrated to us, from Abū Isḥāq, from al-Barāʾ, he said: We fought fifteen expeditions with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and I and ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿUmar were of the same age.
items.ma-18589: Yaḥyā ibn Ādam narrated to us, Abū Bakr narrated to us, from Abū Isḥāq, from al-Barāʾ ibn ʿĀzib, he said: A man came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and asked him about the kalālah, and he said: “The verse of the summer suffices you.”
items.ma-18615: [ʿAbd Allāh said:] And Abū al-Rabīʿ narrated it to us, Ḥammād ibn Zayd narrated to us, from Yūnus ibn Khabbāb, from al-Minhāl ibn ʿAmr, from Zādhān, from al-Barāʾ ibn ʿĀzib, like it.
items.ma-18628: Yaḥyā ibn Ādam narrated to us, Abū al-Aḥwaṣ narrated to us, from Manṣūr, from al-Shaʿbī, from al-Barāʾ ibn ʿĀzib, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ delivered a khuṭbah to us on the Day of Naḥr after the prayer.
items.ma-18678: Ḥusayn narrated to us, Isrāʾīl narrated to us, from Abū Isḥāq, from al-Barāʾ, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “O Ḥassān, satirise the polytheists, for Jibrīl is with you” – or: “Rūḥ al-Qudus is with you.”
items.ma-19276: Rawḥ narrated to us, Ibn Jurayj narrated to us, ʿAmr ibn Dīnār and ʿĀmir ibn Muṣʿab informed me, both heard Abū al-Minhāl, he said: I asked al-Barāʾ and Zayd ibn Arqam. Then he mentioned the like of it.
items.ma-19360: Muḥammad ibn Jaʿfar narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, from Abū Isḥāq, from al-ʿAyzār, from ʿUrwah ibn al-Jaʿd, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “Good is tied to the forelocks of horses.”
items.ma-19908: Ibn Numayr narrated to us, Mālik – meaning Ibn Mighwal – informed us, from Ḥuṣayn, from al-Shaʿbī, from ʿImrān ibn Ḥuṣayn, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “There is no ruqyah except for the evil eye or a venomous sting.”
items.ma-19962: Ibrāhīm ibn Khālid narrated to us, Rabāḥ narrated to us, from Maʿmar, from Ibn Sīrīn, from ʿImrān ibn Ḥuṣayn, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “There is no shighār in Islam.”
items.ma-20008: Wahb ibn Jarīr narrated to us, my father narrated to us, he said: I heard Ḥumayd ibn Hilāl narrating, from Abū Qatādah, from ʿImrān ibn Ḥuṣayn, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Modesty is all good.”
items.ma-20122: ʿAffān narrated to us, Abū ʿAwānah narrated to us, Qatādah narrated to us, from al-Ḥasan, from Samurah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Whoever kills his slave, we will kill him; and whoever mutilates him, we will mutilate him.
items.ma-20183: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān narrated to us, from Ḥammād ibn Salamah, from Qatādah, from al-Ḥasan, from Samurah, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “The neighbour has more right to the neighbouring” – or: “to the house.”
items.ma-20227: Abū Kāmil narrated to us, Ḥammād narrated to us, from Qatādah, from al-Ḥasan, from Samurah ibn Jundub, that the Prophet ﷺ said: “Whoever owns a relative within the prohibited degrees, he is free.”
items.ma-20230: Hushaym narrated to us, Ḥajjāj ibn Arṭāh informed us, from Qatādah, from al-Ḥasan, from Samurah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Kill the old men of the polytheists, and spare their youths.”
