items.ma-20286: Ḥajjāj narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to me, he said: I heard Qatādah narrating from ʿAlqamah ibn ʿAbd Allāh al-Muzanī, from men of the Companions of the Prophet ﷺ, from the Prophet ﷺ; then he mentioned the like of it.
items.ma-20366: Muḥammad ibn Jaʿfar and Yazīd narrated to us, Shuʿbah informed us, he said: I heard Muʿāwiyah ibn Qurrah narrating from his father: that a man used to come to the Prophet ﷺ; then he mentioned the like of it.
items.ma-20403: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from ʿUyaynah, my father narrated to me, from Abū Bakrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Whoever kills a person under a covenant not for the true reason of it, Allah has forbidden Paradise to him, that he find its scent.”
items.ma-20802: ʿAbd al-Razzāq narrated to us, Isrāʾīl informed us, from Simāk, that he heard Jābir ibn Samurah say: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Indeed, before the Hour there will be great liars.”
items.ma-20809: Sulaymān ibn Dāwūd narrated to us, from Sharīk, from Simāk, from Jābir ibn Samurah, that the Prophet ﷺ said: “Seek Laylat al-Qadr in the last ten.”
items.ma-20981: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Fiṭr narrated to us, from Abū Khālid al-Wālibī, from Jābir ibn Samurah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “I and the Hour were sent like these two.”
items.ma-21019: Bahz and Abū Kāmil narrated to us, both said: Ḥammād ibn Salamah narrated to us, Simāk ibn Ḥarb narrated to us, from Jābir ibn Samurah: that Bilāl used to call the adhān for the Ẓuhr when the sun declined.
items.ma-21134: ʿAbd Allāh narrated to us, Suwayd ibn Saʿīd narrated to us, al-Muʿtamir narrated to us, from Ḥumayd, from Anas, from Ubayy ibn Kaʿb, he said: Nothing has entered my heart since I became Muslim; then he mentioned its meaning.
items.ma-21184: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Mahdī narrated to us, from Sufyān, from al-Zubayr ibn ʿAdī, from Abū Razīn, from Zirr ibn Ḥubaysh, from Ubayy ibn Kaʿb, like it.
items.ma-21410: Wakīʿ narrated to us, from ʿUmar ibn Dharr, he said: Mujāhid said: from Abū Dharr, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Allah did not send a prophet except with the language of his people.”
items.ma-21506: ʿAffān narrated to us, Mahdī ibn Maymūn narrated to us, from Ghaylān ibn Jarīr, from Shahr ibn Ḥawshab, from Maʿdī Karib, from Abū Dharr, from the Prophet ﷺ, like it.
items.ma-21815: Ismāʿīl narrated to us, Khālid al-Ḥadhdhāʾ informed us, from ʿIkrimah, from Ibn ʿAbbās, from Usāmah ibn Zayd, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Ribā is only in delay.”
items.ma-22026: Rawḥ narrated to us, Ḥammād – meaning Ibn Salamah – narrated to us, ʿĀṣim ibn Bahdalah narrated to us, from Abū Burdah, from Abū Mūsā: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to be guarded by his Companions; then he mentioned the like of it.
items.ma-22062: Wakīʿ narrated to us, from Sufyān, from Abū al-Zubayr, from Abū al-Ṭufayl, from Muʿādh: that the Prophet ﷺ combined the Ẓuhr and the ʿAṣr, and the Maghrib and the ʿIshāʾ, during the expedition of Tabūk.
items.ma-22479: Abū ʿĀmir narrated to us, Fulayḥ narrated to us, from al-Zuhrī, Jaʿfar ibn ʿAmr ibn Umayyah narrated to me, from his father: that he saw the Prophet ﷺ eat a limb, then pray and not perform wuḍūʾ.
items.ma-22547: ʿAbd Allāh narrated to us, Ibrāhīm ibn al-Ḥajjāj narrated to me, Ḥammād ibn Salamah narrated to us, from Thābit, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Rabāḥ, from Abū Qatādah, from the Prophet ﷺ, like it.
items.ma-22874: Yūnus narrated to us, ʿImrān ibn Yazīd al-Qaṭṭān, a Baṣran, narrated to us, from Abū Ḥāzim, from Sahl ibn Saʿd, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Indeed, this minbar of mine is upon a turʿah of the turaʿ of Paradise.”
items.ma-22880: Ḥasan narrated to us, Ibn Lahīʿah narrated to us, Abū Zurʿah ʿAmr ibn Jābir narrated to us, from Sahl ibn Saʿd, he said: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: “Do not curse Tubbaʿ, for he had become Muslim.”
items.ma-23009: Zayd ibn al-Ḥubāb narrated to us, Ḥusayn ibn Wāqid narrated to me, ʿAbd Allāh ibn Buraydah narrated to me, from his father: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ handed the banner to ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭālib on the day of Khaybar.
items.ma-23052: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Abū Janāb narrated to us, from Sulaymān ibn Buraydah, from his father, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “I used to forbid you from visiting the graves; so visit them, and do not say anything obscene.”
items.ma-23081: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Sufyān narrated to us, from ʿAbd al-Karīm al-Jazarī, from ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Abī ʿAmrah, from his paternal uncle, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Do not combine my name and my kunyah.”
items.ma-23275: Wakīʿ narrated to us, from Ibn Abī Laylā, from an old man called Hilāl, from Ḥudhayfah, he said: I asked the Prophet ﷺ about everything, even the wiping of the pebbles, and he said: “Once, or leave it.”
items.ma-23461: ʿUbaydah ibn Ḥumayd narrated to us, Manṣūr narrated to me, from Abū Wāʾil, from Ḥudhayfah, he said: When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ rose at night, he would scour his mouth with the siwāk.
items.ma-23549: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, from ʿAdī ibn Thābit, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Yazīd, from Abū Ayyūb: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ combined the Maghrib and the ʿIshāʾ at al-Muzdalifah.
items.ma-23736: Abū al-Mughīrah narrated to us, Ibn Thawbān narrated to us, one who heard Khālid ibn Maʿdān narrating narrated to me, from Shuraḥbīl ibn al-Simṭ, from Salmān, like that.
items.ma-23774: Sufyān ibn ʿUyaynah narrated to us, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Abī Bakr, from his father, from Abū al-Baddāḥ, from his father: that the Prophet ﷺ gave a concession to the shepherds to throw one day and leave off one day.
items.ma-23836: Muḥammad ibn Kunāsah narrated to us, Yaḥyā ibn Abī al-Haytham al-ʿAṭṭār narrated to us, from Yūsuf ibn ʿAbd Allāh ibn Salām, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ named me Yūsuf, and sat me in his lap.
items.ma-24165: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from Sufyān, from ʿĀṣim ibn ʿUbayd Allāh, from al-Qāsim, from ʿĀʾishah: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ kissed ʿUthmān ibn Maẓʿūn while he was dead, until I saw the tears flowing down his face.
items.ma-24228: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from Hishām, he said: My father informed me, from ʿĀʾishah, from the Prophet ﷺ: “Indeed the fever – or the intensity of the fever – is from the fayḥ of Jahannam, so cool it with water.”
items.ma-24238: Yaḥyā narrated to us, Hishām narrated to us, my father narrated to me, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to stay in the mosque, and he ﷺ would incline his head to me, and I would comb his hair while I was menstruating.
items.ma-24308: Ibn Numayr narrated to us, Saʿd ibn Saʿīd narrated to us, he said: ʿAmrah informed me, she said: I heard ʿĀʾishah say: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Indeed, breaking the bone of a believer when dead is like breaking it when alive.”
items.ma-24349: Hushaym narrated to us, from ʿUmar ibn Abī Salamah, from his father, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ and I used to wash from janābah from one vessel.
items.ma-24847: Mūsā ibn Dāwūd narrated to us, he said: Muslim ibn Khālid narrated to us, from Hishām ibn ʿUrwah, from his father, from ʿĀʾishah, that the Prophet ﷺ said: “The yield is by liability.”
items.ma-24848: Mūsā ibn Dāwūd narrated to us, Ibrāhīm ibn Saʿd narrated to us, from Ṣāliḥ ibn Kaysān, from al-Qāsim, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Spread it out.”
items.ma-25008: ʿAffān narrated to us, he said: Ḥammād narrated to us, from Ḥammād, from Ibrāhīm, from al-Aswad, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: I used to scrape the semen from the garment of the Prophet ﷺ, then he would go and pray in it.
items.ma-25059: Wakīʿ narrated to us, al-Aʿmash narrated to us, from Ḥabīb, from ʿUrwah, from ʿĀʾishah, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “The woman with istiḥāḍah prays even if the blood drips onto the mat.”
items.ma-25125: Ṣafwān ibn ʿĪsā narrated to us, Usāmah ibn Zayd informed us, from al-Zuhrī, from ʿUrwah, from ʿĀʾishah, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “We are not inherited from; what we leave is ṣadaqah.”
items.ma-25398: Muḥammad ibn Jaʿfar narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, from Sulaymān, from Abū Wāʾil, from Masrūq, from ʿĀʾishah, that she said: I have not seen pain upon anyone more severe than it was upon the Messenger of Allah ﷺ.
items.ma-25413: Muḥammad ibn Jaʿfar narrated to us, he said: Shuʿbah narrated to us, from Manṣūr, from Ibrāhīm, from ʿAlqamah, he said: I asked ʿĀʾishah about the prayer of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and she said: It was a steady rain.
items.ma-25577: Yaḥyā ibn Saʿīd narrated to us, from Zakariyyā, he said: ʿĀmir narrated to us, from Masrūq, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: I used to twist the garlands of the sacrificial animals for the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and he would send them, and he would not enter iḥrām.
items.ma-25601: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from Hishām, he said: My father informed me, he said: ʿĀʾishah informed me, she said: The Prophet ﷺ was shrouded in three white Yamanī garments, among which there was neither a shirt nor a turban.
items.ma-25636: ʿAbd al-Razzāq narrated to us, Maʿmar narrated to us, from al-Zuhrī, from ʿUrwah, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to pray the ʿAṣr before the sun had left my room, rising.
items.ma-25717: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Hishām narrated to us, from his father, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Any condition that is not in the Book of Allah is void, even if it is a hundred conditions.”
items.ma-25720: Wakīʿ narrated to us, from Hishām ibn ʿUrwah, from his father, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: Alighting at al-Muḥaṣṣab is not part of the Sunnah; the Messenger of Allah ﷺ only alighted there so that his departure would be easier.
items.ma-25799: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān narrated to us, he said: Sufyān narrated to us, from Abū al-Zubayr, from ʿĀʾishah and Ibn ʿAbbās, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ delayed the ṭawāf on the Day of Naḥr until the night.
items.ma-25806: ʿAbd al-Malik ibn ʿAmr narrated to us, he said: Ibn Abī Dhiʾb narrated to us, from al-Zuhrī, from ʿUrwah, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ did not pray the voluntary prayer of Ḍuḥā, and indeed I pray it.
items.ma-25822: Ismāʿīl narrated to us, he said: Burd ibn Sinān narrated to us, from Sulaymān ibn Mūsā, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to pray in the garment in which he had intercourse.
items.ma-25867: Ḥajjāj narrated to us, Layth narrated to us, he said: ʿUqayl narrated to us, from Ibn Shihāb, from Abū Salamah ibn ʿAbd al-Raḥmān, from ʿĀʾishah, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ kissed her while he was fasting.
items.ma-25926: Abū Muʿāwiyah narrated to us, he said: Hishām narrated to us, from his father, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: Alighting at al-Abṭaḥ is not part of the Sunnah; the Messenger of Allah ﷺ only alighted there because it was easier for his departure ﷺ.
items.ma-26006: Yazīd narrated to us, he said: Muḥammad ibn ʿAmr informed us, from his father, from his grandfather ʿAlqamah ibn Waqqāṣ, from ʿĀʾishah, that she said: I used to perfume the Messenger of Allah ﷺ when he entered iḥrām and when he came out of it.
items.ma-26177: Rawḥ narrated to us, Abān ibn Ṣamʿah narrated to us, ʿIkrimah narrated to us, he said: ʿĀʾishah narrated to me that she used to wash with the Prophet ﷺ from one vessel.
items.ma-26272: ʿAlī ibn ʿĀṣim narrated to us, from ʿAṭāʾ ibn al-Sāʾib, from Ibrāhīm, from al-Aswad ibn Yazīd, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: I saw the gleam of perfume in the parting of the hair of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ while he was in iḥrām.
items.ma-26325: Yaʿqūb narrated to us, he said: My father narrated to us, from his father, from Abū Salamah, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: He never found the last saḥar with me except asleep. She meant the Prophet ﷺ.
items.ma-26329: Yaʿqūb narrated to us, he said: My father narrated to us, from his father, from al-Qāsim ibn Muḥammad, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Whoever introduces into this matter of ours what is not part of it, it is rejected.”
items.ma-26923: ʿAththām ibn ʿAlī Abū ʿAlī al-ʿĀmirī narrated to us, he said: Hishām ibn ʿUrwah narrated to us, from Fāṭimah, from Asmāʾ, she said: We were indeed commanded to free slaves at the prayer of the eclipse.
items.ma-27206: Yaḥyā ibn Saʿīd narrated to us, from Sufyān, he said: Abū Isḥāq narrated to me, he said: I heard Sulaymān ibn Ṣurad say: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said on the day of al-Aḥzāb: “Now we will fight them, and they will not fight us.”
items.ma-27302: Ismāʿīl narrated to us, from Khālid, from Ḥafṣah, from Umm ʿAṭiyyah, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to them concerning the washing of his daughter: “Begin with her right sides, and the places of wuḍūʾ on her.”
items.ma-27381: Abū Muʿāwiyah narrated to us, he said: Hishām ibn ʿUrwah narrated to us, from his father, from Umm Hāniʾ, she said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Keep sheep, for in them is blessing.”
items.ma-4476: Ismāʿīl narrated to us, Ayyūb narrated to us, from Saʿīd ibn Jubayr: that Ibn ʿUmar used to pray the voluntary prayer on his mount, and when he wanted to pray the Witr he would dismount and pray the Witr on the ground.
items.ma-4497: Ismāʿīl narrated to us, Ayyūb narrated to us, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, he said: It was brought to the Prophet ﷺ – meaning the desert lizard – and he did not eat it, and he did not prohibit it.
items.ma-4551: Sufyān narrated to us, from al-Zuhrī, from Sālim, from his father, from the Prophet ﷺ: “Indeed Bilāl calls the adhān by night, so eat and drink until Ibn Umm Maktūm calls the adhān.”
items.ma-4656: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from ʿUbayd Allāh, Nāfiʿ informed me, Ibn ʿUmar informed me: that the Prophet ﷺ spent the night at Dhū Ṭuwā until morning, then entered Makkah; and Ibn ʿUmar used to do that.
items.ma-4659: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from ʿUbayd Allāh, Nāfiʿ informed me, from Ibn ʿUmar, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “A man must not make a man rise from his seat and then sit in it; rather, make room and make space.”
items.ma-4690: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from Mālik, Nāfiʿ narrated to us, from Ibn ʿUmar, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “Whoever drinks wine in this world and does not repent of it, will be deprived of it in the Hereafter; he will not be given it to drink.”
items.ma-4704: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from Ismāʿīl, from Abū Ḥanẓalah: I asked Ibn ʿUmar about the prayer during travel. He said: The prayer during travel is two rakʿahs. We said: We are secure? He said: The Sunnah of the Prophet ﷺ.
items.ma-4736: Ibn Numayr narrated to us, ʿUbayd Allāh narrated to us, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Whoever buys food, let him not sell it until he has received it in full.”
items.ma-4791: Wakīʿ narrated to us, from Shuʿbah, from Yaʿlā ibn ʿAṭāʾ, from ʿAlī al-Azdī, from Ibn ʿUmar, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “The prayer of the night and the day is two by two.”
items.ma-4919: ʿAbd al-Razzāq narrated to us, Maʿmar informed us, from ʿUbayd Allāh ibn ʿUmar, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, he said: The Prophet ﷺ used to deliver the khuṭbah twice on the day of Jumuʿah, with a sitting between them.
items.ma-4976: Isḥāq ibn Sulaymān narrated to us, ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz ibn Abī Rawwād informed us, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, that the bezel of the ring of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was on the inside of his palm.
items.ma-5000: Abū Muʿāwiyah narrated to us, al-Aʿmash narrated to us, from Mujāhid, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿUmar, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Indeed I know a tree whose blessing is like that of the Muslim man: the date palm.”
items.ma-5184: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from Yaḥyā – meaning Ibn Saʿīd – from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “Do not sell fruit to one another until its soundness appears.”
items.ma-5189: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from Sufyān, ʿAbd Allāh ibn Dīnār narrated to me, I heard Ibn ʿUmar say: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to pray on his mount wherever it turned with him.
items.ma-5248: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Ḥanẓalah narrated to us, from Sālim, from Ibn ʿUmar, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Whoever drags his garment out of arrogance, Lam yanẓur Allāh ilayhi on the Day of Resurrection.”
items.ma-5255: Wakīʿ narrated to us, from Sufyān, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Dīnār; and al-ʿUmarī, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ was asked about the desert lizard, and he said: “I do not eat it and I do not prohibit it.”
items.ma-5412: ʿAffān narrated to us, Salīm ibn Akhḍar narrated to us, ʿUbayd Allāh narrated to me, from Nāfiʿ, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿUmar: that the Prophet ﷺ apportioned in the additional spoils two shares for the horse and one share for the man.
items.ma-5488: Muḥammad ibn Jaʿfar narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, from Ayyūb, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “When one of you goes to Jumuʿah, let him bathe.”
items.ma-5791: Muḥammad ibn ʿUbayd narrated to us, ʿUbayd Allāh ibn ʿUmar narrated to us, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, he said: When travel became urgent for the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, he would combine the Maghrib and the ʿIshāʾ.
items.ma-5794: Muḥammad ibn ʿUbayd narrated to us, ʿUbayd Allāh narrated to us, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Make the last of your prayer at night a Witr.”
items.ma-5839: Wakīʿ narrated to us, al-ʿUmarī narrated to us, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, he said: In the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ I had no place to spend the night and no shelter except in the mosque.
items.ma-5844: Wakīʿ narrated to us, ʿAbd Allāh ibn Nāfiʿ narrated to me, from his father, from Ibn ʿUmar: that the Prophet ﷺ, meaning, was brought faḍīkh in the Mosque of al-Faḍīkh, and he drank it; for that reason it was named [so].
items.ma-5858: ʿAffān narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, ʿAbd Allāh ibn Dīnār narrated to us, he heard Ibn ʿUmar, from the Prophet ﷺ: “Aslam – Allah has made them safe; and Ghifār – Allah has forgiven them.”
items.ma-5860: ʿAffān narrated to us, ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz ibn Muslim narrated to us, ʿAbd Allāh ibn Dīnār informed me, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿUmar: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to come to Qubāʾ riding and walking.
items.ma-5910: [ʿAbd Allāh ibn Aḥmad] said: I heard my father say: Muʾammal heard from ʿUmar ibn Muḥammad ibn Zayd – meaning ḥadīths – and he also heard from Ibn Jurayj.
items.ma-6355: ʿAbd al-Razzāq narrated to us, Maʿmar narrated to us, from al-Zuhrī, from Sālim, from Ibn ʿUmar, he said: The Prophet ﷺ said: “The prayer of the night is two by two, and if you fear the morning, pray the Witr with one [rakʿah].”
items.ma-6528: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Sufyān narrated to us, from Manṣūr, from Hilāl ibn Yasāf, from Abū Yaḥyā, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿAmr, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Perfect the wuḍūʾ.”
items.ma-6965: ʿAffān narrated to us, Hammām narrated to us, from Qatādah, from al-Ḥasan, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿAmr, and he did not raise it, and he said: “until Allah ﷿ takes his sharīṭah from the people.”
items.ma-7262: Sufyān narrated to us, from al-Zuhrī, from Saʿīd, from Abū Hurayrah, or from Abū Salamah; from one of them or both of them: that the Prophet ﷺ said: “The child belongs to the bed, and for the adulterer is the stone.”
items.ma-7346: Sufyān narrated to us, from Abū al-Zinād, from al-Aʿraj, from Abū Hurayrah; he said: Perhaps from the Prophet ﷺ: “When the dog laps in the vessel of one of you, let him wash it seven washings.”
items.ma-7381: Sufyān narrated to us, from Manṣūr, from Abū Ḥāzim, from Abū Hurayrah, attributing it to the Prophet ﷺ: “Whoever heads for this House and does not engage in obscene speech and does not act wickedly, returns as on the day his mother bore him.”
items.ma-7525: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid narrated to us, from ʿAwf, from Khilās, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Let none of you urinate in standing water and then perform wuḍūʾ from it.”
items.ma-7589: Abū al-Yamān narrated to us, Shuʿayb narrated to us, from al-Zuhrī, Ḥumayd ibn ʿAbd al-Raḥmān narrated to me: that Abū Hurayrah said: The Prophet ﷺ said, and he mentioned the ḥadīth.
items.ma-7728: ʿAbd al-Razzāq narrated to us, Dāwūd ibn Qays informed us, from Mūsā ibn Yasār, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Name yourselves by my name, but do not take my kunyah; I am Abū al-Qāsim.”
items.ma-7761: ʿAbd al-Razzāq narrated to us, Maʿmar informed us, from al-Zuhrī, a man from Muzaynah narrated to us while we were with Ibn al-Musayyib: that the Prophet ﷺ stoned a Jewish man and a Jewish woman.
items.ma-7763: ʿAbd al-Razzāq narrated to us, Maʿmar narrated to us, from al-Zuhrī, from Ibn al-Musayyib and Abū Salamah, from Abū Hurayrah, that the Prophet ﷺ said: “The child belongs to the bed, and for the adulterer is the stone.”
items.ma-7843: Ḥammād ibn Usāmah Abū Usāmah narrated to us, he said: ʿUbayd Allāh informed me, from Abū al-Zinād, from al-Aʿraj, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade shighār.
items.ma-8142: And the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Kisrā has perished, and there will be no Kisrā after him; and Qayṣar will surely perish, and there will be no Qayṣar after him; and their treasures will surely be divided in the way of Allah ﷿.”
items.ma-8154: And the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “ʿĪsā son of Maryam ﵇ saw a man stealing, and ʿĪsā said to him: Did you steal? He said: Never, by the One—there is no deity except Him. ʿĪsā said: I believe in Allah, and I have called my eye a liar.”
items.ma-8223: And the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “When the call to prayer is made, come to it walking, with tranquillity upon you; what you catch up with, pray, and what you miss, make up.”
items.ma-8449: Yaḥyā ibn Isḥāq narrated to us, Abū ʿAwānah informed us, from ʿUmar ibn Abī Salamah, from his father, from Abū Hurayrah: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ cursed the women who frequently visit the graves.
items.ma-8543: ʿAffān narrated to us, Ḥammād narrated to us, from Muḥammad ibn ʿAmr, from Abū Salamah, from Abū Hurayrah: that the Prophet ﷺ saw a man following a pigeon, and he said: “A Shayṭān following a female Shayṭān.”
items.ma-8674: And Aswad said with this isnād, he said: And the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “When it is the day of fasting of one of you, let him not engage in obscene speech, nor act wickedly, nor behave ignorantly; and if someone behaves ignorantly towards him, let him say: Indeed I am a man fasting.”
items.ma-8714: Abū Jaʿfar narrated to us, ʿAbbād narrated to us, from Muḥammad ibn ʿAmr, from Abū Salamah, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ: that he used to accept the gift and not accept ṣadaqah.
items.ma-8746: Sulaymān ibn Dāwūd narrated to us, ʿImrān narrated to us, from Qatādah, from Abū Murāyah, from Abū Hurayrah that the Prophet ﷺ said: “The angels do not pray over a wailing woman, nor over one who raises a ringing cry.”
items.ma-9130: Hawdhah narrated to us, ʿAwf narrated to us, from Muḥammad, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “Whoever repents before the sun rises from its place of setting, Allah accepts his repentance.”
items.ma-9250: Khalaf narrated to us, he said: Abū Maʿshar narrated to us, from Saʿīd, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Give gifts to one another, for the gift removes the rancour of the breast.”
items.ma-9381: ʿAffān narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, Dāwūd ibn Farāhīj narrated to us, he said: I heard Abū Hurayrah say: In the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ we had no food except the two black things: dates and water.
items.ma-9570: Yaḥyā al-Qaṭṭān narrated to us, from Ibn ʿAjlān, he said: Saʿīd narrated to us, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Beware of injustice,” and he mentioned the ḥadīth.
items.ma-9733: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Sufyān narrated to us, from Suhayl ibn Abī Ṣāliḥ, from al-Ḥārith ibn Mukhlad, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Cursed is he who comes to his wife in her anus.”
items.ma-9751: Wakīʿ narrated to us, he said: Abān ibn Ṣamʿah narrated to us, from Zubaynah daughter of al-Nuʿmān, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade vessels, except a vessel whose top is tied.
items.ma-9857: Ḥajjāj narrated to us, he said: Shuʿbah narrated to us, he said: I heard Muḥammad ibn Juḥādah narrating from Abū Ḥāzim, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ: that he forbade the earnings of slave-girls.
items.ma-10097: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Ibn Abī Khālid narrated to us, from his father, he said: I saw Abū Hurayrah pray a prayer in which he was brief, and I said to him: Was the prayer of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ like this? He said: Yes, and briefer.
items.ma-10130: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from Muḥammad ibn ʿAmr, he said: Abū Salamah narrated to us, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ: “Narrate from the Children of Israel, and there is no harm.”
items.ma-10144: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from Muḥammad – meaning Ibn ʿAmr – he said: Abū Salamah narrated to me, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “Do not prevent the maidservants of Allah from the mosques of Allah, and let them go out unperfumed.”
items.ma-10237: Wakīʿ narrated to us, he said: al-Aʿmash narrated to us, from ʿUmārah ibn al-Qaʿqāʿ, from Abū Zurʿah, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “O Allah, make the provision of the family of Muḥammad a subsistence.”
items.ma-10240: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Ḥammād ibn Salamah narrated to us, from Muḥammad ibn Ziyād, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “The best of you in Islam are the best of you in character, when they have gained understanding.”
items.ma-10278: Muʾammal narrated to us, Sufyān narrated to us, from Ṣāliḥ ibn Nabhān, he said: I heard Abū Hurayrah say: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “No people have gathered,” and he mentioned it.
items.ma-10472: Yazīd narrated to us, he said: Muḥammad informed us, from Abū Salamah, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Change this white hair, and do not resemble the Jews or the Christians.”
items.ma-10506: Yazīd narrated to us, Muḥammad informed us, from Abū Salamah, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Let it cool down before the prayer, for the intensity of the heat is from the flaring of Jahannam.”
items.ma-10513: Yazīd narrated to us, Muḥammad informed us, from Abū Salamah, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Whoever falsely ascribes to me what I did not say, let him take his seat in the Fire.”
items.ma-10542: Yazīd ibn Hārūn narrated to us, Muḥammad informed us, from Abū Salamah, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Perform wuḍūʾ from what fire has touched, even from a bowl of dried curd.”
items.ma-10595: Yazīd narrated to us, Hishām informed us, from Muḥammad, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “When the dog laps in a vessel, it is washed seven times, the first of them with earth.”
items.ma-10761: ʿAbd al-Ṣamad narrated to us, Ḥammād narrated to us, Suhayl narrated to us, from his father, from Abū Hurayrah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Whoever conceals his Muslim brother, Allah will conceal him on the Day of Resurrection.”
items.ma-10823: ʿAbd al-Ṣamad narrated to us, Ḥammād narrated to us, from Suhayl, from his father, from Abū Hurayrah, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “When one of you rises from his seat and then returns, he is more entitled to it.”
items.ma-10826: ʿAbd al-Ṣamad narrated to us, Ḥammād narrated to me, from Suhayl, from his father, from Abū Hurayrah: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Whoever looks into the house of a people without their permission, and his eye is gouged out, it is nullified.”
items.ma-10879: Abū Saʿīd narrated to us, Ḥammād ibn ʿAbbād al-Sadūsī narrated to us, he said: I heard Abū al-Muhazzim narrating from Abū Hurayrah: that the Prophet ﷺ commanded that the heavens be recited in the ʿIshāʾ.
items.ma-11263: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Dāwūd ibn Qays narrated to us, from ʿIyāḍ ibn ʿAbd Allāh ibn Abī Sarḥ, from Abū Saʿīd al-Khudrī, that the Prophet ﷺ delivered a khuṭbah standing on his feet.
items.ma-11269: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, from Khulayd ibn Jaʿfar, from Abū Naḍrah, from Abū Saʿīd al-Khudrī, he said: Musk was mentioned in the presence of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and he said: “It is the finest of perfumes.”
items.ma-11308: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān narrated to us, he said: Zuhayr narrated to us, from Sharīk, from ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Abī Saʿīd, from his father, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “Water is from water.”
items.ma-11455: ʿAbd al-Ṣamad narrated to us, Abān narrated to us, Qatādah narrated to us, from Ibn Abī ʿUtbah, from Abū Saʿīd, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Ḥajj will surely be performed to the House after the emergence of Yaʾjūj and Maʾjūj.”
items.ma-11590: Zayd ibn al-Ḥubāb narrated to us, al-Mustamirr ibn al-Rayyān al-Zahrānī narrated to me, Abū Naḍrah narrated to us, from Abū Saʿīd al-Khudrī, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “The finest of perfumes is musk.”
items.ma-11737: ʿAffān narrated to us, Hammām narrated to us, from Qatādah, he said: Four men narrated to me, from Abū Saʿīd al-Khudrī that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade the nabīdh of the jarr.
items.ma-12192: Wakīʿ narrated to us, from Ḥammād, from Thābit, from Anas, he said: A man said to the Prophet ﷺ: Where is my father? He said: “In the Fire.” He said: When he saw what was in his face, he said: “Indeed my father and your father are in the Fire.”
items.ma-12203: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, from ʿAttāb, the mawlā of Ibn Hurmuz, he said: I heard Anas ibn Mālik say: We gave the pledge to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ to hear and obey, and he said: “In what you are able.”
items.ma-12245: Yazīd narrated to us, Shuʿbah informed us, from Qatādah, from Anas ibn Mālik, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “I was sent, I and the Hour, like these two,” and he gestured with the index finger and the middle finger.
items.ma-12290: Ḥajjāj narrated to us, Shuʿbah informed us, from Abū al-Tayyāḥ, he said: I heard Anas ibn Mālik narrating from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “Blessing is in the forelocks of the horses.”
items.ma-12350: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Mahdī narrated to us, Ḥammād narrated to us, from Thābit, from Anas, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “A morning [journey] in the way of Allah, or an evening [journey], is better than the world and what is in it.”
items.ma-12433: Khalaf ibn al-Walīd narrated to us, al-Mubārak narrated to us, he said: I heard Thābit, from Anas, he said: A man said: O Messenger of Allah, I love this sūrah, and he mentioned the like of it.
items.ma-12562: ʿAffān narrated it to us, Ḥammād ibn Salamah narrated to us, from ʿAlī ibn Zayd, and Yūnus, and Ḥumayd, from al-Ḥasan: that the Prophet ﷺ said: “The believer is the one whom the people trust,” and he mentioned the like of it.
items.ma-12699: Ghassān ibn Muḍar narrated to us, Saʿīd – meaning Ibn Yazīd – Abū Maslamah narrated to us, he said: I asked Anas: Did the Messenger of Allah ﷺ pray in sandals? He said: Yes.
items.ma-12908: Abū Nuʿaym narrated to us, Sufyān narrated to us, from al-Mukhtār ibn Fulful, from Anas, he said: A man said to the Prophet ﷺ: O best of creation. He said: “That is Ibrāhīm, my father.”
items.ma-12926: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān narrated to us, Ḥammād ibn Salamah narrated to us, from Thābit, from Anas: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ went round to his wives in a single night, with a single ghusl.
items.ma-13005: Bahz narrated to us, Ḥammād narrated to us, Qatādah narrated to us, from Anas: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ would pass by a date, and nothing prevented him from taking it except the fear that it might be ṣadaqah.
items.ma-13073: Yazīd narrated to us, Ḥumayd informed us, from Anas, he said: The prayer of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was of close measure, [and so was that of] Abū Bakr, until ʿUmar came, and he lengthened the morning prayer.
items.ma-13303: ʿAbd al-Wahhāb narrated to us, Saʿīd narrated to us, from Qatādah, from Anas ibn Mālik: that the people of Makkah asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ to show them a sign. He said: So he showed them the splitting of the moon twice.
items.ma-13417: Abū Qaṭan narrated to us, Hishām narrated to us, from Qatādah, from Anas: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to seek refuge from incapacity and cowardice, miserliness and laziness, old age, and the punishment of the grave.
items.ma-13533: Muʾammal narrated to us, Ḥammād narrated to us, Thābit narrated to us, from Anas, he said: The Prophet ﷺ would pass by a date, and nothing prevented him from taking it except the fear that it might be from the dates of ṣadaqah.
items.ma-13597: ʿAffān narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿAbd Allāh ibn Jabr, from Anas ibn Mālik, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ and a woman of his wives used to bathe from one vessel.
items.ma-13671: Ghassān ibn al-Rabīʿ narrated to us, Ḥammād narrated to us, from Thābit and Ḥumayd, from Anas, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “Paradise is surrounded by disliked things, and the Fire is surrounded by desires.”
items.ma-13915: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, from Qatādah, from Anas, he said: I prayed behind the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and behind Abū Bakr, ʿUmar and ʿUthmān, and they did not recite aloud “In the name of Allah, al-Raḥmān, al-Raḥīm”.
items.ma-13962:
Shabābah narrated to us, from Shuʿbah, from Qatādah, from Anas ibn Mālik: that ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn ʿAwf married on the weight of a date-stone.
He said: And al-Ḥakam used to adopt it.
items.ma-13987: ʿAffān narrated to us, Ḥammād ibn Salamah narrated to us, ʿĀṣim al-Aḥwal narrated to us, from Anas ibn Mālik, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ established an alliance between the Emigrants and the Anṣār in the house of Anas ibn Mālik.
items.ma-14082: Bahz narrated to us, Hammām narrated to us, from Qatādah, from Anas, that the Prophet ﷺ said: “No servant believes until he loves for his brother what he loves for himself of good.”
items.ma-14174: Ḥajjāj narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to me, from Qatādah, he said: I heard ʿAṭāʾ ibn Abī Rabāḥ narrating from Jābir ibn ʿAbd Allāh, from the Prophet ﷺ, that he said: “The ʿumrā is permissible.”
items.ma-14240: Yaḥyā ibn Saʿīd narrated to us, from Jarīr ibn Ḥāzim, he said: I heard ʿAṭāʾ, he said: Jābir narrated to us, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade that dates and ripening dates, and raisins and dates, be steeped.
items.ma-14303: Al-Ḥasan narrated it to us, Ibn Lahīʿah informed us, ʿAmr ibn Jābir al-Ḥaḍramī narrated to us, he said: I heard Jābir ibn ʿAbd Allāh say: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say, and he mentioned its meaning.
items.ma-14313: Sufyān narrated to us, from ʿAmr, I heard Jābir say: On the day of al-Ḥudaybiyah we were one thousand and four hundred, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to us: “Today you are the best of the people of the earth.”
items.ma-14347: Ḥasan ibn Mūsā narrated to us, Zuhayr narrated to us, from Abū al-Zubayr, from Jābir, he said: We went out with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ on a journey, and it rained on us. He said: “Let whoever of you wishes pray in his lodging.”
items.ma-14466: Abū al-Naḍr narrated to us, Zuhayr narrated to us, Abū al-Zubayr narrated to us, from Jābir, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade – or he forbade us – the sale of fruit until it becomes good.
items.ma-14469: Muḥammad ibn Bakr narrated to us, Ibn Jurayj informed us, he said: Abū al-Zubayr said, Jābir ibn ʿAbd Allāh said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Whoever prays in a single garment, let him wrap it around himself.”
items.ma-14688: Ḥasan narrated to us, Ibn Lahīʿah narrated to us, Abū al-Zubayr narrated to us, from Jābir, he said: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: “Whoever leaves a dīnār, it is a branding.”
items.ma-14768: Mūsā narrated to us, Ibn Lahīʿah narrated to us, from Abū al-Zubayr, from Jābir, that he heard the Prophet ﷺ say, while the bier of Saʿd ibn Muʿādh was before them: “The ʿArsh of al-Raḥmān shook for it.”
items.ma-14827: Yūnus narrated to us, Ḥammād ibn Zayd narrated to us, from Ayyūb, from Abū al-Zubayr, from Jābir: that the Prophet ﷺ prayed over al-Najāshī, and we formed two rows behind him.
items.ma-14841: Yūnus narrated to us, Ḥammād narrated to us, from Abū al-Zubayr, from Jābir, from the Prophet ﷺ: that he forbade muzābanah, muḥāqalah, mukhābarah, al-thunyā and al-muʿāwamah.
items.ma-14918: And Sulaymān ibn Mūsā said to him, while I was present: Did Jābir narrate to you that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Whoever has land, let him cultivate it, or let him have his brother cultivate it, and let him not rent it out”? ʿAṭāʾ said: Yes.
items.ma-15053: ʿAbd al-Aʿlā narrated to us, from Burd, from ʿAṭāʾ, from Jābir, he said: We used to go on expeditions with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and we would obtain some of the vessels of the polytheists and their waterskins, and make use of them, and we were not blamed for it.
items.ma-15060: Yazīd narrated to us, ʿAbd al-Malik informed us, from Abū al-Zubayr, from Jābir ibn ʿAbd Allāh, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade the gourd, the hollowed trunk, the pitch-coated vessel and the ḥantam.
items.ma-15111: Rawḥ narrated to us, Ibn Jurayj narrated to us, Abū al-Zubayr informed me, that he heard Jābir ibn ʿAbd Allāh say: The Prophet ﷺ said: “The people are followers of Quraysh in good and in evil.”
items.ma-15152: Ḥasan narrated to us, Ibn Lahīʿah narrated to us, Abū al-Zubayr narrated to us, from Jābir, that he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ sternly forbade that a woman attach anything to her head.
items.ma-15196: Aswad narrated to us, Sharīk narrated to us, from Salamah ibn Kuhayl, from ʿAṭāʾ, from Jābir: that a man made a slave of his a mudabbar, while he was in debt, and the Prophet ﷺ sold him for the debt of his master.
items.ma-15203: ʿAffān narrated to us, Abū ʿAwānah narrated to us, from al-Aswad ibn Qays, from Nubayḥ al-ʿAnazī, from Jābir ibn ʿAbd Allāh, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Let none of you come upon his family by night.”
items.ma-15205: ʿAffān narrated to us, Ḥammād narrated to us, from Abū al-Zubayr, from Jābir ibn ʿAbd Allāh, he said: I saw the Prophet pray in a single garment, having crossed its two ends.
items.ma-15219: ʿAbd al-Razzāq narrated to us, Sufyān informed us, from Abū al-Zubayr, from Jābir, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “When one of you is invited, let him respond; then if he wishes he eats, and if he wishes he leaves it.”
items.ma-15420: Ismāʿīl narrated to us, Ayyūb narrated to us, he said: I heard a man of ours narrating from his father, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ sent out a detachment in which I was, and he forbade us to kill the ʿusafāʾ and the wuṣafāʾ.
items.ma-15518: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Ibn Abī Khālid narrated to us, from Qays ibn Abī Ḥāzim, from his father, he said: The Prophet ﷺ saw me while he was delivering the khuṭbah, and he gave a command concerning me, and I was moved to the shade.
items.ma-15876: Yazīd ibn Hārūn narrated to us in Baghdad, Abū Mālik al-Ashjaʿī Saʿd ibn Ṭāriq informed us, from his father, that he heard the Prophet ﷺ say: “Sufficient for my Companions is the killing.”
items.ma-16170: Muḥammad ibn Jaʿfar narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, from al-Nuʿmān ibn Sālim, from Ibn Abī Aws, from his grandfather, he said: I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ perform wuḍūʾ and istawkafa three times – that is, he washed his palms.
items.ma-16334: Sufyān narrated to us, from Hishām ibn ʿUrwah, from his father, from ʿUmar ibn Abī Salamah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to me: “Mention the name of Allah, eat with your right hand, and eat from what is nearest to you.”
items.ma-16434: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān narrated to us, he said: Sufyān narrated to us, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Abī Bakr, from ʿAbbād ibn Tamīm, from his paternal uncle: that the Prophet ﷺ asked for rain and turned his cloak around.
items.ma-17385: Muḥammad ibn Jaʿfar narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, from Qatādah, from al-Ḥasan, from ʿUqbah ibn ʿĀmir al-Juhanī, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “The ʿuhdah of the slave is three days.”
items.ma-17463: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān narrated to us, Saʿīd ibn ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz narrated to us, from Makḥūl, from Zayd ibn Jāriyah, from Ḥabīb ibn Maslamah, he said: I witnessed the Prophet ﷺ grant the third as additional spoils.
items.ma-17994: Wakīʿ narrated to us, ʿAbd al-Ḥamīd ibn Bahrām narrated to us, from Shahr ibn Ḥawshab, from Ibn Ghanm: that the Prophet ﷺ said to Abū Bakr and ʿUmar: “If the two of you were to agree upon a counsel, I would not oppose you.”
items.ma-18088: Muḥammad ibn Jaʿfar narrated to us, Saʿīd narrated to us, and he mentioned the ḥadīth. And he said: Maṭar said: “And neither ṣarf nor ʿadl will be accepted from him.”
items.ma-18239: Wakīʿ narrated to us, from Yūnus ibn Abī Isḥāq, from al-Shaʿbī, from ʿUrwah ibn al-Mughīrah, from his father: that the Prophet ﷺ wore a Roman jubbah with narrow sleeves.
items.ma-18305: Wakīʿ narrated to us, he said: Ibn Abī Khālid narrated to us, from Qays ibn Abī Ḥāzim, from his father, he said: The Prophet ﷺ saw me while he was delivering the khuṭbah and I was in the sun, and he gave a command concerning me, and I was moved to the shade.
items.ma-18623: ʿAbd al-Razzāq narrated to us, Maʿmar narrated to us, from ʿĀṣim, from al-Shaʿbī, from al-Barāʾ ibn ʿĀzib, he said: On the day of Khaybar the Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade us the meat of domestic donkeys, cooked and raw.
items.ma-18662: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Isrāʾīl narrated to us, from Abū Isḥāq, from al-Barāʾ, he said: I saw the Prophet ﷺ on the day of al-Khandaq carrying earth, and the earth had covered the hair of his chest.
items.ma-18690: ʿAffān narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, ʿAdī ibn Thābit informed us, he said: I heard al-Barāʾ say: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say to Ḥassān: “Satirize them – or: Counter-satirize them – and Jibrīl is with you.”
items.ma-18741: Muḥammad ibn Bishr narrated to us, ʿAbd al-Jabbār ibn ʿAbbās narrated to me, from ʿAdī ibn Thābit, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Yazīd al-Khaṭmī, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Every act of kindness is ṣadaqah.”
items.ma-18755: Abū Aḥmad narrated to us, Isrāʾīl narrated to us, from Abū Isḥāq, from Wahb al-Suwāʾī: that he prayed with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ at al-Abṭaḥ the ʿAṣr, two rakʿahs.
items.ma-18817: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān narrated to us, from Sufyān, from Manṣūr, from Hilāl ibn Yisāf, from Salamah ibn Qays, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “When you perform wuḍūʾ, snort water out; and when you perform istijmār, make it odd.”
items.ma-18881: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān narrated to us, Ziyād Abū ʿUmar narrated to us, from al-Ḥasan, from ʿAmmār ibn Yāsir, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “The likeness of my ummah is the likeness of the rain; it is not known whether its first is better or its last.”
items.ma-19125: Hushaym narrated to us, Ismāʿīl ibn Abī Khālid informed us, he said: I said to ʿAbd Allāh ibn Abī Awfā, a Companion of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ: Did the Prophet ﷺ enter the House during his ʿumrah? He said: No.
items.ma-19154: Muḥammad ibn Jaʿfar narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, from Jābir, he said: A man narrated to me, from Ṭāriq al-Tamīmī, from Jarīr, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ passed by some women, and greeted them with salām.
items.ma-19521: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Usāmah ibn Zayd narrated to us, Saʿīd ibn Abī Hind narrated to us, from Abū Mūsā, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Whoever plays nard has disobeyed Allah and His Messenger.”
items.ma-19674: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Burayd ibn Abī Burdah narrated to me, from his father, from his grandfather, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “When one of you passes by with arrows in the mosque, let him hold their arrowheads.”
items.ma-20210: Ḥasan ibn Mūsā narrated to us, Shaybān narrated to us, from ʿAbd al-Malik, from Ḥuṣayn ibn Qabīṣah al-Fazārī, from Samurah ibn Jundub, he said: A Bedouin asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and he mentioned the like of it.
items.ma-20236:
ʿAffān narrated to us, Ḥammād ibn Zayd narrated to us, Ayyūb narrated to us, from Abū Qilābah, he said: Samurah said, and he mentioned it.
And he – meaning ʿAffān – also mentioned from Wuhayb, without Abū al-Muhallab in it.
items.ma-20388: Hushaym narrated to us, from ʿUyaynah ibn ʿAbd al-Raḥmān, from his father, from Abū Bakrah, he said: I saw us with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and indeed we used to move at a quick jog with the bier.
items.ma-20456: Aḥmad ibn ʿAbd al-Malik narrated to us, Bakkār narrated to us, he said: My father narrated to me, from Abū Bakrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Whoever makes [it] heard, Yusammiʿ Allāh bihi; and whoever makes a show, Yurāʾī Allāh bihi.”
items.ma-20478: Yazīd ibn Hārūn narrated to us, Mubārak ibn Faḍālah narrated to us, from al-Ḥasan, from Abū Bakrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “No people will succeed whom a woman rules over.”
items.ma-20606: Ismāʿīl narrated to us, from al-Taymī, from Abū ʿUthmān, from Qabīṣah ibn Mukhāriq and Zuhayr ibn ʿAmr, they both said: When {And warn your nearest clan} was revealed, he mentioned the like of it.
items.ma-20722: Hushaym narrated to us, Khālid informed us, from Abū al-Malīḥ, from Nubayshah al-Hudhalī, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “The days of Tashrīq are days of eating, drinking and remembrance of Allah.”
items.ma-20839: Bahz narrated to us, Ḥammād ibn Salamah narrated to us, from Simāk, he said: I heard Jābir ibn Samurah say: I heard the Prophet ﷺ say: “Before the Hour there will be liars.”
items.ma-21049: Muḥammad ibn Jaʿfar narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, from Simāk ibn Ḥarb, he said: I heard Jābir ibn Samurah say: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: “Indeed Allah named al-Madīnah Ṭābah.”
items.ma-21192: ʿAbd Allāh said: And ʿUthmān ibn Abī Shaybah narrated it to us, Ibn Idrīs narrated to us with his isnād, from the Prophet ﷺ, like it. And he added in it: It has no rays.
items.ma-21246: He said: And I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: “Were it not for the Hijrah, I would be a man of the Anṣār; and if the people took a valley – or a mountain pass – I would be with the Anṣār.”
items.ma-21259:
And the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “When it is the Day of Resurrection, I will be the imām of the Prophets, and their speaker, and the possessor of their intercession, without boasting.”
And the ḥadīth is in the wording of Zakariyyā ibn ʿAdī.
items.ma-21407: Wakīʿ narrated to us, from Abū Hilāl, from Bakr, from Abū Dharr, that the Prophet ﷺ said to him: “Look, for you are not better than a red or a black [person], unless you excel him in taqwā.”
items.ma-21791: Zayd ibn al-Ḥubāb narrated to us, Thābit ibn Qays informed me, from Abū Saʿīd al-Maqburī, from Usāmah: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to fast on Monday and Thursday.
items.ma-21847: Muḥammad ibn Fuḍayl narrated to us, from Ibn Shubrumah, from Abū Maʿshar, from al-Ashʿath ibn Qays, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Whoever does not thank the people does not thank Allah.”
items.ma-22139: ʿAbd Allāh narrated to us, Hudbah ibn Khālid narrated to us, Hammām ibn Yaḥyā and Ḥammād ibn al-Jaʿd narrated to us, from Qatādah, from Ayman, from Abū Umāmah, from the Prophet ﷺ, like it or similar to it.
items.ma-22184: Ḥajjāj narrated to us, Ḥarīz informed us, Sulaym ibn ʿĀmir narrated to me, from Abū Ghālib, from Abū Umāmah, he said: There was never any barley bread left over for the household of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ.
items.ma-22356: Abū Nuʿaym narrated to us: from ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿUtbah, he said: “So they peeled you.” And likewise Abū Aḥmad said, and he said: “So they peeled you.” Abū Nuʿaym said: “As the twig is peeled.”
items.ma-22548: ʿAbd Allāh narrated to us, Ibrāhīm narrated to me, Ḥammād narrated to us, from Ḥumayd, from Bakr ibn ʿAbd Allāh, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Rabāḥ, from Abū Qatādah, from the Prophet ﷺ, like it.
items.ma-22964: Yaḥyā ibn Saʿīd narrated to us, from al-Muthannā ibn Saʿīd, from Qatādah, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Buraydah, from his father, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “Indeed the believer dies with sweat on the forehead.”
items.ma-23379: Muḥammad ibn Jaʿfar narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, he said: I heard Abū Mālik – meaning al-Ashjaʿī – narrating from Ribʿī, from Ḥudhayfah, from the Prophet ﷺ that he said: “Every act of kindness is ṣadaqah.”
items.ma-23572: Bahz narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, ʿAdī ibn Thābit narrated to us, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Yazīd, from Abū Ayyūb al-Anṣārī, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ combined the Maghrib and the ʿIshāʾ at Jamʿ.
items.ma-23834: Yazīd narrated to us, Sallām ibn Miskīn narrated to us, Shahr ibn Ḥawshab narrated to us, from Muḥammad ibn Yūsuf ibn ʿAbd Allāh ibn Salām, and he mentioned the ḥadīth of the neighbour.
items.ma-23913: ʿAlī ibn ʿĀṣim narrated to us, from Abū Zayd ʿAṭāʾ ibn al-Sāʾib, from ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Abī Laylā, from Bilāl, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ commanded me not to make tathwīb except in the Fajr.
items.ma-24017: Hushaym narrated to us, from Abū Ḥarrah, from al-Ḥasan, from Saʿd ibn Hishām, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ stood to pray at night, he would begin his prayer with two light rakʿahs.
items.ma-24025: Muʿtamir narrated to us, he said: I heard Khālid, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Shaqīq, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: I never saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ pray the Ḍuḥā, except that he would arrive from a journey, and then pray two rakʿahs.
items.ma-24097: Sufyān narrated to us, from al-Zuhrī, from ʿUrwah, from ʿĀʾishah: The Prophet ﷺ heard the recitation of Abū Mūsā, and said: “This man has indeed been given [something] of the mazāmīr of the family of Dāwūd.”
items.ma-24118: Sufyān narrated to us, from Hishām, from his father, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: The Prophet ﷺ raced me and I beat him; then we stayed for a while until, when the flesh overtook me, he raced me and beat me. He said: “This is for that.”
items.ma-24208: Abū Muʿāwiyah narrated to us, al-Aʿmash narrated to us, from Muslim ibn Ṣubayḥ, from Masrūq, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ gave us a choice, and we chose him, and he did not count it against us as anything.
items.ma-24234: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from Hishām, he said: My father narrated to me, from ʿĀʾishah that the Prophet ﷺ used to perform ruqyah, saying: “Wipe away the harm, Rabb of the people; in Your Yad is the cure; none removes the distress except You.”
items.ma-24240: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from Sufyān, from Abū Isḥāq, from Abū Maysarah, from ʿĀʾishah: They slaughtered a sheep. I said: O Messenger of Allah, nothing remains of it except its shoulder. He said: “All of it remains except its shoulder.”
items.ma-24244: Yaḥyā narrated to us, Hishām narrated to us, my father informed me, from ʿĀʾishah, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “Let none of you say: My soul has become foul; but let him say: My soul has become churned.”
items.ma-24255: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from Hishām, he said: My father informed me, from ʿĀʾishah that the Prophet ﷺ used to command the killing of the one with the two stripes, saying: “Indeed it strikes the pregnancy and seeks out the sight.”
items.ma-24343: Wakīʿ narrated to us, he said: Ibn Jurayj narrated to us, from Ibn Abī Mulaykah, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Indeed the most hated of men to Allah is the most obstinate in dispute, the quarrelsome.”
items.ma-24456: Ḥusayn ibn Muḥammad narrated to us, he said: al-Mubārak narrated to me, from his mother, from Muʿādhah, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ prayed four rakʿahs of Ḍuḥā in my house.
items.ma-24645: ʿAffān narrated to us, he said: Wuhayb narrated to us, he said: Hishām ibn ʿUrwah narrated to us, from his father, from ʿĀʾishah that she said: By Allah, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ never left the two rakʿahs after the ʿAṣr with me.
items.ma-25069: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Hishām narrated to us, from his father, from ʿĀʾishah: The Prophet ﷺ heard a man reciting a verse, and he said: “﵀, he has indeed reminded me of a verse that I had been made to forget.”
items.ma-25074: Wakīʿ narrated to us, from al-Aʿmash, from Shimr, from Yaḥyā ibn Wathhāb, from ʿĀʾishah: that she rode a camel and cursed it, and the Prophet ﷺ said to her: “Do not ride it.”
items.ma-25076: Wakīʿ narrated to us, from Ismāʿīl, from Muṣʿab ibn Isḥāq ibn Ṭalḥah, from ʿĀʾishah, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “Indeed it makes [it] easy for me that I saw the whiteness of the palm of ʿĀʾishah in Paradise.”
items.ma-25266: Abū Aḥmad al-Zubayrī narrated to us, Muḥammad ibn Sharīk narrated to us, from Ibn Abī Mulaykah, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: The Prophet ﷺ passed away in my house, and on my night.
items.ma-25293: Yaḥyā ibn Zakariyyā narrated to us, ʿAmr ibn Maymūn ibn Mihrān informed us, from Sulaymān ibn Yasār, from ʿĀʾishah: that she used to wash the semen from the garment of the Prophet ﷺ.
items.ma-25531: Wakīʿ narrated to us, from Hishām, from a man of the descendants of al-Zubayr, from ʿĀʾishah that she said: O Messenger of Allah, every one of your wives has a kunyah except me? He said: “You are Umm ʿAbd Allāh.”
items.ma-25676: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from Ibn Jurayj, from Ibn Abī Mulaykah, from ʿĀʾishah, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “No thorn afflicts the believer, nor anything above it – she means – except that it is a kaffārah for him.”
items.ma-25715: Wakīʿ narrated to us, from Hishām, from his father, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ never struck a servant or a woman, and he did not strike anything with his hand, except when striving in the way of Allah.
items.ma-25800: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Mahdī narrated to us, he said: Sufyān narrated to us, from Abū al-Zinād, from ʿAlī ibn Ḥusayn, from ʿĀʾishah that the Prophet ﷺ used to kiss while he was fasting.
items.ma-25847: Isḥāq narrated to us, he said: Sharīk informed us, from Ziyād ibn ʿIlāqah, from ʿAmr ibn Maymūn, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to kiss while he was fasting.
items.ma-25934: Ibn Numayr narrated to us, from al-Aʿmash, from Ibrāhīm, he said: al-Aswad narrated to me, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ pledged a coat of mail to a Jewish man, and took food from him.
items.ma-25960: Muḥammad ibn Bishr narrated to us, he said: Hishām ibn ʿUrwah narrated to us, from his father, from ʿĀʾishah, that the Abyssinians played for the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and he called me, and I looked from above his shoulder until I had my fill.
items.ma-25982: Yazīd narrated to us, he said: Yaḥyā informed us, from ʿAmrah, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: If the Messenger of Allah ﷺ had seen what the women have newly introduced, he would have prevented them from the mosque, as the women of the Children of Israel were prevented.
items.ma-25999: Yazīd narrated to us, he said: Ibn Abī Dhiʾb informed us, from Makhlad ibn Khufāf, from ʿUrwah, from ʿĀʾishah, that the Prophet ﷺ ruled that the kharāj is by ḍamān.
items.ma-26064: [ʿAbd Allāh ibn Aḥmad said]: ʿAbd al-Aʿlā ibn Ḥammād narrated to us, he said: I read to Mālik ibn Anas, from Abū al-Aswad, from ʿUrwah, from ʿĀʾishah: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ performed Ḥajj ifrād.
items.ma-26149: Muḥammad ibn Bakr narrated to us, he said: Saʿīd, from Qatādah, from Saʿīd ibn al-Musayyib, from ʿĀʾishah, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “May Allah curse peoples who took the graves of their prophets as mosques.”
items.ma-26159: Yaḥyā ibn Ādam narrated to us, Sufyān narrated to us, from al-Aʿmash, from Ibrāhīm, from al-Aswad, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to pray nine rakʿahs at night.
items.ma-26201: Abū al-Qāsim ibn Abī al-Zinād narrated to us, he said: Aflaḥ informed me, from al-Qāsim, from ʿĀʾishah: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ had relations with his wife, then in the morning he bathed, prayed, and fasted that day of his.
items.ma-26238: Muḥammad ibn Rabīʿah narrated to us, from ʿUbayd Allāh ibn Abī Ziyād, from al-Qāsim ibn Muḥammad, from ʿĀʾishah, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ entered in the year of the Conquest by way of Thaniyyat al-Adhkhir.
items.ma-26431: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Mahdī narrated to us, from Mālik, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, he said: Ḥafṣah informed me that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to pray two light rakʿahs when the dawn appeared.
items.ma-26585: Muḥammad ibn Yazīd narrated to us, from al-Qāsim ibn al-Faḍl, from Abū Jaʿfar, from Umm Salamah, she said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Ḥajj is the jihād of every weak person.”
items.ma-26844: Wakīʿ narrated to us, he said: Jaʿfar ibn Burqān narrated to us, from Yazīd ibn al-Aṣamm, from Maymūnah, she said: When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ prostrated, he would hold [his arms] apart until the one behind him would see the whiteness of his armpits.
items.ma-27012: Muḥammad ibn Jaʿfar narrated to us, he said: Shuʿbah narrated to us, from Manṣūr, from Ribʿī ibn Ḥirāsh, from his wife, from the sister of Khudhayfah, she said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ delivered a khuṭbah to us, and he mentioned the like of it.
items.ma-27049: Aswad ibn ʿĀmir narrated to us, he said: Sharīk narrated to us, from al-Aʿmash, from Jāmiʿ ibn Shaddād, from Kulthūm, from Zaynab, that the Prophet ﷺ made the women heirs to their plots of land.
items.ma-27119: ʿAffān narrated to us, Wuhayb narrated to us, he said: Ayyūb narrated to us, from Abū Qilābah, from Anas ibn Mālik, from Umm Sulaym: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to pray on the small mat.
items.ma-27382: Abū Muʿāwiyah narrated to us, Misʿar narrated to us, from Abū al-ʿAlāʾ al-ʿAbdī, from Ibn Jaʿdah ibn Hubayrah, from Umm Hāniʾ, she said: I used to hear the recitation of the Prophet ﷺ while I was on my ʿarīsh.
items.ma-27443: Sufyān narrated to us, from ʿUbayd Allāh, from his father, from Umm Ayyūb, she said: Indeed the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “The Qurʾān was revealed in seven aḥruf; whichever of them you recite, it suffices you.”
